articles.title: Nostalgic Board Game ‘Guess Who?’ Drops NFL Edition Featuring Travis Kelce: Buy It Here
articles.author: Tim Chan

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: Just in time for the start of the 2026-27 NFL season, Hasbro has re-stocked its football-themed edition of the popular Guess Who? board game.
paras.zh: 恰逢 2026-27 NFL 赛季开始，孩之宝重新补货了流行的猜猜谁？棋盘游戏。

paras.en: Just like the beloved original, players work to identify the characters — or in this case, the football players — on their opponent’s board and race to be the first one to close all their tabs once they guess correctly.
paras.zh: 就像深受喜爱的原作一样，玩家要努力识别对手棋盘上的角色（或者在本例中为足球运动员），并在猜对后竞相成为第一个关闭所有选项卡的人。

paras.en: The NFL-edition of “Guess Who?” features players from all 32 teams in the league, including superstars like Travis Kelce, Patrick Mahomes, Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts. This is an officially-licensed release from the NFL and Hasbro.
paras.zh: NFL 版“猜猜谁？”拥有来自联盟所有 32 支球队的球员，包括 Travis Kelce、Patrick Mahomes、Josh Allen、Lamar Jackson 和 Jalen Hurts 等超级巨星。这是 NFL 和 Hasbro 官方授权的版本。

paras.en: While the recently-married Kelce is perhaps the most famous face in the pack, there are 48 athletes in total to guess from — 24 from the AFC and 24 from the NFC, though they’re randomly divided between the two boards. Each square has a photo of the football player in their team jersey, along with their position.
paras.zh: 虽然最近结婚的凯尔斯可能是这群人中最著名的面孔，但总共有 48 名运动员可供猜测——其中 24 名来自 AFC，24 名来自 NFC，尽管他们是随机分配在两个委员会之间的。每个方块都有一张穿着球队球衣的足球运动员的照片以及他们的位置。

paras.en: Just like the original Guess Who? game, players can only ask “yes” or “no” questions to try to figure out the mystery NFL star’s identity (hint: start by asking about their team conference or division, then jersey color or playing position).
paras.zh: 就像原来的猜猜谁？游戏中，玩家只能问“是”或“否”问题来尝试找出神秘 NFL 球星的身份（提示：首先询问他们的球队联盟或分区，然后询问球衣颜色或比赛位置）。

paras.en: What we like: the two sides fold out for game-play but then snap together into a single case for easy storage.
paras.zh: 我们喜欢的是：两侧可折叠起来以供玩游戏，但随后可卡入一个盒子中以方便存放。

paras.en: Suitable for kids ages six and up (though really it’s great for all ages), this Guess Who? edition is a great gift idea for sports fans and makes for a fun family game night activity too.
paras.zh: 适合六岁及以上的孩子（虽然真的适合所有年龄段），这个猜猜是谁？版本是送给体育迷的绝佳礼物，也可作为有趣的家庭游戏之夜活动。

paras.en: Hasbro has another fun release for the new football season: a series of Bop It! games featuring the likes of Allen, Mahomes, Justin Jefferson, Saquon Barkley and more.
paras.zh: 孩之宝为新足球赛季推出了另一个有趣的产品：一系列 Bop It!艾伦、马霍姆斯、贾斯汀·杰斐逊、萨昆·巴克利等人的比赛。

paras.en: Hasbro Gaming Bop It! Josh Allen Edition Game
paras.zh: 孩之宝游戏 Bop It！乔什·艾伦版游戏

paras.en: While the original Bop It! involved a wheel-style contraption that players raced to twist, push, pull and spin, the NFL version challenges players to “bop” the football star’s chest, twist his arm with the ball, or pull on his foot, all in random sequences.
paras.zh: 而原来的 Bop It! NFL 版本要求玩家用随机的顺序“击打”橄榄球明星的胸部、用球扭转他的手臂或拉动他的脚，其中包括一个轮式装置，玩家可以竞相扭转、推、拉和旋转。

paras.en: The commands are shouted out by a sports announcer-style voice through the device’s built-in speakers. This is a fun coordination and reaction game for the whole family. When not in use, the figurines stand about seven inches tall and make for a great desktop collectible or shelf display piece.
paras.zh: 这些命令是通过设备的内置扬声器以体育播音员风格的声音喊出的。这是一款适合全家人一起玩的有趣的协调和反应游戏。不使用时，这些雕像高约七英寸，可作为绝佳的桌面收藏品或架子展示品。

paras.en: The NFL Bop It! game requires two AAA batteries (not included). I’ve kept mine in the office for when I need a little break from work or need to re-focus. The figurines make a great gift idea too.
paras.zh: NFL 击球吧！游戏需要两节 AAA 电池（不包含在供货范围内）。当我需要从工作中休息一下或需要重新集中注意力时，我就把它放在办公室里。这些小雕像也是一个很棒的礼物创意。

paras.en: The NFL season began on Sept. 9, 2026. The Seattle Seahawks are the reigning Super Bowl champions after defeated the New England Patriots in last year’s championship game.
paras.zh: NFL 赛季于 2026 年 9 月 9 日开始。西雅图海鹰队在去年的冠军赛中击败新英格兰爱国者队，成为超级碗卫冕冠军。

articles.title: Dakota Johnson & Turnstile on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: On Saturday (Oct. 3), Saturday Night Live returns with the second episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps Verity and Fifty Shades of Grey actress Dakota Johnson to host, while Baltimore hardcore punk band Turnstile serves as musical guest.
paras.zh: 周六（10 月 3 日），《周六夜现场》携第 52 季第二集回归。这部喜剧小品节目由《Verity》和《五十度灰》女演员达科塔·约翰逊 (Dakota Johnson) 主持，巴尔的摩硬核朋克乐队 Turnstile 担任音乐嘉宾。

paras.en: This is Dakota Johnson’s second time hosting, while Turnstile is making its SNL debut.
paras.zh: 这是达科塔·约翰逊第二次主持，而 Turnstile 则是《周六夜现场》的首次亮相。

paras.en: How to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Live Online, at a Glance:
paras.zh: 如何在线观看“周六夜现场”直播，概览：

paras.en: SNL airs live on Saturday (Oct. 3), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.
paras.zh: SNL 于周六（10 月 3 日）直播，开始时间为晚上 11:30。 ET/PT。

paras.en: What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?
paras.zh: 哪个电视网络有“周六夜现场”？

paras.en: In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the variety sketch show is available to livestream on Peacock.
paras.zh: 2026 年，SNL 在 NBC 电视上播出。同时，综艺小品秀也可在孔雀直播。

paras.en: Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?
paras.zh: 今晚谁出现在“周六夜现场”？

paras.en: SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Since Dakota Johnson is hosting, it’s likely that Anne Hathaway and Josh Hartnett might appear.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》以名人在节目中客串而闻名，因此很可能会有许多著名男女演员和唱片艺术家出席。由于达科塔·约翰逊担任主持人，安妮·海瑟薇和乔什·哈奈特很可能会出现。

paras.en: Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past, include Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Mariska Hargitay, Meryl Streep, Harry Styles and others.
paras.zh: 其他已知曾出现在《周六夜现场》的艺术家包括蒂莫西·柴勒梅德、本·斯蒂勒、亚历克·鲍德温、玛莉丝卡·哈吉塔、梅丽尔·斯特里普、哈里·斯泰尔斯等。

paras.en: Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看“周六夜现场”

paras.en: For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch SNL online, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial, while other streaming services, like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV, also offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
paras.zh: 对于掐线者来说，如果您没有有线电视，特别是如果您想免费观看，可以通过多种方式在线观看 SNL。 DirecTV 有五天免费试用期，而 Fubo 和 Hulu + Live TV 等其他流媒体服务也提供免费试用，因此您可以免费观看。

paras.en: Sling TV offers the Blue plan, which comes with NBC. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month. All plans come with a free cloud DVR and an extra 600 or so free channels too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.
paras.zh: Sling TV 提供 Blue 套餐，该套餐随 NBC 一起提供。流媒体套餐拥有 40 多个频道，每月价格为 54.99 美元。所有套餐都附带免费的云 DVR 和额外的 600 个左右的免费频道。请注意：定价和渠道可用性因市场而异。

paras.en: Broadcast and cable networks NBC is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV. Prices for the cable alternative start at $49.99 for the first month ($89.99 per month afterward) for more than 100 live channels, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package.
paras.zh: 广播和有线网络 NBC 可通过 Hulu + Live TV 观看。有线替代方案的价格从第一个月 49.99 美元起（之后每月 89.99 美元），可观看 100 多个直播频道，而每个套餐都附带 Hulu、Disney+ 和 ESPN Unlimited，无需额外付费。对于那些希望将所有这些流媒体服务集中在一个包中的人来说，Hulu + 直播电视可能是最好的选择。

paras.en: There are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $12.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $19.99 per month. If you’re looking to save, you can get 17% off when you do the annual plan for $129.99 per year or $199.99 per year, respectively. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.
paras.zh: Peacock 提供两种不同的计划：高级计划（每月 12.99 美元）或高级计划（每月 19.99 美元）。如果您想省钱，那么当您选择年度套餐时，可以享受 17% 的折扣，价格分别为每年 129.99 美元或每年 199.99 美元。高级套餐支持广告，您可以观看各种电影、电视节目、原创节目、NBC Sports 的体育直播和 NBC News 的直播新闻。

paras.en: Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan, no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.
paras.zh: Peacock 的 Premium Plus 套餐包含 Premium 套餐中的所有内容，无广告、本地 NBC 频道直播以及离线下载和流式传输的功能。

paras.en: On Saturday (Oct. 3), SNL with host Dakota Johnson and musical guest Turnstile broadcasts live on NBC. One of the best ways to watch is with DirecTV.
paras.zh: 周六（10 月 3 日），SNL 与主持人达科塔·约翰逊 (Dakota Johnson) 和音乐嘉宾 Turnstile 在 NBC 进行现场直播。最好的观看方式之一是使用 DirecTV。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Makes Surprise ‘SNL’ Cameo in Dakota Johnson’s Monologue
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance on Saturday Night Live this weekend, crashing host Dakota Johnson’s opening monologue.
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特本周末出人意料地出现在《周六夜现场》中，打破了主持人达科塔·约翰逊的开场独白。

paras.en: Johnson, hosting for the third time on the eve of her birthday (Oct. 4), spent much of the monologue joking about her history of dating musicians, saying she has supportive friends who “don’t judge me for dating these men.”
paras.zh: 约翰逊在生日前夕（10 月 4 日）第三次主持节目，在独白中大部分时间都在开玩笑地谈论她与音乐家约会的历史，并表示她有支持她的朋友，他们“不会因为我和这些男人约会而评判我”。

paras.en: She then introduced “my literal therapist” — cuing Swift, who walked on to correct her. “I’m not your therapist, actually,” Swift said.
paras.zh: 然后她介绍了“我的文字治疗师”——暗示斯威夫特，后者走上前纠正了她。 “实际上，我不是你的治疗师，”斯威夫特说。

paras.en: “You just show up once a week at my house with an empty bottle of wine and ask if I want some.” She continued: “You flop on my couch and overshare, and every so often I just say, ‘Damn, that’s crazy.'” The bit ended with Swift noting she sends Johnson home with “a Pedialyte” and a security escort.
paras.zh: “你每周只需要带着一瓶空酒来我家一次，问我是否想要一些。”她继续说道：“你在我的沙发上摔倒，过度分享，我时常只是说，‘该死，这太疯狂了。’”在这段视频的结尾，斯威夫特指出，她送约翰逊回家，带着“一名儿童电解液”和一名保安护送。

paras.en: The monologue also worked in a nod to Swift’s husband, Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce, as Johnson referenced “England and parts of Ireland and Cleveland” among the places tied to her romantic misadventures — a wink at Kelce’s Cleveland-area roots — prompting a “Woo-woo!” from Swift.
paras.zh: 这段独白也向斯威夫特的丈夫、堪萨斯城酋长队球星特拉维斯·凯尔斯致敬，约翰逊在与她的浪漫不幸经历有关的地方中提到了“英格兰、爱尔兰和克利夫兰的部分地区”——对凯尔斯的克利夫兰地区根源眨了眨眼——引发了“呜呜！”来自斯威夫特。

paras.en: The cameo reunited the pair weeks after they appeared together in the video for “Patient Zero,” the single from Swift’s The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore that she directed and co-starred in. The clip, which premiered at the MTV Video Music Awards, stars Johnson and Colin Farrell as a wealthy couple whose marriage is unraveling, with Swift appearing as a spectral figure. Earlier Saturday, Swift released an expanded eight-minute version of the “Patient Zero” video exclusively on Apple Music.
paras.zh: 几周后，两人在《零号病人》的视频中再次客串，这是斯威夫特执导并联合主演的《歌舞女郎的一生：安可》中的单曲。这段视频在 MTV 音乐录影带大奖上首映，约翰逊和科林·法雷尔饰演一对婚姻破裂的富有夫妇，斯威夫特则以幽灵般的形象出现。周六早些时候，斯威夫特在 Apple Music 上独家发布了“零号病人”视频的八分钟扩展版本。

paras.en: It marked Swift’s first SNL appearance since October 2023, when she introduced musical guest Ice Spice; she has a long history with the show, having hosted in 2009 and appeared as musical guest multiple times.
paras.zh: 这是斯威夫特自 2023 年 10 月以来首次亮相《周六夜现场》，当时她介绍了音乐嘉宾 Ice Spice；她在该节目中有着悠久的历史，曾于 2009 年担任主持人，并多次作为音乐嘉宾出现。

paras.en: The cameo caps a busy stretch for Swift, who released The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore — an expanded edition of her chart-topping 2025 album with four new tracks — on Sept. 25.
paras.zh: 这次客串为斯威夫特忙碌的一段时光画上句号，她于 9 月 25 日发行了《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》——这是她 2025 年排行榜冠军专辑的扩展版，其中包含四首新曲目。

paras.en: Describing the genesis of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore in an Instagram post, Swift said, “About a year ago, you guys did a truly unfathomable thing. Something that completely blew my mind… You gave The Life of a Showgirl the biggest first week for an album in history,” of the LP that debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 thanks to a record-smashing 4.002 million album-equivalent units moved.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特在 Instagram 帖子中描述《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》的起源时说道，“大约一年前，你们做了一件真正深不可测的事情。这件事完全让我大吃一惊……你们为《The Life of a Showgirl》带来了历史上最伟大的首周专辑”，这张唱片凭借创纪录的 400.2 万专辑当量销量在 Billboard 200 上排名第一。

articles.title: Jeremy Strong Says He Doesn’t “Need to Apologize” for Method Acting: “It’s in Service of the Material”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Jeremy Strong says it’s “never my intention to interfere” with the people he works with when method acting, but he doesn’t believe he “need[s] to apologize” for his approach.
paras.zh: 杰里米·斯特朗表示，在方法表演时，“我从来没有打算干涉”与他一起工作的人，但他认为自己“不需要为自己的做法道歉”。

paras.en: The Succession actor is a known method actor, which he has led to criticism from his peers in the past. When speaking with David Remnick for The New Yorker Radio Hour podcast, the host asked Strong if he feels his tendency to do research on his characters and bring that knowledge into his performance is “appreciated by the people around you.” Remnick specifically cited his Oscar-nominated turn in The Apprentice, where he added a scene to the film that wasn’t in the original script.
paras.zh: 《继承》演员是一位众所周知的方法演员，他过去曾因此而受到同行的批评。在《纽约客广播一小时》播客节目中与大卫·雷姆尼克交谈时，主持人问斯特朗，他是否认为自己对角色进行研究并将这些知识带入表演中的倾向“受到周围人的赞赏”。雷姆尼克特别提到了他在《学徒》中获得奥斯卡提名的表演，他在电影中添加了原剧本中没有的场景。

paras.en: “I think I can’t really speak to that,” the actor said. “Of course, some people seem to have been… it is never my intention to interfere with anyone else’s experience or anyone else’s way of working. First, do no harm, right? But commit to fucking what you’re doing, and utterly.”
paras.zh: “我想我真的不能谈论这个，”演员说。 “当然，有些人似乎……我从来没有打算干涉别人的经历或别人的工作方式。首先，不要造成伤害，对吧？但要致力于他妈的你正在做的事情，而且要彻底。”

paras.en: He was then asked if he gets frustrated by others who are not at the same level of commitment, to which Strong responded, “No, just meaning that I’m just there to commit utterly to serving the material.”
paras.zh: 然后他被问到是否会因为其他人没有达到同样的承诺水平而感到沮丧，斯特朗回答说：“不，只是意味着我只是完全致力于为材料提供服务。”

paras.en: “So, if some people feel that I’m taking it too seriously, or it changes the molecules in the room in a way that makes something uncomfortable, I guess that’s something that I don’t feel that I need to apologize for,” he said. “Because I believe, and I think the directors that I work with all believe, that it’s in service of the material, and I personally think that a lot of the reactions to it are of a personal nature.”
paras.zh: “所以，如果有人觉得我把这件事看得太认真了，或者它改变了房间里的分子，让某些东西变得不舒服，我想我觉得我不需要为此道歉，”他说。 “因为我相信，而且我认为与我合作的导演都相信，它是为材料服务的，而且我个人认为，对它的很多反应都是个人性质的。”

paras.en: Strong will next star in Aaron Sorkin‘s The Social Reckoning as Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg. The director recently told The New York Times that Strong treated his co-stars “the way he imagines Mark [Zuckerberg] treats the people around him.”
paras.zh: 斯特朗接下来将在艾伦·索金 (Aaron Sorkin) 执导的《社会清算》(The Social Reckoning) 中饰演 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg)。这位导演最近告诉《纽约时报》，斯特朗对待他的联合主演“就像他想象中的马克[扎克伯格]对待他周围的人一样”。

paras.en: Sorkin explained, “Jeremy does a lot of his own work. He does a tremendous amount of work before he shows up on your set. He did not speak in his own voice on the set or walk the way Jeremy walks.”
paras.zh: 索金解释说，“杰里米自己做了很多工作。在出现在你们的片场之前，他做了大量的工作。他没有在片场用自己的声音说话，也没有像杰里米那样走路。”

paras.en: “I told all the other actors in his scenes: ‘Guys, he’s not going to be hanging out with you at craft service. He’s not going to be yucking it up with you between takes. He’s probably not going to speak to you at all. He is going to treat you the way he imagines Mark treats the people around him,’” he added. “And that’s what happened. You cannot argue with the results.”
paras.zh: “我告诉他场景中的所有其他演员：‘伙计们，他不会在工艺服务中和你们一起出去玩。他不会在拍摄间隙和你们一起吐槽。他可能根本不会和你们说话。他会像马克对待他周围的人一样对待你们，’”他补充道。 “这就是发生的事情。你无法否认结果。”

paras.en: Brian Cox, Strong’s former Succession co-star, shared his criticism of his method acting in a viral New Yorker profile, where he said, “I’ve worked with intense actors before. It’s a particularly American disease, I think, this inability to separate yourself off while you’re doing the job.”
paras.zh: 斯特朗在《继承之战》中的前搭档布莱恩·考克斯在《纽约客》的一篇热门人物简介中分享了他对斯特朗表演方法的批评，他说：“我以前曾与紧张的演员合作过。我认为，这是一种特别的美国通病，就是在工作时无法将自己与自己分开。”

paras.en: The Troy actor has made many remarks about Strong’s method, saying previously, “It’s not good for the ensemble. It creates hostility. That’s the problem.”
paras.zh: 这位特洛伊演员对斯特朗的方法发表了很多评论，他之前曾表示，“这对乐团没有好处。它会产生敌意。这就是问题所在。”

paras.en: Of his reaction to the profile, Strong previously told The Hollywood Reporter, “It was painful for it to be put out to the world, maybe in a less compassionate way than I would’ve hoped.” He added, “I felt that I had a safe forum at The New Yorker. I felt that I had a safe forum to share those things — and ultimately that experience was put in doubt.”
paras.zh: 谈到他对这篇个人资料的反应，斯特朗此前告诉《好莱坞报道》，“将其发布给全世界是令人痛苦的，也许是以一种比我希望的更不富有同情心的方式。”他补充道，“我觉得我在《纽约客》有一个安全的论坛。我觉得我有一个安全的论坛来分享这些事情——最终，这种经历受到了质疑。”

paras.en: When asked if he was hurt by his co-stars coming off as being dismissive of his process, Strong said, “Yeah,” adding, “But a lot of that is just things that are presented out of context or with a certain agenda. I know what everybody said, and there was an angle and a narrative that was being presented. Which is not to say that there was never friction between my co-stars. We’re a family in every sense of the word. But foundationally, there’s deep respect and even love.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他的搭档们对他的制作过程不屑一顾时，他是否感到受伤，斯特朗说：“是的，”他补充道，“但很多事情只是断章取义或有特定议程的东西。我知道每个人都说什么，而且有一个角度和叙述。这并不是说我的搭档之间从来没有摩擦。我们在任何意义上都是一家人。但从根本上来说，我们是深深的尊重，甚至是爱。”

articles.title: How ‘Freaks’ Sent Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein to Hollywood: “That Film Changed Our Lives”
articles.author: Etan Vlessing

paras.en: Zach Lipovsky has done good business with gory horror movies.
paras.zh: 扎克·利波夫斯基在血腥恐怖片方面做得很好。

paras.en: Lipovsky and longtime collaborator Adam B. Stein’s 2018 dark sci-fi thriller Freaks, starring Emile Hirsch and Bruce Dern, was an unlikely box office hit, having made over $375 million worldwide during its theatrical run. “That film changed our lives,” he tells The Hollywood Reporter from the Sony Pictures studio lot in Culver City, California.
paras.zh: 2018 年，利波夫斯基和长期合作者亚当·B·斯坦因 (Adam B. Stein) 执导的黑暗科幻惊悚片《怪胎》(Freaks) 由埃米尔·赫希 (Emile Hirsch) 和布鲁斯·邓恩 (Bruce Dern) 主演，出人意料地取得了票房成功，在全球上映期间获得了超过 3.75 亿美元的票房收入。 “那部电影改变了我们的生活，”他在加利福尼亚州卡尔弗城的索尼影业工作室告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: Freaks effectively transformed the filmmaking duo from B-movie mavens to hot commodities in Hollywood after the dystopian drama world premiered at the Vancouver Film Festival (VIFF). “I grew up in Vancouver. We made the first film in Vancouver. And as a teenager I went to the Vancouver Film Festival, and got a super pass to not only see five films a day, but go to press screenings for three weeks before the festival,” Lipovsky recalled.
paras.zh: 这部反乌托邦剧情片在温哥华电影节 (VIFF) 上进行全球首映后，《怪胎》有效地将电影制作二人组从 B 级电影专家转变为好莱坞的热门商品。 “我在温哥华长大。我们在温哥华制作了第一部电影。十几岁的时候，我参加了温哥华电影节，并获得了一张超级通行证，不仅可以每天看五部电影，还可以在电影节前三周参加新闻发布会，”利波夫斯基回忆道。

paras.en: That festival play gave a young Lipovsky a crash course in world cinema. “I remember seeing filmmakers up on the stage, presenting their films and wishing one day that would be me,” he added. After Freaks –— which featured 7-year-old Chloe (Lexy Kolker) being locked in a ramshackle suburban home by her protective and paranoid father, played by Hirsch — Lipovsky and Stein are returning to Vancouver with their follow-up Freak 2 to screen on Saturday night at the Rio Theatre.
paras.zh: 这部节日戏剧给年轻的利波夫斯基上了世界电影的速成课。 “我记得看到电影制片人在舞台上展示他们的电影，并希望有一天是我，”他补充道。 《怪胎》讲述了 7 岁的克洛伊（莱克西·科尔克饰）被她的保护欲强、偏执的父亲（赫希饰演）锁在一个摇摇欲坠的郊区家里的故事。继《怪胎》之后，利波夫斯基和斯坦将带着他们的续作《怪胎 2》返回温哥华，并于周六晚上在里约剧院上映。

paras.en: “The first film was very much about a girl who can’t leave her house, and really wants a mom. And in the second film, she’s now much older. So she doesn’t want a mom. What she wants is a friend,” he explained. “And how do you find a friend, and how do you build a relationship in a world where society wants you dead,” Lipovsky adds as he teases Freaks 2.
paras.zh: “第一部电影讲述的是一个不能离开家的女孩，她真的想要一个妈妈。而在第二部电影中，她现在老了很多。所以她不需要妈妈。她想要的是一个朋友，”他解释道。 “在一个社会希望你死的世界里，你如何找到朋友，如何建立关系，”利波夫斯基在调侃《怪胎 2》时补充道。

paras.en: Paramount Pictures has already picked up the sequel where Amanda Crew is a mother and Lorelei Olivia Mote plays her daughter, as both look to survive a world that wants to wipe out “freaks” like them as they seek vengeance for their family. Freaks 2 also follows hot on the heels of Lipovsky and Stein directing Final Destination Bloodlines, the sixth installment of the supernatural horror franchise that grossed over $285 million at the worldwide box office.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙影业已经拍摄了续集，阿曼达·克鲁 (Amanda Crew) 饰演一位母亲，罗蕾莱·奥利维亚·莫特 (Lorelei Olivia Mote) 饰演她的女儿，两人都希望在一个想要消灭像她们这样的“怪胎”的世界中生存下去，同时为家人报仇。 《怪胎 2》紧随利波夫斯基和斯坦执导的《死神血统》之后，这是超自然恐怖系列的第六部，全球票房收入超过 2.85 亿美元。

paras.en: “It’s very hard to believe I’m sitting here on the Sony lot where we have our first look [deal] now. And we have a whole building of people now working with us to make movies, which is very surreal,” Lipovsky adds as he and Stein met nearly 20 years ago as rival competitors on On the Lot, the Fox filmmaking competition series from Steven Spielberg and Mark Burnett.
paras.zh: “很难相信我现在正坐在索尼的片场，我们在这里进行了第一次观看（交易）。现在有一整栋大楼的人正在与我们一起制作电影，这非常超现实，”利波夫斯基补充道，他和斯坦因在近 20 年前作为竞争对手在《On the Lot》中相识，这是由史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格和马克·伯内特制作的福克斯电影制作竞赛系列节目。

paras.en: “We didn’t win, and we were off the lot,” Lipovsky recounted. But, two decades later, he and Stein are in-demand movie directors at work on projects like the Long Lost short story adaptation for Amblin and Universal, as writers on Chris Columbus’ Gremlins 3 and for Sony the animated Venom movie and Metal Gear Solid.
paras.zh: “我们没有获胜，我们也被淘汰了，”利波夫斯基回忆道。但二十年后，他和斯坦因成为炙手可热的电影导演，为安培林 (Amblin) 和环球影业 (Universal) 制作了《失落已久》(Long Lost) 短篇小说改编作品，担任克里斯·哥伦布 (Chris Columbus) 的《小魔怪 3》(Gremlins 3) 的编剧，以及为索尼 (Sony) 制作的动画电影《毒液》(Venom) 和《合金装备》(Metal Gear Solid)。

paras.en: Getting known around Hollywood still has Lipovsky pinching himself. “Over 20 years of making movies, you get very used to things not happening, and very used to people saying something’s happening, and then it doesn’t happen. So when things start to click into place, your brain has a very hard time trying to accept that it’s actually real,” he added.
paras.zh: 在好莱坞出名仍然让利波夫斯基掐自己。 “在制作电影 20 多年的时间里，你会非常习惯那些没有发生的事情，也非常习惯人们说某件事正在发生，然后它就没有发生。所以当事情开始发生时，你的大脑很难接受它实际上是真实的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Lipovsky also puts himself and Stein becoming bankable in Hollywood after Freaks and Final Destination Bloodlines down to the recent summer box office success of breakout horror pics Backrooms and Obsession. “Horror is one of the few genres where it’s normal for audiences to show up in theaters for original movies,” Lipovsky argues. “It’s the voice of the authors that are creating the work that audiences are becoming attracted to, and even more so when the work is original, and Hollywood is definitely starting to pay attention to that.”
paras.zh: 利波夫斯基还将自己和斯坦因在《怪胎》和《死神血统》之后在好莱坞的票房收入归功于最近夏季突破性恐怖片《密室》和《痴迷》的票房成功。 “恐怖片是少数几种观众经常到影院观看原创电影的类型之一，”利波夫斯基说道。 “正是创作者的声音吸引了观众，当作品是原创时更是如此，好莱坞肯定开始关注这一点。”

paras.en: Lipovsky will be accompanied at the VIFF screenings for Freaks 2 by his mother, who as a single parent cast aside her own aspirations to become a movie director to work as a TV producer at Knowledge Network, a local Vancouver network. “Becoming a director back in the [19]80s wasn’t really a career path for many women, and she’s always been there by my side, and for her to see the kind of levels to which I’ve been able to create movies has been amazing,” he recalled.
paras.zh: Lipovsky 的母亲将陪同他的母亲参加 VIFF 放映《怪胎 2》。作为单亲家长，她放弃了自己成为电影导演的愿望，在温哥华当地的知识网络 (Knowledge Network) 担任电视制片人。 “对于许多女性来说，在[19]80年代成为一名导演并不是真正的职业道路，但她一直在我身边，让她看到我能够创作电影的水平真是令人惊叹，”他回忆道。

paras.en: One of the VIFF screenings for Freak 2 will also be at the city’s historic Park Theatre, an art deco movie house that Lipovsky helped save from closure as a private investor along with Osgood Perkins, Mike Flanagan, Sean Baker and Finn Wolfhard.
paras.zh: 《怪胎 2》的 VIFF 放映之一也将在该市历史悠久的公园剧院 (Park Theatre) 进行，这是一家装饰艺术电影院，利波夫斯基与奥斯古德·帕金斯 (Osgood Perkins)、迈克·弗拉纳根 (Mike Flanagan)、肖恩·贝克 (Sean Baker) 和芬恩·沃尔夫哈德 (Finn Wolfhard) 一起作为私人投资者帮助挽救了这家装饰艺术电影院。

paras.en: “It’s very special to be able to do the screening there, with a lot of the people that made the movie and a lot of my old friends in the audience and within minutes of where we shot the movie,” he insisted.
paras.zh: “能够在那里进行放映是非常特别的，观众中有很多制作这部电影的人和我的很多老朋友，距离我们拍摄电影的地方只有几分钟的时间，”他坚持说。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Crashes Dakota Johnson’s ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hosting Stint: “My Literal Therapist!”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Dakota Johnson got a special visit from Patient Zero on Saturday Night Live.
paras.zh: 达科塔·约翰逊在《周六夜现场》中受到了零号病人的特别拜访。

paras.en: Taylor Swift joined the Verity actress during her opening monologue on Saturday night’s episode, marking quite the surprise appearance. Johnson joked about having “two very public, very lame breakups with two very awesome musicians” since she’d last been on SNL, and how she had the most supportive friends who “don’t judge me for dating these men.”
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特在周六晚上的剧集开场独白中加入了这位《Verity》女演员的表演，这标志着她的出现相当令人惊讶。约翰逊开玩笑说，自从她上次参加《周六夜现场》以来，她与两位非常出色的音乐家发生了“两次非常公开、非常蹩脚的分手”，以及她如何拥有最支持她的朋友，他们“不会因为我和这些男人约会而评判我”。

paras.en: Cut to Swift! Johnson joked that the singer was “my literal therapist,” to which the Grammy winner responded, “I’m not your therapist. Actually, you just show up once a week at my house with an empty bottle of wine and ask if I want some.”
paras.zh: 切到斯威夫特！约翰逊开玩笑说这位歌手是“我的文字治疗师”，这位格莱美奖得主回应道，“我不是你的治疗师。实际上，你每周只需要带着一瓶空酒到我家来一次，问我是否想要一些。”

paras.en: “Yeah, well I have manners,” the actress said, as Swift continued, “And then you flop on my couch and overshare, and every so often I just say, ‘Damn, that’s crazy.'”
paras.zh: “是的，我很有礼貌，”这位女演员说道，斯威夫特继续说道，“然后你倒在我的沙发上，过度分享，时不时我只是说，‘该死，这太疯狂了。’”

paras.en: “Is that not a therapist?” the Fifty Shades of Grey actress questioned.
paras.zh: “那不是治疗师吗？” 《五十度灰》女主角受到质疑。

paras.en: On Sunday, Swift released the music video for her new single “Patient Zero,” starring none other than Johnson and Colin Farrell. The two debuted the video at the MTV VMAs on Sunday, with the track serving as one of four new songs the musician released as part of The Life of a Showgirl: Encore Edition last Friday.
paras.zh: 周日，斯威夫特发布了她的新单曲《零号病人》的音乐视频，由约翰逊和科林·法雷尔主演。两人于周日在 MTV VMA 上首次亮相了该视频，该歌曲是这位音乐家上周五在《歌舞女郎的一生：安可版》中发布的四首新歌之一。

paras.en: To close out her monologue, Johnson concluded, “Well, just quickly, while we’re on the subject of musicians, I think actually I’m doing a public service by dating them, because ladies, I am saving you a lot of money on Zoloft. So, you’re welcome, America! And also England and parts of Ireland and Cleveland, allegedly,” Johnson said, as Swift added in a quick, “Woo-woo!”
paras.zh: 为了结束她的独白，约翰逊总结道：“好吧，很快，当我们谈论音乐家的话题时，我认为实际上我正在通过与他们约会来提供公共服务，因为女士们，我在左洛复上为你们节省了很多钱。所以，不客气，美国！据说还有英国以及爱尔兰和克利夫兰的部分地区，”约翰逊说，斯威夫特快速补充道，“呜呜！”

paras.en: “Cleveland” is another new track from Showgirl: Encore, where Swift sings about her husband Travis Kelce and their marriage. “Now I’m wearing white (Yeah), so hate all you like (Uh-huh) / This is the love of my life (Hey, hey, hey),” Swift sings at the end of the song.
paras.zh: 《Cleveland》是《Showgirl: Encore》的另一首新歌，斯威夫特在其中唱出了她的丈夫特拉维斯·凯尔斯 (Travis Kelce) 和他们的婚姻。 “现在我穿着白色的衣服（是的），所以讨厌你喜欢的一切（嗯哼）/这是我一生的挚爱（嘿，嘿，嘿），”斯威夫特在歌曲结尾唱道。

paras.en: At the top of her monologue, the Verity actress also addressed the box office bomb Madame Web, while noting that her last SNL appearance was tied to promotion for the film. She joked, “The last time I was here, I was promoting a movie called Madame Web. And tonight, I’m still promoting it. Because the movie hasn’t made any money yet.”
paras.zh: 在独白的开头，这位《Verity》女演员还谈到了《韦伯夫人》的票房炸弹，同时指出她最后一次出现在《周六夜现场》与电影的宣传有关。她开玩笑说：“上次我来的时候，我正在宣传一部叫《韦伯夫人》的电影。今晚，我还在宣传它。因为这部电影还没有赚到钱。”

paras.en: The cold open saw a group of “Republican heavy hitters” get together to film ads ahead of the midterms. Among those who appeared were Marco Rubio, portrayed by Marcello Hernández. Mikey Day also joined as Mitch McConnell, and Jeremy Culhane as J.D. Vance.
paras.zh: 冷开场时，一群“共和党重量级人物”聚集在一起，在中期选举前拍摄广告。出席者包括由马塞洛·埃尔南德斯 (Marcello Hernández) 饰演的马可·鲁比奥 (Marco Rubio)。麦奇·戴 (Mikey Day) 也加入，饰演米奇·麦康奈尔 (Mitch McConnell)，杰里米·卡尔哈恩 (Jeremy Culhane) 饰演 J.D. 万斯 (J.D. Vance)。

paras.en: The last guest before James Austin Johnson’s Trump also joined was Pete Hegseth (Colin Jost). He joined the sketch with a Bero in hand, which he described as “Spider-Man’s new non-alcoholic bitch beer.”
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊饰演的特朗普加入之前的最后一位嘉宾是皮特·赫格斯（科林·乔斯特饰）。他手里拿着一杯 Bero 加入了素描，他将其描述为“蜘蛛侠的新型无酒精母狗啤酒”。

paras.en: “Now listen up, OK, ’cause I need all you patriots at home to do the gayest thing ever and vote,” Jost’s Hegseth said. “Thanks to me, the military finally has its priorities — and sexuality — straight.”
paras.zh: “现在听着，好吧，因为我需要你们所有的爱国者在家里做有史以来最快乐的事情并投票，”约斯特的赫格斯说。 “多亏了我，军队终于明确了自己的优先事项和性取向。”

paras.en: Saturday night’s episode marks Johnson’s third time hosting SNL. She made her debut in February 2015, and returned once more in January 2024. She’s made several appearances throughout the years, including for the 40th anniversary special and a cameo during Josh O’Connor’s hosting stint last December.
paras.zh: 周六晚上的这一集标志着约翰逊第三次主持 SNL。她于 2015 年 2 月首次亮相，并于 2024 年 1 月再次回归。这些年来，她多次露面，包括在 40 周年纪念特别节目中以及去年 12 月在乔什·奥康纳 (Josh O’Connor) 主持期间客串。

paras.en: Season 52 of SNL premiered last week with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson and Katseye. Later this season, Shane Gillis will host on Oct. 10 with musical guest Rosalia, while Obsession star Inde Navarrette makes her SNL hosting debut on the Halloween episode with Gracie Abrams.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》第 52 季于上周首播，由纽约尼克斯队球星贾伦·布伦森 (Jalen Brunson) 和凯西 (Katseye) 主演。本季晚些时候，肖恩·吉利斯 (Shane Gillis) 将于 10 月 10 日与音乐嘉宾罗莎莉亚 (Rosalia) 一起主持，而《痴迷》(Obsession) 明星因德·纳瓦雷特 (Inde Navarrette) 则与格雷西·艾布拉姆斯 (Gracie Abrams) 一起在万圣节剧集中首次亮相 SNL。

articles.title: Ukraine will hit Russian refineries in response to Moscow's 'new doctrine' of airstrikes, Zelenskyy says

paras.en: Ukraine will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries in response to a new policy of airstrikes by Moscow designed to force people to abandon Kyiv and other cities, but will not target civilians, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 总统泽连斯基表示，乌克兰将加大力度攻击俄罗斯炼油厂，以回应莫斯科新的空袭政策，旨在迫使人们放弃基辅和其他城市，但不会针对平民。

paras.en: Ukraine's intelligence services have obtained documents showing that Russian leader Vladimir Putin had issued a "new doctrine" of military attacks on a much broader range of civilian targets ahead of this winter, Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基说，乌克兰情报部门获得的文件显示，俄罗斯领导人普京已发布“新学说”，将在今年冬天之前对更广泛的民用目标进行军事攻击。

paras.en: "We saw documents and we know that they allow them to attack infrastructure, logistics, and especially to attack in the cities, in the villages, everywhere, roads, schools, hospitals," Zelenskyy told Reuters in an interview. "To pressure people to leave the capital, leave different cities: this is the goal of the operation."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在接受路透社采访时表示：“我们看到了文件，我们知道这些文件允许他们攻击基础设施、后勤设施，特别是在城市、村庄、各处、道路、学校、医院进行攻击。” “迫使人们离开首都，离开不同的城市：这就是行动的目标。”

paras.en: Driving the shift in policy, Zelenskyy said, was Putin's desire to appear strong at a time when his military was losing ground in a key frontline region and sustaining higher levels of casualties.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，推动政策转变的原因是，普京希望在其军队在关键前线地区节节败退、伤亡人数不断增加之际表现出强大的态度。

paras.en: The Kremlin was not available to comment on Saturday. But in a statement urging foreign nationals to leave Kyiv, the Russian Foreign Ministry said Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia in recent months.
paras.zh: 周六未能联系到克里姆林宫发表评论。但俄罗斯外交部在一份敦促外国人离开基辅的声明中表示，莫斯科将继续系统性地打击目标，据称是对乌克兰近几个月来对俄罗斯的袭击进行报复。

paras.en: Both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians.
paras.zh: 双方均否认蓄意针对平民。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said a successful Ukrainian counteroffensive, code-named "Vivaldi," had recaptured around 140 sq km (54 sq miles) of Ukraine's eastern Donbas region and was still ongoing. Russia has said it must control Donbas in its entirety as a condition for any peace deal.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰代号为“维瓦尔第”的反攻已成功收复乌克兰东部顿巴斯地区约140平方公里（54平方英里），并且仍在进行中。俄罗斯表示，它必须完全控制顿巴斯，作为达成任何和平协议的条件。

paras.en: In recent weeks, U.S. President Donald Trump's administration has sought to revive talks to end the four-year-old conflict — Europe's bloodiest since World War II.
paras.zh: 最近几周，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府寻求重启谈判，以结束这场持续四年的冲突——这是欧洲自二战以来最血腥的一场冲突。

paras.en: The U.S. leader last month urged Ukraine to refrain from hitting Russian oil installations, saying that was sending global diesel prices surging.
paras.zh: 美国领导人上个月敦促乌克兰不要袭击俄罗斯石油设施，称这将导致全球柴油价格飙升。

paras.en: But Zelenskyy, speaking as air raid sirens blared outside the gilded halls of the presidential offices, said he had received no indications from Russia that Putin was interested in peace talks or discussing a ceasefire on energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 但泽连斯基在总统府镀金大厅外响起空袭警报时表示，他没有收到俄罗斯的任何迹象表明普京有兴趣进行和平谈判或讨论能源基础设施停火。

paras.en: Over the past week, the Ukrainian capital has come under persistent attack by Russian drones and missiles targeting energy and telecoms assets, road and rail infrastructure. For the first time, Russia has targeted the bridges across the Dnipro River connecting east and west Kyiv.
paras.zh: 过去一周，乌克兰首都遭到俄罗斯无人机和导弹的持续攻击，目标是能源和电信资产、公路和铁路基础设施。俄罗斯首次将目标瞄准了连接基辅东西部的第聂伯河上的桥梁。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Ukraine would react to the change in tactics by Moscow, but would not target civilian infrastructure indiscriminately.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰将对莫斯科的策略变化做出反应，但不会不分青红皂白地针对民用基础设施。

paras.en: "We have to respond in any way (we can). With their attacks on our energy, we have to respond on their energy. First of all, oil refiners etc: what gives money to them for this war," Zelenskyy said in English. "But we will not respond, of course, just like them, on any civilian objects."
paras.zh: “我们必须以任何方式（我们可以）做出回应。随着他们对我们能源的攻击，我们也必须对他们的能源做出回应。首先，炼油厂等：什么为他们提供了这场战争的资金，”泽伦斯基用英语说道。 “但我们当然不会像他们一样对任何民用物体做出反应。”

paras.en: After the Trump administration invited Putin to attend a G20 summit in Miami in December and discussed business deals with Russian envoys, Zelenskyy urged Washington not to normalize relations with Russia before ensuring a return to peace.
paras.zh: 在特朗普政府邀请普京参加12月在迈阿密举行的G20峰会并与俄罗斯特使讨论商业交易后，泽连斯基敦促华盛顿在确保恢复和平之前不要与俄罗斯实现关系正常化。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he would be happy to meet Putin for peace talks at the G20, but he warned the US not to believe in "illusions" that Russia would simply end hostilities if it gained control of Donbas.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，他很高兴在二十国集团(G20)上与普京会面进行和平谈判，但他警告美国不要相信俄罗斯如果控制顿巴斯就会简单地结束敌对行动的“幻想”。

paras.en: "It's not fair just to normalize," said Zelenskyy, dressed in his trademark black T-shirt and military-style jacket. Any resumption of economic and diplomatic ties with the West had to be in return for Russia ending hostilities, he said: "Because peace is more important than any kind of economy."
paras.zh: “仅仅实现正常化是不公平的，”泽连斯基穿着他标志性的黑色 T 恤和军装风格夹克说道。他说，与西方恢复经济和外交关系都必须以俄罗斯结束敌对行动为代价：“因为和平比任何经济都更重要。”

paras.en: While the U.S. has proposed resuming trilateral talks in the coming weeks in the UAE, Zelenskyy noted that an exact date and location for the technical-level conversations had still not been set.
paras.zh: 尽管美国提议未来几周在阿联酋恢复三边会谈，但泽伦斯基指出，技术层面对话的确切日期和地点尚未确定。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials warn that Russia has stockpiled hundreds of ballistic missiles ahead of an expected winter onslaught against electricity and water infrastructure. Last winter, the worst of the war, Russian strikes left swathes of the country without electricity and heating for days at a time.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员警告称，俄罗斯已储备了数百枚弹道导弹，以应对预计冬季对电力和水利基础设施的攻击。去年冬天，在战争最严重的时期，俄罗斯的空袭导致该国大片地区一度断电和供暖数天。

paras.en: Since the summer, Moscow has also begun launching dozens of fast, relatively cheap jet-powered Shahed drones a day at Ukraine, and its air defense teams have struggled to cope because their interceptor drones were too slow to catch them.
paras.zh: 自今年夏天以来，莫斯科还开始每天在乌克兰发射数十架快速、相对便宜的喷气式“沙赫德”无人机，而其防空部队一直难以应对，因为他们的拦截无人机速度太慢，无法捕获它们。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Ukraine had been forced to rely heavily on its fighter aircraft – F-16s and MiGs – to down around 60% of the Russian jet-powered drones, but supplies of 20 mm ammunition for the planes were running low.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰被迫严重依赖其战斗机（F-16 和米格）来击落约 60% 的俄罗斯喷气式无人机，但飞机的 20 毫米弹药供应不足。

paras.en: Kyiv was urgently working on other solutions – including boosting its electronic jamming capabilities, he said. In the second half of October, it would receive the first shipment of small, cheap air defense missiles capable of hitting the new Shaheds.
paras.zh: 他说，基辅正在紧急研究其他解决方案，包括提高其电子干扰能力。十月下半月，它将收到第一批能够击中新沙希德的小型廉价防空导弹。

paras.en: Last week, Zelenskyy said Ukraine was developing five models of new interceptor drones capable of downing the jet Shaheds. Fresh from a meeting with his defense chiefs, he said tests on two of those models showed a modest success rate of around 30%.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基上周表示，乌克兰正在开发五种型号的新型拦截无人机，能够击落沙赫兹战机。刚与国防部长会面后，他表示对其中两种型号的测试显示成功率约为 30%。

paras.en: "We'll have to scale it," he said. "I hope that with all these things, with all these elements, we'll find a way."
paras.zh: “我们必须扩大规模，”他说。 “我希望通过所有这些事情、所有这些因素，我们能找到办法。”

paras.en: Ukraine announced the first combat use this week of its own domestically made ballistic missile, theFP-7, which has a range of around 250 km (155 miles).
paras.zh: 乌克兰本周宣布首次在战斗中使用本国制造的弹道导弹FP-7，射程约为250公里（155英里）。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he had called the manufacturer Fire Point to pressure executives to finish a longer-range model, the FP-9, which the company has said could hit Moscow.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，他已致电制造商 Fire Point，向高管施压，要求他们完成一款远程型号 FP-9，该公司表示该型号可能会袭击莫斯科。

paras.en: "I said to them, where is my FP-9?" said Zelenskyy, with a grin. "We need the FP-9. And the FP-9 will be (ready) this autumn, I'm sure."
paras.zh: “我对他们说，我的 FP-9 在哪里？”泽连斯基笑着说道。 “我们需要 FP-9。我确信 FP-9 将在今年秋天准备就绪。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said a recent spate of Russian drone incursions and hybrid attacks in Europe were an effort to intimidate European populations and to undermine support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，俄罗斯最近在欧洲发生的一系列无人机入侵和混合袭击是为了恐吓欧洲民众并削弱对乌克兰的支持。

paras.en: Some European leaders were starting to understand this, he said, and toughen their position.
paras.zh: 他说，一些欧洲领导人开始理解这一点，并加强了立场。

paras.en: Russia says such accusations are baseless and the result of anti-Russian hysteria.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，此类指控毫无根据，是反俄歇斯底里的结果。

paras.en: After talks with European officials in Brussels this week, Ukraine had unlocked funding to order the drones that it needs to keep fighting at the start of 2027, Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，本周在布鲁塞尔与欧洲官员举行会谈后，乌克兰已释放资金来订购 2027 年初继续作战所需的无人机。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials worked with European partners on plans to plug a $27 billion hole in Kyiv's defense budget this year.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员与欧洲伙伴合作制定了填补基辅今年 270 亿美元国防预算缺口的计划。

paras.en: The plans involve a combination of reallocating Ukraine's own budget resources, bilateral assistance, and using "money credits" from next year's portion of a €90 billion EU loan, Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，这些计划包括重新分配乌克兰自己的预算资源、双边援助以及使用明年 900 亿欧元欧盟贷款中的“货币信贷”。

paras.en: "We will close this (gap). I think this is absolutely a big success for our country," he said.
paras.zh: “我们将缩小这一（差距）。我认为这对我们国家来说绝对是一个巨大的成功，”他说。

articles.title: Trump taps Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as AI czar: WSJ reports

paras.en: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton has been chosen as the Trump administration's new AI czar, leading its response to artificial intelligence amid growing concerns about the risks of this rapidly evolving technology, The Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》周六报道，国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿被选为特朗普政府的新任人工智能沙皇，在人们对这种快速发展的技术的风险日益担忧的情况下，领导政府对人工智能的反应。

paras.en: Clayton told the Journal he will lead a new White House task force, which will have 120 days to research and report on AI's risks and opportunities, and offer recommendations on the federal government's responsibilities regarding the new technology.
paras.zh: 克莱顿告诉《华尔街日报》，他将领导一个新的白宫特别工作组，该工作组将有 120 天的时间研究和报告人工智能的风险和机遇，并就联邦政府在这项新技术方面的责任提出建议。

paras.en: "The president asked that a group be put together that was going to ensure exactly what he said, which is that we stay the leaders in superintelligence, and that the interests of the American people are put first," Clayton said, the Journal reported.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，克莱顿说：“总统要求组建一个小组，以确保他所说的一切，即我们继续保持超级智能领域的领导地位，并将美国人民的利益放在第一位。”

paras.en: The group will be called the "Super Intelligence Force," or SI — the term President Donald Trump prefers over AI — and Clayton will effectively become the new AI czar, the Journal said, citing a senior White House official.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》援引一位白宫高级官员的话说，该组织将被称为“超级情报力量”（SI）——唐纳德·特朗普总统更喜欢这个词，而不是人工智能——而克莱顿实际上将成为新的人工智能沙皇。

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to a CNBC request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: In September, Trump announced in a Truth Social post that he would create a new "AI Force" to help facilitate the industry and root out bad actors.
paras.zh: 9 月，特朗普在 Truth Social 帖子中宣布，他将创建一支新的“人工智能力量”，以帮助促进该行业发展并铲除不良行为者。

paras.en: "We will not in any way hinder or stifle the Growth of this incredible Industry. Rather, we will cherish it, help it, and watch over it, as it grows!" Trump said the post, which also announced plans to hire an AI czar.
paras.zh: “我们不会以任何方式阻碍或扼杀这个令人难以置信的行业的发展。相反，我们会珍惜它，帮助它，并在它成长的过程中守护它！”特朗普在帖子中说道，同时还宣布了聘请人工智能沙皇的计划。

paras.en: "Only High I.Q. individuals need apply!" the president added.
paras.zh: “只有高智商的人才需要申请！”总统补充道。

paras.en: Clayton is a former chair of the Securities and Exchange Commission and U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York. The Senate confirmed him in July as DNI, giving him authority over 18 U.S. intelligence agencies.
paras.zh: 克莱顿是美国证券交易委员会前主席和纽约南区联邦检察官。参议院于 7 月确认他为国家情报总监，赋予他管理 18 个美国情报机构的权力。

paras.en: The announcement comes days after AI industry leaders met with Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson at the White House. The AI developers signed onto an agreement of voluntary safety standards that Trump said was "morally binding."
paras.zh: 这一消息是在人工智能行业领导人在白宫会见特朗普和众议院议长迈克·约翰逊几天后发布的。人工智能开发商签署了一份自愿安全标准协议，特朗普称该协议具有“道德约束力”。

paras.en: Despite dire warnings from within the industry and calls from AI leaders Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman for federal guardrails on frontier AI models, Trump has so far opposed regulation.
paras.zh: 尽管来自行业内部的可怕警告以及人工智能领袖 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 和 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 呼吁联邦对前沿人工智能模型采取监管措施，但特朗普迄今为止反对监管。

paras.en: In the same September post, Trump suggested AI fears were a hoax and blamed "Radical Left Dumocrats."
paras.zh: 在同一篇 9 月份的帖子中，特朗普表示对人工智能的担忧是一场骗局，并指责“激进的左翼杜民主人士”。

paras.en: Venture capitalist David Sacks had previously served as AI and crypto czar under Trump, but in March said that his time as a special government employee had ended. Sacks is co-chair of the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a federal advisory committee made up of outside experts on technology, scientific research and innovation policy.
paras.zh: 风险投资家戴维·萨克斯（David Sacks）此前曾在特朗普领导下担任人工智能和加密货币沙皇，但今年 3 月份表示，他作为特殊政府雇员的时代已经结束。萨克斯是总统科学技术顾问委员会的联合主席，该委员会是一个由技术、科学研究和创新政策方面的外部专家组成的联邦咨询委员会。

articles.title: Ukraine’s surprise robot offensive exposes a vulnerability in Putin’s war machine

paras.en: A surprise Ukrainian robot offensive in the eastern Donbas region appears to have reversed over a year of Russian territorial gains, according to security experts, dealing a strategic blow to Russian President Vladimir Putin's territorial ambitions.
paras.zh: 安全专家称，乌克兰机器人在顿巴斯东部地区出人意料地发起进攻，似乎扭转了俄罗斯一年多来所取得的领土进展，对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的领土野心造成了战略打击。

paras.en: Details of the Ukrainian counteroffensive, dubbed "Operation Vivaldi," have started to come to light in recent weeks, offering rare insight into the fast-changing nature of frontline combat operations amid Russia's full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 被称为“维瓦尔第行动”的乌克兰反攻细节最近几周开始曝光，为了解俄罗斯全面入侵期间前线作战行动的快速变化性质提供了罕见的见解。

paras.en: As part of the ongoing operation, which started in May, security experts said Ukraine's Third Army Corps had been able to deploy large bomber drones and remote-controlled robots behind enemy lines around Lyman in the northern Donetsk Oblast, apparently catching Russian forces off guard.
paras.zh: 安全专家表示，作为5月份开始的持续行动的一部分，乌克兰第三军团已经能够在顿涅茨克州北部莱曼周围的敌后部署大型轰炸机无人机和遥控机器人，这显然让俄罗斯军队措手不及。

paras.en: Russian forces have been seeking to encircle Ukraine's so-called fortress belt cities that make up the remaining Ukrainian-held territory in the region for the past 12 months.
paras.zh: 过去12个月里，俄罗斯军队一直在寻求包围乌克兰所谓的要塞带城市，这些城市构成了该地区剩余的乌克兰控制领土。

paras.en: The third phase of Operation Vivaldi, however, liberated an additional 51 square kilometers, taking the total area of territory retaken to 176 square kilometers, Ukrainian Brigadier-General Andrii Biletskyi said on Sept. 28. The latest phase of fighting inflicted over 2,000 Russian losses, with over 250 Russian soldiers taken prisoner, he added.
paras.zh: 然而，乌克兰准将安德里·比列茨基 (Andrii Biletskyi) 9 月 28 日表示，维瓦尔第行动第三阶段又解放了 51 平方公里，使收复的领土总面积达到 176 平方公里。他补充说，最新阶段的战斗造成了 2000 多人的损失，超过 250 名俄罗斯士兵被俘。

paras.en: Patrick Bolder, a defense expert and strategic advisor at the Hague Center for Strategic Studies (HCSS), described the offensive as a "big bloody nose" to Putin's minimal war aim of seizing Ukraine's Donbas region.
paras.zh: 海牙战略研究中心（HCSS）的防务专家兼战略顾问帕特里克·博尔德（Patrick Bolder）将此次攻势描述为对普京夺取乌克兰顿巴斯地区的最低战争目标的“大鼻子”。

paras.en: Alongside demonstrating an ability to keep details of the operation secret, running disinformation campaigns against Russia and orchestrating a months-long air operation to disrupt logistical supplies to the frontline, Bolder said Ukrainian forces had managed to secure control of the air in the Lyman area, denying Russia the use of its drones.
paras.zh: 博尔德表示，除了展示对行动细节保密的能力、针对俄罗斯开展虚假信息宣传活动以及策划长达数月的空中行动以中断前线的后勤供应外，乌克兰军队还成功地控制了莱曼地区的制空权，阻止俄罗斯使用其无人机。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces were then able to deploy their own drones to drop unmanned ground vehicles behind enemy lines to attack the Russian troops from behind, Bolder said, without endangering their own personnel.
paras.zh: 博尔德说，乌克兰军队随后能够部署自己的无人机，将无人驾驶地面车辆投放到敌后，从后方攻击俄罗斯军队，而不会危及自己的人员。

paras.en: "They put this together masterly," Bolder said.
paras.zh: “他们巧妙地将这些组合在一起，”博尔德说。

paras.en: For the Kremlin, "gaining the Donbas is very far away at the moment because the Ukrainians have come into better defendable positions now — which will make it harder for the Russians to try to do this again," he added.
paras.zh: 对于克里姆林宫来说，“目前夺取顿巴斯还很遥远，因为乌克兰人现在已经处于更好的防御位置——这将使俄罗斯人更难再次尝试这样做，”他补充道。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Russia's Embassy in London was not available to comment when contacted by CNBC on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五 CNBC 联系俄罗斯驻伦敦大使馆发言人时，未能置评。

paras.en: Security experts made it clear that Ukraine's robot offensive should not be seen as a decisive breakthrough.
paras.zh: 安全专家明确表示，乌克兰的机器人攻势不应被视为决定性突破。

paras.en: It does, however, send "a powerful message to Moscow and to Kyiv's partners that the highly innovative Ukrainian military remains capable of defeating Russia on the battlefield," according to David Kirichenko, an associate research fellow at the Henry Jackson Society, a U.K.-based national security think tank.
paras.zh: 然而，英国国家安全智库亨利·杰克逊协会副研究员戴维·基里琴科表示，它确实“向莫斯科和基辅的合作伙伴发出了一个强有力的信息，即高度创新的乌克兰军队仍然有能力在战场上击败俄罗斯”。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy lauded the success of Ukraine's Third Army Corps when he met with soldiers carrying out the counteroffensive, describing the operation as "important in many ways" for Ukraine's defense overall, and the Donbas region especially.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在会见进行反攻的士兵时赞扬了乌克兰第三军团的成功，称这次行动对乌克兰整体防御，特别是顿巴斯地区“在很多方面都很重要”。

paras.en: "One particularly promising area now is replacing our warriors with ground robotic systems wherever possible," Zelenskyy said in a social media post on Sept. 30.
paras.zh: “现在一个特别有前途的领域是尽可能用地面机器人系统取代我们的战士，”泽伦斯基在 9 月 30 日的社交媒体帖子中表示。

paras.en: "During Vivaldi, this capability allowed us to accomplish many things. We will scale it up so that, more and more often, a drone rather than a warrior carries out the most dangerous tasks at the front," he added.
paras.zh: “在维瓦尔第期间，这种能力使我们能够完成许多事情。我们将扩大规模，以便越来越多地由无人机而不是战士在前线执行最危险的任务，”他补充道。

paras.en: Russia has stepped up its attacks on Ukraine's capital and major cities in recent days, targeting data centers, communications and energy infrastructure as it seeks to disrupt the flow of information and force power cuts ahead of winter.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯最近几天加大了对乌克兰首都和主要城市的攻击力度，以数据中心、通信和能源基础设施为目标，试图扰乱信息流动并在冬季前强制断电。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials have expressed deep concern over the attacks, saying there is an urgent need for the country to be able to rapidly respond to missile and drone threats.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员对袭击表示深切关注，称该国迫切需要能够快速应对导弹和无人机威胁。

paras.en: Ukraine, for its part, has sought to raise the cost of Russia's more than four-and-a-half-year war against it, targeting the country's oil refineries and logistics hubs.
paras.zh: 乌克兰则试图提高俄罗斯长达四年半的战争成本，目标是该国的炼油厂和物流中心。

paras.en: Robotic systems have become one of the key factors in Ukraine's counter-offensive operations, according to Serhii Kuzan, chairman of the Kyiv-based Ukrainian Security and Cooperation Center think tank.
paras.zh: 总部位于基辅的乌克兰安全与合作中心智囊团主席谢尔希·库赞表示，机器人系统已成为乌克兰反攻行动的关键因素之一。

paras.en: "Their use has not only reduced the risks to personnel but has also changed the very logic of combat: where previously dozens or hundreds of soldiers were required, remotely controlled platforms are increasingly being deployed," Kuzan told CNBC by email.
paras.zh: 库赞通过电子邮件向 CNBC 表示：“它们的使用不仅降低了人员面临的风险，还改变了战斗的逻辑：以前需要数十或数百名士兵，现在越来越多地部署远程控制平台。”

paras.en: "The experience of Operation 'Vivaldi' has demonstrated that the systematic replacement of human personnel with robots is changing the paradigm of modern warfare, enabling tasks to be carried out with minimal personnel losses."
paras.zh: “‘维瓦尔第’行动的经验表明，用机器人系统性地取代人类人员正在改变现代战争的范式，使任务能够在人员损失最小的情况下完成。”

paras.en: Ultimately, Kuzan said Ukraine's counter-offensive in the Lyman area had been aimed at seizing the initiative on the battlefield, "which will ultimately force the Russian army to abandon the objectives set by its political leadership."
paras.zh: 库赞最终表示，乌克兰在莱曼地区的反攻旨在夺取战场主动权，“这最终将迫使俄罗斯军队放弃其政治领导层设定的目标。”

paras.en: Ukrainian officials have reported that Russia's political leadership had previously set an objective to capture the Donetsk region by the end of the year, although the Russian military is said to now be seeking an extension to March next year.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员报道称，俄罗斯政治领导层此前已设定目标，要在今年年底前夺取顿涅茨克地区，但据称俄罗斯军方目前正寻求将行动期限延长至明年三月。

paras.en: "This is because, according to Ukrainian intelligence, on the main thrust directions of Kostiantynivka, Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, the Russian army is suffering its heaviest losses, accounting for 70–80 per cent of all casualties," Kuzan said.
paras.zh: 库赞说：“这是因为，根据乌克兰情报，在科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡、斯洛维安斯克和克拉马托尔斯克的主攻方向上，俄军损失最为惨重，占全部伤亡的70%至80%。”

articles.title: How to start foraging for edible plants, according to Black Forager

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman. And normally I’d tell you who today’s guest is but she described herself so delightfully that I want you to hear it in her own words:
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：《科学美国人》的《科学快报》，我是雷切尔·费尔特曼。通常我会告诉你今天的客人是谁，但她对自己的描述是如此令人愉快，我希望你能听到她自己的话：

paras.en: Alexis Nikole Nelson: Alexis Nikole Nelson, field botanist, eater of things off ground?
paras.zh: 亚历克西斯·尼科尔·纳尔逊：亚历克西斯·尼科尔·纳尔逊，野外植物学家，吃地上的东西？

paras.en: Feltman: Even if you don’t know Alexis by name, you’ve almost certainly seen some of her work on social media as Black Forager. Millions of followers devour her videos about finding and eating wild foods, from fruits to flowers to seaweeds. She’s here today to talk about her debut book, Happy Snacking, Don’t Die!
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：即使您不知道亚历克西斯的名字，您几乎肯定在社交媒体上看到过她的一些作品，名为“黑色觅食者”。数以百万计的粉丝热衷于观看她关于寻找和食用野生食物（从水果到鲜花再到海藻）的视频。她今天在这里谈论她的处女作《快乐零食，别死！》

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Thank you so much for coming on to chat with us today.
paras.zh: 非常感谢您今天接受我们的采访。

paras.en: Nelson: Oh, my gosh, I’m so happy to be joining you.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：哦，天哪，我很高兴能加入你们。

paras.en: Feltman: So let’s talk about your new book a little bit and how you got to be writing it. I would love to just go back in time a little bit and hear how you first got into foraging.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：让我们来谈谈你的新书以及你是如何写它的。我很想回到过去，听听你是如何开始觅食的。

paras.en: Nelson: So I began foraging at, like, the ripe old age of five with my mom. I used to love tagging along when she was working in the garden on the weekends. And I don’t know if you know this, famously, five-year-olds, not the most helpful genre of human. Motor skills not fully downloaded yet. And so whether it was an act of love and sharing knowledge or an act of trying to keep a small child busy, my mom pointed out some onion grass that was growing in our back lawn, and I had never noticed it before.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：所以我在五岁时就开始和妈妈一起觅食。当她周末在花园里干活时，我常常喜欢跟着她。我不知道你是否知道这一点，众所周知，五岁的孩子不是最有帮助的人类类型。运动技能尚未完全下载。因此，无论这是一种爱和分享知识的行为，还是一种试图让小孩子忙碌的行为，我妈妈指出了我们后草坪上生长的一些洋葱草，而我以前从未注意到它。

paras.en: I asked her when she put it there. She said she didn’t, it was just there on accident, and that there were lots of plants that were just there minding their own business that were also edible and medicinal. And to me, a small child, that blew my mind. I was like, “What do you mean you didn’t put it here? And why isn’t everyone talking about this? Alert the presses. Alert the masses.” And that just sparked my love of knowing all things edible that happened to be growing in my general vicinity, which, you know, has now spread to just a love of the natural world in general.
paras.zh: 我问她什么时候把它放在那里的。她说她没有，只是偶然在那里，而且那里有很多植物，它们只是自顾自地工作，也可以食用和药用。对于我这个小孩子来说，这让我大吃一惊。我当时想，“你没有把它放在这里是什么意思？为什么不是每个人都在谈论这个？提醒媒体。提醒大众。”这激发了我对了解所有在我附近生长的可食用事物的热爱，你知道，这种热爱现在已经蔓延到对自然世界的热爱。

paras.en: Feltman: You know, speaking of the love of the natural world and, you know, how foraging feeds that for you, tell me about, you know, what you love about foraging and why it feels so important to share with other people.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：你知道，谈到对自然世界的热爱，以及觅食如何为你提供这种爱，请告诉我，你知道，你对觅食的热爱是什么，以及为什么与其他人分享如此重要。

paras.en: Nelson: I think it’s two main things that I really love about it. One is: It’s really meditative. It’s a beautiful way to force your brain to slow down and to notice tiny details about the world around you, to participate in your local ecosystem. And I think that does my brain a whole world of good. I know I’ve been traveling a lot lately, so I haven’t been able to, and I can definitely tell the difference in brain when I am outside in the woods every day and brain when I’m not.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：我认为我真正喜欢它的主要有两点。一是：这真的很冥想。这是一种迫使你的大脑放慢速度并注意周围世界的微小细节、参与当地生态系统的美妙方式。我认为这对我的大脑有很大的好处。我知道我最近经常旅行，所以我没能去，而且我绝对可以分辨出我每天在树林里时的大脑和不在树林里时的大脑的差异。

paras.en: And additionally, I think especially this past summer, we have recognized how fragile some of our food systems are and how maybe we have created such a big food system in which we’re so separated from the food that ends up on our plates that maybe we’ve taken a bridge too far. So it’s really nice to have some things in your pantry, on your dinner plate, that you know the entire trajectory of its travel from being in the ground to being on your plate.
paras.zh: 此外，我认为特别是在去年夏天，我们已经认识到我们的一些食物系统是多么脆弱，以及我们如何创造了如此庞大的食物系统，在这个系统中，我们与最终出现在我们盘子里的食物如此分离，也许我们已经走得太远了。因此，在你的食品储藏室里、你的餐盘上放一些东西真是太好了，这样你就知道它从地下到盘子里的整个旅行轨迹。

paras.en: I think it’s a good skill to have. I don’t think it’s ever gonna replace the grocery store for anybody, but there’s something really fulfilling about being responsible for some of the things you’re eating. You know, people who have hobby vegetable gardens will say the exact same thing.
paras.zh: 我认为这是一项很好的技能。我不认为它会取代任何人的杂货店，但对你所吃的一些东西负责确实有一种满足感。你知道，那些有菜园爱好的人也会说同样的话。

paras.en: Feltman: So in doing this work publicly including on the Internet, what kinds of questions do you get from the people who are watching what you’re creating?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：因此，在公开开展这项工作（包括在互联网上）时，您会从观看您创作的人们那里得到什么样的问题？

paras.en: Have you been surprised at all by what kinds of feelings come up in people when they, they see you sharing stuff about foraging?
paras.zh: 当人们看到你分享有关觅食的事情时，他们会产生什么样的感受，你是否对此感到惊讶？

paras.en: Nelson: Yeah, absolutely. I think the two most surprising questions that I still get with some amount of frequency is always a question of where I’m foraging and the legality of me as an individual foraging there.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊：是的，绝对是。我认为我仍然经常遇到的两个最令人惊讶的问题始终是我在哪里觅食以及我作为个人在那里觅食的合法性问题。

paras.en: Nelson: And there’s a lot to unpack in that particular question, ’cause sometimes it is really coming from a place of, like, earnest curiosity. A lot of times, some people are also kind of telling on themselves with some of their own inherent biases, and I try to talk through that with people to the best of my ability, ’cause a lot of our feelings about trespass and who has access to wild spaces ends up becoming, like, a classism conversation, I think, a lot faster than people necessarily expect it to.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：这个特定问题有很多东西需要解开，因为有时它确实来自于真诚的好奇心。很多时候，有些人也会用自己固有的偏见来讲述自己，我试图尽我最大的能力与人们讨论这一点，因为我们对侵入和谁有权进入野生空间的很多感觉最终会变成一场阶级主义对话，我认为，比人们预期的要快得多。

paras.en: And I also don’t think a lot of people realize that the origin of a lot of trespass law lies in purposefully cutting off poor people and people of color from being able to access wild foods, be they plants, fungi, fish, squirrels, on land that doesn’t belong to them.
paras.zh: 而且我认为很多人也没有意识到，许多非法侵入法的根源在于故意切断穷人和有色人种在不属于他们的土地上获取野生食物的机会，无论是植物、真菌、鱼类、松鼠。

paras.en: The other question very much in that same vein is “Well, what happens if everyone starts foraging? What’s gonna be left?” People think everyone’s gonna see one of my videos, and then it’s just going to be, like, a cartoon desert with a tumbleweed going by—except maybe no tumbleweed, ’cause, you know, that’s a brassica. Somebody might try to eat that, too. And the first thing that I love to assure people is everyone’s not gonna become a forager.
paras.zh: 另一个同样的问题是“好吧，如果每个人都开始觅食会发生什么？会剩下什么？”人们认为每个人都会看到我的一个视频，然后它就会像卡通沙漠一样，有风滚草经过，除了可能没有风滚草，因为，你知道，那是芸苔属植物。也许有人也会尝试吃它。我想向人们保证的第一件事是，每个人都不会成为采集者。

paras.en: I know, ’cause I try. I can’t even get my whole family to go foraging with me. And that’s okay. Choose your own adventure, like the books at the library in the ’90s. Choose your own adventure. I am not here to yuck anybody’s yum, and sometimes people are city mice and inside mice, not country mice, and that’s fine.
paras.zh: 我知道，因为我尝试过。我什至无法让全家人和我一起去觅食。没关系。选择您自己的冒险之旅，就像 90 年代图书馆里的书籍一样。选择你自己的冒险。我不是来吐槽任何人的美味的，有时人们是城市老鼠和室内老鼠，而不是乡村老鼠，这很好。

paras.en: Second of all, I think, to assume some sort of, like, capitalist intent behind every single person who is foraging is also kind of telling on yourself if that’s the frame of mind you’re going into asking the question with—because I do honestly and earnestly believe that if people were just foraging for the sake of being able to take care of themselves, their family and the community in which they live, and that includes your human neighbors and your not human neighbors, too, then they will make an informed choice while they are gathering.
paras.zh: 其次，我认为，假设每个正在觅食的人背后都存在某种资本主义意图，这也可以告诉你自己，这是否是你提出问题的心态——因为我确实真诚地相信，如果人们只是为了能够照顾自己、他们的家人和他们所居住的社区而进行觅食，这也包括你的人类邻居和非人类邻居，那么他们在聚集时会做出明智的选择。

paras.en: You know, there are a lot of different global cultures that have rules and rituals to follow, whether that is, you know, some of the Indigenous bands here in the United States taking a moment to pause, lay down tobacco, because that moment of mindfulness helps you from going overboard. You know, globally there’s a lot of also, you know, never take the first thing that you see of a specific species. You know, never take a noticeable amount of a specific species—because not only would that be bad for the thing you’re gathering, but in the long run, it’s also bad for you.
paras.zh: 你知道，有很多不同的全球文化都有需要遵循的规则和仪式，无论是美国的一些土著乐队都会停下来，放下烟草，因为那一刻的正念可以帮助你避免走极端。你知道，在全球范围内，还有很多人永远不会第一眼看到某个特定物种。你知道，永远不要大量采集某种特定物种——因为这不仅对你所采集的东西有害，而且从长远来看，对你也有害。

paras.en: Nelson: You know, foragers are constantly having to be future-focused. We are constantly in a conservationist mindset, not just because we also want to keep having that experience, but we would love people a generation down the road, seven generations down the road, to also get to foster these relationships with our nonhuman neighbors, with the trees and the plants and the fungi and the animals that we happen to be lucky enough to live near.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：你知道，采集者必须始终着眼于未来。我们始终处于保护主义心态中，不仅因为我们也想继续拥有这种经历，而且我们希望一代人、七代人能够与我们的非人类邻居、与我们幸运地生活在附近的树木、植物、真菌和动物建立这种关系。

paras.en: I think foraging becomes poaching when you start putting money into the equation. I live in a part of the country that is, you know, in the ramp belt. And if you’re not a foodie, a ramp is a very pungent wild onion that is in season for about a month in the Midwest.
paras.zh: 我认为，当你开始投入金钱时，觅食就变成了偷猎。我住在这个国家的一部分，你知道，在坡道地带。如果您不是美食家，坡道洋葱是一种非常辛辣的野洋葱，在中西部的季节大约有一个月。

paras.en: Nelson: They lose their minds. People lose their ever plant-loving minds over them.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊：他们失去了理智。人们对它们失去了对植物的热爱。

paras.en: Martha Stewart wrote one article about them two decades ago, and the ramps have not recovered since. And you will see people, in order to be able to stock, like, farmers markets in Manhattan and in order to be able to stock, you know, the kitchens of Michelin-starred restaurants around the country, coming into places like southeast Ohio, coming into West Virginia, and filling up trash bags with this plant that frequently can take nearly a decade to reach maturity. You know, [it] can sometimes take 10 years before it is at a point where it can be procreating, creating seeds. Those seeds take an additional two years then to break down their seed coat and germinate. So you, you do have to be using your noggin when you’re going out and gathering.
paras.zh: 玛莎·斯图尔特二十年前写了一篇关于它们的文章，自那以后坡道就再也没有恢复过。你会看到人们，为了能够进货，比如曼哈顿的农贸市场，为了能够进货，你知道，全国各地米其林星级餐厅的厨房，来到俄亥俄州东南部、西弗吉尼亚州等地，用这种植物装满垃圾袋，而这种植物通常需要近十年才能成熟。你知道，[它]有时需要 10 年才能达到可以繁殖、产生种子的程度。这些种子还需要两年的时间才能分解种皮并发芽。所以，当你出去聚会时，你确实必须使用你的头脑。

paras.en: And if you’re just gathering enough for you and your family to have a mess of greens for a couple nights in the spring and to pickle a couple jars of bulbs, that’s totally fine. I’m not the person who’s gonna be, like, pick-shaming people for going and gathering ramps. They’re a wonderful springtime treat. But yeah, the second that you put money into the equation and start putting more steps in between the gathering and the consuming of the plant, the muddier the waters become, the less careful the people doing the gathering suddenly start to be because you have this magical dollar sign hovering over your head that you’re chasing.
paras.zh: 如果你收集的只是足够你和你的家人在春天的几个晚上吃一堆蔬菜并腌制几罐球茎，那就完全没问题了。我不是那种会因为人们去和聚集坡道而羞辱他们的人。它们是春天的美妙享受。但是，是的，当你把钱投入方程式并开始在植物的采集和消耗之间采取更多步骤时，水变得越浑浊，采集的人突然开始变得不那么小心，因为你的头顶上盘旋着你正在追逐的神奇美元符号。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah. So let’s talk about your book. Who is it for, and what are they going to come away with after reading it?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的。那么我们来谈谈你的书吧。它是为谁而写的，读完之后他们会得到什么？

paras.en: Nelson: My book is for current and future foragers. I think people assume you have to be at my level to be considered a forager, and I think if you just go and dig up the dandelions in your backyard, congratulations, you are a forager. Your laminated name tag will be in the mail shortly, I promise. And I want this book to help people recognize that and also help them recognize that you don’t have to live in the middle of the woods on an expansive piece of land in order to become a forager.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊：我的书是为当前和未来的觅食者而写的。我认为人们认为你必须达到我的水平才能被视为采集者，而且我认为如果你去后院挖蒲公英，恭喜你，你就是采集者。我保证，您的层压姓名标签很快就会寄出。我希望这本书能够帮助人们认识到这一点，也帮助他们认识到你不必住在树林中央、广阔的土地上才能成为一名采集者。

paras.en: There are so many opportunities. I live in the middle of a city. I love getting—you know, another question I get a lot is “Oh, where do you live where you find all of the”—Columbus, Ohio. We often don’t take stock of the plants that do exist around us. Even if you feel like you’re living in a concrete jungle, odds purslane is still coming up out of the sidewalk cracks. There you go. That’s a snack that you could be foraging. Make sure it’s not in a place where a dog could have peed on it, but you know, that’s still something forageable in the heat of summer, surrounded by nothing but industry and concrete.
paras.zh: 有很多机会。我住在城市的中心。我喜欢——你知道，我经常收到的另一个问题是“哦，你住在哪里，你可以找到所有这些”——俄亥俄州哥伦布市。我们通常不会评估我们周围确实存在的植物。即使你感觉自己生活在水泥丛林中，马齿苋仍然会从人行道的裂缝中冒出来。就这样吧。这是你可以寻找的零食。确保它不在狗可能撒尿的地方，但你知道，在炎热的夏天，这仍然是可以觅食的东西，周围除了工业和混凝土之外什么也没有。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah, very cool. What are some other of your favorite sort of like gateway-drug foraging things that, like, are more abundant than people realize, that they’re gonna love once they try them, and then they won’t be able to stop picking stuff?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的，非常酷。你最喜欢的其他一些东西，比如入门毒品寻找的东西，比人们想象的要丰富，一旦他们尝试过，他们就会喜欢上，然后他们就无法停止挑选东西？

paras.en: Nelson: Ooh, my favorite is actually a throwback for both of us, Rachel, and that is serviceberries, which secretly have a million names. If I don’t call them by the name that you at home specifically call them, I’m so sorry, but we don’t have time....
paras.zh: 尼尔森：哦，我最喜欢的实际上是我们俩的复古，雷切尔，那就是serviceberry，它秘密地有一百万个名字。如果我没有用你在家里专门称呼他们的名字来称呼他们，我很抱歉，但我们没有时间......

paras.en: Feltman: And you can go listen to my other show,The Weirdest Thing I Learned This Week, if you want to hear, still probably not literally every name for the serviceberry, but many more of them.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：如果你想听的话，你可以去听我的另一个节目《本周我学到的最奇怪的事情》，可能仍然不是所有服务莓的名字，而是更多。

paras.en: Nelson: They’re such a popular planting for parks and lining city streets because they’re resilient, their foliage is beautiful in the autumn, and their fruits are so good. Amelanchier arborea is the species that I see used in parks globally the most. I saw an Amelanchier arborea in the middle of Tokyo earlier this year.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：它们在公园和城市街道上很受欢迎，因为它们生命力强，叶子在秋天很漂亮，而且果实也很好吃。 Amelanchier arborea 是我看到全球公园中使用最多的物种。今年早些时候，我在东京市中心看到了阿梅兰奇尔树丛。

paras.en: So when I say that there is one hiding near you, that is not a joke. Unless you live right around the equator, where it’s a little too toasty for them, you will probably find a park close to you that has these guys, and they are such a springtime treat. You might have to fight some birds for them. I have an uneasy truce with the robins in my neighborhood. They’re like, “You don’t bring out the berry rake, we don’t poop on you. That’s the deal.”
paras.zh: 所以当我说你附近藏着一个人时，这不是开玩笑。除非你住在赤道附近，那里的气候对它们来说有点太热了，否则你可能会发现靠近你的一个公园里有这些家伙，它们是春天的一种享受。你可能必须为了它们而与一些鸟战斗。我和附近的知更鸟达成了不安的休战协议。他们就像是，“你不拿出浆果耙，我们就不会在你身上拉屎。就这么定了。”

paras.en: Feltman: Well, and so as an experienced forager, I would also love to hear, to inspire our guests for their future foraging endeavors: What are some of the more surprising or challenging things that you have foraged yourself?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，作为一名经验丰富的采集者，我也很想听听，以激励我们的客人未来的采集工作：您自己采集到的一些更令人惊讶或更具挑战性的东西是什么？

paras.en: Nelson: Ooh. Well, I was in Glacier National Park last summer and just hanging out on a mountainside, eating alpine strawberries. That was fun and worth it. I mean, that hike did kick my whole butt. But also, if you’ve never had a wild strawberry, I need you to pencil it in for next summer because the amount of flavor that gets packed into one of those little guys is insane. They’re so good.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊：哦。嗯，去年夏天我在冰川国家公园的山腰上闲逛，吃着高山草莓。那很有趣而且值得。我的意思是，那次徒步旅行确实让我大吃一惊。而且，如果你从来没有吃过野草莓，我需要你把它记下来以备明年夏天使用，因为这些小家伙的味道实在是太疯狂了。他们太好了。

paras.en: Feltman: Well, another one that I would love to hear more about, I think you recently did some ocean pickling, uh, which of course, so much interesting science there. So for our listeners who don’t follow you yet online, it would be great if you could tell us a little bit about that one.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，另一个我很想听听更多的事情，我想你最近做了一些海洋腌制，呃，当然，那里有很多有趣的科学。因此，对于尚未在网上关注您的听众来说，如果您能告诉我们一些有关该问题的信息，那就太好了。

paras.en: Nelson: So I love food history, especially when it comes to things like foraging and fermentation and older food preservation methods. And there is a pretty strong bit of evidence for humans discovering lacto-fermented pickles through preserving things in saltwater, because frequently, so long as it hasn’t rained super recently, ocean water is right around the salinity that you want to make a good sour lacto-fermented pickle—like, high 2 percent to high 3 percent range, enough that you get some good salty flavor but also not so salty that the lactobacteria can’t get really active and create that delicious lactic acid that we love, that wonderful crisp acidity that we love from a good pickle.
paras.zh: 尼尔森：所以我喜欢食物历史，特别是当涉及到诸如觅食和发酵以及古老的食物保存方法之类的事情时。有相当有力的证据表明，人类通过在盐水中保存东西来发现乳发酵泡菜，因为通常，只要最近没有下雨，海水的盐度就正好是你想要制作好的酸乳发酵泡菜的盐度，例如，高 2% 到高 3% 的范围，足以让你获得一些好的咸味，但也不会太咸，以至于乳酸菌无法真正活跃并产生美味的乳酸我们喜欢的，我们喜欢来自优质泡菜的美妙清脆的酸度。

paras.en: So to showcase this, while I was visiting some of my family on Martha’s Vineyard—far away from industry, I promise, that’s always everyone’s biggest fear—I checked the water quality levels before I did this. I gathered up a bunch of seawater, put it through multiple layers of filtration. We filtered out the bits, big and small, brought it up to a rolling boil for just a moment, just to kill off anything too small to be able to be filtered out.
paras.zh: 因此，为了展示这一点，当我在玛莎葡萄园岛拜访我的一些家人时（远离工业区，我保证，这始终是每个人最大的恐惧），我在这样做之前检查了水质水平。我收集了一堆海水，将其经过多层过滤。我们过滤掉大大小小的碎片，将其煮沸一会儿，只是为了杀死任何太小而无法过滤掉的东西。

paras.en: And then I have pickled beets, jalapeños, garlic. They all pickle beautifully. And due to the fact that our ocean water, it’s not just sodium making a salt in the ocean, we also have some magnesium salts in there, too, which I think add to the flavor profile of the pickles. They are pretty slammin’, if I may say so myself. And I love an excuse to sneakily shove some science education into my videos.
paras.zh: 然后我吃了腌甜菜、墨西哥辣椒和大蒜。它们都腌得很漂亮。由于我们的海水，不仅仅是钠在海洋中形成盐，我们还含有一些镁盐，我认为这会增加泡菜的风味。如果我可以自己这么说的话，他们真是太猛烈了。我喜欢找借口偷偷地将一些科学教育塞进我的视频中。

paras.en: Feltman: Amazing. Well, thank you so much for coming on to chat with us. This has been wonderful.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：太棒了。嗯，非常感谢您接受我们的采访。这真是太棒了。

paras.en: Nelson: Thank you so much for having me.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊：非常感谢你邀请我。

paras.en: Feltman: That’s all for today’s episode. We’ll be back on Monday with our usual science news roundup.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：这就是今天这一集的全部内容。我们将在周一带着我们通常的科学新闻综述回来。

paras.en: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman. Have a great weekend!
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》的这位人物是雷切尔·费尔特曼 (Rachel Feltman)。周末愉快！

articles.title: How AI helped bring an ancient tomb dating to before the Roman empire back to life

paras.en: Although it not always obvious, sound guides how we experience the world around us. And the latest archaeoacoustic techniques show that even the world’s earliest architects understood this.
paras.zh: 尽管声音并不总是显而易见，但它指导着我们如何体验周围的世界。最新的考古声学技术表明，即使是世界上最早的建筑师也明白这一点。

paras.en: The ancient pre-Roman society of Etruria in central Italy, for example, embedded sound throughout its culture, using ritual calendars dedicated to recognising key noises of nature, such as thunder. They were also early pioneers of musical instruments in the southern Mediterranean region.
paras.zh: 例如，意大利中部的古前罗马社会伊特鲁里亚将声音嵌入到其文化中，使用仪式日历致力于识别自然的关键噪音，例如雷声。他们也是地中海南部地区乐器的早期先驱。

paras.en: Surviving Etruscan painted tombs in towns such as Tarquinia, Chiusi and Orvieto are known for their dynamic scenes of music, feasting and the afterlife. But our latest research shows how these tombs – built for Etruscans of higher socioeconomic and political status—were designed to offer sophisticated sensory experiences.
paras.zh: 塔尔奎尼亚、丘西和奥维多等城镇中幸存的伊特鲁里亚彩绘坟墓以其充满活力的音乐、宴会和来世场景而闻名。但我们最新的研究表明，这些为社会经济和政治地位较高的伊特鲁里亚人建造的坟墓是如何设计的，旨在提供复杂的感官体验。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: This study springs from our existing research involving artificial intelligence (AI) and acoustics. This includes the University of Oxford-led Sounds of Silence project, which has used new acoustic techniques to investigate the soundscapes surrounding these Etruscan tombs. At Duke University, meanwhile, the Neuroartifact project is using neuroscience and AI to better understand the cognitive impact of archaeological artifacts.
paras.zh: 这项研究源于我们现有的涉及人工智能 (AI) 和声学的研究。其中包括牛津大学领导的“沉默之声”项目，该项目使用新的声学技术来研究这些伊特鲁里亚坟墓周围的声景。与此同时，杜克大学的 Neuroartifact 项目正在利用神经科学和人工智能来更好地了解考古文物对认知的影响。

paras.en: We have combined all these techniques to shed fresh light on two 5th-century BC Etruscan painted tombs: Tomba dei Demoni Azzurri (Tomb of the Blue Demons) and Tomba del Gallo (Tomb of the Rooster).
paras.zh: 我们将所有这些技术结合起来，为两座公元前 5 世纪的伊特鲁里亚彩绘坟墓提供了新的线索：Tomba dei Demoni Azzurri（蓝色恶魔之墓）和 Tomba del Gallo（公鸡之墓）。

paras.en: Our research suggests these tombs were designed and constructed not simply to house the dead, but to affect the living through a sensorily immersive environment similar to a modern 3D film experience.
paras.zh: 我们的研究表明，这些坟墓的设计和建造不仅仅是为了安置死者，而是为了通过类似于现代 3D 电影体验的沉浸式感官环境来影响生者。

paras.en: Archaeologists have tended to look at the paintings in these burial chambers as two-dimensional images to analyze. Our goal was to capture the “performing power”of these ancient monuments, using a combination of acoustic, visual and AI technology.
paras.zh: 考古学家倾向于将这些墓室中的绘画视为二维图像来分析。我们的目标是结合声学、视觉和人工智能技术，捕捉这些古老古迹的“表演力量”。

paras.en: Upon walking into the Blue Demon tomb for the first time, I (Jacqueline) was immediately struck how the paintings seemed to confront me wherever I turned. Merry banqueters on the rear wall appeared unaware of the demons crawling up the side wall, as though ready to burst into the chamber itself.
paras.zh: 第一次走进蓝魔坟墓时，我（杰奎琳）立即感到惊讶的是，无论我转身，这些画似乎都在我面前。后墙上的快乐宴会者似乎没有意识到恶魔爬上了侧墙，仿佛准备冲进房间本身。

paras.en: My experience was, though, shaped by modern LED lighting. Ancient viewers would have relied on beeswax and tallow candles, incense burners and torches. The dim lighting would have both constrained their movement through the tomb and heightened their experience of what they were seeing.
paras.zh: 不过，我的经历是受到现代 LED 照明的影响。古代观众会依靠蜂蜡和牛脂蜡烛、香炉和火把。昏暗的灯光既限制了他们在坟墓中的移动，又增强了他们对所见事物的体验。

paras.en: Our research presents the first investigation of subterranean funerary spaces in Etruria as “transitional spaces” between life and death.
paras.zh: 我们的研究首次对伊特鲁里亚的地下殡葬空间作为生与死之间的“过渡空间”进行了调查。

paras.en: The senses of anyone entering these tombs were heavily manipulated. Intense sound effects—such as the exceptionally long reverberation and echoes inside the Blue Demon tomb—gave a dramatic soundtrack to this intense, immersive experience.
paras.zh: 任何进入这些坟墓的人的感官都受到了严重的操纵。强烈的音效——例如蓝魔墓穴内超长的混响和回声——为这种强烈、身临其境的体验提供了戏剧性的配乐。

paras.en: Torchlight or candles flickering across painted figures would have created movement amid the shadows. Incense and the smell of libations (ceremonial liquids) added yet another sensory dimension.
paras.zh: 火炬光或蜡烛在彩绘人物上闪烁，会在阴影中产生运动。熏香和奠酒（仪式液体）的气味又增添了另一个感官维度。

paras.en: Our reconstructions support the idea that some Etruscan painted tombs were used and reused to perpetuate the legacy and power of their families or clans. They may have been kept open throughout the year for rituals commemorating important dates and festivals, as well as the worshipping of the dead.
paras.zh: 我们的重建支持这样的想法：一些伊特鲁里亚彩绘坟墓被使用和重复使用，以延续其家庭或氏族的遗产和权力。它们可能全年开放，用于纪念重要日期和节日的仪式以及对死者的崇拜。

paras.en: The sophisticated design of these tombs is striking. While the Blue Demon induces perceptual disorientation, the Rooster privileges visual attention and the architectural discipline of gaze.
paras.zh: 这些坟墓的复杂设计令人惊叹。蓝色恶魔会引起知觉迷失，而公鸡则优先考虑视觉注意力和凝视的建筑纪律。

paras.en: The tomb’s entrance passage, with narrowing walls and descending axis, creates a liminal stage to orient the body before entering the burial chamber. There, trenches, benches, niches and other architectural devices are carved into the floor and walls—adding to the drama of the paintings covering the walls.
paras.zh: 坟墓的入口通道，墙壁变窄，轴线下降，在进入墓室之前创造了一个阈限阶段，为尸体定位。在那里，地板和墙壁上刻有战壕、长凳、壁龛和其他建筑装置，为覆盖墙壁的绘画增添了戏剧性。

paras.en: Together, these architectural and symbolic elements mediate between order and chaos, memory and transformation. Our work re-imagines these ancient tombs as theatrical spaces, built to perpetuate a form of metaphysical human experience.
paras.zh: 这些建筑和象征元素共同在秩序与混乱、记忆与转变之间发挥作用。我们的作品将这些古墓重新想象为戏剧空间，旨在延续某种形而上的人类经验。

paras.en: In our interpretation, these tombs should not simply be viewed as depositories for the dead. They would have made a deep impression on the living, through their physical and sensory organization.
paras.zh: 根据我们的解释，这些坟墓不应简单地被视为死者的存放处。他们会通过他们的身体和感官组织给活着的人留下深刻的印象。

paras.en: In turn, perhaps it is time to reconsider the category of funerary architecture throughout the ancient Mediterranean and beyond. The combined engineering of spatial, acoustic and visual experiences is, perhaps, still not fully appreciated.
paras.zh: 反过来，也许是时候重新考虑整个古地中海及其他地区的丧葬建筑类别了。空间、听觉和视觉体验的综合工程也许还没有得到充分的重视。

paras.en: But the story does not end here. Our research is already leading in new directions beyond ancient interiors. We are using similar acoustic and AI techniques to investigate exterior landscapes that were used for ritual activities, both in the wider southern Mediterranean and beyond.
paras.zh: 但故事并没有就此结束。我们的研究已经引领了古代室内装饰之外的新方向。我们正在使用类似的声学和人工智能技术来调查用于仪式活动的外部景观，无论是在更广阔的地中海南部还是其他地区。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: How the brain uses memory to imagine what might have been

paras.en: A month ago philosopher Felipe De Brigard received a strange phone call. “Are you in a private place where you can have a private conversation?” the voice on the other end asked.
paras.zh: 一个月前，哲学家费利佩·德布里加德接到一个奇怪的电话。 “你们是在一个可以进行私人谈话的私人场所吗？”那头的声音问道。

paras.en: He was on a work retreat surrounded by colleagues. “Just say you need to talk about your taxes,” the caller said. De Brigard excused himself to find a private space, panicking the whole time about his taxes—but it was actually the MacArthur Foundation on the line. De Brigard had been awarded a prestigious “genius grant,” an $800,000 fellowship with no strings attached.
paras.zh: 他正在一次工作静修中，周围都是同事。 “只要说你需要谈谈你的税收，”来电者说。德布里加德借口找了一个私人空间，一直对他的税收感到恐慌——但实际上是麦克阿瑟基金会打来的。德布里加德获得了一项著名的“天才补助金”，这是一笔价值 80 万美元、无任何附加条件的奖学金。
