articles.title: How the eviction of an 87-year-old became Spain's 'last straw'
articles.author: Tessa Flemming

paras.en: It was an image of an 87-year-old woman on a stretcher, wheeled out by paramedics, that sparked a national movement.
paras.zh: 一张躺在担架上的 87 岁妇女被护理人员推出的照片引发了一场全国性的运动。

paras.en: Maricarmen Abascal had lived in her Madrid apartment for more than 70 years.
paras.zh: Maricarmen Abascal 在她位于马德里的公寓里住了 70 多年。

paras.en: She took over the lease her father signed in 1956, and enjoyed capped rent.
paras.zh: 她接手了父亲1956年签署的租约，并享受租金上限。

paras.en: Then, in 2018, her apartment was bought by an investment firm.
paras.zh: 然后，2018年，她的公寓被一家投资公司买下了。

paras.en: The monthly rent soon soared from €500 ($811) to €1,650 ($2,678).
paras.zh: 月租金很快从 500 欧元（811 美元）飙升至 1,650 欧元（2,678 美元）。

paras.en: And Maricarmen, a pensioner with a disability whose monthly benefits total €1,350 ($2,192), was forced out in a court-ordered eviction.
paras.zh: Maricarmen 是一名残疾养老金领取者，每月福利总额为 1,350 欧元（2,192 美元），在法院下令驱逐中被迫离开。

paras.en: For Spaniards, the eviction stirred up a deep-seated anger over a housing crisis that has only worsened in recent years.
paras.zh: 对于西班牙人来说，驱逐激起了人们对住房危机的根深蒂固的愤怒，而这种危机近年来不断恶化。

paras.en: Previously, protests included flotillas in the path of cruise ships and water pistol protests, as locals blamed tourism for housing unaffordability.
paras.zh: 此前，抗议活动包括船队挡住游轮航线和水枪抗议，当地人将住房负担不起归咎于旅游业。

paras.en: But it is Maricarmen's plight that could be the catalyst for real change to protect renters.
paras.zh: 但马里卡门的困境可能成为保护租房者的真正变革的催化剂。

paras.en: Days before her eviction, Maricarmen walked writer David Uclés through her Retiro home of more than seven decades.
paras.zh: 在被驱逐的前几天，马里卡门带着作家大卫·尤克莱斯参观了她在雷蒂罗居住了七十多年的家。

paras.en: She showed him the living room where she watched the coverage of former Spanish leader and dictator Francisco Franco's death in 1975.
paras.zh: 她带他参观了客厅，在那里她观看了 1975 年西班牙前领导人兼独裁者弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥去世的报道。

paras.en: She showed him the bedrooms where her mother and father drew their final breaths.
paras.zh: 她带他参观了她父母最后呼吸的卧室。

paras.en: "I've always felt safe here," she told Uclés and Spanish newspaper El País.
paras.zh: “我在这里一直感到安全，”她告诉尤克莱斯和西班牙报纸《国家报》。

paras.en: "My home has been everything to me. I wouldn't exist without it."
paras.zh: “我的家就是我的一切。没有它我就不会存在。”

paras.en: The apartment in the upscale central Madrid suburb has been Maricarmen's sanctuary since she was 17.
paras.zh: 这套位于马德里市中心高档郊区的公寓从 Maricarmen 17 岁起就成了她的庇护所。

paras.en: But for the past eight years, it has also turned into a battleground in her David-and-Goliath fight.
paras.zh: 但在过去的八年里，这里也变成了她以弱胜强的战场。

paras.en: After real estate investment company Urbagestión took over Maricarmen's lease in 2018, it first attempted to raise the rent to €2,650 ($4,313) — a 300 per cent increase.
paras.zh: 房地产投资公司 Urbagestión 于 2018 年接管 Maricarmen 的租约后，首先尝试将租金提高至 2,650 欧元（4,313 美元），涨幅达 300%。

paras.en: That was later decreased to €1,650 ($2,678).
What followed was a drawn-out court feud over the new contract.
paras.zh: 接下来是围绕新合同的旷日持久的法庭争执。

paras.en: Three previous attempts to evict her were blocked by the courts. And with each appeal by Urbagestión, public attention on the case grew.
paras.zh: 此前三次驱逐她的尝试均被法院阻止。随着 Urbagestión 的每一次上诉，公众对此案的关注度都在增加。

paras.en: In June, the UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights called for the pensioner's eviction to be halted and for her to be offered affordable alternative accommodation.
paras.zh: 六月，联合国经济、社会和文化权利委员会呼吁停止驱逐这位养老金领取者，并为她提供负担得起的替代住所。

paras.en: Madrid City Council said later that Maricarmen had declined its offer of a place in an aged care home.
paras.zh: 马德里市议会后来表示，马里卡门拒绝了其在老年护理院提供的住宿机会。

paras.en: Then, in late September, the courts ruled in Urbagestión's favour.
paras.zh: 然后，在 9 月下旬，法院做出了有利于 Urbagestión 的裁决。

paras.en: A groundswell of protesters gathered at Maricarmen's address to protect the pensioner.
paras.zh: 大批抗议者聚集在马里卡门的演讲前，以保护这位养老金领取者。

paras.en: "Fight for your housing because we have the right to it," she told the crowd of hundreds on September 22.
paras.zh: 9 月 22 日，她对数百人说：“为你们的住房而战，因为我们有权获得它。”

paras.en: The next morning, police officers beat down Maricarmen's door.
paras.zh: 第二天早上，警察敲开了马里卡门的门。

paras.en: Reporters were cordoned off, and several demonstrators were dragged away.
paras.zh: 记者被封锁，几名示威者被拖走。

paras.en: Over the past decade, the average rental price per square metre in Spain has almost doubled, reaching €15.10 ($24.62) per square metre in August, according to real estate portal Idealista.
paras.zh: 根据房地产门户网站 Idealista 的数据，在过去十年中，西班牙每平方米的平均租金价格几乎翻了一番，8 月份达到每平方米 15.10 欧元（24.62 美元）。

paras.en: The Bank of Spain estimates that the country of about 50 million people is short of 700,000 homes, based on the gap between demand and new construction.
paras.zh: 西班牙央行根据需求与新建房屋之间的差距估计，这个拥有约 5000 万人口的国家缺少 70 万套住房。

paras.en: Social housing in Spain makes up less than 2 per cent of the housing stock, according to Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development data.
paras.zh: 根据经济合作与发展组织的数据，西班牙的社会住房仅占住房存量的不到 2%。

paras.en: The European Union average is about 6–7 per cent.
paras.zh: 欧盟的平均水平约为 6-7%。

paras.en: Protesters did not back down as Maricarmen recovered in hospital.
paras.zh: 当马里卡门在医院康复时，抗议者并没有退缩。

paras.en: Instead, they built a tent encampment in Puerta del Sol, one of Madrid's busiest landmarks.
paras.zh: 相反，他们在马德里最繁忙的地标之一太阳门搭建了一个帐篷营地。

paras.en: "Maricarmen is one person, but there are many people in this situation," one protester said.
paras.zh: 一名抗议者说：“马里卡门是一个人，但有很多人处于这种情况。”

paras.en: "We want the right to decent housing for all."
paras.zh: “我们希望所有人都有权获得体面的住房。”

paras.en: A 43-year-old teacher, Simón de la Riva, said: "Maricarmen has been, in a way, the last straw that sparked this social unrest, but we've been dealing with this whole issue for a long time now."
paras.zh: 43 岁的教师西蒙·德拉里瓦 (Simón de la Riva) 表示：“从某种程度上来说，马里卡门是引发这场社会动荡的最后一根稻草，但我们已经处理这整个问题很长时间了。”

paras.en: The encampment was led largely by Madrid's Tenant Union, with aims set out by spokesperson Valeria Racu.
paras.zh: 该营地主要由马德里租户联盟领导，其目标由发言人瓦莱里娅·拉库（Valeria Racu）制定。

paras.en: Either the investment rental falls or the government falls: "Let it be very clear," she said.
paras.zh: 要么投资租金下降，要么政府垮台：“说得非常清楚，”她说。

paras.en: Spain is expected to head to an election in less than 12 months.
paras.zh: 预计西​​班牙将在不到 12 个月的时间内举行大选。

paras.en: Still facing heat over the Ceuta crisis, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has told the public he is working "against the clock" to bring new housing regulations into law.
paras.zh: 仍面临休达危机的压力，总理佩德罗·桑切斯告诉公众，他正在“争分夺秒”地将新的住房法规纳入法律。

paras.en: The new decrees would be "for Maricarmen and for the millions of Spaniards who are suffering from the housing crisis".
paras.zh: 新法令将“为了马里卡门和数百万遭受住房危机的西班牙人”。

paras.en: "This is not a question of ideology; it is a question of humanity,"
paras.zh: “这不是意识形态问题，而是人性问题”

paras.en: "We didn't think this was going to happen because situations like this happen all the time," Urbagestión co-owner Ricardo Alonso told conservative outlet Horizonte.
paras.zh: Urbagestión 共同所有人里卡多·阿隆索 (Ricardo Alonso) 告诉保守派媒体 Horizo​​nte：“我们认为这种情况不会发生，因为这样的情况一直在发生。”

paras.en: He said protesters had pursued and overwhelmed the company.
paras.zh: 他说，抗议者追赶并淹没了该公司。

paras.en: After five days of protest and more than four hours of meetings, Urbagestión offered Maricarmen a new eight-year rental contract on September 28.
paras.zh: 经过五天的抗议和四个多小时的会议，Urbagestión 于 9 月 28 日向 Maricarmen 提供了一份新的八年租赁合同。

paras.en: The contract came with a capped rent that would not exceed 30 per cent of her net income, similar to what she paid before the company took over in 2018.
paras.zh: 该合同附带的租金上限不会超过她净收入的 30%，与 2018 年公司接管之前她支付的租金类似。

paras.en: Mr Sánchez followed shortly after, with two new housing measures.
paras.zh: 桑切斯先生紧随其后，推出了两项新的住房措施。

paras.en: Among his promises were plans to stop "vulture funds" from buying in bulk then reselling properties at higher prices; an eviction ban on vulnerable tenants until 2030; and a new tax on seasonal rentals.
paras.zh: 他的承诺包括计划阻止“秃鹫基金”大量购买房产然后以更高的价格转售； 2030 年之前禁止驱逐弱势租户；以及针对季节性租金的新税。

paras.en: But Spain's Congress on Friday rejected those measures, heightening speculation that Mr Sánchez, who does not have a congressional majority, may call an early general election.
paras.zh: 但西班牙国会周五拒绝了这些措施，加剧了人们对桑切斯先生可能会提前举行大选的猜测，桑切斯先生在国会中不占多数。

paras.en: Madrid's tent encampment shows no sign of packing up.
paras.zh: 马德里的帐篷营地没有任何收拾行李的迹象。

paras.en: Elsewhere, more tent cities are popping up across Spain — in Barcelona, Seville and even the tourist mecca of Palma de Mallorca, in the Balearic Islands.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，更多的帐篷城市正在西班牙各地涌现——巴塞罗那、塞维利亚，甚至巴利阿里群岛的旅游圣地马略卡岛帕尔马。

paras.en: In Madrid, the tenants' union said mass protests would go ahead on Saturday, local time, while crowds had already met outside Spain's assembly chanting "your profits, our misery", according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，在马德里，租户工会表示大规模抗议活动将于当地时间周六继续进行，而人群已经聚集在西班牙议会外，高呼“你的利润，我们的苦难”。

paras.en: "There are years when nothing happens, and weeks when history is made. This could be one of them," the union said in a statement.
paras.zh: 工会在一份声明中表示：“有几年什么都没有发生，有几周创造历史。这可能就是其中之一。”

paras.en: From her hospital bed, Maricarmen continued to champion those who had supported her.
paras.zh: 在病床上，马里卡门继续支持那些支持她的人。

paras.en: "I have fought so that others can learn to fight for what's theirs," she said.
paras.zh: “我奋斗是为了让其他人能够学会为属于他们的东西而奋斗，”她说。

paras.en: It is a fight symbolic of the slogan some have used in the days since the pensioner's eviction.
paras.zh: 这是一场象征着自养老金领取者被驱逐以来一些人使用的口号的斗争。

paras.en: A slogan that hints this fight is anything but over.
paras.zh: 这句口号暗示这场战斗还没有结束。

paras.en: "Until the end comrades, as Maricarmen has taught us."
paras.zh: “直到最后，同志们，正如马里卡门教给我们的那样。”

articles.title: Australian arrested for holding 'pistol-like object' in Hong Kong

paras.en: An Australian man has been arrested after being spotted with a "pistol-like object" in a bar in Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子在香港一家酒吧被发现携带“手枪状物体”后被捕。

paras.en: The Hong Kong Police Force alleges the man then damaged a wall and a smoke detector while in custody.
paras.zh: 香港警务处称，该男子在拘留期间损坏了墙壁和烟雾探测器。

paras.en: An expert says possession of an imitation firearm carries a maximum penalty of two years' imprisonment.
paras.zh: 一位专家表示，拥有仿制枪支最高可判处两年监禁。

paras.en: An Australian man has been in custody in Hong Kong after being arrested on suspicion of carrying what appeared to be a gun and causing property damage.
paras.zh: 一名澳大利亚男子因涉嫌携带疑似枪支并造成财产损失而被捕，目前在香港被拘留。

paras.en: The Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) deployed counterterrorism officers and the Emergency Unit, after reports the 36-year-old tourist was "holding a pistol-like object" on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，有报道称这名 36 岁的游客“持有手枪状物体”，香港警务处 (HKPF) 部署了反恐人员和冲锋队。

paras.en: Pictures seen by the ABC showed the man with his face covered by a black hood as he was taken away in a police vehicle in the district of Jordan.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司看到的照片显示，这名男子在约旦地区被一辆警车带走，他的脸被黑色头罩遮住。

paras.en: Despite multiple local media reports that the object seized was a "toy gun", the ABC could not independently verify the claim.
paras.zh: 尽管多家当地媒体报道称查获的物品是一把“玩具枪”，但澳大利亚广播公司无法独立核实这一说法。

paras.en: In a statement to the ABC, a spokesperson for HKPF confirmed the man has been charged with one count of possession of an imitation firearm and one count of criminal damage.
paras.zh: 香港警察发言人在给澳大利亚广播公司的一份声明中证实，该男子已被指控一项持有仿制枪支罪和一项刑事毁坏罪。

paras.en: "Police officers arrived at the scene and a suspected air gun was seized," a HKPF spokesperson told ABC News.
paras.zh: 香港警察发言人告诉美国广播公司新闻：“警察到达现场，缴获了一把疑似气枪。”

paras.en: "While in custody at Yau Ma Tei Police Station, he damaged a wall and a smoke detector, leading to an additional offence of criminal damage."
paras.zh: “在油麻地警署羁押期间，他损坏了墙壁和烟雾探测器，导致追加刑事毁坏罪。”

paras.en: The case will be mentioned at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today.
paras.zh: 案件将于今日在西九龙裁判法院提堂。

paras.en: The Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) told the ABC it was providing consular assistance to the family of the Australian citizen.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚外交和贸易部（DFAT）告诉澳大利亚广播公司，它正在向澳大利亚公民的家人提供领事协助。

paras.en: HKPF said officers were first alerted just after 10pm on Wednesday, after the man was reportedly spotted carrying "a pistol-like object" in an alleyway near Shanghai Street in the Yau Ma Tei district of the city.
paras.zh: 香港警务处表示，周三晚上 10 点刚过，警方首次收到警报，因为据报该男子被发现在油麻地区上海街附近的一条小巷里携带“手枪状物体”。

paras.en: About 15 minutes later, police reportedly received a second report that the man had tried to enter a bar in the Jordan district.
paras.zh: 据报道，大约15分钟后，警方接到第二份报告，称该男子试图进入约旦区的一家酒吧。

paras.en: Local media outlet The Standard reported the man had entered the bar to use the toilet, but a staff member called the police and asked him to leave.
paras.zh: 当地媒体《标准报》报道称，该男子进入酒吧上厕所，但一名工作人员报了警并要求他离开。

paras.en: The outlet also reported the man was on holiday with his family and had been drinking alcohol.
paras.zh: 该媒体还报道称，该男子当时正在与家人一起度假，并且一直在喝酒。

paras.en: Hong Kong has strict laws governing firearms and imitation firearms, although toy guns are legally available in some shops.
paras.zh: 尽管玩具枪可以在一些商店合法销售，但香港对枪支和仿制枪支有严格的法律管理。

paras.en: Authorities have tightened security measures in recent years following the large-scale anti-extradition protest in 2019.
paras.zh: 自2019年大规模反逃犯送中抗议活动发生后，当局近年来加强了安全措施。

paras.en: Enshen Li, associate professor at City University of Hong Kong said the consequences would depend on whether the object seized by police was legally considered an imitation firearm or a toy.
paras.zh: 香港城市大学副教授李恩深表示，后果将取决于警方扣押的物品在法律上是否被视为仿制枪械或玩具。

paras.en: Dr Li said possession of an imitation firearm could be an offence under Hong Kong's Firearms and Ammunition Ordinance, carrying a maximum penalty of two years' imprisonment.
paras.zh: 李博士表示，根据香港《枪械及弹药条例》，拥有仿制枪械可能构成犯罪，最高可判处两年监禁。

paras.en: If the object turned out to be a toy gun, he said a possible charge would be negligently discharging an air gun in a way that endangered or annoyed others, which carried a maximum penalty of a $HK500 ($90) fine or three months in prison.
paras.zh: 他表示，如果该物体最终是一把玩具枪，可能的指控是疏忽地以气枪的方式开枪，危及或惹恼他人，最高可判处 500 港元（90 美元）罚款或三个月监禁。

paras.en: "The judge will consider all relevant mitigating and aggravating factors when deciding the sentence," Dr Li said.
paras.zh: “法官在判决时会考虑所有相关的减刑和加重因素，”李博士说。

articles.title: Verity is the latest Colleen Hoover novel to get a film adaptation
articles.author: Mawunyo Gbogbo

paras.en: Hollywood loves a Colleen Hoover adaptation.
paras.zh: 好莱坞喜欢科琳·胡佛的改编作品。

paras.en: The latest is psychological thriller Verity.
paras.zh: 最新的是心理惊悚片《Verity》。

paras.en: In the film, struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson) is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford (Oscar winner Anne Hathaway).
paras.zh: 在影片中，苦苦挣扎的作家洛文·阿什利（达科塔·约翰逊饰）被聘请为著名作家维里蒂·克劳福德（奥斯卡奖得主安妮·海瑟薇饰）的代笔人。

paras.en: It starts out as an assignment taken under mysterious circumstances, with Lowen recruited by Verity's husband, Jeremy (Josh Hartnett).
paras.zh: 故事一开始是在神秘的情况下执行的一项任务，洛文被维蒂的丈夫杰里米（乔什·哈奈特饰）招募。

paras.en: But when Lowen uncovers what appears to be chilling autobiographical confessions in Verity's notes, she wrestles with these disturbing and twisted revelations.
paras.zh: 但当洛文在维蒂的笔记中发现了看似令人毛骨悚然的自传式忏悔时，她为这些令人不安和扭曲的揭露而苦苦挣扎。

paras.en: Verity is a glossy thriller punctuated by its beautiful people and slick presentation.
paras.zh: 《Verity》是一部光鲜亮丽的惊悚片，其美丽的人物和流畅的表演不时出现。

paras.en: It's a fun watch that ends on a tantalising cliffhanger, which is almost as scandalous as it is unexpectedly satisfying.
paras.zh: 这是一部有趣的手表，结局是一个诱人的悬念，这几乎与令人震惊的同时却出乎意料地令人满意。

paras.en: But critics have both emphatically praised the film and have had scathing reactions.
paras.zh: 但影评人对这部电影既给予了大力赞扬，又做出了严厉的反应。

paras.en: The Sydney Morning Herald called Verity "perfect for these post-truth times".
paras.zh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》称 Verity“非常适合后真相时代”。

paras.en: Mamamia referred to it as a "delicious" thriller.
paras.zh: 《妈妈咪呀》称其为“美味”的惊悚片。

paras.en: But The Nightly called it "diabolical", saying it was "embarrassing" for its A-list stars to be "dragged" into the film.
paras.zh: 但《晚间晚报》称其为“恶魔”，称其一线明星被“拖入”这部电影是“令人尴尬的”。

paras.en: Who, meanwhile, has categorised it as a "straight to DVD territory" type of movie.
paras.zh: 与此同时，谁将其归类为“直接进入 DVD 领域”类型的电影。

paras.en: One of Hoover's biggest outings since It Ends with Us
paras.zh: 自《与我们同在》以来胡佛最大的外出活动之一

paras.en: As far as Hoover adaptations go, Verity comes after Reminders of Him (2026) and Regretting You (2025), but the internet is still talking about 2024's It Ends with Us.
paras.zh: 就胡佛的改编而言，《真实》是在《提醒他》（2026 年）和《后悔你》（2025 年）之后推出的，但互联网上仍在谈论 2024 年的《我们终结》。

paras.en: That movie was overshadowed by the off-screen drama between its two stars, Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni.
paras.zh: 这部电影被两位明星布莱克·莱弗利和贾斯汀·巴尔多尼之间的幕后戏剧蒙上了阴影。

paras.en: They have settled their legal battles in a civil case.
paras.zh: 他们已经通过民事案件解决了法律纠纷。

paras.en: Lively had alleged Baldoni conspired with publicists to pre-emptively destroy her reputation after she privately accused him of sexually harassing her on the movie set.
paras.zh: 莱弗利指控巴尔多尼在片场私下指控巴尔多尼对她进行性骚扰后，与公关人员合谋先发制人地破坏她的声誉。

paras.en: From Misery to Yellowface, books about writers are favourites among the authors who pen them, and audiences also love a behind-the-scenes look at the literary world.
paras.zh: 从《苦难》到《黄脸》，有关作家的书籍是作者的最爱，观众也喜欢了解文学世界的幕后花絮。

paras.en: It's fertile ground for novelists writing about a world they're familiar with, setting the stakes high in an imagined narrative.
paras.zh: 对于小说家来说，这是写他们熟悉的世界的沃土，在想象的叙述中赌注很高。

paras.en: The authentic details an author can bring to such a story are what make them so spicy and alluring as they blend reality and fiction.
paras.zh: 作者为这样的故事带来的真实细节使得它们如此辛辣和诱人，因为它们融合了现实和虚构。

paras.en: Verity is based on the worldwide best-selling novel of the same name by Hoover.
paras.zh: 《真理》改编自胡佛的全球畅销同名小说。

paras.en: In 2012, Hoover was the first self-published author to top The New York Times bestseller list, which she did again with Verity in 2018, and is a pioneer of modern indie publishing.
paras.zh: 2012年，胡佛成为第一位登上《纽约时报》畅销书榜首的自行出版作家，并于2018年与Verity合作再次登上榜首，是现代独立出版的先驱。

paras.en: She has since had a great deal of mainstream success.
paras.zh: 此后，她在主流社会取得了巨大的成功。

paras.en: She had already authored 16 romance books prior to that and amassed millions of fans.
paras.zh: 在此之前，她已经创作了16本言情小说，并拥有数百万粉丝。

paras.en: In adapting the novel, director Michael Showalter aimed to produce a film as closely aligned with the book as possible.
paras.zh: 在改编这部小说时，导演迈克尔·肖沃尔特的目标是制作一部尽可能与原著紧密结合的电影。

paras.en: "The book is a big hit, people love it, so let's make a movie out of the book," Showalter said.
paras.zh: “这本书很受欢迎，人们喜欢它，所以让我们根据这本书拍一部电影，”肖沃尔特说。

paras.en: "My approach was to do it the way it was in the book wherever possible.
paras.zh: “我的方法是尽可能按照书中的方式去做。

paras.en: "Let people see what a true adaptation would look and feel like and honour that."
paras.zh: “让人们看到真正的改编会是什么样子和感觉，并尊重这一点。”

articles.title: 'Prepared ourselves for the worst': FlyDubai passenger recounts moments during cockpit attack
articles.author: Anya Zoledziowski

paras.en: 'Prepared ourselves for the worst': FlyDubai passenger recounts moments during cockpit attack
paras.zh: “做好最坏的准备”：迪拜航空乘客讲述驾驶舱遇袭事件

paras.en: Amog Italie was on his way home to Israel following family trip to Japan during foiled attack
paras.zh: 阿莫格·意大利 (Amog Italie) 与家人前往日本旅行后，在未遂袭击事件中返回以色列

paras.en: Almog Italie and his family were on the final leg of their trip home following a vacation in Japan when they felt FlyDubai flight FZ1073 plummet.
paras.zh: Almog Italie 和他的家人在日本度假后踏上回家之旅的最后一站，突然感觉到 FlyDubai 航班 FZ1073 坠落。

paras.en: "Suddenly we were moving like a roller-coaster without any notice ... I thought it was turbulence," Italie said, adding that after several seconds, the plane stabilized before it started diving again.
paras.zh: 伊塔利说：“突然间，我们像过山车一样移动，没有任何通知……我以为是湍流。”他补充说，几秒钟后，飞机稳定下来，然后再次开始俯冲。

paras.en: He quickly realized something was amiss.
paras.zh: 他很快意识到有些不对劲。

paras.en: "We understood something is wrong and something is going on in the cockpit, because that wasn't normal at all," he told CBC News.
paras.zh: 他告诉加拿大广播公司新闻：“我们知道驾驶舱出了问题，因为这根本不正常。”

paras.en: Italie was one of 174 people on board the plane earlier this week when one of the pilots stabbed the other in an attempt to crash the plane. The flight plunged 17,000 feet.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，一名飞行员刺伤了另一名飞行员，试图让飞机坠毁，Italie 是机上 174 名乘客之一。飞机坠落 17,000 英尺。

paras.en: "It was very fast," Italie said of the situation.
paras.zh: “速度非常快，”伊塔利谈到当时的情况时说道。

paras.en: He recounted how crew and passengers ran to the cockpit to foil the attempt.
paras.zh: 他讲述了机组人员和乘客如何跑到驾驶舱阻止这次尝试。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later revealed how the stabbed pilot, Indian national Smit Machchhar, was covered with blood and on the floor when he managed to open the cockpit door, allowing others to rush in, subdue the perpetrator and let a second pair of FlyDubai pilots take over the flight.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的发言人后来透露，被刺伤的印度籍飞行员斯米特·马赫恰尔(Smit Macchhar)设法打开驾驶舱门，让其他人冲进去，制服了肇事者，并让第二名迪拜航空飞行员接管了航班，他浑身是血，倒在地板上。

paras.en: Those involved resurfaced several minutes later to update the other passengers and confirm that they were looking for a safe place to land.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，相关人员重新浮出水面，向其他乘客通报最新情况，并确认他们正在寻找安全的着陆地点。

paras.en: "So, what needed to be done was to maintain calm, stay in the seats and do nothing else that would cause chaos," Italie said. "And this is exactly what saved our lives. Nobody panicked and we controlled the situation."
paras.zh: 伊塔利说：“因此，需要做的是保持冷静，留在座位上，不要做其他会造成混乱的事情。” “这正是拯救我们生命的原因。没有人惊慌，我们控制了局势。”

paras.en: "We didn't know how the landing was going to go, so we prepared ourselves for the worst," he added.
paras.zh: “我们不知道着陆将如何进行，所以我们做好了最坏的打算，”他补充道。

paras.en: Ultimately, the plane landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where Italie said authorities warmly welcomed passengers and crew, even providing food.
paras.zh: 最终，飞机安全降落在沙特阿拉伯塔布克，意大利表示，当局热情欢迎乘客和机组人员，甚至提供食物。

paras.en: "They were very, very nice," Italie said. "Much appreciated."
paras.zh: “他们非常非常友善，”伊塔利说。 “非常感谢。”

paras.en: 'Unity' saved everyone's life: passenger
paras.zh: “团结”拯救了每个人的生命：乘客

paras.en: Hours later, passengers were on board a different flight and made it to Tel Aviv. But passengers continue to recount those terrifying minutes.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，乘客搭乘另一架航班飞往特拉维夫。但乘客们仍在继续回忆那些可怕的时刻。

paras.en: "I just can say that it was a miracle. It was awful, crazy, and we thank God that we survived it. We didn't think we will make it, but thank God we are in Israel. We are back home. And we are happy to see everyone here," said another passenger, Lital Shachaf.
paras.zh: “我只能说这是一个奇迹。这太可怕了，太疯狂了，我们感谢上帝让我们活了下来。我们本以为自己活不成了，但感谢上帝我们在以色列。我们回到了家。我们很高兴看到这里的每个人，”另一名乘客利塔尔·沙哈夫(Lital Shachaf)说。

paras.en: For Italie, the "unity" on board saved everyone's life.
paras.zh: 对于意大利来说，船上的“团结”拯救了每个人的生命。

paras.en: Yaniv Hayun, 50, was one of four passengers who rushed to the cockpit during the chaos to overpower the unidentified co-pilot behind the attack. He said he learned what to do thanks to an aircrash television show. Another, a dentist, treated Machchhar's wounds.
paras.zh: 50 岁的亚尼夫·哈云 (Yaniv Hayun) 是在混乱中冲进驾驶舱制服袭击背后的身份不明的副驾驶的四名乘客之一。他说，得益于空难电视节目，他学会了该怎么做。另一位牙医为马赫恰尔处理伤口。

paras.en: "The people united. We helped each other," Italie said. "That's a message I want to share."
paras.zh: “人们团结起来。我们互相帮助，”伊塔利说。 “这是我想分享的信息。”

paras.en: - A previous story said the FlyDubai plane plunged 30,000 feet in less than 30 seconds. In fact, it was 17,000 feet.Oct 02, 2026 10:26 AM EDT
paras.zh: - 之前的报道称 FlyDubai 飞机在不到 30 秒的时间内从 30,000 英尺的高度坠落。事实上，高度为 17,000 英尺。2026 年 10 月 2 日上午 10:26 EDT

articles.title: CBS Sports describes Tony Romo's permanent exit as mutual parting

paras.en: CBS Sports describes Tony Romo's permanent exit as mutual parting
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道将托尼·罗莫的永久退出描述为相互告别

paras.en: Ex-NFL QB pleaded no contest to DWI charge after July traffic stop in Wisconsin
paras.zh: 前 NFL QB 在威斯康星州 7 月交通堵塞后对 DWI 指控不提出异议

paras.en: CBS Sports and Tony Romo have officially parted ways, one month after the former Dallas Cowboys quarterback pleaded no contest to charges of operating a vehicle while intoxicated.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道 (CBS Sports) 与托尼·罗莫 (Tony Romo) 正式分道扬镳，一个月前，前达拉斯牛仔队四分卫托尼·罗莫 (Tony Romo) 对醉酒驾驶车辆的指控没有提出抗辩。

paras.en: Romo had been on leave since his July 23 arrest in Wisconsin. He had been the lead game analyst for CBS' NFL coverage since 2017.
paras.zh: 罗莫自 7 月 23 日在威斯康星州被捕以来一直处于休假状态。自 2017 年以来，他一直担任 CBS NFL 报道的首席比赛分析师。

paras.en: "CBS Sports and Tony Romo have mutually agreed to part ways," CBS Sports said Friday in a statement. "We thank Tony for his contributions over the past nine years and wish him the best moving forward."
paras.zh: “哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道和托尼·罗莫已双方同意分道扬镳，”哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道周五在一份声明中表示。 “我们感谢托尼在过去九年中所做的贡献，并祝愿他未来一切顺利。”

paras.en: Analyst JJ Watt had joined play-by-play announcer Jim Nantz and sideline reporter Tracy Wolfson on CBS Sports' lead NFL team during Romo's absence. Watt will continue in that role now and all other CBS teams will remain the same.
paras.zh: 在罗莫缺席期间，分析师 JJ Watt 与实况播音员 Jim Nantz 和场边记者 Tracy Wolfson 一起加入了 CBS Sports 的 NFL 主队。瓦特现在将继续担任这一职务，所有其他 CBS 团队将保持不变。

paras.en: "I'm proud of what I accomplished at CBS Sports over the last nine years," Romo said in a statement. "I approached my role as a game analyst the way I've approached everything in my life, with a desire to win and be the best that I can be.
paras.zh: “我对过去九年在哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道取得的成就感到自豪，”罗莫在一份声明中说。 “我对待游戏分析师的角色就像对待生活中的一切一样，渴望获胜并尽我所能。

paras.en: "I'm going to use this time to take a break, something I've never done before, and focus on my health and my family before moving on to my next opportunity. I am grateful for my time with CBS Sports and for the continued support of my family and friends, as well as the NFL community and fans."
paras.zh: “我将利用这段时间休息一下，这是我以前从未做过的事情，并在继续我的下一个机会之前关注我的健康和家人。我很感谢我在哥伦比亚广播公司体育频道的时光，以及我的家人和朋友以及 NFL 社区和球迷的持续支持。”

paras.en: Romo was arrested following a traffic stop as he was driving south on Interstate 43 in Wisconsin. He pleaded no contest to a charge of operating while intoxicated on Sept. 1 and issued a statement apologizing for the actions that led to his arrest.
paras.zh: 罗莫在威斯康星州 43 号州际公路向南行驶时，在交通堵塞后被捕。他对 9 月 1 日醉酒驾驶的指控没有提出抗辩，并发表声明，为导致他被捕的行为道歉。

paras.en: According to Milwaukee County court records, Romo lost his driving privileges for six months and was ordered to complete an alcohol assessment program.
paras.zh: 根据密尔沃基县法院记录，罗莫失去了六个月的驾驶权限，并被勒令完成酒精评估计划。

paras.en: "The past month has been difficult, but it has also been personally significant," Romo said Sept. 1 in a statement on Instagram. "It has required me to confront and own my mistakes fully — to the Lord, to myself, to my family and now to the public."
paras.zh: 9 月 1 日，罗莫在 Instagram 上发表声明称：“过去的一个月很艰难，但对我个人来说也意义重大。” “这要求我完全面对并承认自己的错误——向主、向我自己、向我的家人，现在向公众。”

paras.en: Romo said the multiple back surgeries that led to his retirement as a player "left me with constant, debilitating pain." He noted that the pain "led to a dependence on pain medication, and my efforts to get off those medications led to an over-reliance on alcohol."
paras.zh: 罗莫表示，多次背部手术导致他作为球员退役，“给我带来了持续的、令人衰弱的疼痛。”他指出，疼痛“导致我对止痛药产生依赖，而我努力戒掉这些药物导致了对酒精的过度依赖。”

paras.en: "None of this is an excuse," Romo said. "These are my failures and I take responsibility for them."
paras.zh: “这些都不是借口，”罗莫说。 “这些都是我的失败，我对此承担责任。”

paras.en: Romo said he is working with a team of doctors to address his health and "make the necessary changes."
paras.zh: 罗莫说，他正在与一组医生合作解决他的健康问题并“做出必要的改变”。

paras.en: The 46-year-old Romo made four Pro Bowl appearances during a playing career that ran from 2004-16 and was spent entirely with Dallas.
paras.zh: 46 岁的罗莫在 2004-16 赛季的职业碗生涯中四次参加职业碗比赛，并且完全在达拉斯度过。

articles.title: Christa Pike on ventilator after surviving Tennessee execution attempt, lawyer says

paras.en: Christa Pike on ventilator after surviving Tennessee execution attempt, lawyer says
paras.zh: 律师称，克里斯塔·派克在田纳西州行刑未遂后使用呼吸机

paras.en: Pike, 50, in critical condition after surviving state's lethal injection attempt on Wednesday
paras.zh: 周三，50 岁的派克在州注射死刑中幸存，情况危急

paras.en: Christa Pike is unconscious, intubated and receiving breathing assistance from a ventilator after Tennessee's failed attempt to execute her, her attorneys said on Friday, providing the first detailed account of the extent of injuries she suffered during the lethal injection.
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克的律师周五表示，在田纳西州试图处决她失败后，克里斯塔·派克已经失去知觉，正在插管并接受呼吸机的呼吸辅助，这首次详细描述了她在注射死刑期间所受的伤害程度。

paras.en: Hospital staff are working to save Pike's life and clear the lethal drug pentobarbital from her system, her attorneys said in an emergency court filing seeking an order requiring Tennessee's Department of Correction to preserve evidence from Wednesday night's failed execution.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在一份紧急法庭文件中表示，医院工作人员正在努力挽救派克的生命，并清除她体内的致命药物戊巴比妥，该文件寻求命令田纳西州惩教部保存周三晚上处决失败的证据。

paras.en: Pike remains in critical condition, her lawyers said, two days after the state administered two doses of pentobarbital but failed to kill her. She has suffered significant injuries to both arms, they added.
paras.zh: 派克的律师表示，派克仍处于危急状态，两天前，该州注射了两剂戊巴比妥，但未能杀死她。他们补充说，她的双臂受了重伤。

paras.en: "At no point did any member of the execution team realize that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown and that the pentobarbital was, in whole or in part, entering Ms. Pike’s body," Pike's lawyers said in a filing in the Chancery Court for the State of Tennessee Twentieth Judicial District.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在向田纳西州第二十司法区衡平法院提交的一份文件中表示，“执行小组的任何成员都没有意识到静脉输液管放置不正确，或者静脉已经破裂，戊巴比妥全部或部分进入了派克女士的身体。”

paras.en: The filing provides the fullest picture yet of the medical consequences of an attempted execution that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee said followed the state's established protocol.
paras.zh: 该文件提供了迄今为止关于田纳西州州长比尔·李表示遵循该州既定协议的企图处决的医疗后果的最全面信息。

paras.en: It was the state's second botched execution this year. Lee has halted any further state killings for the rest of 2026 and ordered an independent review of what happened.
paras.zh: 这是该州今年第二次失败的处决事件。李已在 2026 年剩余时间内停止任何进一步的国家杀戮，并下令对所发生的事情进行独立审查。

paras.en: Pike's attorneys have said the execution team's difficulties administering the drug were related to intravenous access, an issue they had warned the state and courts about before the execution.
paras.zh: 派克的律师表示，行刑团队在使用药物时遇到的困难与静脉注射有关，他们在行刑前已向州和法院警告过这个问题。

paras.en: Pike, 50, was convicted of killing her 19-year-old classmate Colleen Slemmer in 1995, when Pike was 18. She had been scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than two centuries.
paras.zh: 50 岁的派克因 1995 年杀害 19 岁的同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 而被定罪，当时派克 18 岁。她原计划成为两个多世纪以来田纳西州第一位被处决的女性。

articles.title: Latvians head to the polls with Russia on their minds

paras.en: Four German Air Force Eurofighter jets stand ready at Latvia's Lielvarde military air base, just 60 kilometers from Riga. The aircraft are part of NATO's efforts to strengthen Baltic air defenses on the alliance's eastern flank ahead. Germany sent the jets amid repeated drone incursions, which have put Latvia on alert ahead of the country's elections on October 3.
paras.zh: 四架德国空军欧洲战斗机在拉脱维亚利尔瓦德军事空军基地待命，距离里加仅 60 公里。这些飞机是北约加强其东侧波罗的海防空力量的一部分。德国在无人机一再入侵之际派遣了这些飞机，这使得拉脱维亚在 10 月 3 日大选之前处于戒备状态。

paras.en: Security has become one of the defining issues of this campaign — defense promises appearing on the programs of most of the leading parties in Latvia. And the Latvian public's anxieties aren't unfounded.
paras.zh: 安全已成为这场竞选活动的决定性问题之一——国防承诺出现在拉脱维亚大多数主要政党的计划中。拉脱维亚公众的焦虑并非没有根据。

paras.en: In recent months, several drones have entered Baltic airspace. The latest incident occurred on September 15 in Lithuania, when a drone believed to have crossed from Belarus was shot down by an NATO fighter jet.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，多架无人机进入波罗的海领空。最近的一次事件发生在9月15日的立陶宛，当时一架据信从白俄罗斯越境的无人机被北约战斗机击落。

paras.en: On top of that there are hybrid threats, including migrant flows that Latvia and its neighbors say are being encouraged by Russia's ally Belarus to pressure the EU and test border security. Intelligence officials of several European countries, including Latvia and the Czech Republic have warned that Russia could seek to test NATO in the upcoming "months, not years."
paras.zh: 除此之外，还存在混合威胁，包括拉脱维亚及其邻国称俄罗斯盟友白俄罗斯鼓励移民流动，以向欧盟施压并测试边境安全。包括拉脱维亚和捷克共和国在内的几个欧洲国家的情报官员警告称，俄罗斯可能会在未来“几个月而不是几年”内寻求测试北约。

paras.en: "There are concerns in the West and also here in the Baltic states that Russia might be trying some further actions here in the Baltics," says Maris Andzans, director of the Center for Geopolitical Studies in Riga. "If you want to test NATO, there is no better place than the Baltic states."
paras.zh: 里加地缘政治研究中心主任马里斯·安德赞斯表示：“西方和波罗的海国家都担心俄罗斯可能会在波罗的海地区尝试采取进一步行动。” “如果你想测试北约，没有比波罗的海国家更好的地方了。”

paras.en: Latvia elects its 100-seat parliament, Saeima, through proportional representation, meaning coalition governments are the norm. Polls currently put the centrist United List, led by Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs ahead, followed by the populist alliance Sovereign Power/Young Latvians Alliance and Latvia First led by Ainars Slesers. The center-left Progressives and the conservative National Alliance are also expected to enter parliament.
paras.zh: 拉脱维亚通过比例代表制选举拥有 100 个席位的议会 Saeima，这意味着联合政府是常态。目前的民意调查显示，由总理安德里斯·库尔伯格斯领导的中间派联合名单领先，其次是由艾纳斯·斯莱瑟斯领导的民粹主义联盟主权力量/拉脱维亚青年联盟和拉脱维亚优先联盟。中左翼进步党和保守党国家联盟也有望进入议会。

paras.en: Most of these Latvian parties view Russia as a security challenge.
paras.zh: 大多数拉脱维亚政党都将俄罗斯视为安全挑战。

paras.en: "The biggest threat is our neighbors, Russia and Belarus," says Agnese Kupca of the United List. "Our partners in the EU should understand: it is not only our border with Russia, but also EU and NATO border with aggressor."
paras.zh: “最大的威胁是我们的邻国俄罗斯和白俄罗斯，”联合名单的阿格尼塞·库普卡说。 “我们在欧盟的伙伴应该明白：这不仅是我们与俄罗斯的边界，也是欧盟和北约与侵略者的边界。”

paras.en: Latvia is one of the few NATO members that have committed by law to spending 5% of GDP on defense, and analysts say the country's foreign policy orientation is unlikely to change regardless of which coalition emerges after the vote as there is nearly unanimous consensus on the importance of NATO. Which is backed by their voters: according to Friedrich Ebert Stiftung (FES) Security Radar 2025 Latvians generally have a positive view of NATO.
paras.zh: 拉脱维亚是少数几个依法承诺将GDP的5%用于国防的北约成员国之一，分析人士表示，无论投票后出现哪个联盟，拉脱维亚的外交政策取向都不太可能改变，因为人们对北约的重要性几乎达成了一致共识。这得到了选民的支持：根据弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会 (FES) 安全雷达 2025，拉脱维亚人普遍对北约持积极看法。

paras.en: But while security policy enjoys broad agreement, the economic consequences of Latvia distancing itself from Russia remain contentious.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管安全政策得到广泛认同，但拉脱维亚与俄罗斯疏远的经济后果仍然存在争议。

paras.en: Before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Russia was among Latvia's most important trading partners. Since 2022, Latvia has reduced imports from Russia and Belarus by more than 90% and introduced some of the toughest restrictions in the EU on goods from the two countries. Latvia's economy has adapted, but businesses with strong pre-war links to Russia were among the hardest hit.
paras.zh: 在全面入侵乌克兰之前，俄罗斯是拉脱维亚最重要的贸易伙伴之一。自2022年以来，拉脱维亚已将从俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的进口减少了90%以上，并对来自这两个国家的商品实行了欧盟最严格的一些限制。拉脱维亚的经济已经适应，但战前与俄罗斯有密切联系的企业受到的打击最为严重。

paras.en: "This closeness to the theater of war has strongly influenced the investment climate," says political analyst Filips Rajevskis. "So the big question is how to increase the investments and grow the economy."
paras.zh: 政治分析师 Filips Rajevskis 表示：“这种与战区的密切关系强烈影响了投资环境。” “所以最大的问题是如何增加投资并发展经济。”

paras.en: Many Latvians reject any economic cooperation with Russia on security grounds. Sixty percent said they want Latvia to reduce dependence on Russia, according to FES Security Radar 2025. "In the current situation, it's absolute nonsense. We can't watch what's happening and still be friends with Russia," one passerby in Riga told DW.
paras.zh: 许多拉脱维亚人以安全为由拒绝与俄罗斯进行任何经济合作。据FES安全雷达2025报道，60%的人表示希望拉脱维亚减少对俄罗斯的依赖。“在目前的情况下，这绝对是无稽之谈。我们不能一边看着正在发生的事情，一边仍然与俄罗斯做朋友，”里加的一位路人告诉德国之声。

paras.en: At the same time 20% of Latvians, according to FES, favor closer ties with Russia. Calls for a more pragmatic approach towards its eastern neighbor are not uncommon in the political debates.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据 FES 称，20% 的拉脱维亚人赞成与俄罗斯建立更密切的关系。在政治辩论中，要求对其东部邻国采取更加务实态度的呼声并不罕见。

paras.en: Julija Stepanenko, leader of Sovereign Power/Young Latvians Alliance, has repeatedly argued against completely severing economic ties with Russia and Belarus.
paras.zh: 主权力量/拉脱维亚青年联盟领导人朱莉娅·斯捷潘年科(Julija Stepanenko)多次反对完全切断与俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的经济联系。

paras.en: Earlier this year, it emerged that Stepanenko has received gifts worth roughly €400,000 ($470,000) from her father, a Russia-based businessman whose company manufactures construction materials, including anti-tank fortifications known as "dragon's teeth." But despite that, her party remains in second place in the polls.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，有消息称，斯捷潘年科从她的父亲那里收到了价值约 40 万欧元（合 47 万美元）的礼物。她的父亲是一位俄罗斯商人，其公司生产建筑材料，包括被称为“龙牙”的反坦克防御工事。但尽管如此，她的政党在民意调查中仍位居第二。

paras.en: When DW met Lyubov Shvetsova, one of Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians party candidates at a campaign stand just outside the center of Riga, she rejected accusations that the party is pro-Russian.
paras.zh: 当德国之声在里加市中心外的一个竞选站见到新拉脱维亚主权力量/新拉脱维亚联盟党候选人之一柳博芙·什韦佐娃时，她否认了该党亲俄的指控。

paras.en: "Our approach is pragmatism oriented toward the interests of Latvian business," she said.
paras.zh: “我们的方针是以拉脱维亚企业利益为导向的实用主义，”她说。

paras.en: Another advocate of a more pragmatic economic approach is Ainars Slesers, former businessman and leader of Latvia First.
paras.zh: 另一位更务实的经济方针的倡导者是艾纳斯·斯莱瑟斯(Ainars Slesers)，他是前商人、拉脱维亚优先党的领导人。

paras.en: During an interview on Latvian public television earlier in September, Slesers argued that transit of goods with Russia should continue as long as it is not prohibited by EU sanctions.
paras.zh: 9月初，斯莱瑟斯在接受拉脱维亚公共电视台采访时表示，只要欧盟制裁不禁止，与俄罗斯的货物过境就应该继续进行。

paras.en: His party has focused heavily on economic issues, arguing that Latvia should prioritize growth and investment over what it sees as excessive self-imposed restrictions. And this approach has found support: more than 9% are ready to vote for Latvia First, which is in third place in the polls.
paras.zh: 他的政党重点关注经济问题，认为拉脱维亚应该优先考虑增长和投资，而不是过度的自我限制。这种做法得到了支持：超过 9% 的人准备投票给拉脱维亚优先，该国在民意调查中排名第三。

paras.en: However, discussions about fully restoring trade with Russia are premature, party member Edmunds Zivtins told DW. "As long as the war in Ukraine is ongoing, we cannot talk about it," he said.
paras.zh: 然而，该党成员埃德蒙兹·齐夫廷斯(Edmunds Zivtins)告诉德国之声，讨论全面恢复与俄罗斯的贸易还为时过早。 “只要乌克兰战争仍在继续，我们就不能谈论它，”他说。

paras.en: Analysts say such parties may attract some voters who feel alienated by Latvia's increasingly restrictive approach toward Russia.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，此类政党可能会吸引一些因拉脱维亚对俄罗斯日益严格的态度而感到疏远的选民。

paras.en: The appeal is not necessarily driven by support for the Kremlin. Rather, it often comes from parts of the country's Russian-speaking minority who feel overlooked by mainstream parties and uneasy about policies such as the phase-out of Russian-language school education and the reduced role of Russian in public life.
paras.zh: 这种呼吁不一定是出于对克里姆林宫的支持。相反，它往往来自该国部分讲俄语的少数民族，他们感到被主流政党忽视，并对逐步取消俄语学校教育和俄语在公共生活中的作用下降等政策感到不安。

paras.en: About one-third of Latvia's population speaks Russian at home.
paras.zh: 大约三分之一的拉脱维亚人口在家讲俄语。

paras.en: However, the outcome of these elections is hard to predict. Filips Rajevskis says many voters are hiding not only their party preference, but even their decision to go to vote ahead of elections.
paras.zh: 然而，这些选举的结果很难预测。菲利普斯·拉杰夫斯基斯表示，许多选民不仅隐藏了他们的政党偏好，甚至还隐藏了他们在选举前投票的决定。

paras.en: As Latvians head to the polls, Moscow is shaping the campaign in ways both direct and indirect: as a security threat driving support for NATO and defense spending, and as an economic and cultural question that continues to divide parts of the electorate.
paras.zh: 当拉脱维亚人前往投票站时，莫斯科正在以直接和间接的方式塑造竞选活动：作为推动对北约和国防开支的支持的安全威胁，以及继续分裂部分选民的经济和文化问题。

articles.title: This island in Kiribati could be the key to solve the Amelia Earhart mystery

paras.en: Amelia Earhart's attempt to become the first woman to fly around the globe at the equator ended in mystery when she and her navigator, Fred Noonan, disappeared over the Pacific Ocean in July 1937.
paras.zh: 1937 年 7 月，阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特 (Amelia Earhart) 与她的领航员弗雷德·努南 (Fred Noonan) 在太平洋上空失踪，试图成为第一位在赤道环球飞行的女性。

paras.en: With the 90th anniversary of her disappearance on the horizon, a new expedition is setting out to finally determine what happened over the vast Pacific. This expedition has what it believes is crucial new evidence.
paras.zh: 随着她失踪 90 周年纪念日的临近，一支新的探险队即将出发，最终确定浩瀚太平洋上发生的事情。这次探险获得了它认为至关重要的新证据。

paras.en: The team from Purdue University in Indiana and the Archaeological Legacy Institute (ALI) is scheduled to depart for the uninhabited island of Nikumaroro on Saturday to determine if an anomaly in the island's lagoon is Earhart's missing plane.
paras.zh: 来自印第安纳州普渡大学和考古遗产研究所（ALI）的团队定于周六出发前往无人居住的尼库马罗罗岛，以确定岛上泻湖中的异常现象是否是埃尔哈特失踪的飞机。

paras.en: Part of the low-lying Pacific island nation of Kiribati, Nikumaroro has long been considered the place where Earhart and Noonan died.
paras.zh: 尼库马罗罗是地势低洼的太平洋岛国基里巴斯的一部分，长期以来一直被认为是埃尔哈特和努南去世的地方。

paras.en: The pair took off from New Guinea on July 2, 1937, on the leg to the island of Howland, where they were to refuel before continuing on to Hawaii and completing the circumnavigation in California.
paras.zh: 两人于 1937 年 7 月 2 日从新几内亚起飞，途中前往豪兰岛，在那里补充燃料，然后继续前往夏威夷并在加利福尼亚州完成环球航行。

paras.en: Something went amiss en route, however, and even though a US Coast Guard ship could hear Earhart's radio transmissions and her Lockheed Electra must have been tantalizingly close, she was never found.
paras.zh: 然而，途中出了点问题，尽管美国海岸警卫队的船只可以听到埃尔哈特的无线电传输，而且她的洛克希德·伊莱克特拉号肯定就在附近，但她从未被发现。

paras.en: One of the last messages said she was running on a north-south navigational line that gave her the best chance of finding land before her fuel ran out. That line went through Nikumaroro.
paras.zh: 最后的一条消息称，她正在一条南北航线上行驶，这给了她在燃料耗尽之前找到陆地的最佳机会。这条线穿过 Nikumaroro。

paras.en: In 1988, researchers from the International Group for Historic Aircraft Recovery (TIGHAR) were the first to suggest that Earhart could have reached Nikumaroro and landed on its fringing coral reef.
paras.zh: 1988 年，国际历史飞机修复组织 (TIGHAR) 的研究人员首次提出埃尔哈特可能已抵达尼库马罗罗并降落在其边缘珊瑚礁上。

paras.en: TIGHAR's first visit to the island was in 1989, and the group has returned seven more times, turning up compelling artifacts, including lengths of aircraft aluminum and plexiglass from a windscreen.
paras.zh: TIGHAR 于 1989 年首次访问该岛，此后该团队又返回了七次，并发现了引人注目的文物，包括长条的飞机铝材和挡风玻璃上的有机玻璃。

paras.en: The group found a scent bottle, a zip made in Pennsylvania in the mid-1930s, parts of a pocket knife of the same brand listed in the aircraft inventory, and the heel of a woman's shoe.
paras.zh: 该小组发现了一个香水瓶、一个 20 世纪 30 年代中期在宾夕法尼亚州制造的拉链、飞机库存中列出的同一品牌小刀的零件以及一只女鞋的后跟。

paras.en: Archive research discovered that human remains discovered on the island in 1940 were initially believed to be of Earhart or Noonan — but were lost in the chaos of the Pacific war.
paras.zh: 档案研究发现，1940 年在岛上发现的人类遗骸最初被认为属于埃尔哈特或努南，但在太平洋战争的混乱中丢失了。

paras.en: Despite the searches, no one has yet found the "smoking gun" artifact, an item that could only have come from the doomed flight.
paras.zh: 尽管进行了搜查，但还没有人找到“铁证”文物，这一物品只能来自这趟注定失败的航班。

paras.en: Expedition leader Rick Pettigrew, executive director of the Archaeological Legacy Institute (ALI), believes the elements may have uncovered incontrovertible evidence.
paras.zh: 探险队领队、考古遗产研究所 (ALI) 执行主任里克·佩蒂格鲁 (Rick Pettigrew) 认为，这些元素可能已经发现了无可争议的证据。

paras.en: A powerful tropical cyclone tore through the central Pacific in 2015, shifting geographical features on the island and in its lagoon. Satellite images taken over the following years showed what might be the outline of an aircraft fuselage and wings in shallow water off the Taraia promontory.
paras.zh: 2015 年，一场强大的热带气旋席卷太平洋中部，改变了该岛及其泻湖的地理特征。接下来几年拍摄的卫星图像显示了塔拉亚海角浅水中飞机机身和机翼的轮廓。

paras.en: "This object in the satellite images is exactly the right size to represent the fuselage and tail of the Electra," the ALI website states. "It also appears to be very reflective and is likely to be metallic. It lies in very shallow water, largely covered by sediment, in a place where the current would bring an object floating into the lagoon through Tatiman Passage, the opening to the ocean and the reef."
paras.zh: ALI 网站称：“卫星图像中的这个物体的尺寸恰好适合代表 Electra 的机身和尾部。” “它看起来也非常反光，很可能是金属的。它位于非常浅的水中，大部分被沉积物覆盖，在这个地方，水流会将物体通过塔蒂曼通道（通向海洋和珊瑚礁的开口）带入泻湖。”

paras.en: Pettigrew's 17-strong team intends to focus all its efforts on the place where the images indicate debris may be located, using drone photography, remote sensing with magnetometers and sonar units. If the initial results are positive, a hydraulic dredge will excavate sediment.
paras.zh: Pettigrew 的 17 人团队打算利用无人机摄影、磁力计遥感和声纳装置，将全部精力集中在图像显示碎片可能所在的地方。如果初步结果是积极的，液压挖泥机将挖掘沉积物。

paras.en: "Once we have a sufficient portion of the object exposed, we should be able to identify it," according to the ALI's expedition plan. "If it is made of aircraft aluminum and has the specific shape and rivet patterns of the Electra, we will know that we have found the remains of Earhart's aircraft."
paras.zh: 根据 ALI 的探险计划，“一旦我们暴露了足够多的物体，我们就应该能够识别它”。 “如果它是用飞机铝制成的，并且具有伊莱克特拉号的特定形状和铆钉图案，我们就会知道我们找到了埃尔哈特飞机的残骸。”

paras.en: Much of the ALI's theory is based on the research and fieldwork carried out by TIGHAR, but its executive director, Ric Gillespie, is not convinced the researchers will find the "smoking gun."
paras.zh: ALI 的大部分理论都是基于 TIGHAR 进行的研究和实地考察，但其执行董事 Ric Gillespie 并不相信研究人员会找到“确凿证据”。

paras.en: "The object visible in old satellite imagery that Pettigrew believes is aircraft wreckage does not look like aircraft wreckage," Gillespie told DW. "It looks like a dead pandanus tree that was uprooted in a storm and washed up on Taraia."
paras.zh: 吉莱斯皮告诉德国之声：“佩蒂格鲁认为旧卫星图像中可见的物体是飞机残骸，但它看起来并不像飞机残骸。” “它看起来就像一棵死去的露兜树，在暴风雨中被连根拔起并被冲到了塔拉亚岛。”

paras.en: "Pettigrew thinks the wreckage is no longer visible because it is buried in silt," Gillespie noted. "He has never been to that location and does not understand that the silt there is only a few inches deep."
paras.zh: “佩蒂格鲁认为残骸不再可见，因为它被埋在淤泥中，”吉莱斯皮指出。 “他从未去过那个地方，也不知道那里的淤泥只有几英寸深。”

paras.en: Teams from TIGHAR searched the same location in 2001 and 2007 with metal detectors and drew blanks, he said. Yet Gillespie remains convinced that Earhart was on Nikumaroro.
paras.zh: 他说，TIGHAR 团队在 2001 年和 2007 年使用金属探测器对同一地点进行了搜查，并没有找到任何线索。但吉莱斯皮仍然坚信埃尔哈特就在 Nikumaroro 上。

paras.en: "I think the aircraft sank immediately after being washed over the reef edge and was smashed to pieces in the surf," he said. "Major components were eventually buried in underwater landslides … or grown over with coral. We have found what there is to find."
paras.zh: “我认为飞机被冲过礁石边缘后立即沉没，并在海浪中被撞成碎片，”他说。 “主要成分最终被埋在水下山体滑坡中……或者长满了珊瑚。我们已经找到了能找到的东西。”

paras.en: Dorothy Cochrane, who has monitored progress in the search for Earhart for more than 35 years as curator at the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum in Washington, DC, and continues to do so since her recent retirement, says Earhart still holds fascination for so many people "because it is 'the greatest unsolved mystery of the 20th and continuing into the 21st centuries.'"
paras.zh: 多萝西·科克伦 (Dorothy Cochrane) 在华盛顿特区的史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆担任馆长超过 35 年，一直在关注埃尔哈特的搜寻进展，最近退休后，她继续这样做。她说，埃尔哈特仍然让很多人着迷，“因为它是‘20 世纪乃至 21 世纪最大的未解之谜’”。

paras.en: She has a different view of what happened in 1937. She argues that if Earhart was nearly out of fuel while still close to Howland, it would have been impossible to fly another 640 kilometers (400 miles) to Nikumaroro. Cochrane also says that items cited as evidence of a castaway on the island can be explained by other visitors and by a small settlement that existed there for several years.
paras.zh: 她对 1937 年发生的事情有不同的看法。她认为，如果埃尔哈特在距离豪兰很近的时候几乎耗尽燃料，就不可能再飞行 640 公里（400 英里）到达尼库马罗罗。科克伦还表示，被引用为岛上漂流者证据的物品可以由其他游客和在那里存在了几年的一个小定居点来解释。

paras.en: "I believe that Earhart and Noonan were in the general vicinity of Howland Island, based on the facts of the flight, but just could not find it before they ran out of fuel," she said.
paras.zh: “根据飞行的事实，我相信埃尔哈特和努南当时就在豪兰岛附近，但在燃料耗尽之前找不到它，”她说。

paras.en: "Howland Island was a tiny speck in the morning light of a vast sea," she said, suggesting Earhart could not establish radio contact to guide her the last few miles to her destination.
paras.zh: “豪兰岛是浩瀚大海晨光中的一个小斑点，”她说，暗示埃尔哈特无法建立无线电联系来引导她到达目的地的最后几英里。

paras.en: Cochrane believes the Electra lies on the seabed near Howland. Others have advanced this theory, and several searches of the area have been carried out in recent years.
paras.zh: 科克伦认为厄勒克特拉号位于豪兰附近的海底。其他人提出了这一理论，近年来对该地区进行了多次搜索。

paras.en: If Pettigrew's lead pays off, however, it will conclude aviation's nearly 90-year puzzle.
paras.zh: 然而，如果佩蒂格鲁的领先优势得到回报，航空业近 90 年的难题将得到解决。

articles.title: Australia: Car crashes into rugby fans, 10 injured

paras.en: A car drove into a crowd of rugby league supporters in the eastern Australian city of Newcastle on Saturday after its driver appeared to lose control, leaving at least 10 people injured, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周六，在澳大利亚东部城市纽卡斯尔，一辆汽车在司机似乎失去控制后冲撞了一群橄榄球联盟支持者，造成至少 10 人受伤。

paras.en: Several children were reported to be among the wounded.
paras.zh: 据报道，伤者中有几名儿童。

paras.en: Two of the injured were in a critical condition, including a 5-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man, New South Wales officials said.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州官员称，其中两名伤者情况危急，其中包括一名 5 岁女孩和一名 67 岁男子。

paras.en: What do we know about the car crash in Australia?
paras.zh: 我们对澳大利亚的车祸了解多少？

paras.en: The incident occurred in Newcastle's Wallsend suburb, situated some 110 kilometers (68 miles) north of Sydney.
paras.zh: 该事件发生在纽卡斯尔的沃尔森德郊区，位于悉尼以北约 110 公里（68 英里）处。

paras.en: Fans had gathered on the streets to cheer on the Newcastle Knights rugby team who were leaving for the National Rugby League grand final against the Sydney Roosters, slated to be held in Sydney on Sunday.
paras.zh: 球迷们聚集在街上为纽卡斯尔骑士橄榄球队加油，他们将前往参加定于周日在悉尼举行的全国橄榄球联盟总决赛，对阵悉尼公鸡队。

paras.en: Local reports cited the police as identifying the driver as an 18-year-old man, who was arrested and taken to the hospital for mandatory testing.
paras.zh: 当地报道称，警方确认司机为一名 18 岁男子，随后将其逮捕并送往医院进行强制检查。

paras.en: Newcastle Mayor Gavin Morris said in televised remarks that the driver was a rugby fan and that he lost control of his vehicle.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔市长加文·莫里斯在电视讲话中表示，司机是一名橄榄球迷，他对车辆失去了控制。

paras.en: "He was revving the car, he was excited, he was a supporter, he was there for the joy of the moment," Morris told Australian broadcaster ABC.
paras.zh: 莫里斯告诉澳大利亚广播公司美国广播公司（ABC）：“他正在加速赛车，他很兴奋，他是一名支持者，他在那里享受这一刻的快乐。”

paras.en: "Somehow he lost control of the car ... and he's gone into the crowd."
paras.zh: “不知何故，他失去了对汽车的控制……然后他就钻进了人群中。”

paras.en: Police said they were probing the incident and initial inquiries indicated it was not terrorism-related.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们正在调查这起事件，初步调查表明这与恐怖主义无关。

paras.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the incident was "horrible."
paras.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞称这一事件“可怕”。

paras.en: "Rugby league brings people together, and this should have been a weekend of excitement and pride for Newcastle fans," he said in a statement on X.
paras.zh: “橄榄球联赛将人们聚集在一起，这对纽卡斯尔球迷来说应该是一个激动和自豪的周末，”他在 X 上的一份声明中说道。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您就可以始终首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Two Iranians charged over alleged plot targeting Jewish community in UK

paras.en: British authorities have charged two Iranian nationals with planning a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in northern England.
paras.zh: 英国当局指控两名伊朗国民策划针对英格兰北部犹太社区的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: The UK Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) said on Friday that Rahman Salehi, 34, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, were charged with preparing to commit or assisting another to commit an act of terrorism in Manchester “on or before” Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement, which began at sundown on September 20.
paras.zh: 英国皇家检察署 (CPS) 周五表示，34 岁的拉赫曼·萨利希 (Rahman Salehi) 和 36 岁的萨拉姆·艾哈迈迪安 (Salam Ahmadyan) 被指控准备在 9 月 20 日日落开始的犹太赎罪日当天或之前在曼彻斯特实施或协助他人实施恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: “It is alleged that the two men were in contact with an overseas third-party who may be in Iran in relation to the plot,” police said in a separate statement on Friday.
paras.zh: 警方在周五的另一份声明中表示：“据称，这两人与可能在伊朗的海外第三方就该阴谋进行了联系。”

paras.en: Details of the alleged plot have not been released, but police have confirmed its “disruption”.
paras.zh: 涉嫌阴谋的细节尚未公布，但警方已证实其“破坏”。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police said Salehi and Ahmadyan, both arrested in Manchester on September 20, allegedly tried to acquire components and equipment to make an improvised explosive device and conducted reconnaissance on potential targets for attack.
paras.zh: 反恐警方表示，萨利希和艾哈迈迪安均于 9 月 20 日在曼彻斯特被捕，据称他们试图获取组件和设备来制造简易爆炸装置，并对潜在的袭击目标进行侦察。

paras.en: The pair will appear at London’s Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Saturday, the CPS said.
paras.zh: CPS 表示，两人将于周六在伦敦威斯敏斯特地方法院出庭。

paras.en: Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood said Salehi and Ahmadyan arrived in the UK on a small boat from Europe several years ago. One of the men had been granted asylum and the other had a live asylum claim, the Home Office said.
paras.zh: 内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德表示，萨利希和艾哈迈迪安几年前乘坐小船从欧洲抵达英国。内政部表示，其中一名男子已获得庇护，另一名男子则提出实时庇护申请。

paras.en: “It is no secret that this country faces a range of serious threats from the Iranian regime,” she said in a statement.
paras.zh: 她在一份声明中说：“这个国家面临伊朗政权的一系列严重威胁，这已不是什么秘密。”

paras.en: “They target our Jewish communities and try to silence their critics overseas, often through proxies and criminal networks to hide their involvement,” she added.
paras.zh: “他们以我们的犹太社区为目标，并试图让海外的批评者噤声，通常通过代理人和犯罪网络来隐藏他们的参与，”她补充道。

paras.en: The charges come a year after two people were killed in a knife and gun attack by a British citizen of Syrian descent at the Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation Synagogue in northern Manchester on October 2, 2025.
paras.zh: 一年前，2025 年 10 月 2 日，一名叙利亚裔英国公民在曼彻斯特北部的希顿公园希伯来会堂发生刀枪袭击，造成两人死亡。

paras.en: “I’m aware that the news of this alleged plot coming during the High Holy day period has caused a great deal of concern to the Jewish community, as well as with the wider public,” Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, senior national coordinator for counterterrorism policing, said on Friday.
paras.zh: “我知道，在至高圣日期间发生的这一涉嫌阴谋的消息引起了犹太社区以及广大公众的极大关注，”国家反恐警务高级协调员、副助理专员维姬·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 周五表示。

paras.en: “It also coincides with the anniversary of the devastating terrorist attack last year at Heaton Park synagogue and comes in a wider context of increasing antisemitic incidents across the UK.”
paras.zh: “这也恰逢去年希顿公园犹太教堂发生毁灭性恐怖袭击的周年纪念日，并且是在英国各地反犹太主义事件不断增加的大背景下进行的。”

paras.en: Detectives said there was no connection between Friday’s charges and the suspected plot involving the RAF Fairford air base, over which a dual UK-Iranian national was arrested on Thursday, according to the Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，侦探们表示，周五的指控与涉及英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地的涉嫌阴谋之间没有任何联系，周四一名英国-伊朗双重国籍公民因该基地被捕。

paras.en: Britain said Tehran had been involved in an alleged plot earlier this week targeting an air base used by the US to launch attacks against Iran.
paras.zh: 英国表示，德黑兰参与了本周早些时候涉嫌针对美国用来对伊朗发动袭击的空军基地的阴谋。

paras.en: Iran denied any involvement in the RAF Fairford plot and said speculation would “fuel Iranophobia propaganda”.
paras.zh: 伊朗否认参与了英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋，并表示猜测将“助长仇视伊朗的宣传”。

articles.title: 10 injured after car crashes into rugby supporters in Australia

paras.en: A car has crashed into a crowd of rugby league supporters in the eastern Australian city of Newcastle, injuring 10 people, including three children.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚东部城市纽卡斯尔，一辆汽车撞向橄榄球联盟支持者人群，造成 10 人受伤，其中包括 3 名儿童。

paras.en: New South Wales police said on Saturday that two of the injured – a five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man – were in a critical condition and the other eight were in stable condition in hospital.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方周六表示，其中两名伤者——一名 5 岁女孩和一名 67 岁男子——情况危急，另外八人在医院情况稳定。

paras.en: Police said they had arrested the 18-year-old man driving the vehicle and were investigating what happened. They said the crash was not believed to be related to terrorism.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们已经逮捕了驾驶该车的 18 岁男子，并正在调查发生的事情。他们表示，坠机事件据信与恐怖主义无关。

paras.en: The crowd had gathered to farewell the local rugby league side, the Newcastle Knights, ahead of their grand final against the Sydney Roosters on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在周日对阵悉尼公鸡队的决赛之前，人群聚集在一起告别当地橄榄球联盟球队纽卡斯尔骑士队。

paras.en: Newcastle Lord Mayor Gavin Morris said the driver, a rugby league fan, had lost control of his vehicle and had been taken into custody.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔市长加文·莫里斯表示，司机是一名橄榄球联盟球迷，他的车辆失去了控制，已被拘留。

paras.en: “He was revving the car, he was excited, he was a supporter, he was there for the joy of the moment,” Morris told the national broadcaster ABC.
paras.zh: 莫里斯告诉美国广播公司：“他正在加速赛车，他很兴奋，他是一名支持者，他在那里享受这一刻的快乐。”

paras.en: “Somehow he lost control of the car … and he’s gone into the crowd,” he added.
paras.zh: “不知何故，他失去了对汽车的控制……他走进了人群，”他补充道。

paras.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said: “My thoughts are with everyone injured or involved in the horrible incident this morning in Newcastle.”
paras.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯表示：“我的心与今天早上在纽卡斯尔发生的可怕事件中受伤或卷入的所有人同在。”

paras.en: “Rugby league brings people together, and this should have been a weekend of excitement and pride for Newcastle fans,” he wrote in a social media post.
paras.zh: “橄榄球联赛将人们聚集在一起，这对纽卡斯尔球迷来说应该是一个激动和自豪的周末，”他在社交媒体帖子中写道。

articles.title: WHO warns of ‘devastating consequences’ due to delayed aid entry into Gaza

paras.en: Repeated delays in bringing life-saving medicines, prosthetics and other supplies from Israel into Gaza risk having “devastating consequences” for Palestinians who urgently need them, the World Health Organization (WHO) has said.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）表示，从以色列向加沙运送救生药品、假肢和其他物资的工作一再拖延，可能会给迫切需要这些物资的巴勒斯坦人带来“毁灭性后果”。

paras.en: Approved aid can enter Gaza only through Kerem Shalom, at the southern tip of the territory, while Rafah, also in the south, is open only for limited movement of people, including patients needing medical treatment abroad, the WHO said on Friday.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织周五表示，批准的援助只能通过该领土南端的凯雷姆沙洛姆进入加沙，而同样位于南部的拉法仅对有限的人员流动开放，包括需要在国外接受治疗的患者。

paras.en: “A truck full of non-priority supplies or the right supplies arriving too late, doesn’t save lives. That’s the question that actually matters,” Reinhilde Van De Weerdt, the WHO’s representative in Palestine, said.
paras.zh: “一辆装满非优先物资的卡车或正确的物资到达太晚，并不能挽救生命。这是真正重要的问题，”世界卫生组织驻巴勒斯坦代表雷因希尔德·范德韦尔特说。

paras.en: Van De Weerdt called on Israeli authorities to “release the pressure on medical supplies”, saying essential medicines “should not be considered as dual use, as they are globally accepted standards on medical items anybody needs anywhere to run a hospital or a clinic”.
paras.zh: 范德韦尔特呼吁以色列当局“释放对医疗用品的压力”，并表示基本药物“不应被视为双重用途，因为它们是全球公认的任何人在任何地方经营医院或诊所所需的医疗用品标准”。

paras.en: She added that one shipment of prosthetics and assistive devices had been rejected four times over the past six months.
paras.zh: 她补充说，过去六个月里，一批假肢和辅助器具被拒绝四次。

paras.en: “Every rejection means another delay for someone who has already lost a limb and is simply waiting for the chance to walk again,” she said, noting that medicines “by contrast, move relatively well”, with almost 87 percent approved and just over 1 percent rejected.
paras.zh: 她说：“对于已经失去肢体、只是等待再次行走机会的人来说，每一次拒绝都意味着又一次延误。”她指出，药物“相比之下，移动得相对较好”，几乎 87% 的药物被批准，略高于 1% 的药物被拒绝。

paras.en: “Our ask is simple and has not changed: we need the unimpeded and predictable entry of humanitarian and health supplies into Gaza at scale. We also need a multi-crossing model so that aid isn’t forced to trickle down through a limited number of crossings,” Van De Weerdt said.
paras.zh: 范德韦尔特说：“我们的要求很简单，也没有改变：我们需要人道主义和卫生物资能够不受阻碍、可预测地大规模进入加沙。我们还需要一个多过境点模式，这样援助就不会被迫通过有限数量的过境点流入。”

paras.en: Four other main entry points into Gaza – Kissufim, Gate 96, Erez and Erez West – remain closed and under total Israeli control.
paras.zh: 进入加沙的其他四个主要入境点——Kissufim、96号门、埃雷兹和埃雷兹西——仍然关闭并处于以色列的完全控制之下。

paras.en: She praised the “extraordinary health workers” still risking their lives in Gaza, who she said were not receiving enough supplies to give patients the care they needed.
paras.zh: 她赞扬了仍在加沙冒着生命危险的“杰出卫生工作者”，她说他们没有获得足够的物资来为患者提供所需的护理。

paras.en: “As winter begins, this urgency to get supplies into Gaza only deepens,” Van De Weerdt said. “Almost two million people are in need of shelter to protect against the cold and the risk of flooding, exposing people to serious health and safety risks, let alone their dignity.”
paras.zh: 范德韦尔特说：“随着冬季的到来，向加沙运送物资的紧迫性只会更加迫切。” “近200万人需要庇护所以抵御寒冷和洪水风险，这使人们面临严重的健康和安全风险，更不用说他们的尊严了。”

paras.en: She said residents faced a heightened risk of preventable disease outbreaks linked to the lack of safe shelter and clean water, and a high number of rats whose bites transmit infection, a threat made harder to track by the destruction of public health laboratories.
paras.zh: 她说，由于缺乏安全住所和清洁水，居民面临着可预防疾病爆发的更大风险，而且大量老鼠被咬伤传播感染，而公共卫生实验室被毁使这一威胁更难以追踪。

paras.en: The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Thursday of serious public health risks from the accumulation of solid waste in Gaza City, where sanitation gains remain fragile because of a lack of reliable access to heavy machinery, engine oil, spare parts and fuel funding.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）周四警告称，加沙城固体废物的堆积将带来严重的公共卫生风险，由于缺乏可靠的重型机械、机油、备件和燃料资金，加沙城的卫生状况仍然脆弱。

paras.en: Almost 12 months into a fragile “ceasefire” between Hamas and Israel, marked by continuing Israeli air attacks and other military activity, Gaza’s humanitarian situation remains “overwhelming”, according to OCHA.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅称，哈马斯和以色列之间脆弱的“停火”已近 12 个月，以色列持续进行空袭和其他军事活动，加沙的人道主义局势仍然“不堪重负”。

articles.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
paras.zh: G7将在未来4个月内释放1亿桶柴油储备

paras.en: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿加大压力后，七国集团召开了能源紧急会议。世界上最富有的国家表示，他们将释放1亿桶石油和柴油储备。

paras.en: It seems President Trump has prevailed on the world's wealthiest nations to release diesel from their stockpiles. That decision came earlier today at an emergency G7 meeting. Trump had been threatening to stop all exports of U.S. diesel fuel if Europeans didn't release their own diesel. A U.S. ban would have pushed already high global diesel prices even higher. And those steep prices, which have risen substantially since the U.S. went to war with Iran, are already squeezing everyone, from farmers to small business owners. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley joins us now from Paris. Hi there.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统似乎已经说服世界上最富裕的国家释放其库存的柴油。这一决定是在今天早些时候召开的七国集团紧急会议上作出的。特朗普一直威胁称，如果欧洲不释放自己的柴油，他将停止所有美国柴油出口。美国的禁令将使本已很高的全球柴油价格进一步推高。自美国与伊朗开战以来，价格大幅上涨，从农民到小企业主，每个人都受到挤压。 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 现在从巴黎加入我们。你好呀。

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: Good afternoon, Juana.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：下午好，胡安娜。

paras.en: SUMMERS: Eleanor, tell us more about what the G7 decided today.
paras.zh: 萨默斯：埃莉诺，请告诉我们更多有关七国集团今天决定的信息。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, in this emergency meeting, they decided to release 100 million barrels over the next four months, beginning immediately, and they'll begin by releasing barrels of diesel fuel in the first 20 days. France chairs the G7, and President Emmanuel Macron convened the meeting by video conference, which included the head of the International Energy Agency, which is based in Paris.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：在这次紧急会议上，他们决定在接下来的四个月内立即开始释放 1 亿桶柴油，并且他们将在前 20 天内开始释放几桶柴油。法国是七国集团主席国，总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙通过视频会议召开了会议，总部位于巴黎的国际能源署负责人也出席了会议。

paras.en: Macron said the release would be coordinated by the IEA. Macron said G7 members would also coordinate to increase production and bring down transport costs like the insurance for tankers, he said, and push to get more tankers flowing through the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，此次发布将由国际能源署协调。马克龙表示，七国集团成员还将协调增加产量，降低油轮保险等运输成本，并推动更多油轮通过霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: SUMMERS: And, Eleanor, President Trump's earlier threat to cut off diesel fuel experts - did it work?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：埃莉诺，特朗普总统早些时候威胁要切断柴油专家的联系，这有效吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, I would say, yes, that pressure did work, even though no one outright said so. You know, Europe is extremely dependent on imports of oil and diesel from the Middle East and the U.S., and its dependence has increased since Russia's war on Ukraine - because Russia no longer is a supplier - and since the Iran war and the choking of the Strait of Hormuz. Macron has called a possible U.S. diesel export ban, quote, "catastrophic." Just take France. It consumes about 600,000 barrels of diesel a day and imports half of that.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，我想说，是的，压力确实起作用了，尽管没有人直接这么说。要知道，欧洲极度依赖从中东和美国进口石油和柴油，而且自俄罗斯对乌克兰战争以来（因为俄罗斯不再是供应国）以及伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡堵塞以来，其依赖程度有所增加。马克龙称美国可能实施的柴油出口禁令是“灾难性的”。就拿法国来说吧。它每天消耗约 60 万桶柴油，其中一半依靠进口。

paras.en: Macron convened today's meeting after calling President Trump. Macron wants a coordinated approach between partners to the energy crisis, and the French president spoke to the media just after the G7 put out its statement, and he said this. Let's listen.
paras.zh: 马克龙在致电特朗普总统后召开了今天的会议。马克龙希望合作伙伴之间采取协调一致的方法来应对能源危机，法国总统在七国集团发表声明后不久就向媒体发表了上述言论。我们来听听。

paras.en: PRESIDENT EMMANUEL MACRON: (Speaking French).
paras.zh: 总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙：（讲法语）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "We have also agreed there will be no export bans or limitations between partners in any category," he said. "There were rumors in the market about that, and that's what made prices rise," said Macron. "So what we've done sends a signal of unity, and this should also help bring world prices down." You know, the G7 statement includes in writing that commitment of no export restrictions on energy products between G7 partners. That's a win for the Europeans who import a lot of oil and diesel from the U.S.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“我们还同意，任何类别的合作伙伴之间都不会存在出口禁令或限制，”他说。马克龙表示：“市场上有关于此事的传言，这就是价格上涨的原因。” “因此，我们所做的事情发出了团结的信号，这也应该有助于降低世界价格。”要知道，G7声明中书面承诺G7伙伴之间不限制能源产品出口。这对于从美国进口大量石油和柴油的欧洲人来说是一场胜利。

paras.en: SUMMERS: What are the domestic political considerations for EU leaders?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：欧盟领导人的国内政治考虑是什么？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, they're huge. You know, while Europeans are not involved in the Iran War and did not support it, skyrocketing energy prices are hurting consumers and businesses on the continent and putting so much pressure on governments that are already not very popular. Europe's diesel prices have more than doubled since the start of the U.S.-Iran war in late February.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，它们很大。要知道，虽然欧洲人没有卷入伊朗战争，也不支持伊朗战争，但能源价格的飙升正在损害非洲大陆的消费者和企业，给本来就不太受欢迎的政府带来巨大压力。自二月底美伊战争爆发以来，欧洲柴油价格上涨了一倍多。

paras.en: In France, Juana, diesel is $10 a gallon. Farmers, fishermen, truckers - all these categories of workers use diesel. They're also known to protest and shut down cities and highways, so leaders are really worried about social unrest. You know, we've seen some student protests turn violent here in France in the last week. It wasn't directly related to fuel costs, but anything could happen.
paras.zh: 胡安娜，在法国，柴油是每加仑 10 美元。农民、渔民、卡车司机——所有这些类别的工人都使用柴油。他们还以抗议和关闭城市和高速公路而闻名，因此领导人非常担心社会动荡。你知道，上周我们在法国看到一些学生抗议活动演变成暴力活动。这与燃料成本没有直接关系，但任何事情都有可能发生。

paras.en: And in Germany, the centrist party of Chancellor Friedrich Merz is under pressure after electoral gains on the far right and far left in state elections. So these governments are in fragile and tense situations.
paras.zh: 在德国，极右翼和极左翼在州选举中获胜，总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的中间派政党面临压力。所以这些政府处于脆弱和紧张的境地。

paras.en: SUMMERS: NPR's Eleanor Beardsley in Paris, thank you.
paras.zh: 萨默斯：NPR 驻巴黎的埃莉诺·比尔兹利，谢谢。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.

articles.title: How Brazil's two leading presidential candidates are talking about crime
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: How Brazil's two leading presidential candidates are talking about crime
paras.zh: 巴西两位主要总统候选人如何谈论犯罪问题

paras.en: Crime is at the top of voters' concerns in Brazil ahead of Sunday's national elections. Many are calling for tougher measures — part of a broader rightward shift across Latin America.
paras.zh: 在周日的全国选举之前，犯罪是巴西选民最关心的问题。许多人呼吁采取更严厉的措施——这是整个拉丁美洲更广泛的右倾趋势的一部分。

paras.en: Brazilians want tougher measures to combat crime. Polls show that's their top issue going into this Sunday's elections, and that's not good news for Brazil's leftist president. He's perceived to be soft on criminals, and he's locked in a tight campaign against the conservative son of the country's former far-right president. NPR's Carrie Kahn reports.
paras.zh: 巴西人希望采取更严厉的措施打击犯罪。民意调查显示，这是他们进入周日选举的首要问题，这对巴西左翼总统来说不是好消息。人们认为他对犯罪分子很软弱，而且他还陷入了一场针对该国前极右翼总统的保守派儿子的激烈竞选之中。 NPR 的凯莉·卡恩报道。

paras.en: CARRIE KAHN, BYLINE: Robson Florencio hits the turn signal as he heads on to a busy boulevard in Belem, his working-class neighborhood on Sao Paulo's eastern side.
paras.zh: 卡丽·卡恩连线：罗布森·弗洛伦西奥在驶向贝伦区一条繁忙的林荫大道时按下了转向灯，贝伦区是他位于圣保罗东部的工薪阶层社区。

paras.en: ROBSON FLORENCIO: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 罗布森·弗洛伦西奥：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: "You're about to see all the people living on the streets, taking and selling drugs anywhere you see a shuttered shop," he says. "We don't go out at night anymore," adds the 38-year-old father of two small kids.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“你会看到所有的人都流落街头，只要你看到一家关门的商店，他们就会吸毒和贩卖毒品，”他说。 “我们晚上不再出去了，”这位 38 岁的两个孩子的父亲补充道。

paras.en: FLORENCIO: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 弗洛伦西奥：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KAHN: We head into one of Sao Paulo's more chic, or affluent, areas. He points to a tree-lined median. About two months ago, an assailant ran up to his car, smashed the window and snatched the cell phone right out of the hand of his client sitting in the backseat. It doesn't matter where you are, he says.
paras.zh: 卡恩：我们前往圣保罗更时尚或更富裕的地区之一。他指着绿树成荫的中线。大约两个月前，一名袭击者跑到他的车前，砸碎了车窗，并从坐在后座的客户手中抢走了手机。他说，你在哪里并不重要。

paras.en: FLORENCIO: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 弗洛伦西奥：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KAHN: "Violence hits even where the rich people live," he adds. While public security data shows a drop in Brazil's homicide rate and in violent robberies, street crime remains high in many cities. Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro are infamous for snatch-and-grab cell phone theft.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“即使是富人居住的地方也会发生暴力，”他补充道。尽管公共安全数据显示巴西的凶杀率和暴力抢劫有所下降，但许多城市的街头犯罪率仍然很高。圣保罗和里约热内卢因抢夺手机盗窃而臭名昭著。

paras.en: Crime dominates conservative presidential hopeful Flavio Bolsonaro's regular stump speech. He's considered more moderate than his bombastic father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, now jailed for attempting a coup. However, the younger Bolsonaro has taken to waving a huge plastic machete at recent rallies.
paras.zh: 保守派总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的定期巡回演讲中，犯罪问题占据主导地位。他被认为比他夸夸其谈的父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗更为温和，后者目前因企图政变而入狱。然而，年轻的博尔索纳罗在最近的集会上开始挥舞着一把巨大的塑料砍刀。

paras.en: FLAVIO BOLSONARO: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KAHN: "Attention all rapists, abuser of women and children - chemical castration is coming for you," he says. Crime and insecurity used to be key issues in only local races since Brazil's states run most public safety forces. But Roberto Simone, a Brazilian risk analyst, says this year is different. It's become key in the top ticket races and presidential contest.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“所有强奸犯、虐待妇女和儿童的人请注意——化学阉割即将降临到你们身上，”他说。由于巴西各州拥有大部分公共安全部队，犯罪和不安全曾经是地方选举中的关键问题。但巴西风险分析师罗伯托·西蒙尼表示，今年有所不同。它已成为顶级门票竞赛和总统竞选的关键。

paras.en: ROBERTO SIMON: It is definitely mobilizing voters. And generally speaking, that's bad news for the left. It is a topic that traditionally favors more conservative candidates.
paras.zh: 罗伯托·西蒙：这绝对是在动员选民。一般来说，这对左派来说是个坏消息。传统上，这个话题有利于较为保守的候选人。

paras.en: KAHN: On the campaign trail, incumbent leftist president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva talks more about moving people out of poverty and improving opportunities as a way to fight crime, along with better coordination to take down crime bosses.
paras.zh: 卡恩：在竞选过程中，现任左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦更多地谈到了让人们摆脱贫困和增加机会作为打击犯罪的一种方式，以及更好地协调以打倒犯罪头目。

paras.en: PRESIDENT LUIZ INACIO LULA DA SILVA: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦总统：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: "Working together, I guarantee the Brazilian people will win," he recently told the hosts of a popular global network news show. Such long-anoterm reform messages don't excite Latin Americans as much as the iron fist or Mano Dura approach to fighting crime. Right-wing candidates have chalked up big wins in the region with tough-on-crime campaigns, says Ben Gedan of the Washington-based Stimson Center.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“通过共同努力，我保证巴西人民将会获胜，”他最近对一个受欢迎的全球网络新闻节目的主持人说道。这种长期的改革信息并不像铁拳或马诺杜拉打击犯罪的方法那样让拉丁美洲人兴奋。华盛顿史汀生中心的本·格丹表示，右翼候选人通过打击犯罪活动在该地区取得了重大胜利。

paras.en: BEN GEDAN: In the short term, voters want to see more police on the streets and more criminals in jail or in the morgue.
paras.zh: BEN GEDAN：短期内，选民希望看到街上有更多警察，监狱或太平间里有更多罪犯。

paras.en: KAHN: The last seven presidential contests in Latin America all went to conservatives and far-right candidates.
paras.zh: 卡恩：拉丁美洲过去七次总统竞选全部落入保守派和极右翼候选人手中。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: At a Bolsonaro rally overlooking Copacabana's beach, 63-year-old Marli Alves says she voted for Lula four years ago. But with what she says is out-of-control crime, she's switching to Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卡恩：在俯瞰科帕卡巴纳海滩的博尔索纳罗集会上，63 岁的马莉·阿尔维斯 (Marli Alves) 表示，她四年前投票给了卢拉。但由于她所说的犯罪失控，她转向博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: MARLI ALVES: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: MARLI ALVES：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: KAHN: "He defends us," she says. "The left just protects the criminals." Polls show the race is a statistical tie and most likely will go to a runoff later this month. Carrie Kahn, NPR News, Rio de Janeiro.
paras.zh: 卡恩：“他保护我们，”她说。 “左派只是保护罪犯。”民意调查显示，这场竞选在统计上是平手，很可能会在本月晚些时候进行决选。卡丽·卡恩，NPR 新闻，里约热内卢。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
