articles.title: Anne Hathaway Says Rihanna Inspired Her to Shake Up Her Maternity Style: ‘She Changed the Game’
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Anne Hathaway is shining bright like a diamond in her maternity looks, and she credits Rihanna as her inspiration.
paras.zh: 安妮·海瑟薇（ Anne Hathaway ）像钻石一样闪闪发光，她认为蕾哈娜（ Rihanna ）是她的灵感来源。

paras.en: While visiting CBS Mornings on Friday (Oct. 1), the actress opened up about her glamorous outfits on red carpets as of late as she promotes new psychological thriller Verity, in which she plays the titular role. When host Gayle King praised her for being so adventurous with her wardrobe while proudly showing off her baby bump, Hathaway — who’s expecting her third child with husband Adam Shulman — said, “I think we have Rihanna to thank.”
paras.zh: 在周五（ 10月1日）访问哥伦比亚广播公司早间节目时，这位女演员最近在红地毯上公开了她迷人的服装，因为她推广了新的心理惊悚片Verity ，在其中她扮演了名义上的角色。当体验达人Gayle King称赞她在自豪地炫耀她的婴儿颠簸的同时对衣柜充满冒险精神时， Hathaway （她正在期待与丈夫Adam Shulman的第三个孩子）说： “我想我们要感谢Rihanna。”

paras.en: “She changed the game,” the Devil Wears Prada star continued of the Fenty mogul. “When I saw what she was doing with her maternity style, I just realized that I just needed to use my imagination and go out there and have more fun.”
paras.zh: “她改变了游戏规则，”穿着Prada的恶魔明星继续说道。“当我看到她以母性风格所做的事情时，我刚刚意识到，我只需要运用我的想象力，走出去，享受更多的乐趣。”

paras.en: Indeed, Ri has earned acclaim for how she approached maternity fashion during her pregnancies with sons RZA and Riot Rose and daughter Rocki, whom she shares with A$AP Rocky. Rather than always keeping her baby bumps concealed or camouflaged, the hitmaker embraced bold colors and cutouts that made her belly a focal point.
paras.zh: 事实上， Ri在怀孕期间与儿子RZA和Riot Rose以及女儿Rocki （她与A $ AP Rocky分享）一起对待孕妇时尚的方式赢得了赞誉。这位热门歌手不是总是隐藏或伪装婴儿的颠簸，而是采用大胆的颜色和剪裁，使她的腹部成为焦点。

paras.en: “I’m enjoying not having to worry about covering up my tummy,” Rihanna told People in 2022. “If I feel a little chubby, it’s like, whatever! It’s a baby!”
paras.zh: 蕾哈娜在2022年告诉《人物》杂志： “我很享受不用担心掩盖我的肚子。” “如果我觉得有点胖，那就像是，不管怎样！这是一个婴儿！”

paras.en: As for Hathaway, she told King that — in addition to fun pregnancy fashion — she’s enjoying family time with her two sons, who are 10 and 6. “We’re thrilled, we’re overjoyed,” the Oscar winner shared. “But what we’re really focused on right now is actually just taking in still being a family of four, because everything’s going to change for us, but it’s really going to change for our kids.”
paras.zh: 至于Hathaway ，她告诉King ，除了有趣的怀孕时尚之外，她还与10岁和6岁的两个儿子一起享受家庭时光。“我们很高兴，我们非常高兴，”这位奥斯卡获奖者分享道。“但我们现在真正关注的实际上只是接受仍然是一个四口之家，因为对我们来说一切都会改变，但对我们的孩子来说真的会改变。”

paras.en: Watch Hathaway chat about Ri’s impact on her maternity style and new movie Verity below.
paras.zh: 观看Hathaway聊天，了解Ri对她的孕产妇风格和新电影Verity的影响。

articles.title: ‘Digger’ Unearths $1.2M in Box Office Previews Amid Warner Bros.’ Leadership Shake-Up
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Tom Cruise‘s Digger begins a bumpy box office road as it opens theatrically amid a period of transition for the Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group.
paras.zh: 汤姆·克鲁斯的《挖掘者》在华纳兄弟电影集团的转型时期上映，开启了一条崎岖的票房之路。

paras.en: Digger collected $1.2 million domestically from Thursday previews ahead of opening this weekend in more than 3,300 North American locations. Warner Bros. expects a start in the range of $12 million to $15 million for the satire that carries a $125 million production budget.
paras.zh: 《Digger》在周四的预演中获得了 120 万美元的国内票房，本周末将在北美 3,300 多个地点上映。华纳兄弟预计这部讽刺剧的起始成本为 1200 万至 1500 万美元，制作预算为 1.25 亿美元。

paras.en: Director Alejandro G. Iñárritu‘s ambitious movie marks a big swing for the studio and star alike. Digger is unlike the recent action franchises for which Cruise has been known and harkens back to the more filmmaker-driven projects from earlier in his career, such as Rain Man, Born on the Fourth of July and Magnolia. Riz Ahmed, John Goodman and Sandra Hüller also star in Digger, which centers on Cruise’s audacious oil tycoon grappling with having started a natural disaster.
paras.zh: 导演亚历杭德罗·G·伊纳里图 (Alejandro G. Iñárritu) 这部雄心勃勃的电影标志着工作室和明星的重大转变。 《挖掘者》与克鲁斯最近出名的动作片不同，它让人回想起他职业生涯早期更多由电影制作人驱动的项目，比如《雨人》、《生于七月四日》和《木兰花》。里兹·艾哈迈德 (Riz Ahmed)、约翰·古德曼 (John Goodman) 和桑德拉·惠勒 (Sandra Hüller) 也主演了《挖掘者》(Digger)，该片以克鲁斯饰演的大胆石油大亨与引发的自然灾害作斗争为中心。

paras.en: Warner Bros. sees this as an awards play and hopes for legs through word of mouth, although critics have been split, as Digger holds a 52 percent approval rating from Rotten Tomatoes reviewers. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, chief film critic David Rooney wrote that the film “ultimately just prompts a worn-down shrug.”
paras.zh: 华纳兄弟认为这是一部颁奖剧，并希望通过口碑传播，尽管评论家们意见不一，因为《Digger》在烂番茄影评人中获得了 52% 的支持率。首席影评人大卫·鲁尼在《好莱坞报道》的评论中写道，这部电影“最终只会让人疲惫不堪地耸耸肩”。

paras.en: The film arrives in theaters amid news having broken that Warner Bros. film chiefs Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy are exiting the studio. The move comes ahead of Paramount Skydance’s $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. that is likely to be finalized Oct. 6, with Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein expected to oversee the film side for both studios. De Luca and Abdy had a glittery 2025, highlighted by the Oscar wins for such celebrated titles as One Battle After Another and Sinners, although the conversation surrounding this year’s output has been dominated by high-profile misses like The Bride! and Supergirl.
paras.zh: 这部电影在影院上映之际，有消息称华纳兄弟电影首席执行官迈克尔·德·卢卡和帕梅拉·阿布迪将退出工作室。此举发生在派拉蒙 Skydance 与华纳兄弟 1110 亿美元的合并之前，该合并可能于 10 月 6 日完成，预计达纳·戈德堡和乔什·格林斯坦将负责两家电影公司的电影部门。德卢卡和阿卜迪度过了辉煌的 2025 年，其中以《一场又一场》和《罪人》等著名作品赢得奥斯卡奖为亮点，尽管围绕今年作品的讨论主要是《新娘》等备受瞩目的失败！和女超人。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Amazon MGM Studios’ Verity is expected to take the top spot over the weekend as spooky season begins. Launching Friday in 3,510 North American theaters, Verity grossed $4.5 million from Thursday previews. The studio projects an opening in the range of $27 million to $30 million for filmmaker Michael Showalter’s thriller that carries a $40 million production budget. Starring Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett, Verity adapts Colleen Hoover’s novel about struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Johnson) taking a gig as a ghostwriter for acclaimed author Verity Crawford (Hathaway).
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着恐怖季节的开始，亚马逊米高梅影业的 Verity 预计将在周末占据榜首。 《Verity》周五在北美 3,510 家影院上映，周四首映票房收入达 450 万美元。该工作室预计电影制片人迈克尔·肖沃尔特 (Michael Showalter) 的惊悚片的首映成本为 2,700 万至 3,000 万美元，制作预算为 4,000 万美元。 《维里蒂》由安妮·海瑟薇、达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特主演，改编自科琳·胡佛的小说，讲述了苦苦挣扎的作家洛文·阿什利（约翰逊饰）为著名作家维里蒂·克劳福德（海瑟薇饰）担任代笔作家的故事。

paras.en: Its previews total marks the second-best sum for a Hoover feature adaptation, behind the $7 million for Sony’s embattled 2024 offering It Ends With Us that notched an opening weekend of $50 million domestically. Last year, Universal’s adaptation of Hoover’s Reminders of Him collected $1.9 million in previews on its way to a $17.9 million domestic opening weekend.
paras.zh: 它的预映总票房创下胡佛故事片改编作品中第二高的票房成绩，仅次于索尼 2024 年推出的陷入困境的影片《与我们同在》的 700 万美元票房，后者在国内首映周末票房收入为 5,000 万美元。去年，环球影业根据胡佛的《提醒他》改编的电影在国内首周末票房收入为 1790 万美元，预映票房收入为 190 万美元。

paras.en: Verity holds a challenging 39 percent Rotten Tomatoes score from reviewers. Critic Richard Lawson wrote for THR that the movie “careens off a cliff, plummeting past so-bad-it’s-good and crashing on the rocks of agonizingly dumb.”
paras.zh: Verity 的烂番茄评分高达 39%，颇具挑战性。影评人理查德·劳森 (Richard Lawson) 为《好莱坞报道》撰文称，这部电影“从悬崖上坠落，从糟糕的美好事物中一落千丈，跌落在令人痛苦的愚蠢的岩石上”。

articles.title: James Gunn, Peter Safran to Stay at DC Studios as Brand Takes Key Position at Skydance
articles.author: Aaron Couch

paras.en: When David Ellison unveiled Skydance as the new (but old) name for the combined Paramount and Warner Bros. media entity Friday morning, he showed off a snazzy video reel with clips of movies and shows from both companies, set to the Hans Zimmer score from Inception.
paras.zh: 周五早上，当大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 宣布 Skydance 作为派拉蒙和华纳兄弟媒体实体合并后的新（但旧）名称时，他展示了一段时髦的视频卷轴，其中包含两家公司的电影和节目片段，背景是《盗梦空间》中汉斯·齐默 (Hans Zimmer) 的配乐。

paras.en: The video end with a constellation of eight brand logos surrounding the Skydance name. And at the top tier, above Skydance, were the Paramount mountain, the Warners shield, and … the round DC bullet.
paras.zh: 视频结尾是围绕 Skydance 名称的八个品牌徽标。在顶层，Skydance 上方，是派拉蒙山、华纳盾牌和……圆形 DC 子弹。

paras.en: The appearance of DC in the constellation is as strong a Bat-signal as you can have as to the importance of DC, both the studio and the publisher, to the new company.
paras.zh: DC 在星座中的出现就像一个强烈的蝙蝠信号，表明 DC（工作室和发行商）对新公司的重要性。

paras.en: More importantly, according to several insiders, in the midst of a shakeout that is seeing executives stay or exiting, DC heads James Gunn and Peter Safran are staying put. At least for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，据几位内部人士透露，在高管留任或离职的洗牌过程中，DC 负责人詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 仍留任。至少在可预见的未来。

paras.en: Multiple sources tell The Hollywood Reporter that the duo met with Ellison in person Thursday and that the meeting was positive. The pair were asked to stay and “keep doing what you’re doing,” per one source.
paras.zh: 多位消息人士告诉《好莱坞报道》，两人周四亲自会见了埃里森，这次会面是积极的。据一位消息人士透露，两人被要求留下来，“继续做你正在做的事情”。

paras.en: But it’s unclear how the two heads, and DC in general, fit into the organizational structure of Skydance. It is unknown to whom Gunn and Safran would report, whether it would be straight to Ellison or if it would be layered underneath Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg, the current Paramount film heads who are expected to oversee both film studios, while current Warner film chiefs, Pam Abdy and Michael De Luca, are being shown the door. (At Warner Bros. Discovery, Gunn and Safran reported directly to CEO David Zaslav.)
paras.zh: 但目前尚不清楚这两位负责人以及整个 DC 如何适应 Skydance 的组织结构。目前尚不清楚冈恩和萨夫兰将向谁汇报，是直接向埃里森汇报，还是隶属于派拉蒙现任电影主管乔什·格林斯坦和达纳·戈德堡，他们预计将监管两家电影制片厂，而华纳现任电影主管帕姆·阿布迪和迈克尔·德·卢卡则被赶出公司。 （在华纳兄弟探索频道，Gunn 和 Safran 直接向首席执行官 David Zaslav 汇报。）

paras.en: At this point, it is known that Ellison is supportive of Gunn and Safran and wants them to continue leading. The general consensus is they should at least see through the releases of the movies that are either completed or in post-production, namely the upcoming horror thriller Clayface (Oct. 23), and the especially Man of Tomorrow, the big-budget Superman sequel that opens July 2027. In a show of support, Ellison visited the Atlanta set of that movie over the summer.
paras.zh: 目前，众所周知，埃里森支持冈恩和赛峰，并希望他们继续领先。普遍的共识是，他们至少应该看完已上映或正在后期制作的电影，即即将上映的恐怖惊悚片《泥面》（10 月 23 日），以及将于 2027 年 7 月上映的大预算超人续集《明日之人》。为了表示支持，埃里森在夏天参观了该电影在亚特兰大的拍摄地。

paras.en: No one want to a repeat of the situation that occurred with the 2023 releases of The Flash and Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom, two movies made by one studio regime and opened by another, and which were left dangling in the wind. Both underperformed at the box office.
paras.zh: 没有人希望重蹈 2023 年上映的《闪电侠》和《海王与失落的王国》的覆辙，这两部电影由一个制片厂制作、由另一个制片厂开拍，却被搁置在风中。两者的票房表现均不佳。

paras.en: That said, the executives’ fortunes could turn swiftly turn. Abdy and DeLuca are examples of that.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，高管们的命运可能会迅速转变。阿迪和德卢卡就是这样的例子。

paras.en: As one studio insider notes, De Luca and Abdy “were led to believe they would still be here post-merger.” Adds this person: “They met with David months ago and felt secure. Clearly a lot has changed since then.”
paras.zh: 正如一位工作室内部人士指出的那样，德卢卡和阿卜迪“被引导相信合并后他们仍会留在这里。”此人补充道：“他们几个月前见过大卫，感到很安全。显然，自那以后发生了很多变化。”

paras.en: The DC logo appearance is also good news for DC Comics, which in the last two years has seen an turnaround in which the publisher has overtaken sales and marketshare from rival Marvel Comics for the first time in decades. That is thanks to the new Absolute Universe imprint and a focus on rebuilding creator relationships.
paras.zh: DC标志的出现对DC漫画来说也是个好消息，在过去的两年里，DC漫画出现了好转，几十年来首次超越竞争对手漫威漫画的销量和市场份额。这要归功于新的绝对宇宙印记和对重建创造者关系的关注。

paras.en: In the past several years, there have been blips of rumors that Warner Bros. Discovery wanted to sell off the division, which WBD head David Zaslav never did. The likelihood of that is even less now. “It’s an IP generator,” says one source with knowledge of the workings of DC and comics world.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，一直有传言称华纳兄弟探索频道想要出售该部门，但 WBD 负责人大卫·扎斯拉夫 (David Zaslav) 从未这么做过。现在这种可能性更小了。 “这是一个 IP 生成器，”一位了解 DC 和漫画世界运作的消息人士说道。

paras.en: It does, however, suggest DC could potentially put out comics based on Paramount-owned IP, such as Star Trek and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.
paras.zh: 不过，这确实表明 DC 可能会推出基于派拉蒙旗下 IP 的漫画，例如《星际迷航》和《忍者神龟》。

paras.en: “I can see why Skydance would combine Nickelodeon with Cartoon Network,” says the source. “DC? They’re not touching that.”
paras.zh: “我明白为什么 Skydance 会将 Nickelodeon 与卡通频道结合起来，”消息人士说道。 “DC？他们没有碰那个。”

articles.title: Skydance Is a Decent Name, It’s Just Weaker Than Paramount or Warner Bros.
articles.author: James Hibberd

paras.en: In the wake of David Ellison announcing that his combined Paramount-Warner Bros. company would be called Skydance, many on social media are making variations on the same comment: “Ellison just killed the legacies of both Warner Bros. and Paramount in one fell swoop,” bemoaned one New York Post. “Skydance is so weak.”
paras.zh: 在大卫·埃里森宣布他的派拉蒙与华纳兄弟合并后的公司将更名为 Skydance 后，社交媒体上的许多人都对同一评论做出了不同的说法：“埃里森一举扼杀了华纳兄弟和派拉蒙的遗产，”《纽约邮报》的一篇哀叹道。 “天舞太弱了。”

paras.en: Ellison has reassured that the 103-year-old Warner Bros. brand and the 114-year-old Paramount brand will stick around. “We will honor what makes Paramount and Warner Bros. special — giving both studios the opportunity to grow, tell more great stories and bring those stories to even broader audiences around the world, powered by the scale and capabilities of Skydance,” he wrote in a statement announcing the branding change Friday.
paras.zh: 埃里森保证，拥有 103 年历史的华纳兄弟品牌和拥有 114 年历史的派拉蒙品牌将继续存在。 “我们将尊重派拉蒙和华纳兄弟的特殊之处——在 Skydance 的规模和能力的推动下，让两家工作室都有机会成长，讲述更多精彩故事，并将这些故事带给世界各地更广泛的观众，”他在周五宣布品牌变更的声明中写道。

paras.en: Ellison revealed a logo menu that had Skydance front and center and large, orbited by tiny icons for brands like Warners and Paramount (along with CBS, HBO Max, DC, CNN and, perhaps just to balance out the graphic, Nickelodeon).
paras.zh: 埃里森透露了一个标志菜单，其中Skydance位于前面和中间，而且很大，周围是华纳和派拉蒙等品牌的小图标（还有CBS、HBO Max、DC、CNN，也许只是为了平衡图形，Nickelodeon）。

paras.en: It’s unclear how much the Paramount and Warner Bros. brands will mean going forward. The optimistic parent-studio example would be something like Comcast owning Universal — audiences still think of Universal as its own thing. The pessimistic version is Disney buying 20th Century Fox — it kept the studio but dropped the “Fox,” and the label’s output shrank. Early signs, including Ellison’s leadership shakeups, point to a combined studio here as well. “Paramount” and “Warner Bros.” might remain strong entities … or could devolve into names used mostly for the movies and shows they’re stamped on rather than for actual companies.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚派拉蒙和华纳兄弟品牌未来的意义有多大。乐观的家长工作室的例子就像康卡斯特收购环球影业一样——观众仍然认为环球影业是自己的东西。悲观的版本是迪士尼收购了二十世纪福克斯——它保留了工作室，但放弃了“福克斯”，而该公司的产量也随之萎缩。包括埃里森领导层改组在内的早期迹象也表明这里将有一个联合工作室。 “派拉蒙”和“华纳兄弟”可能仍然是强大的实体……或者可能会演变为主要用于电影和节目的名称，而不是实际公司的名称。

paras.en: Still, the naming decision looked rather egoic, didn’t it? You buy one iconic company, then buy a second iconic company, then slap your 20-year-old production company’s banner above both of them. It’s not quite a Trump-ian move — Ellison could have called the company ELLISON and then sat back and laughed at Mark Ruffalo’s rage tweets — but it’s certainly in the neighborhood of saying, “Hey, I won.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这个命名决定看起来还是相当自负，不是吗？你购买了一家标志性公司，然后购买了第二家标志性公司，然后将你已有 20 年历史的制作公司的旗帜打在这两家公司上方。这并不完全是特朗普式的举动——埃里森本可以将该公司称为“埃里森”，然后坐下来嘲笑马克·鲁法洛的愤怒推文——但这肯定是在说，“嘿，我赢了。”

paras.en: And as corporate names go, Skydance isn’t terrible.
paras.zh: 就公司名称而言，Skydance 并不糟糕。

paras.en: I know. The move this morning is to hate on it. But Skydance isn’t like … Comcast. Or Max. Or Tubi. Or Peacock. Or AMC Networks (relationship to AMC Theatres? None whatsoever!). Those are terrible.
paras.zh: 我知道。今天早上的举动是讨厌它。但 Skydance 不像……康卡斯特。或者麦克斯。或者图比。或者孔雀。或者 AMC Networks（与 AMC Theatres 的关系？没有任何关系！）。那些太可怕了。

paras.en: Skydance just sounds very much like what it is: A circa 2006 production company that also feels vaguely Silicon Valley. One can imagine a Skydance Corp. making fintech products, data centers or dating apps. As such, it also seems very 21st century, which one supposes goes into the brand’s plus column.
paras.zh: Skydance 听起来很像它的实际情况：一家 2006 年左右的制作公司，也隐隐约约带有硅谷的感觉。人们可以想象 Skydance Corp. 生产金融科技产品、数据中心或约会应用程序。因此，它看起来也很21世纪，人们认为这属于该品牌的加号栏。

paras.en: And it doesn’t carry a fraction of the weight, gravitas, legacy, or brand recognition of the studios it effectively overtook.
paras.zh: 而且它的分量、庄重、遗产或品牌认知度远不及它所取代的工作室的一小部分。

paras.en: Warner Bros. has the most value for consumers. The studio has 12,500 feature films and 2,400 TV programs. The name is so valued, it’s survived countless mergers and acquisitions (see Erik Hayden’s excellent history of the Warner Bros. and Paramount names).
paras.zh: 华纳兄弟对消费者来说最具价值。该工作室拥有 12,500 部故事片和 2,400 部电视节目。这个名字非常有价值，经历了无数次并购（参见埃里克·海登（Erik Hayden）关于华纳兄弟和派拉蒙名字的精彩历史）。

paras.en: Yet the name is also a relic — the legacy of Harry, Albert, Sam and Jack, the last of whom passed away nearly 50 years ago. One can understand Ellison not wanting to name the parent company after some studio bosses from the 1940s.
paras.zh: 然而，这个名字也是一个遗迹——哈利、阿尔伯特、萨姆和杰克的遗产，其中最后一个人已于近 50 年前去世。人们可以理解埃里森不想以 20 世纪 40 年代的一些工作室老板的名字来命名母公司。

paras.en: The Paramount library is considerably smaller, but the name was still a household name. The combined company could have kept Paramount on top. The name doesn’t feel particularly dated. So to whatever extent going with the name Skydance is a surprise, the surprise is that Ellison didn’t just stick with Paramount like Shari Redstone did when she merged CBS with her father’s company Viacom (now there’s a bad name — Viacom sounds like a villainous corporation from a 1980s Paul Verhoeven film).
paras.zh: 派拉蒙图书馆规模要小得多，但这个名字仍然家喻户晓。合并后的公司本可以让派拉蒙继续保持领先地位。这个名字感觉不是特别过时。因此，无论在多大程度上使用 Skydance 这个名字都是令人惊讶的，令人惊讶的是，埃里森并没有像莎莉·雷石东 (Shari Redstone) 将哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 与其父亲的公司维亚康姆 (Viacom) 合并时那样，只坚持使用派拉蒙 (Viacom)（维亚康姆听起来像是 20 世纪 80 年代保罗·范霍文 (Paul Verhoeven) 电影中的邪恶公司）。

paras.en: Doing some combined monster like “Paramount Skydance Warner Bros. Discovery” would have been dreadful — a name that only a lawyer could love and a constant reminder of the ghost of mergers past.
paras.zh: 制作像“Paramount Skydance Warner Bros. Discovery”这样的合并怪物会很可怕——这个名字只有律师才会喜欢，而且不断提醒人们过去合并的幽灵。

paras.en: Starting Tuesday, all this becomes Wall Street official when PSKY switches to SKYD on the ticker.
paras.zh: 从周二开始，当股票代码上的 PSKY 切换为 SKYD 时，这一切都将成为华尔街的正式内容。

paras.en: There’s a line from Raiders of the Lost Ark — which opens with the Paramount mountain fading into a similar-looking peak in South America — where the villain tells Indiana Jones that when you bury a trinket in the sand, and enough years pass, it becomes priceless. So who knows. Maybe with another 100 years of track record, Skydance will be a name worth to entertainment fans what Warner Bros. and Paramount are worth today. It’s just a long time to wait.
paras.zh: 《夺宝奇兵》中有一句台词——开头是派拉蒙山渐渐消失在南美洲一座类似的山峰中——反派告诉印第安纳·琼斯，当你把一件小饰品埋在沙子里，经过足够长的时间，它就会变得无价。所以谁知道呢。或许，凭借再过 100 年的业绩记录，Skydance 对于娱乐迷来说将成为一个像今天的华纳兄弟和派拉蒙那样的品牌。只是等待的时间很长。

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report

paras.en: Treasury yields rose on Friday, after initially falling following an unexpectedly weak September jobs report likely put the brakes on a Federal Reserve rate hike in October.
paras.zh: 周五美国国债收益率上涨，此前9月份就业报告出人意料地疲软，可能会阻碍美联储10月份加息，随后美国国债收益率最初下跌。

paras.en: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield rose 4 basis points to 5.281%. Earlier this week, the yield reached its highest levels since 2002. The 30-year Treasury yield added 3 basis points at 5.633%. The 2-year Treasury yield, which is the most sensitive to Fed moves, was higher by almost 5 basis points at 4.835%.
paras.zh: 基准10年期国债收益率上涨4个基点至5.281%。本周早些时候，收益率达到2002年以来的最高水平。30年期国债收益率上涨3个基点至5.633%。对美联储举措最敏感的2年期国债收益率上涨近5个基点至4.835%。

paras.en: One basis point is equal to 0.01%, and yields and prices move in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 1个基点等于0.01%，收益率和价格走势相反。

paras.en: Nonfarm payrolls increased by just 29,000 for the month while the unemployment rate increased to 4.2% from 4.1%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday. Economists surveyed by Dow Jones had been predicting an 84,000 increase and unemployment to remain steady. The August jobs count was revised lower to a gain of 133,000.
paras.zh: 美国劳工统计局周五报告称，本月非农就业人数仅增加 29,000 人，而失业率则从 4.1% 升至 4.2%。接受道琼斯调查的经济学家此前预计新增人数将增加 84,000 人，失业率将保持稳定。 8 月份就业人数下调至 133,000 人。

paras.en: Yields initially fell in reaction to the report, but throughout the trading session they moved back into positive territory.
paras.zh: 最初，收益率因该报告而下跌，但在整个交易时段，收益率又回到正值区域。

paras.en: "I think that's the right move because I don't think this report necessarily changes the story for the Fed," said Timothy Chubb, chief investment officer at Girard Advisory Services. "I still think the trajectory from here is higher for longer."
paras.zh: 吉拉德咨询服务公司首席投资官蒂莫西·查布表示：“我认为这是正确的举措，因为我认为这份报告不一定会改变美联储的情况。” “我仍然认为从这里开始的轨迹会更高，持续时间更长。”

paras.en: Traders now see a 78% chance that the Federal Reserve will hold rates steady at its October meeting, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool, though traders still see a high likelihood for a hike at its meeting in December.
paras.zh: 根据 CME 集团的 FedWatch 工具，交易员目前认为美联储在 10 月会议上维持利率不变的可能性为 78%，不过交易员仍然认为在 12 月会议上加息的可能性很高。

paras.en: Lindsay Rosner, head of multi-sector fixed income investing at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, agrees that a rate increase is unlikely this month, but that it's likely the Fed's hiking cycle isn't over.
paras.zh: 高盛资产管理公司多部门固定收益投资主管 Lindsay Rosner 也认为本月不太可能加息，但美联储的加息周期可能还没有结束。

paras.en: "Today's soft print argues against the idea that the labor market is retightening," she said. "One follow-up hike in December remains our base case; however, continued pressure by markets and moves higher in energy prices could force the Fed's hand this month as well."
paras.zh: “今天的软文反对劳动力市场正在收紧的观点，”她说。 “12月份的一次后续加息仍然是我们的基本预期；然而，市场的持续压力和能源价格的走高也可能迫使美联储本月采取行动。”

paras.en: Pressure on global government bonds eased elsewhere after a sharp sell-off this week, with 10-year yields down by around 3 basis points across major European economies. The recent rise in yields reflects concerns about stubborn inflation and hawkish central bank commentary, fueling expectations that interest rates could remain elevated for longer.
paras.zh: 本周大幅抛售后，全球政府债券面临的压力有所缓解，欧洲主要经济体 10 年期国债收益率下降了约 3 个基点。近期收益率上升反映了对顽固通胀和央行鹰派评论的担忧，引发了利率可能在更长时间内保持高位的预期。

articles.title: Why Lilly and Novo are betting on amylin to power a new wave of obesity drugs after GLP-1s

paras.en: The next generation of blockbuster obesity drugs isn't trying to replace GLP-1 medicines.
paras.zh: 下一代重磅减肥药物并不试图取代 GLP-1 药物。

paras.en: Instead, drugmakers are developing treatments that can complement existing drugs and push weight loss further, or offer new options for potentially millions of people who may not get enough benefit from GLP-1s.
paras.zh: 相反，制药商正在开发可以补充现有药物并进一步减轻体重的治疗方法，或者为可能无法从 GLP-1 中获得足够益处的数百万人提供新的选择。

paras.en: That's the early potential of a new slate of injections, pills, and combination regimens targeting the amylin pathway, which involves a hormone released in the pancreas alongside insulin that helps regulate hunger and fullness. Amylin gives Eli Lilly, Novo and several other companies another biological lever to pull in treating obesity and Type 2 diabetes, either as an independent treatment or layered on top of existing drugs.
paras.zh: 这是针对胰淀素途径的一系列新的注射剂、药物和联合治疗方案的早期潜力，该途径涉及胰腺中释放的一种激素以及胰岛素，有助于调节饥饿和饱腹感。 Amylin 为礼来 (Eli Lilly)、Novo 和其他几家公司提供了另一种生物手段来治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病，既可以作为独立治疗方法，也可以叠加在现有药物之上。

paras.en: Lilly offered a promising glimpse of that strategy this week.
paras.zh: 礼来公司本周对该策略做出了有希望的一瞥。

paras.en: The company's experimental amylin-targeting drug, eloralintide, helped produce substantially more weight loss when combined with tirzepatide – the active ingredient in its blockbuster Zepbound and Mounjaro shots – in a Phase 2 trial on patients with obesity and Type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 该公司的实验性胰淀素靶向药物 eloralintide 在一项针对肥胖和 2 型糖尿病患者的 2 期试验中，与替西帕肽（其畅销药物 Zepbound 和 Mounjaro 注射液中的活性成分）联合使用，有助于显着减轻体重。

paras.en: At 48 weeks, people receiving the highest-dose combination lost an average of 23.3% of their body weight, compared with 14.8% among those only taking a high dose of tirzepatide. Those figures are based on efficacy analysis that assumes patients remained on treatment in the trial.
paras.zh: 48 周时，接受最高剂量联合治疗的患者体重平均减轻了 23.3%，而仅服用高剂量替泽帕肽的患者体重减轻了 14.8%。这些数字基于功效分析，假设患者在试验中继续接受治疗。

paras.en: "These are encouraging results," said Benjamin Bikman, a professor at Brigham Young University and leading expert on metabolic health and insulin resistance. "Adults with type 2 diabetes typically lose less weight on these therapies than those without diabetes."
paras.zh: “这些结果令人鼓舞，”杨百翰大学教授、代谢健康和胰岛素抵抗领域的首席专家本杰明·比克曼说。 “患有 2 型糖尿病的成年人在这些疗法中通常比没有糖尿病的人减轻的体重更少。”

paras.en: Lilly is developing eloralintide both as a standalone treatment and as part of that combo therapy. The two components make up what some analysts view as a major future franchise for the company.
paras.zh: 礼来公司正在开发 eloralintide，既可以作为独立疗法，也可以作为联合疗法的一部分。一些分析师认为，这两个部分构成了该公司未来的主要特许经营权。

paras.en: Leerink Partners analyst David Risinger forecasts $23.2 billion in annual sales for Lilly's eloralintide products by the end of 2035. He said he expects the standalone drug to launch first in 2029, followed by the combo in 2030.
paras.zh: Leerink Partners 分析师 David Risinger 预测，到 2035 年底，礼来公司 eloralintide 产品的年销售额将达到 232 亿美元。他表示，他预计该独立药物将在 2029 年首次上市，随后在 2030 年推出复方药物。

paras.en: "There are millions of individuals, potentially over 10 million people, who have tried GLP-1s and failed due to efficacy reasons, tolerability issues, or genetic issues where they simply do not respond to one," Risinger told CNBC. "We think this novel mechanism, this amylin analog … will offer a major new treatment alternative for patients, both as a monotherapy and as a combination therapy. "
paras.zh: Risinger 告诉 CNBC：“有数以百万计的人，可能超过 1000 万人，尝试过 GLP-1，但由于功效原因、耐受性问题或基因问题而失败，因为他们对 GLP-1 根本没有反应。” “我们认为这种新颖的机制，这种胰淀素类似物……将为患者提供一种主要的新治疗选择，既可以作为单一疗法，也可以作为联合疗法。”

paras.en: Risinger said he sees greater potential for standalone eloralintide given the "huge independent patient pool" that hasn't seen success on existing GLP-1s. Lilly still sees a clear opportunity for pairing the medications.
paras.zh: Risinger 表示，鉴于现有 GLP-1 尚未取得成功的“庞大的独立患者库”，他认为独立的 eloralintide 具有更大的潜力。礼来公司仍然看到了将药物配对的明显机会。

paras.en: "Patients may not get what they need from a drug like tirzepatide," Ken Custer, president of Lilly Cardiometabolic Health, said in an interview. "They may not get what they need from a drug like a eloralintide on its own."
paras.zh: 礼来公司心脏代谢健康公司总裁肯·卡斯特在接受采访时表示：“患者可能无法从像替西帕肽这样的药物中获得所需的东西。” “他们可能无法从像 eloralintide 这样的药物本身获得所需的东西。”

paras.en: Bikman also said he sees the combo as an opportunity for patients who started on tirzepatide alone but saw their weight loss plateau.
paras.zh: 比克曼还表示，他认为该组合对于那些开始单独服用替泽帕肽但体重下降停滞不前的患者来说是一个机会。

paras.en: But Lilly still has a lot to prove. The data comes from a relatively small Phase 2 study that the company will need to confirm in Phase 3 trials, which will begin later this year.
paras.zh: 但莉莉还有很多东西需要证明。这些数据来自一项相对较小的第二阶段研究，该公司需要在今年晚些时候开始的第三阶段试验中确认该研究。

paras.en: Lilly also aims to improve how well patients tolerate the combo regimen in later studies. More patients taking both drugs — 10.8% to 27%, depending on the dose — discontinued treatment due to side effects, compared with the 2.9% of people on tirzepatide alone in the trial.
paras.zh: 礼来公司还致力于在后续研究中提高患者对联合疗法的耐受性。更多服用这两种药物的患者（10.8% 至 27%，具体取决于剂量）因副作用而停止治疗，而试验中仅服用替西帕肽的患者为 2.9%。

paras.en: "A therapy is only effective if patients can remain on it, so tolerability in Phase 3 will be as important as efficacy," Bikman said.
paras.zh: Bikman 说：“只有患者能够坚持治疗，治疗才有效，因此第三阶段的耐受性与疗效同样重要。”

paras.en: Dr. Caroline Apovian, co-director of the Center for Weight Management and Wellness at Brigham and Women's Hospital, added that "27% is not a good number."
paras.zh: 布莱根妇女医院体重管理和健康中心联席主任卡罗琳·阿波维安博士补充说，“27% 并不是一个好数字。”

paras.en: Still, the results add to a growing body of evidence that amylin could become an important tool against obesity and diabetes.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些结果仍然增加了越来越多的证据表明胰淀素可以成为对抗肥胖和糖尿病的重要工具。

paras.en: Lilly isn't alone in betting that amylin can become a building block for the next generation of obesity drugs. Novo has spent years pursuing a similar strategy.
paras.zh: 礼来公司并不是唯一一家押注胰淀素可以成为下一代肥胖药物的基础材料的公司。 Novo 多年来一直在推行类似的战略。

paras.en: Novo's experimental amylin-based drug, cagrilintide, has shown meaningful weight loss as a standalone treatment in a late-stage trial. Combining it with semaglutide – together dubbed CagriSema – has produced even greater weight loss in clinical studies. CagriSema is expected to launch early next year, followed by standalone cagrilintide and a higher-dose version of CagriSema in 2028.
paras.zh: Novo 的实验性胰淀素药物卡格林肽 (cagrilintide) 在一项后期试验中作为独立治疗显示出有意义的减肥效果。在临床研究中，将其与索马鲁肽（一起称为 CagriSema）相结合，可以产生更大的减肥效果。 CagriSema 预计将于明年初推出，随后将在 2028 年推出独立的 cagrilintide 和高剂量版本的 CagriSema。

paras.en: Novo is also developing another treatment called amycretin, or zenagamtide, which is a single molecule that would target both GLP-1 and amylin to treat obesity and Type 2 diabetes. The Danish drugmaker is testing it as a once-weekly injection and a daily oral tablet, and the drug showed promising Phase 2 results earlier this year.
paras.zh: Novo 还在开发另一种治疗方法，称为amycretin 或zenagamtide，它是一种单分子，可同时靶向GLP-1 和amylin 来治疗肥胖和2 型糖尿病。这家丹麦制药商正在将其作为每周一次的注射剂和每日口服片剂进行测试，该药物在今年早些时候显示出有希望的 2 期结果。

paras.en: Several companies, including Pfizer, AstraZeneca and Viking Therapeutics, are developing their own amylin products, as well.
paras.zh: 包括辉瑞（Pfizer）、阿斯利康（AstraZeneca）和 Viking Therapeutics 在内的几家公司也在开发自己的胰淀素产品。

paras.en: The first – and so far only – amylin therapy was approved in the U.S. more than two decades ago as an add-on mealtime injection for people with diabetes who use insulin. But adoption was limited in part because it required multiple injections a day.
paras.zh: 二十多年前，第一个也是迄今为止唯一的胰淀素疗法在美国获得批准，作为使用胰岛素的糖尿病患者的附加餐时注射。但采用受到限制，部分原因是它需要每天多次注射。

paras.en: New therapies in development are long-acting, meaning they are designed to mimic the hormone in a sustained way and can be taken once a week, Bikman said.
paras.zh: 比克曼说，正在开发的新疗法是长效的，这意味着它们旨在以持续的方式模拟这种激素，并且可以每周服用一次。

paras.en: Amylin helps signal fullness, suppress appetite and slow the movement of food through the stomach, similar to what GLP-1 does. But amylin achieves that by acting on an entirely different biological pathway.
paras.zh: 胰淀素有助于发出饱腹感、抑制食欲并减缓食物在胃中的移动，类似于 GLP-1 的作用。但胰淀素通过作用于完全不同的生物途径来实现这一点。

paras.en: "It's the same outcome, but a different approach," Bikman told CNBC.
paras.zh: 比克曼告诉 CNBC：“结果相同，但方法不同。”

paras.en: The idea is that targeting multiple pathways could produce more weight loss or other metabolic benefits than any single pathway can achieve on its own, and without relying entirely on higher doses of a single drug.
paras.zh: 这个想法是，针对多种途径可以比任何单一途径单独实现更多的减肥或其他代谢益处，并且无需完全依赖更高剂量的单一药物。

paras.en: New data from Novo this week suggests that the benefits could go beyond physical changes.
paras.zh: Novo 本周的新数据表明，其好处可能不仅仅是身体变化。

paras.en: CagriSema reduced "food noise" — persistent thoughts about food — and showed improvements to organ and bone health in a yearlong functional magnetic resonance imaging study, which is a noninvasive method to measure brain activity during specific tasks. Novo said CagriSema changed how the brain reacted to tempting, high-calorie foods in areas linked to cravings, pleasure and self-control in people with obesity or who were overweight.
paras.zh: CagriSema 减少了“食物噪音”（对食物的持续思考），并在一项为期一年的功能性磁共振成像研究中显示出器官和骨骼健康的改善，这是一种在特定任务期间测量大脑活动的非侵入性方法。诺沃说，CagriSema 改变了肥胖或超重人群的大脑对诱人的高热量食物的反应，这些区域与渴望、愉悦和自我控制有关。

paras.en: "The signal in the brain changes in a way that actually is associated with improved quality of life," Martin Holst Lange, Novo's chief scientific officer, said in an interview.
paras.zh: Novo 首席科学官马丁·霍尔斯特·兰格 (Martin Holst Lange) 在接受采访时表示：“大脑信号的变化实际上与生活质量的提高有关。”

paras.en: Developing treatments that target several hormone pathways rather than one is part of a broader shift in the obesity drug race, even beyond amylin.
paras.zh: 开发针对多种激素途径而不是一种激素途径的治疗方法是肥胖药物竞赛中更广泛转变的一部分，甚至超越胰淀素。

paras.en: Tirzepatide already pairs GLP-1 with GIP, while Lilly's experimental drug retatrutide also adds glucagon to the mix. Retatrutide has produced some of the largest weight loss results reported in obesity drug trials to date, and Bikman said published data on the drug demonstrate substantial reductions in liver fat, triglycerides and fasting insulin.
paras.zh: Tirzepatide 已经将 GLP-1 与 GIP 配对，而礼来公司的实验药物瑞他鲁肽也将胰高血糖素添加到混合物中。迄今为止，瑞他鲁肽在肥胖药物试验中取得了一些最大的减肥效果，比克曼表示，该药物的公布数据表明，肝脏脂肪、甘油三酯和空腹胰岛素大幅减少。

paras.en: It's too early to definitively say whether combination amylin drugs could be superior to tirzepatide or other next-generation treatments. They'll have to clear more clinical trials and regulatory reviews first.
paras.zh: 现在确定联合胰淀素药物是否优于替泽帕肽或其他下一代治疗方法还为时过早。他们必须首先通过更多的临床试验和监管审查。

paras.en: But all the medicines in development are working toward a broader goal shared by several drugmakers: giving patients a variety of obesity and diabetes treatment options to meet their individualized needs.
paras.zh: 但所有正在开发的药物都致力于实现几个制药商共同的更广泛目标：为患者提供多种肥胖和糖尿病治疗选择，以满足他们的个性化需求。

articles.title: Stocks rise after soft jobs data; Nasdaq hits record led by Nvidia: Live updates

paras.en: Stocks rose Friday, though were off their highs, following a surprisingly weak jobs report that raised hopes the Federal Reserve will hold rates steady in October.
paras.zh: 周五股市上涨，但仍脱离高点，此前就业报告出人意料地疲软，提高了美联储将在 10 月份维持利率稳定的希望。

paras.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 244 points, or 0.5%. The S&P 500 gained 0.7%, while the Nasdaq Composite climbed 1.2%, hitting an all-time high earlier in the day before retreating slightly from those levels.
paras.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 244 点，即 0.5%。标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.7%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨 1.2%，当天早些时候触及历史新高，然后小幅回落。

paras.en: Treasury yields fell Friday initially following the employment report, though they rebounded, pushing U.S. equities off their highs for the session.
paras.zh: 周五就业报告公布后，美国国债收益率最初下跌，但随后反弹，推动美国股市脱离盘中高点。

paras.en: Tech stocks rallied as risk-taking resumed on Wall Street, with shares of Nvidia hitting an all-time high for the first time since May. CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks and AMD also all rose to all-time highs. Meanwhile, shares of AMD also and 2%.
paras.zh: 随着华尔街恢复冒险精神，科技股上涨，英伟达股价自 5 月份以来首次创下历史新高。 CrowdStrike、Palo Alto Networks 和 AMD 的股价也都升至历史新高。与此同时，AMD的股价也上涨了2%。

paras.en: September's nonfarm payrolls report showed the U.S. economy added 29,000 jobs last month, with unemployment rising to 4.2%. The Dow Jones consensus called for jobs growth of 84,000 and for the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.1%.
paras.zh: 9月非农就业报告显示，美国经济上月新增就业岗位2.9万个，失业率升至4.2%。道琼斯共识预计就业岗位将增长 84,000 个，失业率稳定在 4.1%。

paras.en: "This is the exact kind of number the market wanted from a labor standpoint," said Phil Blancato, chief market strategist at Osaic. "Not too hot, not too cold ... not overly great, and not weakening."
paras.zh: Osaic 首席市场策略师 Phil Blancato 表示：“从劳动力的角度来看，这正是市场想要的数字。” “不太热，不太冷……不太好，也不会减弱。”

paras.en: That number made traders reassess the next move for the Federal Reserve. Fed funds futures trading suggests a 78% likelihood the central bank will stand pat at this month's meeting, up from a roughly 76% chance just the prior day, according to the CME FedWatch Tool.
paras.zh: 这个数字让交易员重新评估美联储的下一步行动。根据 CME FedWatch 工具的数据，联邦基金期货交易表明，美联储在本月的会议上保持不变的可能性为 78%，高于前一天的约 76%。

paras.en: Saira Malik, chief investment officer at Nuveen, told CNBC's "Squawk Box" that the report may give the market support before earnings season kicks off, which she thinks will be "very strong."
paras.zh: Nuveen 首席投资官 Saira Malik 向 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”表示，该报告可能会在财报季开始前为市场提供支撑，她认为这将“非常强劲”。

paras.en: "So, I think this could be the start of the Santa Claus rally that we've all been hoping for," she said.
paras.zh: “所以，我认为这可能是我们一直希望的圣诞老人集会的开始，”她说。

paras.en: Oil prices pulled back, supporting equities, following a report that European nation states are considering a release of strategic fuel reserves following pressure from the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 有报道称，在特朗普政府的压力下，欧洲国家正在考虑释放战略燃料储备，油价回落，支撑股市。

paras.en: Investors are coming off a modestly higher session Thursday, to start off the month of October. However, the Dow and the S&P 500 were headed for weekly losses amid a global bond rout, while the Nasdaq was the only major average on pace to end the week with gains.
paras.zh: 投资者周四小幅走高，迎接十月份的到来。然而，在全球债券暴跌的情况下，道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数将每周下跌，而纳斯达克指数是唯一有望在本周结束时上涨的主要指数。

paras.en: — CNBC's Jeff Cox contributed to this report
paras.zh: — CNBC 的杰夫·考克斯 (Jeff Cox) 对本报告做出了贡献

articles.title: How to see rainbows on exoplanets

paras.en: In some ways, finding exoplanets is amazingly easy.
paras.zh: 从某些方面来说，寻找系外行星非常容易。

paras.en: It doesn’t necessarily take a huge telescope and sophisticated equipment to detect these alien worlds. Characterizing them, however—getting detailed information on their size, orbital period, and more—is usually more difficult.
paras.zh: 不一定需要巨大的望远镜和先进的设备来探测这些外星世界。然而，表征它们——获得有关它们的大小、轨道周期等的详细信息——通常更加困难。

paras.en: Studying their atmospheres is currently at the cutting edge of what we can do, because that does indeed take state-of-the-art observatories. For example, astronomers can painstakingly gather a star’s light after it has physically passed through an orbiting planet’s air and look for the subtle signatures of various molecules absorbing some of that light at specific wavelengths.
paras.zh: 研究它们的大气层目前是我们能做的最前沿的事情，因为这确实需要最先进的天文台。例如，天文学家可以在恒星物理穿过绕轨道运行的行星的空气后，煞费苦心地收集恒星的光，并寻找各种分子吸收特定波长的光的微妙特征。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: But it’s not the only way to find and examine an atmosphere. Research published a few years back in the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (MNRAS) indicates another very clever method that astronomers could implement with a future space telescope.
paras.zh: 但这并不是寻找和检查大气的唯一方法。几年前发表在《皇家天文学会月刊》（MNRAS）上的研究表明，天文学家可以利用未来的太空望远镜实施另一种非常聪明的方法。

paras.en: They could look for exoplanetary rainbows.
paras.zh: 他们可以寻找系外行星彩虹。

paras.en: There’s not a prayer of viewing one directly, alas; just getting a dotlike image of an exoplanet is already quite a task. But, with careful planning, some telltale indicators of rainbows and other optical phenomena can be seen.
paras.zh: 唉，没有直接观看的祈祷；仅仅获得系外行星的点状图像就已经是一项艰巨的任务了。但是，通过仔细的计划，可以看到彩虹和其他光学现象的一些迹象。

paras.en: To be clear, none of these can be detected with our extant fleet of telescopes. But NASA is currently developing a mission called the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO), planned for launch in the early 2040s. This huge telescope will sport an at least six-meter light-collecting mirror and will be fine-tuned to look for Earth-sized worlds orbiting nearby sunlike stars in their habitable zone, the circumstellar region in which a planet can sustain liquid water on its surface.
paras.zh: 需要明确的是，我们现有的望远镜无法探测到这些。但 NASA 目前正在开发一项名为“宜居世界观测站”(HWO) 的任务，计划于 2040 年代初发射。这架巨大的望远镜将配备一个至少六米的聚光镜，并将进行微调，以寻找在其宜居带中围绕附近类日恒星运行的地球大小的世界，即行星表面可以维持液态水的星周区域。

paras.en: Using HWO’s capabilities as a baseline, the astronomers responsible for that MNRAS paper investigated the prospects for detecting atmospheric phenomena such as rainbows, Rayleigh scattering and sunglint on exoplanets.
paras.zh: 负责 MNRAS 论文的天文学家以 HWO 的能力为基准，研究了探测系外行星上的彩虹、瑞利散射和日照等大气现象的前景。

paras.en: Observing such things, it turns out, is essentially a matter of perspective: They can all be revealed as an exoplanet goes through phases while orbiting its host star, just like the moon does as it orbits Earth. When the planet is between its star and us, we’re looking at its dark, unilluminated half (its “new” phase). As it orbits and appears to move away from the star, it exhibits a crescent phase, growing to appear half full at its farthest separation, then becoming full when it’s on the opposite side of the star from our viewpoint. The phases then occur in reverse order as it moves around the star and returns to its original “new phase” position. With a telescope like HWO, we wouldn’t see such phases directly, instead registering them as periodic brightness changes as a targeted exoplanet waxes and wanes.
paras.zh: 事实证明，观察这些事物本质上是一个视角问题：当系外行星绕其主恒星运行时经历阶段时，它们都可以被揭示出来，就像月球绕地球运行一样。当行星位于其恒星和我们之间时，我们看到的是它黑暗的、未照亮的一半（它的“新”阶段）。当它绕轨道运行并似乎远离恒星时，它呈现出新月相，在距离最远的地方逐渐呈现出半满状态，然后当它从我们的角度来看位于恒星的另一侧时，它就变成满月了。当恒星围绕恒星移动并返回到其原始的“新相位”位置时，这些相位会以相反的顺序发生。使用像 HWO 这样的望远镜，我们不会直接看到这些阶段，而是将它们记录为目标系外行星盈亏时的周期性亮度变化。

paras.en: The atmospheric phenomena potentially detectable by HWO depend on those phases and the angle between the planet, its star, and the observatory, and therefore are best seen at different times in the planet’s orbit.
paras.zh: HWO 可能探测到的大气现象取决于这些相位以及行星、恒星和天文台之间的角度，因此在行星轨道上的不同时间观察效果最好。

paras.en: Of these, sunglint is the simplest: it’s just the reflection of the sun on a body of water, such as a lake or an ocean. The surface of the water acts exactly like a mirror, bouncing incoming sunlight at an angle away from the sun. You can see this for yourself on a beach when the sun is low, with the bright reflection visible just under the sun in the water. This has also been seen from orbit many times in photos from the International Space Station and, in fact, was seen by the Cassini spacecraft at Saturn when sunlight reflected off lakes of liquid methane on its huge moon Titan.
paras.zh: 其中，sunglint 是最简单的：它只是太阳在水体（例如湖泊或海洋）上的反射。水面就像一面镜子，以远离太阳的角度反射入射的阳光。当太阳较低时，您可以在海滩上亲眼看到这一点，在阳光下的水中可以看到明亮的反射。国际空间站的照片中也多次从轨道上看到了这一现象，事实上，土星上的卡西尼号太空船在其巨大的卫星土卫六上的液态甲烷湖反射阳光时也看到了这一现象。

paras.en: Sunglint is seen when the angle between the sun, the water and the observer is very low, like at sunrise or sunset. For an exoplanet, it occurs when the planet is nearly between the star and Earth. From our viewpoint, the planet, if we could see it clearly, would be in a crescent phase.
paras.zh: 当太阳、水和观察者之间的角度非常低时（例如日出或日落时），就会看到日光。对于系外行星来说，当行星几乎位于恒星和地球之间时，就会发生这种情况。从我们的角度来看，如果我们看得清楚的话，这颗行星将处于新月相。

paras.en: In their MNRAS paper, the astronomers found that in projected HWO observations, the glint would add a small but significant bump in brightness to some planets at and near crescent phase. And because water and most other liquids can’t persist on a planet’s surface without an insulating blanket of air, seeing such a glint could signal the presence of an atmosphere as well.
paras.zh: 在他们的 MNRAS 论文中，天文学家发现，在预测的 HWO 观测中，闪烁会给一些处于新月相或接近新月相的行星带来小而显着的亮度提升。由于没有绝缘的空气层，水和大多数其他液体就无法在行星表面持续存在，因此看到这种闪烁也可能表明存在大气层。

paras.en: Rainbows on Earth occur when sunlight passes through raindrops. Different colors of light bounce inside the drops at different angles, so when they emerge they’re spread out. When we stand with the sun at our backs, the drops we’re facing send that light back toward us sorted by color, creating a characteristic prismatic arc in the sky: a rainbow.
paras.zh: 当阳光穿过雨滴时，地球上就会出现彩虹。不同颜色的光以不同的角度在水滴内部反射，因此当它们出现时，它们会散开。当我们背对着太阳站立时，我们面对的水滴会将光线按颜色分类返回给我们，在天空中形成一道独特的棱柱弧：彩虹。

paras.en: If this occurs on an exoplanet, we won’t be able to see it directly. The light in rainbows is polarized, however. This means the waves all align. (For example, they oscillate up and down or left and right.) HWO will likely carry a polarimeter—an instrument designed to let through only the light aligned in one way—and the paper’s authors modeled what it might see. If an exoplanet is at the right phase, HWO’s polarimeter should be able to detect the extra bump in polarized light from potential rainbows (and related phenomena like glories, which have been detected on other planets). The amount of polarization can also reveal how big the rainbow-making raindrops are and possibly even their composition.
paras.zh: 如果这种情况发生在系外行星上，我们将无法直接看到它。然而，彩虹中的光是偏振的。这意味着波浪全部对齐。 （例如，它们上下或左右振动。）HWO 可能会携带一个旋光计——一种设计为只让以一种方式排列的光通过的仪器——论文的作者模拟了它可能看到的东西。如果系外行星处于正确的相位，HWO 的旋光计应该能够检测到来自潜在彩虹的偏振光的额外凸起（以及在其他行星上检测到的相关现象，如荣耀）。偏振的程度还可以揭示形成彩虹的雨滴有多大，甚至可能揭示它们的成分。

paras.en: Rayleigh scattering occurs when incoming sunlight bounces off molecules like nitrogen in Earth’s atmosphere, and it makes our sky blue. This scattering also polarizes the light; the amount of polarization seen depends on the incoming light’s angle with respect to the observer.
paras.zh: 当入射的阳光被地球大气中的氮等分子反射时，就会发生瑞利散射，使我们的天空呈现蓝色。这种散射也会使光偏振。看到的偏振量取决于入射光相对于观察者的角度。

paras.en: You can see this effect for yourself on a clear, sunny day! Polarized sunglasses are essentially basic polarimeters. They have filters in them with molecules all aligned in one direction (usually vertically); light polarized vertically passes through that filter like a key in a lock, while light polarized in another direction (say, horizontally) does not. The sky’s Rayleigh scattering causes the strongest polarization of sunlight 90 degrees away from the sun: if you rotate your sunglasses around while looking through them, you’ll see the sky darken significantly as you do—the sunglasses block the light when the light’s polarization angle doesn’t match that of the sunglasses. Closer to the sun—though be careful and don’t look too close!—this effect is much smaller. This is the effect astronomers can exploit using HWO to look for signs of an exoplanet’s atmosphere.
paras.zh: 您可以在晴朗、阳光明媚的日子亲眼目睹这种效果！偏光太阳镜本质上是基本的偏光计。它们内部有过滤器，其中的分子全部沿一个方向（通常是垂直）排列；垂直偏振的光就像锁中的钥匙一样穿过该滤光片，而另一个方向（例如水平）偏振的光则不会。天空的瑞利散射会导致太阳光在距太阳 90 度的地方出现最强的偏振：如果您在透过太阳镜观看时旋转太阳镜，您会看到天空明显变暗，因为当光线的偏振角与太阳镜的偏振角不匹配时，太阳镜会阻挡光线。离太阳越近——不过要小心，不要看得太近！——这种影响要小得多。天文学家可以利用 HWO 来寻找系外行星大气层的迹象。

paras.en: Based on simulations using data from real stars HWO might survey, the team of scientists found that polarization signals of rainbows and sunglints should be detectable on a decent fraction of accompanying small, warm rocky worlds, while Rayleigh scattering would register for most of them—presuming they have atmospheres, that is. That’s the whole point: we want to optimize HWO’s ability to detect air on alien worlds, and searching for these optical phenomena would really give it a boost.
paras.zh: 基于使用 HWO 可能调查的真实恒星数据进行的模拟，科学家团队发现，在相当一部分伴随的小型温暖岩石世界上，应该可以检测到彩虹和日光的偏振信号，而瑞利散射将记录其中的大多数——假设它们有大气层。这就是重点：我们希望优化 HWO 探测外星世界空气的能力，而搜索这些光学现象确实会增强它的性能。

paras.en: A blue sky, a poststorm rainbow and the sun reflecting off the ocean are sights we take for granted here on Earth. But they may be ubiquitous on planets throughout the cosmos. If they are, we may be on the verge of being able to detect them.
paras.zh: 蓝天、暴风雨后的彩虹和海面反射的阳光，这些都是我们在地球上习以为常的景象。但它们可能在整个宇宙的行星上无处不在。如果是的话，我们可能即将能够检测到它们。

articles.title: Can bioengineered bacteria help terraform Mars?

paras.en: Last month Erika DeBenedictis, CEO of the nonprofit start-up Pioneer Labs, delighted or shocked many space nerds with some big news: she and her colleagues had engineered “the first microbe for Mars.”
paras.zh: 上个月，非营利初创公司先锋实验室的首席执行官埃里卡·德贝内迪蒂斯 (Erika DeBenedictis) 宣布了一些重大消息，让许多太空迷感到高兴或震惊：她和她的同事们已经设计出了“第一个火星微生物”。

paras.en: In a post on X that has garnered more than two million views, DeBenedictis claimed that her bacterium, a tweaked version of Cupriavidus necator, represents “the first step towards terraforming” the Red Planet. By seeding Mars with microbial life, she has argued, we can make the world more Earthlike from the ground up.
paras.zh: 在 X 上发表的一篇获得超过 200 万次浏览的帖子中，DeBenedictis 声称她的细菌是 Cupriavidus necator 的改良版，代表着“改造红色星球的第一步”。她认为，通过在火星上播下微生物生命的种子，我们可以让世界从头开始变得更像地球。

paras.en: “Everything life needs to thrive is given to us by nature,” observed DeBenedictis, a synthetic biologist with a Ph.D. from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, in a slick promotional video that was included with the post. “When humanity goes to space, we have to bring nature with us.” The clip teased a future Mars with green valleys and self-sufficient, see-through, domed habitats, all constructed with locally sourced materials, some of them courtesy of the microbe, which DeBenedictis and Pioneer Labs call “sPL.001.”
paras.zh: “生命蓬勃发展所需的一切都是大自然赋予我们的，”拥有博士学位的合成生物学家德贝尼迪蒂斯说。来自麻省理工学院，在帖子中包含的一段精美的宣传视频中。 “当人类进入太空时，我们必须带上自然。”这段视频描绘了未来的火星，那里有绿色的山谷和自给自足、透明的圆顶栖息地，所有这些都用当地采购的材料建造，其中一些是由微生物提供的，DeBenedictis 和 Pioneer Labs 称之为“sPL.001”。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: It’s certainly a compelling story. And it’s backed up with a few recent preprint papers detailing Pioneer Labs’ research. But how much of it is fantasy?
paras.zh: 这当然是一个引人入胜的故事。它得到了最近几篇详细介绍先锋实验室研究的预印本论文的支持。但其中有多少是幻想呢？

paras.en: Scientific American put that question to several researchers working at the intersection of planetary science, astrobiology, microbial ecology and bioengineering—and their responses are, on the whole, fairly positive. The most critical assessment comes from Chris McKay, a planetary scientist at NASA’s Ames Research Center, who has studied terraforming for decades. McKay is senior author of “The Case for Mars Terraforming Research,” a paper led by DeBenedictis that was published last year in Nature Astronomy. The engineered bacterium is “not very interesting, not very new yet,” he says. “I hope better is coming soon.” Paul Race, who studies industrial biotechnology at Newcastle University in England, offers the same impression, calling the announcement “rather over the top.”
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》向几位从事行星科学、天体生物学、微生物生态学和生物工程交叉领域工作的研究人员提出了这个问题，总的来说，他们的回答相当积极。最关键的评估来自美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心的行星科学家克里斯·麦凯，他研究地球化已有数十年。麦凯是《火星地球化研究案例》的资深作者，该论文由德贝内迪蒂斯领导，去年发表在《自然天文学》杂志上。他说，这种工程细菌“不是很有趣，也不是很新”。 “我希望更好的事情很快就会到来。”英国纽卡斯尔大学研究工业生物技术的保罗·雷斯也给出了同样的印象，称这一声明“相当夸张”。

paras.en: Their core qualm is that this microbe alone can’t bring a dead planet to life. “This microorganism, sPL.001, is not for terraforming Mars—it’s for making feedstock for 3D-printed houses,” McKay says. “It can only be grown in a bioreactor,” an apparatus for incubating microbes, such as yeast, to yield useful by-products. DeBenedictis’s microbe would pump out a form of bioplastic by consuming Martian dirt, water and compressed carbon dioxide delivered to the bioreactor with autonomous machinery. To her credit, DeBenedictis has been clear on this point: sPL.001 “is the first of five organisms we will need to make Mars green,” she wrote in a post on Pioneer Labs’ Substack.
paras.zh: 他们的核心疑虑是，仅靠这种微生物无法让死去的星球复活。 “这种微生物，sPL.001，不是为了改造火星，而是为了制造 3D 打印房屋的原料，”麦凯说。 “它只能在生物反应器中生长”，生物反应器是一种用于培养微生物（例如酵母）以产生有用副产品的装置。德贝尼迪蒂斯的微生物通过消耗火星泥土、水和压缩二氧化碳，通过自主机械输送到生物反应器，从而泵出一种生物塑料。值得赞扬的是，DeBenedictis 在这一点上很明确：sPL.001“是我们使火星变得绿色所需的五种生物中的第一种，”她在 Pioneer Labs 的 Substack 上发表的一篇文章中写道。

paras.en: “Hopefully,” McKay says, “some of the other four are green and can actually grow on Mars!”
paras.zh: “希望，”麦凯说，“其他四种植物中的一些是绿色的，并且实际上可以在火星上生长！”

paras.en: DeBenedictis founded Pioneer Labs in 2024, when she was a resident at the San Francisco Bay Area–based Astera Institute, a billionaire-backed nonprofit focused on incubating science and technology projects with ambitious long-term visions (and correspondingly ambitious needs for sustained funding). The company’s name, DeBenedictis says, comes from the ecological idea of “pioneer species” that colonize barren territory as a first step for the creation of complex ecosystems. And its stated goal is no small thing: to make the universe more friendly to life.
paras.zh: DeBenedictis 于 2024 年创立了 Pioneer Labs，当时她是位于旧金山湾区的 Astera Institute 的常驻人员，这是一家由亿万富翁支持的非营利组织，专注于孵化具有雄心勃勃的长期愿景（以及相应的对持续资金的雄心勃勃的需求）的科学和技术项目。德贝尼迪蒂斯说，该公司的名字来源于“先锋物种”的生态理念，即在贫瘠的土地上殖民，作为创建复杂生态系统的第一步。它所宣称的目标可不是一件小事：让宇宙对生命更加友好。

paras.en: On Earth, pioneer species are usually organisms we think of as weeds or pests that can tolerate the harshest environments: molds that feast on decaying organic matter, lichens that thrive almost anywhere or dandelions that grow in and break up rock to make and enrich soil. They’re not glamorous, but they allow “fancier organisms and shrubs and trees and stuff to grow, and that’s exactly what we’re trying to do” for Mars, DeBenedictis tells Scientific American.
paras.zh: 在地球上，先锋物种通常是我们认为能够忍受最恶劣环境的杂草或害虫生物：以腐烂的有机物为食的霉菌、几乎在任何地方都能生长的地衣，或者生长在岩石中并分解岩石以形成和肥沃土壤的蒲公英。德本尼迪蒂斯告诉《科学美国人》，它们并不迷人，但它们允许“更奇特的生物体、灌木、树木和其他东西生长，而这正是我们正在努力为火星做的事情”。

paras.en: Bootstrapping a biosphere there isn’t easy, however. Biology is bedeviled on the planet, exposed as it is to unrelenting harmful radiation and given its paltry atmosphere, 1 percent as thick as Earth’s, and temperatures that, in a single Martian day, can swing violently by 100 degrees Celsius. The low levels of nitrogen in the atmosphere and in the ground add insult to injury—a 2025 review paper in Communications Biology noted that a lack of nitrogen is “a major limiting factor for establishing Earth-like organisms or supporting human agriculture, and limits our capacity to terraform the planet.” Plus, some samples of Martian soil contain high levels of perchlorates, toxic chemical compounds, also found in rocket fuel, that could potentially poison the planet’s supplies of water and food.
paras.zh: 然而，在那里建立一个生物圈并不容易。地球上的生物体受到了困扰，因为它暴露在无情的有害辐射之下，而且其大气层厚度只有地球的百分之一，而且火星的温度在一天之内就可以剧烈波动100摄氏度。大气和地下的氮含量较低，雪上加霜——《通讯生物学》2025 年发表的一篇评论论文指出，缺乏氮是“建立类地生物或支持人类农业的主要限制因素，并限制了我们改造地球的能力。”此外，火星土壤的一些样本含有高含量的高氯酸盐，这种有毒化合物也存在于火箭燃料中，可能会毒害地球的水和食物供应。

paras.en: “We need to choose carefully” when we devise bioengineered microbes to overcome these immense challenges, DeBenedictis says.
paras.zh: 德贝尼迪蒂斯说，当我们设计生物工程微生物来克服这些巨大挑战时，“我们需要谨慎选择”。

paras.en: Neveda Naz, an astrobiologist at Tufts University, who has grown microbes in material from Martian meteors, says Pioneer Labs had done just that with its focus on the bioplastic-producing version of C. necator. “They have picked an organism, adapted it to a defined Mars-relevant chemical environment and demonstrated improved production of a useful material,” Naz says. “If the goal is eventually to manufacture materials off-Earth using predominantly local resources rather than transporting everything from Earth, that’s a very worthwhile and smart direction to explore.”
paras.zh: 塔夫茨大学的天体生物学家内维达·纳兹 (Neveda Naz) 在火星流星材料中培养了微生物，她表示先锋实验室已经做到了这一点，重点关注生产生物塑料的 C. necator。纳兹说：“他们选择了一种有机体，使其适应特定的火星相关化学环境，并证明了有用材料的生产得到了改进。” “如果最终目标是主要利用当地资源在地球外制造材料，而不是从地球运输所有东西，那么这是一个非常值得探索的明智方向。”

paras.en: Alexandre Rosado, a microbiologist who has studied terraforming and focuses on ultrahardy microbes called extremophiles, agrees. “I think the work is interesting, and there is certainly good science there,” he says. “I would not dismiss it. My view is that microbes will almost certainly be part of any serious attempt to use local Martian resources or, much further down the road, modify Martian environments.”
paras.zh: 微生物学家亚历山大·罗萨多（Alexandre Rosado）对此表示同意，他研究了地球化改造并专注于被称为极端微生物的超耐寒微生物。 “我认为这项工作很有趣，而且其中肯定有很好的科学依据，”他说。 “我不会忽视它。我的观点是，微生物几乎肯定会成为任何认真尝试使用当地火星资源的一部分，或者更进一步，改变火星环境的一部分。”

paras.en: Both Naz and Rosado, however, quibble with Pioneer Labs’ declaration that this makes the modified C. necator a “microbe for Mars.” For Rosado, the company’s language around terraforming “goes quite a bit beyond what they have actually demonstrated.” And, Naz says, “there is an important distinction between showing that Martian regolith can provide biologically useful nutrients and showing that an organism can grow in the Martian environment.”
paras.zh: 然而，纳兹和罗萨多都对先锋实验室的声明提出质疑，即这使得改良的 C. necator 成为“火星微生物”。对于罗萨多来说，该公司关于地球化改造的语言“远远超出了他们实际展示的范围”。纳兹说，“证明火星风化层可以提供生物上有用的营养物质和证明有机体可以在火星环境中生长之间存在着重要的区别。”

paras.en: DeBenedictis is aware of the distinction—it’s the centerpiece of Pioneer Labs’ safety strategy for avoiding potentially ruinous interplanetary contamination, PRIM (Propagation Restricted, Inert on Mars). In her team’s experiments, the researchers found that C. necator failed to reproduce if it was starved of water and carbon. So, she says, if the microbe somehow escaped a bioreactor on Mars, its chances of survival and reproduction would be infinitesimal. “Even a full, catastrophic leak of an industrial-scale Mars bioreactor would still clear the planetary protection threshold by a factor of several hundred,” DeBenedictis says. “I’m genuinely not worried about it.”
paras.zh: DeBenedictis 意识到了其中的区别——它是 Pioneer Labs 安全策略的核心，旨在避免潜在的破坏性行星际污染，PRIM（传播受限，在火星上惰性）。在她的团队的实验中，研究人员发现，如果缺乏水和碳，线虫就无法繁殖。因此，她说，如果微生物以某种方式逃离了火星上的生物反应器，它的生存和繁殖的机会将是微乎其微的。德贝尼迪蒂斯说：“即使工业规模的火星生物反应器发生全面、灾难性的泄漏，仍然会使行星保护阈值提高数百倍。” “我真的不担心这个。”

paras.en: Whether policymakers who set international standards for “planetary protection” protocols won’t worry about it, either, is another hazy aspect of Pioneer Labs’ hopeful aspirations. Without regulatory approval, DeBenedictis’s best-laid plans for helping to terraform Mars may literally fail to launch. As NASA administrator Jared Isaacman noted on X, however, his team has been working to revise the space agency’s protection policies to align them with what he calls the “common-sense principles” originally established in the “early days of planetary exploration and later reflected in Article IX of the Outer Space Treaty.” He thinks current protection policies needlessly add “extreme cost and time to robotic missions to Mars when the overarching goal is to send astronauts there as quickly and safely as possible.”
paras.zh: 为“行星保护”协议制定国际标准的政策制定者是否也不会担心这一点，是先锋实验室充满希望的另一个模糊的方面。如果没有监管部门的批准，德贝尼迪蒂斯帮助火星改造的最周密的计划可能根本无法启动。然而，正如 NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在 X 上指出的那样，他的团队一直在努力修改航天局的保护政策，以使其符合他所谓的“常识原则”，这些原则最初是在“行星探索早期制定的，后来在《外层空间条约》第九条中得到了体现。”他认为，当前的保护政策不必要地增加了“当首要目标是尽可能快速、安全地将宇航员送往火星时，机器人的火星任务增加了极大的成本和时间。”

paras.en: Ricard Solé, a biologist who heads the Complex Systems Lab at Pompeu Fabra University in Barcelona and studies, among other things, terraforming via bioengineered ecosystems, thinks PRIM is on point. “It separates useful biotechnology from uncontrolled ecological spread,” he says. “Pioneer Labs’ proposal is a very interesting and important step, but if the goal is eventually to build a stable, closed ecology on Mars, then a systems-level perspective will be essential.” Mars will need more than “a single engineered strain,” Solé says, envisioning a larger assemblage of multispecies communities that collectively recycle matter, turn one organism’s waste into another’s resource, regulate environmental conditions, and so on. “In that sense,” he says, “the challenge is not only to engineer organisms but to engineer the ecological interactions that allow the whole system to sustain itself.”
paras.zh: 生物学家 Ricard Solé 是巴塞罗那庞培法布拉大学复杂系统实验室的负责人，他的研究领域包括通过生物工程生态系统进行地球化改造，他认为 PRIM 是正确的。 “它将有用的生物技术与不受控制的生态传播分开，”他说。 “先锋实验室的提议是非常有趣且重要的一步，但如果目标最终是在火星上建立一个稳定、封闭的生态，那么系统级的视角将至关重要。”索莱说，火星需要的不仅仅是“单一的工程菌株”，他设想了一个更大的多物种群落组合，这些群落共同回收物质、将一种生物体的废物转化为另一种生物体的资源、调节环境条件等等。 “从这个意义上说，”他说，“挑战不仅在于设计有机体，还在于设计生态相互作用，使整个系统能够自我维持。”

paras.en: This is where DeBenedictis’s as-yet-unannounced four other microbes come in. They have yet to be revealed, she says, because Pioneer Labs hasn’t entirely settled on which organisms could do the job. Whichever ones win the day will have to offer “transparent building materials, perchlorate reduction, making fertile soil, and then food and oxygen,” she says. The transparent material, crucial for making windows, will be the hardest to find, she speculates. “We don’t have very many examples of biomaterials that are transparent when they’re dry, which is what you need on Mars because the atmosphere outside will dry anything out, so we’ll see what we come up with.”
paras.zh: 这就是 DeBenedictis 尚未公布的其他四种微生物的用武之地。她说，它们尚未被揭示，因为先锋实验室尚未完全确定哪些微生物可以完成这项工作。她说，无论哪一个获胜，都必须提供“透明的建筑材料、减少高氯酸盐、制造肥沃的土壤，然后是食物和氧气”。她推测，对于制造窗户至关重要的透明材料将是最难找到的。 “我们没有太多干燥时透明的生物材料的例子，这正是火星上所需要的，因为外面的大气会使任何东西变干，所以我们会看看我们能想出什么。”

paras.en: If all goes to plan, she thinks, the effect will be to transform the night sky by a significant smidge. “You can see Mars outside with your naked eye, and it’s noticeably a little red relative to other stars in the background,” she says. “And I think, before I die, I’ll get to see it be a little bit green.”
paras.zh: 她认为，如果一切按计划进行，夜空将会发生明显的改变。 “你可以用肉眼看到外面的火星，而且相对于背景中的其他恒星，它明显有点红，”她说。 “我想，在我死之前，我会看到它变得有点绿。”

articles.title: This weird particle may have come from a black hole exploding in another dimension

paras.en: A bizarre neutrino that crashed into Earth in February 2023 is gaining no shortage of equally bizarre explanations.
paras.zh: 2023 年 2 月，一颗奇异的中微子撞击地球，人们对它的解释也同样奇异。

paras.en: About 35 times more energetic than any neutrino seen before, it was picked up by the under-construction Cubic Kilometer Neutrino Telescope (KM3NeT) detector off the coast of Sicily. Some theorists have guessed it came from a well-known source of extreme astrophysical mayhem, a type of highly active galaxy known as a blazar, among other easy to parse explanations. Another group of scientists, however, has proposed it came from something far stranger: a tiny black hole exploding on the outskirts of the solar system.
paras.zh: 它的能量大约是以前见过的任何中微子的 35 倍，被西西里岛海岸正在建设的立方公里中微子望远镜 (KM3NeT) 探测器探测到。一些理论家猜测它来自一个众所周知的极端天体物理混乱的来源，一种被称为耀变体的高度活跃的星系，以及其他易于解析的解释。然而，另一组科学家提出，它来自更奇怪的东西：一个在太阳系外围爆炸的小黑洞。

paras.en: This would have been a primordial black hole (PBH), a hypothesized object formed in the universe’s earliest moments. Like all black holes, PBHs would evaporate over time by emitting Hawking radiation, gradually losing mass until finally exploding in a flash of radiation and neutrinos; unlike other black holes, PBHs would be so low-mass that their last-gasp outbursts could be happening now rather than untold eons in the future.
paras.zh: 这可能是一个原始黑洞（PBH），一个在宇宙最早时刻形成的假设物体。像所有黑洞一样，PBH 会随着时间的推移通过发射霍金辐射而蒸发，逐渐失去质量，直到最终在辐射和中微子的闪光中爆炸。与其他黑洞不同，PBH 的质量如此之低，以至于它们最后的爆发可能会发生在现在，而不是在未来的无数个世纪里。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A new paper leveraging the arcane tenets of string theory has taken this outlandish idea even further. Published in the journal Physical Review D on September 28, it suggests that the KM3NeT event wasn’t caused by just any PBH but one initially formed from light-years-long cracks in spacetime called cosmic strings and cloaked inside a fifth dimension.
paras.zh: 一篇利用弦理论的神秘原理的新论文进一步发展了这个古怪的想法。该文章于 9 月 28 日发表在《物理评论 D》杂志上，表明 KM3NeT 事件并非由任何 PBH 引起，而是最初由称为宇宙弦的时空裂缝形成，并隐藏在第五维度中。

paras.en: Dieter Lüst of the Max Planck Institute for Physics in Munich, a co-author on the paper, says this highly speculative scenario would “completely resolve this puzzle” of why KM3NeT’s neutrino wasn’t accompanied by any photons, which should have been detected by other instruments but weren’t. If the exploding PBH sat inside this fifth dimension, Lüst says, the physics would dictate that only neutrinos could escape into our more familiar universe.
paras.zh: 该论文的合著者、慕尼黑马克斯·普朗克物理研究所的迪特·鲁斯特表示，这种高度推测性的情景将“彻底解决这个谜题”，即为什么 KM3NeT 的中微子没有伴随任何光子，而光子本应被其他仪器检测到，但没有检测到。 Lüst 说，如果爆炸的 PBH 位于第五维度内，物理学将决定只有中微子才能逃逸到我们更熟悉的宇宙中。

paras.en: This sort of fifth dimension isn’t a novel idea. It’s sometimes called a “dark dimension” because it could potentially form as a side effect of dark energy, the mysterious force driving the universe’s accelerating expansion. You can imagine it as “an extra circle” about one micron wide, Lüst says, that’s curled up atop every point of our three-dimensional universe, plus time. “The reason we do not see it is that we live on a one-plus-three-dimensional brane, on which all other interactions—like electromagnetism—take place. The only force which can penetrate the fifth dimension is gravity.”
paras.zh: 这种第五维度并不是一个新奇的想法。它有时被称为“黑暗维度”，因为它可能是暗能量的副作用，暗能量是驱动宇宙加速膨胀的神秘力量。 Lüst 说，你可以把它想象成一个大约一微米宽的“额外的圆”，它卷曲在我们三维宇宙的每个点以及时间的顶部。 “我们看不到它的原因是我们生活在一个一加三维的膜上，所有其他相互作用（例如电磁力）都发生在这个膜上。唯一可以穿透第五维的力是重力。”

paras.en: Cumrun Vafa, a string theorist at Harvard University, says the idea of a fifth dimension is “not only plausible; it is derived, in some sense, with minimal assumptions from string theory ideas,” which he described in a paper posted as a preprint in 2022 and published in 2023. “And it turns out when the size of the black holes are smaller than a micron, they can sit inside other points in the extra dimension,” he says.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学弦理论家卡姆伦·瓦法 (Cumrun Vafa) 表示，第五维的想法“不仅看似合理；从某种意义上说，它是在弦理论思想的最小假设下得出的”，他在 2022 年作为预印本发布并于 2023 年发表的一篇论文中对此进行了描述。“事实证明，当黑洞的尺寸小于一微米时，它们可以位于额外维度中的其他点内，”他说。

paras.en: The idea is understandably controversial. “We don’t know that there is a fifth dimension,” says Dan Hooper, a cosmologist at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, who has studied PBHs. Lüst, Vafa and other dark-dimension-touting string theorists “seem to be making some very strong statements that I wouldn’t be able to defend.”
paras.zh: 这个想法是有争议的，这是可以理解的。 “我们不知道第五维的存在，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的宇宙学家丹·胡珀（Dan Hooper）说道，他研究了PBH。勒斯特、瓦法和其他宣扬黑暗维度的弦理论家“似乎做出了一些我无法辩护的非常强烈的声明。”

paras.en: Hooper and other cosmologists have suggested that PBHs are a natural outcome of conditions in the early universe, such as inflation—a sudden exponential increase in cosmic expansion that is thought to have occurred shortly after the big bang. Such processes could create overdensities—regions so dense that spacetime collapsed in on itself, forming PBHs of a range of masses. The smallest of these would have evaporated quickly, disappearing from the cosmos long ago. But more massive PBHs would last longer, with those roughly the mass of an asteroid enduring to evaporate in our current cosmic epoch.
paras.zh: 胡珀和其他宇宙学家认为，PBH是早期宇宙条件的自然结果，例如通货膨胀——宇宙膨胀的突然指数增长，被认为是在大爆炸后不久发生的。这样的过程可能会造成密度过高——区域密度如此之大，以至于时空自身塌陷，形成各种质量的PBH。其中最小的一个也会很快蒸发，很久以前就从宇宙中消失了。但质量更大的PBH会持续更长时间，其质量大约相当于小行星的质量，在我们当前的宇宙时代会持续蒸发。

paras.en: Last year Alexandra Klipfel and David Kaiser of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology proposed that a PBH expiring within 2,000 astronomical units (2,000 times the Earth-sun distance) of our solar system could have produced the neutrino picked up by KM3NeT. As other ideas have failed to fully explain the event, the wild concept “still looks really beautifully consistent,” Kaiser says, “which doesn’t mean it’s right. But it is using some really off-the-shelf, more typical elements that are woven into many parts of our understanding of black hole physics.”
paras.zh: 去年，麻省理工学院的 Alexandra Klipfel 和 David Kaiser 提出，太阳系 2,000 个天文单位（地日距离的 2,000 倍）内的 PBH 可能产生了 KM3NeT 捕获的中微子。由于其他想法未能完全解释这一事件，这个疯狂的概念“看起来仍然非常一致，”凯泽说，“这并不意味着它是正确的。但它使用了一些真正现成的、更典型的元素，这些元素融入了我们对黑洞物理理解的许多部分。”

paras.en: Lüst and his colleagues’ proposal, meanwhile, requires slightly more stretching of the imagination to be plausible. In their model, the PBH wouldn’t have only been sitting inside this fifth dimension; it also might have initially formed not through inflation-induced overdensities but from collapsing cosmic strings, theoretical cracks in the fabric of spacetime that may have manifested in the very early universe. “Around these cosmic strings, the densities are high enough to form primordial black holes,” Lüst says.
paras.zh: 与此同时，吕斯特和他的同事的提议需要稍微扩展一下想象力才能变得合理。在他们的模型中，PBH 不仅仅位于第五维度内；它还位于第五维度中。它最初也可能不是由膨胀引起的密度过高形成的，而是由宇宙弦的塌缩形成的，宇宙弦是时空结构中的理论上的裂缝，可能在非常早期的宇宙中就已经显现出来。 “在这些宇宙弦周围，密度足够高，足以形成原始黑洞，”吕斯特说。

paras.en: The existence of PBHs alone is “a lot to hang on a single neutrino,” says Ignacio Taboada, an astrophysicist at the Georgia Institute of Technology. “And then you add the fifth dimension, and it gets even more convoluted. Is it plausible? Yes, it is. It’s just that the evidence for that is so tenuous.” Taboada instead favors a more conventional (and somewhat catch-all) scenario in which KM3NeT fortuitously caught an especially energetic “cosmogenic” neutrino produced from high-energy cosmic rays smashing into particles and atoms across the universe. “We know the cosmic ray background exists,” he says, “so the particle physics is not that difficult.”
paras.zh: 佐治亚理工学院的天体物理学家伊格纳西奥·塔博阿达 (Ignacio Taboada) 表示，PBH 的存在本身“对单个中微子来说就很重要”。 “然后加上第五维，它就变得更加复杂。这合理吗？是的，确实如此。只是这方面的证据太薄弱了。” Taboada 相反倾向于一种更传统（并且有点包罗万象）的场景，其中 KM3NeT 偶然捕获了一种特别高能的“宇宙成因”中微子，该中微子是由高能宇宙射线撞击宇宙中的粒子和原子而产生的。 “我们知道宇宙射线背景的存在，”他说，“所以粒子物理学并不那么困难。”

paras.en: One reason some theorists prefer the more contrived PBH-sourced scenario is that PBHs might also explain dark matter, the invisible stuff that serves as gravitational glue for most galaxies. PBHs could account for some—or even all—of the dark matter in the universe, replacing or supplementing other candidates such as weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs) and axions. Remarkably, the existence of a fifth dimension could boost the chances for PBH-based dark matter, Hooper says, because it would allow the microscopic black holes to evaporate more slowly and thus occupy a larger range of masses in the modern-day universe. A fifth dimension gives “more opportunity to make dark matter with black holes,” he says.
paras.zh: 一些理论家更喜欢更人为的源自PBH的假设的原因之一是PBH也可能解释暗物质，暗物质是大多数星系的引力粘合剂。 PBH 可以解释宇宙中的部分甚至全部暗物质，取代或补充其他候选物质，例如弱相互作用大质量粒子 (WIMP) 和轴子。胡珀说，值得注意的是，第五维的存在可能会增加基于PBH的暗物质的机会，因为它将使微观黑洞蒸发得更慢，从而在现代宇宙中占据更大的质量范围。他说，第五维提供了“更多利用黑洞制造暗物质的机会”。

paras.en: PBHs could help resolve other enigmas, too, for instance by acting as seeds for the rapid growth of supermassive black holes in the early universe. “They give very nice explanations for several things that we have evidence for,” says Andrea Thamm, a theoretical physicist at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. So far, however, we “do not know [PBHs] exist” or even exactly the way in which they would have formed.
paras.zh: PBH 还可以帮助解决其他谜团，例如充当早期宇宙中超大质量黑洞快速增长的种子。马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的理论物理学家安德里亚·塔姆 (Andrea Thamm) 表示：“他们对我们有证据支持的几件事给出了非常好的解释。”然而，到目前为止，我们“不知道[PBH]存在”，甚至不知道它们的形成方式。

paras.en: Another confusing aspect of KM3NeT’s neutrino was that the more capable IceCube Neutrino Observatory detector in Antarctica should have picked up something, too—but it didn’t. “It was really surprising because [KM3NeT’s event] was so much higher in energy than IceCube had ever seen,” says Erin O’Sullivan, a neutrino astrophysicist at Uppsala University in Sweden and spokesperson for IceCube. In early 2023 IceCube’s mesh of detectors in the Antarctic ice spanned an area some 20 times larger than KM3NeT’s submerged detectors and had been operating 10 times longer, since 2011. Work released in September, however, showed no accompanying high-energy neutrinos in IceCube’s data at the same time as KM3NeT, and the Antarctic facility has picked up no neutrinos of comparable energy in its 15 years of operations.
paras.zh: KM3NeT 中微子的另一个令人困惑的方面是，南极洲能力更强的冰立方中微子观测站探测器也应该探测到一些东西，但它没有。 “这确实令人惊讶，因为 [KM3NeT 事件] 的能量比 IceCube 所见过的要高得多，”瑞典乌普萨拉大学的中微子天体物理学家、IceCube 发言人艾琳·奥沙利文 (Erin O’Sullivan) 说。 2023 年初，IceCube 在南极冰层中的探测器网覆盖的面积比 KM3NeT 水下探测器大约 20 倍，自 2011 年以来运行时间延长了 10 倍。然而，9 月份发布的工作显示，IceCube 的数据中没有与 KM3NeT 同时存在的高能中微子，而且南极设施在其 15 个探测器中也没有探测到具有可比能量的中微子。年的运营。

paras.en: Even so, scientists are fairly confident KM3NeT’s detection was a real neutrino; an instrument error or miscalculation is “very unlikely,” Taboada says.
paras.zh: 即便如此，科学家们仍然相当有信心 KM3NeT 的探测是一个真正的中微子；塔博阿达说，仪器错误或计算错误“可能性很小”。

paras.en: A nearby PBH, five-dimensional or not, could provide an answer by flinging a neutrino at just the right orientation to hit KM3NeT’s detectors but not IceCube’s. Other searches to find PBHs near and far, however, have so far been unsuccessful. In May, for example, astronomers suggested that a lunar-mass PBH might have been spotted drifting through the halo of our Milky Way, but follow-up work suggested the sighting was a variable star, not a black hole.
paras.zh: 附近的 PBH，无论是否是五维的，都可以通过向正确的方向抛出中微子来击中 KM3NeT 的探测器而不是 IceCube 的探测器来提供答案。然而，其他寻找近处和远处的 PBH 的搜索迄今为止尚未成功。例如，5月份，天文学家提出，可能发现了一个月球质量的PBH在我们银河系的光环中漂流，但后续工作表明，这次目击事件是一颗变星，而不是黑洞。

paras.en: Finding additional high-energy neutrinos could provide some answers, and efforts to do so are under way. The Radio Neutrino Observatory is currently under construction in Greenland, which will expand the search by using radio signals instead of optical light, which IceCube utilizes, to look for incoming neutrinos. A proposed second-generation IceCube detector, meanwhile, would similarly use radio and span an area of 500 square kilometers compared with IceCube’s current single cubic kilometer. “You can put the stations much further apart” using radio, O’Sullivan says, and “catch these higher energies.”
paras.zh: 寻找更多的高能中微子可以提供一些答案，并且正在为此努力。射电中微子观测站目前正在格陵兰岛建设中，该观测站将通过使用无线电信号而不是 IceCube 使用的光学来扩大搜索范围，以寻找传入的中微子。与此同时，拟议的第二代 IceCube 探测器将同样使用无线电，覆盖面积为 500 平方公里，而 IceCube 目前的面积为单立方公里。奥沙利文说，“你可以使用无线电将这些电台分开得更远”，并“捕捉到这些更高的能量”。

paras.en: For now, KM3NeT’s neutrino has plenty of explanations that are easier to countenance than black holes. “I don’t think there’s any reason it has to be something exotic,” Hooper says. “We know there are high-energy cosmic rays in our universe that will sometimes collide with gas or radiation and make neutrinos,” as well as astrophysical sources, such as blazars, that could produce them, too. Until such ideas can be confirmed, though, five-dimensional primordial black holes formed by cosmic strings remain a possibility, however fantastical they might sound.
paras.zh: 目前，KM3NeT 的中微子有很多比黑洞更容易被接受的解释。 “我认为没有任何理由它必须是异国情调的东西，”胡珀说。 “我们知道宇宙中存在高能宇宙射线，它们有时会与气体或辐射碰撞并产生中微子，”以及天体物理来源，例如耀变体，也可能产生中微子。然而，在这些想法得到证实之前，由宇宙弦形成的五维原初黑洞仍然是一种可能性，无论它们听起来多么荒诞。

articles.title: This year’s El Niño just broke a record months before it’s expected to peak
articles.author: Nikk Ogasa

paras.en: Warnings of an El Niño unlike any other are starting to become reality.
paras.zh: 与以往不同的厄尔尼诺现象的警告正开始成为现实。

paras.en: For months, scientists have cautioned that the natural climate pattern could grow into a record-breaking beast, releasing extraordinary amounts of heat from the ocean and fueling droughts, floods, heat waves and severe storms. Now, a traditional strength measurement of El Niño, called the Oceanic Niño Index, indicates that the pattern has reached an intensity unseen in recorded history.
paras.zh: 几个月来，科学家们一直警告说，自然气候模式可能会发展成为破纪录的野兽，从海洋释放大量热量，加剧干旱、洪水、热浪和严重风暴。现在，厄尔尼诺现象的传统强度测量方法（称为海洋尼诺指数）表明，这种模式已经达到了有记录的历史上前所未见的强度。

paras.en: On September 21, the daily sea surface temperature in the region where El Niño develops — the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean — reached 3.08 degrees Celsius warmer than the 1991 to 2020 average. That’s more extreme than any other El Niño ever recorded.
paras.zh: 9月21日，厄尔尼诺现象发生的地区——赤道中东部太平洋的日海表温度比1991年至2020年的平均值高出3.08摄氏度。这比任何其他有记录的厄尔尼诺现象都要极端。

paras.en: Since El Niño emerged in June, the daily average sea surface temperature has climbed extraordinarily high in the heart of the Pacific Ocean region where El Niño develops. On September 21, it reached 3.08 degrees Celsius above both the 1991 to 2020 average (coarse dashed line) and the 1982 to 2010 average (fine dashed line). Prior to this month, the most extreme anomaly on record was 3.02 degrees Celsius, set by an El Niño in November 2015.
paras.zh: 自6月厄尔尼诺现象出现以来，厄尔尼诺现象发生的太平洋中心地区日平均海面温度异常升高。 9月21日，气温比1991年至2020年平均水平（粗虚线）和1982年至2010年平均水平（细虚线）高出3.08摄氏度。本月之前，有记录以来最极端的异常气温为 3.02 摄氏度，由 2015 年 11 月的厄尔尼诺现象造成。

paras.en: “It has been a remarkable event,” says Nathaniel Johnson, a climate scientist at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration’s Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory in Princeton, N.J. What’s more, the El Niño will probably grow even stronger, Johnson says. “We’re probably going to reach our peak within the next few months.”
paras.zh: 位于新泽西州普林斯顿的国家海洋和大气管理局地球物理流体动力学实验室的气候科学家纳撒尼尔·约翰逊说：“这是一件了不起的事件。”此外，约翰逊说，厄尔尼诺现象可能会变得更加强烈。 “我们可能会在接下来的几个月内达到顶峰。”

paras.en: The oceanic heat released by the phenomenon could contribute to an increase in global land temperatures of about 1.2 degrees Celsius over the coming months, leading to over 450,000 additional heat-related deaths by February 2027, researchers from the Climate Impact Lab at the University of Chicago report.
paras.zh: 芝加哥大学气候影响实验室的研究人员报告称，这种现象释放的海洋热量可能导致未来几个月全球陆地温度升高约 1.2 摄氏度，到 2027 年 2 月将导致超过 45 万人因高温而死亡。

paras.en: NOAA has yet to declare this event the strongest on record. It uses a rolling three-month-average anomaly, rather than the daily anomaly, in calculations of an El Niño’s strength. And it’s shifted to a new method for measuring El Niño strength, called the Relative Oceanic Niño index, which better represents the phenomenon’s ability to sway weather globally. By that measurement, the current El Niño has yet to surpass the strength of the one in 1997 and 1998.
paras.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 尚未宣布此次活动是有记录以来最强的一次。在计算厄尔尼诺现象的强度时，它使用三个月的滚动平均异常值，而不是每日异常值。它还转向了一种测量厄尔尼诺强度的新方法，称为相对海洋尼诺指数，它更好地代表了这种现象影响全球天气的能力。以此衡量，当前厄尔尼诺现象的强度尚未超过1997年和1998年的厄尔尼诺现象。

paras.en: But that record is on track to be broken soon, the latest seasonal forecast from NOAA’s Climate Prediction Center suggests. To understand what’s driving this historic El Niño and its potential impact, Science News spoke with Johnson, who is part of the team that produces the forecasts, and Nathan Lenssen, a climate scientist at the National Center of Atmospheric Research in Boulder, Colo. The conversation has been edited for length and clarity.
paras.zh: 但美国国家海洋和大气管理局气候预测中心的最新季节性预测表明，这一记录很快就会被打破。为了了解这次历史性厄尔尼诺现象的驱动因素及其潜在影响，《科学新闻》采访了预测团队成员约翰逊和科罗拉多州博尔德国家大气研究中心的气候科学家内森·伦森。为了篇幅和清晰度，对话经过了编辑。

paras.en: SN: How much of this El Niño’s strength has been fueled by human-caused climate change?
paras.zh: SN：这次厄尔尼诺现象的强度有多少是由人为造成的气候变化推动的？

paras.en: Johnson: It’s really an unanswered question. If we look at the historical record, we have been seeing more rapid swings between El Niño and La Niña [which is the other extreme phase of the El Niño Southern Oscillation that generally has the opposite effect on weather patterns]. There’s some evidence from simulations that increasing greenhouse gas emissions leads to more of those extreme swings. But there’s not yet a scientific consensus on how climate change is impacting El Niño, especially an extreme El Niño like this one.
paras.zh: 约翰逊：这确实是一个没有答案的问题。如果我们查看历史记录，就会发现厄尔尼诺现象和拉尼娜现象之间的波动更加迅速（这是厄尔尼诺南方涛动的另一个极端阶段，通常对天气模式产生相反的影响）。模拟中有一些证据表明，温室气体排放量的增加会导致更多的极端波动。但对于气候变化如何影响厄尔尼诺现象，尤其是像这样的极端厄尔尼诺现象，科学界尚未达成共识。

paras.en: Lenssen: It’s a matter of debate how much we can directly attribute to climate change. But due to the warming of the planet, there is more energy in the oceans now, and El Niños are when the ocean releases some of that heat into the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 伦森：我们可以在多大程度上直接归因于气候变化，这是一个有争议的问题。但由于地球变暖，海洋中现在有更多的能量，而厄尔尼诺现象是海洋将部分热量释放到大气中的现象。

paras.en: SN: What are the most predictable and unpredictable impacts of this El Niño?
paras.zh: SN：这次厄尔尼诺现象最可预测和最不可预测的影响是什么？

paras.en: Johnson: We see a lot of the most predictable impacts in the tropical regions, as that’s where El Niño itself develops. We’ve already seen this suppressed Atlantic hurricane season and enhanced Pacific hurricane season, and we’ve also seen droughts in Central America. We also tend to see droughts over northern South America and the Amazon, and a weakening of the Indian monsoon.
paras.zh: 约翰逊：我们在热带地区看到了许多最可预测的影响，因为厄尔尼诺现象本身就是在那里发展的。我们已经看到大西洋飓风季节受到抑制，太平洋飓风季节增强，而且中美洲也出现干旱。我们还倾向于看到南美洲北部和亚马逊地区出现干旱，以及印度季风减弱。

paras.en: As we get into late fall, we typically see more impacts a little farther from the equator.
