articles.title: NASA Model Wing Lights Up During First Pressure Sensitive Paint Tests
articles.author: Brandon Ingram

paras.en: Groundbreaking tests at NASA’s Langley Research Center in Hampton, Virginia, are paving the way for new wind tunnel capabilities for designing the aircraft technologies of the future.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局位于弗吉尼亚州汉普顿的兰利研究中心进行的突破性测试正在为设计未来飞机技术的新风洞能力铺平道路。

paras.en: In a first-of-its-kind test in NASA Langley’s Transonic Dynamics Tunnel, researchers used unsteady Pressure Sensitive Paint to study how air flows around a standard wind tunnel model known as the Benchmark Supercritical Wing. As the team observed the test, the paint’s special capabilities made the model wing glow pink-purple when exposed to special ultraviolet lights, while high-speed cameras captured every detail.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局兰利跨音速动力学隧道中进行的首次测试中，研究人员使用非定常压敏涂料来研究空气如何在称为“基准超临界机翼”的标准风洞模型周围流动。当团队观察测试时，这种涂料的特殊功能使模型机翼在暴露于​​特殊的紫外线灯下时会发出粉紫色的光，而高速摄像机则捕捉到了每一个细节。

paras.en: The test combined two valuable NASA tools. NASA’s benchmark wings don’t represent a particular type of aircraft, rather they are meant as universal models to help researchers improve computer modeling using wind tunnel data.
paras.zh: 该测试结合了两个有价值的 NASA 工具。美国宇航局的基准机翼并不代表特定类型的飞机，而是作为通用模型来帮助研究人员使用风洞数据改进计算机建模。

paras.en: Unsteady pressure sensitive paint is a specialized coating that varies in brightness according to how much pressure the air flow applies to the wing. High-speed cameras capture those changes, providing data for computer models. For years, NASA researchers at centers including Langley and the agency’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley have been working to integrate the paint into wind tunnel tests for aircraft and rockets. NASA researchers consider the paint a vital tool and expect to find many more wind tunnel applications in the future.
paras.zh: 非稳态压敏涂料是一种特殊的涂料，其亮度根据气流施加在机翼上的压力而变化。高速摄像机捕捉这些变化，为计算机模型提供数据。多年来，美国宇航局兰利和位于加州硅谷的艾姆斯研究中心等中心的研究人员一直致力于将这种涂料整合到飞机和火箭的风洞测试中。美国宇航局研究人员认为这种涂料是一种重要的工具，并期望在未来发现更多的风洞应用。

paras.en: This test marked the technique’s first use on a large-scale, freely moving model in a low‑oxygen environment, an achievement made possible by the Transonic Dynamic Tunnel’s unique testing capabilities.
paras.zh: 此次测试标志着该技术首次在低氧环境下的大型、自由移动模型上使用，这是跨音速动态隧道独特的测试能力所取得的成就。

paras.en: This milestone opens the door for upcoming tests on flexible aircraft models that are designed to bend and adapt during flight to improve efficiency. It also lays the foundation for better simulations and designs as NASA advances the future of flight.
paras.zh: 这一里程碑为即将进行的灵活飞机模型测试打开了大门，这些飞机模型旨在在飞行过程中弯曲和适应以提高效率。随着 NASA 推进飞行的未来，它还为更好的模拟和设计奠定了基础。

articles.title: NASA Campaign Explores Clouds Spawned by Wildfires

paras.en: The Wildhorse grass fire in eastern Idaho erupted with a massive pulse of smoke. No one had expected it, but the wildfire had launched what’s known as a pyrocumulonimbus cloud, or pyroCb. It was an elusive weather phenomenon that scientists on NASA’s INSPYRE (INjected Smoke and PYRocumulonimbus Experiment) campaign spent weeks this summer hunting across western North America.
paras.zh: 爱达荷州东部的野马草大火爆发并产生大量烟雾。没有人预料到，野火引发了所谓的火积雨云（pyroCb）。这是一种难以捉摸的天气现象，今年夏天，美国宇航局 INSPYRE（注入烟雾和热积雨云实验）活动的科学家们花了数周时间在北美西部寻找这种现象。

paras.en: Pyrocumulonimbus clouds rise above intense fires, producing lightning and rain along with powerful winds that can whip the flames below into a fury. The largest pyroCbs funnel smoke 30,000 to 50,000 feet (10 to 15 kilometers) above Earth’s surface, as high as the cruising altitudes of commercial jets and even into the stratosphere.
paras.zh: 火积雨云在强烈的火焰上方升起，产生闪电和降雨，以及强风，可以将下面的火焰吹得更加猛烈。最大的焦炭漏斗烟雾距地球表面 30,000 至 50,000 英尺（10 至 15 公里），与商用喷气式飞机的巡航高度一样高，甚至可进入平流层。

paras.en: The significance of pyroCbs emerged around the turn of the 21st century, when satellite observations revealed smoke reaching altitudes previously associated with major volcanic eruptions. Once in the stratosphere, pyroCb smoke can spread across continents, circle the globe, and persist far longer than it would in the lower atmosphere.
paras.zh: 21世纪之交，pyroCbs的重要性开始显现，当时卫星观测显示烟雾达到了先前与大型火山喷发相关的高度。一旦进入平流层，焦炭烟雾就会扩散到各大洲，环绕地球一周，并且比在低层大气中持续的时间要长得多。

paras.en: Despite their massive size, pyroCb clouds remain mysterious. But it’s important to understand how they form and connect with the atmosphere, because their smoke can affect climate and weather far from the fires that produced them and long after they’ve extinguished. They also can produce dangerous fire-generated winds.
paras.zh: 尽管pyroCb云体积巨大，但它仍然神秘。但了解它们如何形成以及与大气的联系很重要，因为它们的烟雾会影响远离产生它们的火灾并且在它们熄灭很久之后的气候和天气。它们还会产生危险的起火风。

paras.en: “We still do not understand if they’re driven by fire energetics, or fire intensity, or by atmospheric conditions above,” said Olga Kalashnikova, a researcher with NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California, who is one of the principal investigators leading INSPYRE, the first aircraft campaign designed specifically around studying pyroCbs.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室研究员奥尔加·卡拉什尼科娃 (Olga Kalashnikova) 表示：“我们仍然不知道它们是由火灾能量、火灾强度还是上面的大气条件驱动的。”她是 INSPYRE 项目的主要研究人员之一，这是第一个专门围绕研究 PyroCbs 设计的飞机项目。

paras.en: For six weeks this summer, INSPYRE researchers climbed aboard a Gulfstream jet for a series of flights from the plane's home base at the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) near Boulder, Colorado. Scientists collected smoke particles, sampled gases, photographed ice crystals, and monitored radiation passing through clouds and reflected back into space. The aircraft crisscrossed above, below, and through clouds to get a close-up view of fire-induced weather and smoke.
paras.zh: 今年夏天的六周时间里，INSPYRE 研究人员登上一架湾流喷气式飞机，从飞机位于科罗拉多州博尔德附近的国家大气研究中心 (NCAR) 的基地出发进行了一系列飞行。科学家们收集了烟雾颗粒，采集了气体样本，拍摄了冰晶，并监测了穿过云层并反射回太空的辐射。飞机在云层上方、下方和穿过云层来回穿梭，近距离观察火灾引起的天气和烟雾。

paras.en: Meanwhile, NASA’s high-flying ER-2 aircraft, loaded with 14 instruments, tracked fire intensity, updraft speeds, smoke, and cloud properties from above, while crews drove trucks equipped with sensors to view the same events from the ground. Ultimately, the team will investigate how wildfire-generated clouds transport smoke upward, how clouds transform particles and gases in smoke, how much reaches the stratosphere, and what happens once it gets there.
paras.zh: 与此同时，NASA 的高空飞行 ER-2 飞机装载了 14 个仪器，从上方跟踪火灾强度、上升气流速度、烟雾和云特性，而机组人员则驾驶配备传感器的卡车从地面观察相同的事件。最终，该团队将研究野火产生的云如何向上输送烟雾，云如何转化烟雾中的颗粒和气体，有多少到达平流层，以及到达那里后会发生什么。

paras.en: Firefighters will benefit from a better understanding of when pyroCbs are likely to develop and how they affect fire conditions on the ground. “A unique thing about pyrocumulonimbus is they are fire-generated weather, meaning the fire makes its own weather,” said Neil Lareau, an atmospheric scientist at the University of Nevada, Reno, who led INSPYRE’s ground observations. “The fire is making its own thunderstorm, and in the process of doing that, it’s also making its own wind.”
paras.zh: 消防员将受益于更好地了解焦炭何时可能形成以及它们如何影响地面火灾状况。领导 INSPYRE 地面观测的内华达大学里诺分校大气科学家 Neil Lareau 表示：“火积雨云的一个独特之处在于它们是由火产生的天气，这意味着火会产生自己的天气。” “火在制造自己的雷暴，在这个过程中，它也在制造自己的风。”

paras.en: A unique thing about pyrocumulonimbus is they are fire-generated weather . . . the fire makes its own weather.
paras.zh: 火积雨云的一个独特之处在于它们是由火产生的天气。 。 。火创造了自己的天气。

paras.en: Lareau hopes the research will lead to warnings comparable to the alerts meteorologists issue for severe thunderstorms. For example, he said, a forecast would warn firefighters that a developing cloud could soon produce a dangerous downdraft and wind shift, giving fire managers time to pull personnel off the line.
paras.zh: 拉罗希望这项研究能够发出与气象学家发出的强雷暴警报相当的警告。例如，他说，天气预报会警告消防员，正在形成的云可能很快会产生危险的下沉气流和风向变化，从而使消防管理人员有时间将人员从火线上撤离。

paras.en: Additionally, INSPYRE could also improve Earth system models. PyroCbs can carry enormous quantities of smoke into the stratosphere, where particles can persist for months or longer and affect how much solar energy the atmosphere absorbs and how much reaches Earth's surface. Most numerical prediction models don’t explicitly include the effects of pyroCbs and their smoke injections, said Dave Peterson, a Naval Research Laboratory meteorologist and INSPYRE’s co-principal investigator. Measurements of the particles, gases, and radiation associated with these events will give scientists data to test and improve simulations of their effects on Earth’s weather and climate.
paras.zh: 此外，INSPYRE 还可以改进地球系统模型。 PyroCbs 可以将大量烟雾带入平流层，颗粒物可以在平流层中持续数月或更长时间，并影响大气层吸收的太阳能量以及到达地球表面的太阳能量。海军研究实验室气象学家兼 INSPYRE 联合首席研究员戴夫·彼得森 (Dave Peterson) 表示，大多数数值预测模型并没有明确包括 PyroCbs 及其烟雾喷射的影响。对与这些事件相关的粒子、气体和辐射的测量将为科学家提供数据，以测试和改进它们对地球天气和气候影响的模拟。

paras.en: To study wildfire smoke and clouds, and perhaps catch a pyroCb in action, the INSPYRE team first had to find one. The challenge was getting an aircraft to the right place at the right time. Pyrocumulonimbus clouds can develop in minutes and subside just as quickly, while reaching fires hundreds of miles away takes hours of preparation, flight time, and coordination with air traffic controllers.
paras.zh: 为了研究野火烟雾和云，或许还能捕捉到正在燃烧的 PyroCb，INSPYRE 团队首先必须找到一个。挑战在于让飞机在正确的时间到达正确的地点。火积雨云可以在几分钟内形成并很快消退，而到达数百英里外的火场则需要数小时的准备、飞行时间以及与空中交通管制员的协调。

paras.en: But on Aug. 26, the team got lucky. The Gulfstream was returning from a fire farther west when Sarah Woods, a National Center for Atmospheric Research scientist serving as spotter, got word that the Wildhorse fire was unexpectedly intense.
paras.zh: 但8月26日，团队很幸运。当湾流号从更西边的一场大火中返回时，担任观察员的国家大气研究中心科学家莎拉·伍兹(Sarah Woods)得到消息称野马大火出乎意料地猛烈。

paras.en: The fire hadn’t initially attracted much attention. “We knew there was a grass fire there, and everyone’s like, it’s just a grass fire; we’re not going to worry about it,” Peterson said. “And it ended up being the main event.”
paras.zh: 这场火灾最初并没有引起太多关注。 “我们知道那里发生了草火，每个人都说，这只是草火；我们不会担心它，”彼得森说。 “这最终成为了主要事件。”

paras.en: We knew there was a grass fire there, and everyone’s like, it’s just a grass fire; we’re not going to worry about it . . . And it ended up being the main event.”
paras.zh: 我们知道那里发生了草火，每个人都说，这只是草火；我们不会为此担心。 。 。这最终成为了主要事件。”

paras.en: When the flight path neared the Wildhorse fire, Woods spotted the fresh remains of a pyroCb from her cramped jump seat behind the pilots. “It looks just like a big thunderstorm, and so as you approach it, you look for a visual indication of the fire on the ground,” said Woods.
paras.zh: 当飞行路线接近 Wildhorse 火灾时，伍兹在飞行员后面狭窄的跳椅上发现了新的 PyroCb 残骸。 “它看起来就像一场大雷暴，所以当你接近它时，你会寻找地面上火灾的视觉迹象，”伍兹说。

paras.en: Seeing the fire on the ground far below confirmed that the cloud was fire-generated. At Woods’ request, the pilots swung the plane around and spent the next three hours flying back and forth through the cloud plume and the trail of smoke drifting northwest toward Wyoming.
paras.zh: 看到下面远处地面上的火焰证实了云是由火产生的。在伍兹的要求下，飞行员调转飞机，在接下来的三个小时里在云羽和向西北飘向怀俄明州的烟雾中来回飞行。

paras.en: The chance encounter gave the INSPYRE team measurements of a pyroCb plume roughly an hour after the cloud first erupted. Other flights coordinated between the Gulfstream jet and ER-2 added crucial observations of active fire-driven atmospheric airflow that will help document how the resulting smoke plumes evolve over the days and weeks that follow.
paras.zh: 这次偶然的邂逅让 INSPYRE 团队在云首次喷发大约一小时后对 PyroCb 羽流进行了测量。湾流喷气式飞机和 ER-2 之间协调的其他航班增加了对活跃火灾驱动的大气气流的重要观测，这将有助于记录由此产生的烟羽在接下来的几天和几周内如何演变。

paras.en: Measurements from the Gulfstream and ER-2 will now be combined with satellite and ground observations and compared with models.
paras.zh: 湾流和 ER-2 的测量结果现在将与卫星和地面观测相结合，并与模型进行比较。

paras.en: “When clouds form, they modify chemistry,” said Kalashnikova, the JPL-based principal investigator. That altered smoke can have different effects on radiation, she said, making it important to understand both how pyroCbs form and the smoke that emerges from them.
paras.zh: “当云形成时，它们会改变化学反应，”喷气推进实验室的首席研究员卡拉什尼科娃说。她说，这种改变的烟雾会对辐射产生不同的影响，因此了解pyroCbs的形成方式以及从中产生的烟雾非常重要。

paras.en: In the summer of 2026, the challenge was finding the clouds and collecting the measurements. Now comes the work of understanding what they found.
paras.zh: 2026 年夏天，挑战是寻找云层并收集测量结果。现在需要了解他们的发现。

articles.title: La NASA abre solicitudes para próxima promoción de directores de vuelo
articles.author: María José Viñas

paras.en: La NASA busca líderes para uno de los puestos más prestigiosos de la Tierra en el ámbito de los vuelos espaciales tripulados: director de vuelo en el control de misión del Centro Espacial Johnson de la agencia, en Houston. Esta función es fundamental para reforzar el liderazgo estadounidense en la exploración espacial, a medida que la NASA allana el camino hacia una presencia humana sostenida en la Luna.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的故事是在休斯敦约翰逊太空中心任务控制中心负责人。该功能是在太空探索中重新设计的基本功能，是美国宇航局在月球上的未来之路的一部分。

paras.en: El plazo para presentar solicitudes está abierto desde ahora hasta el lunes 12 de octubre. Los ciudadanos estadounidenses pueden presentar su solicitud en (información en inglés):
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日，我们将在广场表达关切。 Los ciudadanos estadounidenses pueden Presentar su solicitud en (información en inglés):

paras.en: Las personas seleccionadas como directores de vuelo de la NASA dirigirán misiones tripuladas a la Estación Espacial Internacional, misiones Artemis a la Luna y, más adelante, las primeras misiones tripuladas a Marte.
paras.zh: 角色选择由 NASA 导演在国际空间站执行三项任务，在月球上执行阿耳忒弥斯任务，还有更多任务，在马尔特执行三项任务。

paras.en: Los directores de vuelo dirigen equipos de controladores de vuelo, astronautas y socios comerciales e internacionales en la ejecución de misiones en tiempo real y en la gestión de riesgos. Durante los preparativos de una misión, los directores de vuelo colaboran con los equipos de ingeniería, seguridad y programas para garantizar que los planes operativos se ajusten a las capacidades de la nave espacial y a los objetivos de la misión.
paras.zh: 负责控制车辆、宇航员、社会商业和国际任务、执行实际任务和管理国家的设备的主管。在执行任务期间，我们将指导工程设备的协作、安全和计划，以保证飞机的操作和调整太空能力和任务目标。

paras.en: “Estamos en un momento apasionante y decisivo, ya que seguimos dando soporte a las operaciones en la Estación Espacial Internacional mientras construimos la próxima etapa de los vuelos espaciales tripulados con las misiones de Artemis y Base Lunar, y nos preparamos para llegar más lejos que nunca”, dijo Emily Nelson, jefa de directores de vuelo en el centro Johnson. “Alcanzar estos ambiciosos objetivos requiere directores de vuelo que sean expertos en integración, capaces de reunir una amplia variedad de equipos y disciplinas en un esfuerzo de misión claro y unificado. Esta función esencial representa lo mejor de la innovación y el trabajo en equipo”.
paras.zh: “我们是一个坚定的时刻和决定性的时刻，我们将在国际空间站的行动中继续进行行动，以实现阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地的任务中的太空三人计划，并为更多的事情做好准备” lejos que nunca”，艾米丽·尼尔森 (Emily Nelson)，约翰逊中心的导演。 “Alcanzar estos ambiciiosos objetivos requiere directes de vuelo que Sean Expertos en integración, capaces de reunir una amplia differentad de Equipment y disciplinas en un esfuerzo de Mission claro y unificado. Esta función esencialrepresenta lo mejor de la innovación y el trabajo en Equipment”。

paras.en: Para ser considerados, los candidatos a director de vuelo deben ser ciudadanos estadounidenses y contar con una licenciatura de una institución acreditada en ingeniería, ciencias biológicas, ciencias físicas, informática o matemáticas. También necesitarán una amplia experiencia profesional afín y de responsabilidad creciente, que incluya la toma de decisiones críticas en entornos de alta presión y alto riesgo. Aunque muchos directores de vuelo de la NASA han sido antes controladores de vuelo en el control de misión, no es un requisito para presentar la solicitud.
paras.zh: 考虑到，候选人应获得国家公民的荣誉，并获得工程、生物科学、物理学、信息或数学方面的机构认证许可证。需要充分体验专业工作和责任，包括对高级领导和高级决策的批评决策。美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的许多主管都曾是控制任务的控制者，这并不是提出请求的必要条件。

paras.en: La NASA prevé anunciar las selecciones antes de que termine el año. Los nuevos directores de vuelo recibirán una amplia formación en control de vuelo y sistemas de naves espaciales, así como en liderazgo operativo y gestión de riesgos.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局 (NASA) 宣布近期将进行选择。新的指挥者将控制声音和空间系统，以控制操作和管理。

paras.en: Obtén más información sobre los directores de vuelo de la NASA y el proceso de solicitud en (información en inglés):
paras.zh: 获取 NASA 主管和征求程序的更多信息（英语信息）：

articles.title: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter

paras.en: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter
paras.zh: 加沙：世卫组织呼吁在冬季到来之前提供大量援助

paras.en: Repeated delays in bringing lifesaving medicines, prosthetics and more from Israel into Gaza risk having devastating consequences on Palestinians who urgently need them in the war-torn enclave, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）周五表示，从以色列向加沙运送救生药品、假肢等物资的工作一再拖延，可能会对饱受战争蹂躏的飞地中迫切需要这些物资的巴勒斯坦人造成毁灭性后果。

paras.en: “A truck full of non-priority supplies or the right supplies arriving too late, doesn't save lives. That's the question that actually matters," said Dr Reinhilde Van De Weerdt, WHO Representative in the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT).
paras.zh: 世卫组织驻巴勒斯坦被占领土代表 Reinhilde Van De Weerdt 博士表示：“一辆满载非优先物资的卡车或正确的物资抵达太晚，并不能挽救生命。这是真正重要的问题。”

paras.en: Almost 12 months into a fragile ceasefire agreement between Hamas fighters and Israel marked by ongoing Israeli airstrikes and other military activity, Gaza’s humanitarian situation remains “overwhelming”, according to the UN aid coordination office, OCHA.
paras.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室人道协调厅表示，哈马斯武装分子与以色列达成脆弱的停火协议已近 12 个月，以色列持续进行空袭和其他军事活动，加沙的人道主义局势仍然“不堪重负”。

paras.en: Approved aid can only be brought into the Strip via Kerem Shalom in the southern tip of the enclave, while Rafah (also in the south) is open for the limited movement of people including patients requiring medical treatment abroad. At least four other main entry points into Gaza for aid remain closed: Kissufim, Gate 96, Erez and Erez West.
paras.zh: 批准的援助只能通过该飞地南端的凯雷姆沙洛姆进入加沙地带，而拉法（也在南部）对人员有限的流动开放，包括需要在国外接受治疗的患者。至少有四个进入加沙的援助主要入口仍然关闭：Kissufim、96 号门、埃雷兹和埃雷兹西。

paras.en: In a call to the Israeli authorities to “release the pressure on medical supplies”, Dr Van De Weerdt also stressed that essential medicines “should not be considered as dual use” – and therefore banned by Israel on the grounds that they could be used by Hamas fighters – “as they are globally accepted standards on medical items anybody needs anywhere to run a hospital or a clinic”.
paras.zh: 在呼吁以色列当局“释放医疗用品压力”时，范德韦尔特博士还强调，基本药物“不应被视为双重用途”——因此被以色列禁止，理由是它们可能被哈马斯武装分子使用——“因为它们是全球公认的医疗用品标准，任何人在任何地方经营医院或诊所都需要”。

paras.en: In the last six months, one shipment of prosthetics and assistive devices was rejected four times. "Every rejection means another delay for someone who has already lost a limb and is simply waiting for the chance to walk again," stressed the WHO official, who noted that medicines "by contrast, move relatively well", with almost 87 per cent approved and just over 1 per cent rejected.
paras.zh: 在过去六个月中，一批假肢和辅助器具被拒绝四次。这位世卫组织官员强调说：“对于已经失去肢体、只是等待再次行走机会的人来说，每一次拒绝都意味着又一次延误。”他指出，药物“相比之下，移动得相对顺利”，近 87% 的药物获得批准，略高于 1% 的药物被拒绝。

paras.en: UN aid agencies operating in Gaza still provide critical assistance to families across the Strip in coordination with the Israeli authorities, but this lifesaving work is impeded by a lack of reliable and timely access.
paras.zh: 在加沙开展行动的联合国援助机构仍在与以色列当局协调，向加沙地带的家庭提供重要援助，但这项救生工作因缺乏可靠和及时的准入而受到阻碍。

paras.en: “Our ask is simple and has not changed: we need the unimpeded and predictable entry of humanitarian and health supplies into Gaza at scale. We also need a multi-crossing model so that aid isn't forced to trickle down through a limited number of crossings,” the WHO senior official said.
paras.zh: 世卫组织高级官员表示：“我们的要求很简单，也没有改变：我们需要大规模、不受阻碍和可预测的人道主义和卫生用品进入加沙。我们还需要一种多重过境模式，这样援助就不会被迫通过有限数量的过境点流入。”

paras.en: Highlighting the “extraordinary health workers” still risking their lives to help others in Gaza, Dr Van De Weerdt said that too few supplies were reaching them and not enough patients were getting the care they needed and deserved. The already dire humanitarian situation risks getting even worse soon, once autumn ends.
paras.zh: 范德韦尔特博士强调，“杰出的卫生工作者”仍在冒着生命危险帮助加沙的其他人，他说，到达他们手中的物资太少，也没有足够的患者得到他们需要和应得的护理。秋季结束后，本已严峻的人道主义局势有可能很快变得更糟。

paras.en: “As winter begins, this urgency to get supplies into Gaza only deepens. Almost two million people are in need of shelter to protect against the cold and the risk of flooding, exposing people to serious health and safety risks, let alone [their] dignity,” the WHO official explained.
paras.zh: 世卫组织官员解释说：“随着冬季的到来，向加沙运送物资的紧迫性只会进一步加深。近200万人需要庇护所以抵御寒冷和洪水的风险，这使人们面临严重的健康和安全风险，更不用说[他们的]尊严。”

paras.en: As in previous winters in Gaza, the enclave’s residents are expected to face a heightened risk of preventable disease outbreaks, linked to the absence of safe shelter, a lack of clean water and the high number of rats, whose bites transmit infection. The destruction of public health laboratories has complicated the task of identifying potential epidemics, WHO explained.
paras.zh: 与加沙往年冬天一样，该飞地的居民预计将面临更大的可预防疾病爆发的风险，原因是缺乏安全住所、缺乏清洁水以及大量老鼠，老鼠的叮咬会传播感染。世卫组织解释说，公共卫生实验室被毁使识别潜在流行病的任务变得更加复杂。

paras.en: The development follows a warning from OCHA on Thursday about serious public health risks linked to the accumulation of solid waste in the heart of Gaza City.
paras.zh: 此前，人道主义事务协调厅周四就加沙市中心固体废物堆积所带来的严重公共卫生风险发出警告。

paras.en: Recent gains in improving sanitation in Gaza remain fragile because of a lack of reliable access to heavy machinery and equipment, OCHA explained, “or to engine oil and spare parts required to keep them running. Sustained funding for fuel is also critical.”
paras.zh: 人道协调厅解释说，由于无法可靠地获得重型机械和设备，“或者缺乏维持其运行所需的发动机油和备件”，加沙最近在改善卫生条件方面取得的进展仍然脆弱。持续的燃料资金也至关重要。

paras.en: Meanwhile, mine action partners reported that they still lack “permissions and equipment” to remove unexploded ordnance hazards identified in the rubble during 37 assessment missions.
paras.zh: 与此同时，排雷行动合作伙伴报告称，他们仍然缺乏“许可和设备”来清除 37 次评估任务期间在废墟中发现的未爆炸弹药危险。

articles.title: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis

paras.en: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis
paras.zh: 也门战事升级加剧粮食安全危机

paras.en: Fighting between Government forces and Houthi rebels along the southwestern coast has forced nearly 150,000 people from their homes, disrupted markets and restricted humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 政府军与胡塞叛乱分子在西南海岸发生的战斗迫使近 15 万人逃离家园，扰乱市场并限制人道主义援助准入。

paras.en: “What is beginning as a hunger crisis in Yemen could certainly compound a greater food security crisis far beyond its borders,” Matthew Hollingworth, WFP Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations, told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署负责项目业务的助理执行主任马修·霍林沃斯在日内瓦对记者说：“也门的饥饿危机肯定会加剧远远超出其边界的更大的粮食安全危机。”

paras.en: Yemen was already among the world’s top humanitarian crises and “hunger hotspots” prior to the escalation. More than 18 million people nationwide face acute food security, and some 2.2 million children under five are acutely malnourished.
paras.zh: 在升级之前，也门已经是世界上最严重的人道主义危机和“饥饿热点”之一。全国有超过1800万人面临严重的粮食安全问题，约220万五岁以下儿童严重营养不良。

paras.en: Speaking from Rome. Mr. Hollingworth said that today, nearly three out of four households in accessible areas are unable to meet their basic needs – “a record number for this year in just a few weeks.”
paras.zh: 从罗马说起。霍林沃斯先生表示，如今，在交通便利的地区，近四分之三的家庭无法满足其基本需求——“在短短几周内就创下了今年的创纪录数字”。

paras.en: “People are finding it hard to put any food on the table, or if they indeed have a table if they're displaced,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人们发现餐桌上很难有任何食物，或者即使他们流离失所，也很难找到桌子。”

paras.en: “They're skipping meals, they are eating a much smaller diversity of food types, and they are facing hunger on a daily basis.”
paras.zh: “他们不吃饭，吃的食物种类少得多，而且每天都面临饥饿。”

paras.en: Food prices are rising sharply, while traders report limited wheat flour stocks and disruption to vegetable oil supplies, which is making it difficult for families to afford these items.
paras.zh: 食品价格大幅上涨，而贸易商报告小麦面粉库存有限，植物油供应中断，这使得家庭难以负担这些物品。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the influx of displaced people is putting pressure on urban areas and existing displacement sites. Many have arrived at these locations after walking for days without water or food.
paras.zh: 与此同时，流离失所者的涌入给城市地区和现有的流离失所地点带来了压力。许多人在没有水和食物的情况下步行数天后到达这些地点。

paras.en: WFP is stepping up operations in Yemen and has assisted more than 70,000 people across two of the biggest “displacement hotspots” in Lahaj and Taiz, providing hot meals and other assistance.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署正在加强在也门的行动，并已为拉哈吉和塔伊兹两个最大的“流离失所热点地区”的 7 万多人提供了热餐和其他援助。

paras.en: The UN agency was already supporting more than 1.5 million people in Government-held areas prior to the escalation.
paras.zh: 在升级之前，联合国机构已经为政府控制地区的超过 150 万人提供了支持。

paras.en: “We know we can reach that height of support with the pre-positioned stocks we have, but we are finding it increasingly hard to move food into frontline areas,” Mr. Hollingworth said.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生说：“我们知道，利用我们所拥有的预先配置的库存，我们可以达到这样的支撑高度，但我们发现将粮食运送到前线地区变得越来越困难。”

paras.en: The fighting has cut off access to parts of Taiz and Hudaydah, preventing WFP and partners from accessing some 350,000 people in areas where they used to assist.
paras.zh: 战斗导致塔伊兹和荷台达部分地区的交通被切断，粮食计划署及其合作伙伴无法接触到他们曾经援助过的地区的约 35 万人。

paras.en: Humanitarian teams cannot work in these areas, which are under the control of the Houthi de facto authorities, in line with an operational pause mandated by the UN Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 根据联合国秘书长的暂停行动规定，人道主义救援队无法在这些地区开展工作，这些地区由胡塞事实上的当局控制。

paras.en: In the face of the food security crisis, WFP is drawing on its stocks already allocated for the broader response in Yemen.
paras.zh: 面对粮食安全危机，粮食计划署正在动用已分配的库存，用于也门的更广泛应对行动。

paras.en: “We're robbing Peter to feed Paul,” Mr. Hollingworth said, stressing the critical need for funding to support both newly displaced people and the millions who have depended on the agency’s support for years.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生说：“我们是在抢彼得来养活保罗。”他强调，迫切需要资金来支持新的流离失所者和多年来依赖该机构支持的数百万人。

paras.en: “If the world doesn't step up soon to help Yemen, the outlook is going to get bleaker,” he warned, because “the consequences of this conflict are stretching beyond Yemen.”
paras.zh: “如果世界不尽快采取行动帮助也门，前景将会变得更加黯淡，”他警告说，因为“这场冲突的后果将蔓延到也门以外的地区。”

paras.en: At least 3,700 Yemenis have crossed the Bab al-Mandab Strait to seek shelter in Djibouti, where WFP is working with the authorities to support the arrivals.
paras.zh: 至少有 3,700 名也门人越过曼德海峡前往吉布提寻求庇护，粮食计划署正在与当地当局合作为抵达者提供支持。

paras.en: Mr. Hollingworth said the Strait is critical for the transport of food, fuel and commercial goods moving between Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Europe.
paras.zh: 霍林沃斯先生表示，该海峡对于亚洲、中东、非洲和欧洲之间的食品、燃料和商品运输至关重要。

paras.en: “Instability around this corridor risks driving food prices higher and deepening food insecurity across a much bigger region –the world.”
paras.zh: “这条走廊周围的不稳定可能会推高粮食价格，并加剧整个更大地区（全世界）的粮食不安全。”

paras.en: He noted that the Yemen crisis is happening at a time when Bab al-Mandab and two other “critical maritime choke points” – the Black Sea and the Strait of Hormuz - are under pressure.
paras.zh: 他指出，也门危机发生之际，曼德海峡和另外两个“关键海上咽喉要道”——黑海和霍尔木兹海峡——正面临压力。

paras.en: “When all three of these are under pressure at the same time, you can add to that the impact of a super El Niño weather pattern. These consequences are going to ripple through food systems everywhere,” he said.
paras.zh: “当这三个因素同时面临压力时，超级厄尔尼诺天气模式的影响就会加剧。这些后果将波及世界各地的粮食系统，”他说。

paras.en: “We've said this before but let me be clear once again: today's humanitarian shock and supply chain disruptions can become tomorrow's global food crisis.”
paras.zh: “我们之前已经说过这一点，但让我再次明确：今天的人道主义冲击和供应链中断可能会成为明天的全球粮食危机。”

articles.title: World News in Brief: Cycle of violence continues in Haiti, seafarer deaths off Somalia, food insecurity in the Middle East

paras.en: World News in Brief: Cycle of violence continues in Haiti, seafarer deaths off Somalia, food insecurity in the Middle East
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：海地暴力循环仍在继续，索马里海域海员死亡，中东粮食不安全

paras.en: In an update to the Human Rights Council, the High Commissioner welcomed the first Gang Suppression Force operations, mandated by the UN Security Council.
paras.zh: 在向人权理事会通报最新情况时，高级专员对联合国安理会授权的首次帮派镇压行动表示欢迎。

paras.en: These will help boost security in Haiti “but the Force remains far below the strength needed”, Mr. Türk insisted, in support of its “full, accelerated deployment” with human rights safeguards embedded.
paras.zh: 图尔克坚称，这些将有助于加强海地的安全，“但部队的兵力仍远远低于所需的水平”，以支持其“全面、加速部署”并纳入人权保障措施。

paras.en: At least 5,700 people have been confirmed killed or injured by gangs – or during operations against them – since 1 January, according to the UN human rights office, OHCHR.
paras.zh: 据联合国人权高专办称，自 1 月 1 日以来，至少有 5,700 人被团伙或在针对团伙的行动中杀害或受伤。

paras.en: Gang members have also kidnapped more than 230 people and raped at least 1,000 women and girls. The real figures are likely much higher, Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: 该团伙成员还绑架了 230 多人，并强奸了至少 1,000 名妇女和女孩。图尔克先生说，实际数字可能要高得多。

paras.en: In his update, the High Commissioner for Human Rights also warned that “extortion, looting and destruction of property” are crippling economic activity in Haiti.
paras.zh: 人权事务高级专员在最新情况中还警告说，“敲诈勒索、抢劫和破坏财产”正在削弱海地的经济活动。

paras.en: The “constant danger” prevents people from reaching schools, hospitals, and essential services, Mr. Türk stressed.
paras.zh: 图尔克强调，“持续的危险”使人们无法到达学校、医院和基本服务机构。

paras.en: Five seafarers killed as three hijacked ships are freed off Somalia
paras.zh: 三艘被劫持的船只在索马里海域被释放，五名海员丧生

paras.en: Three hijacked ships have been freed after months in captivity, but five seafarers died during the rescue of one of them, the head of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has said.
paras.zh: 国际海事组织（IMO）负责人表示，三艘被劫持的船只在被囚禁数月后已被释放，但其中一艘船只有五名海员在营救过程中死亡。

paras.en: IMO Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez offered his condolences after the operation to free the HONOUR 25 in Somali waters on 29 September, in which several other crew members were seriously injured.
paras.zh: 国际海事组织秘书长阿塞尼奥·多明计斯在 9 月 29 日在索马里水域解救 HONOR 25 号行动后表示哀悼，此次行动导致其他几名船员受重伤。

paras.en: Mr. Dominguez said seafarers “should not have to lose their lives for the service they provide for the world”, and called for renewed resolve, targeted cooperation and the resources needed to stop piracy in the region.
paras.zh: 多明格斯表示，海员“不应该因为为世界提供的服务而失去生命”，并呼吁重新下定决心、开展有针对性的合作并提供制止该地区海盗活动所需的资源。

paras.en: The HONOUR 25 was one of three vessels released this week, along with the SEAMULL (also known as SIBU 1) and the MT EUREKA, all seized between April and August by pirates and armed robbers.
paras.zh: HONOR 25 是本周获释的三艘船只之一，其他船只还有 SEAMULL（也称为 SIBU 1）和 MT EUREKA，均在 4 月至 8 月期间被海盗和武装劫匪扣押。

paras.en: In total, 44 seafarers were freed and their governments are working to arrange their repatriation. Mr. Dominguez thanked Somalia's Government for its efforts, but noted that 22 seafarers remain captive aboard the ASANA.
paras.zh: 总共有 44 名海员获释，他们的政府正在努力安排他们的遣返。多明计斯先生感谢索马里政府所做的努力，但指出仍有 22 名海员仍被扣押在 ASANA 上。

paras.en: He urged Governments to bring new initiatives, such as the proposed Group of Friends of Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers, to the IMO, and stressed the importance of the EUNAVFOR Aspides and Atalanta operations for maritime security in the region.
paras.zh: 他敦促各国政府向国际海事组织提出新的倡议，例如拟议的航运和海员安全保障之友小组，并强调欧洲海军阿斯皮德斯和亚特兰大行动对该地区海事安全的重要性。

paras.en: Millions more women could go hungry as tensions escalate in the Middle East
paras.zh: 随着中东紧张局势升级，数百万妇女可能会挨饿

paras.en: An additional 11.7 million women and girls in 28 countries could face food insecurity by the end of the year due to the escalating conflict in the Middle East and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 由于中东冲突升级和霍尔木兹海峡的混乱，到今年年底，28个国家的另外1170万妇女和女童可能面临粮食不安全。

paras.en: These crises are driving up food prices and putting a strain on livelihoods and household resources, UN Women said in new analysis published on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署在周五发布的新分析中表示，这些危机正在推高食品价格，给生计和家庭资源带来压力。

paras.en: Presenting the findings to journalists in Geneva, UN Women Deputy Executive Director Nyaradzayi Gumbonzvanda said the estimates are a potential scenario, not a forecast, and that the number is in addition to the 208 million women and girls who were already estimated to be food insecure or malnourished in these countries.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署副执行主任 Nyaradzayi Gumbonzvanda 在日内瓦向记者介绍调查结果时表示，这些估计只是一种可能的情况，而不是预测，而且这个数字不包括在这些国家中已经估计有 2.08 亿妇女和女童面临粮食不安全或营养不良的人数。

paras.en: “Experience from past conflicts shows that when food is scarce, women often reduce the amount they eat or skip meals so that children and other family members can eat,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“过去冲突的经验表明，当食物匮乏时，妇女往往会减少进食量或不吃饭，以便孩子和其他家庭成员有饭吃。”

paras.en: The greatest numbers of women and girls at risk are in populous countries, while South Sudan, Sudan, Haiti, Yemen and Palestine face the highest concentration of overlapping vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 面临风险的妇女和女童数量最多的是人口稠密的国家，而南苏丹、苏丹、海地、也门和巴勒斯坦面临的重叠脆弱性最为集中。

paras.en: UN Women recommends linking food and cash assistance to nutrition, protection, employment and agricultural services. Women should also have access to land, credit and productive resources.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署建议将粮食和现金援助与营养、保护、就业和农业服务联系起来。妇女还应该能够获得土地、信贷和生产资源。

paras.en: The agency also highlighted the need for better collection of data that shows where food insecurity is worsening and who is eating less, losing income and carrying the heaviest burden of unpaid care work.
paras.zh: 该机构还强调需要更好地收集数据，以显示哪些地区的粮食不安全状况正在恶化，以及哪些人吃得更少、收入减少以及承担最重的无偿护理工作负担。

articles.title: Doyle: Maltese Cross to bring home Arc glory for Marquand and Haggas

paras.en: Hollie Doyle: Maltese Cross to bring home Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe glory for Tom Marquand and William Haggas
paras.zh: 霍莉·多伊尔：马耳他十字勋章将为汤姆·马昆德和威廉·哈加斯带回凯旋门奖荣耀

paras.en: Speaking to Simon Mapletoft, Sky Sports Racing ambassador Hollie Doyle looks forward to a thrilling weekend of action, headlined by Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe; Watch Europe's richest race - live on Sky Sports Racing - at 3.05pm
paras.zh: 天空体育赛车大使霍莉·多伊尔 (Hollie Doyle) 在接受西蒙·梅普莱托夫特 (Simon Mapletoft) 采访时，期待着以周日凯旋门大奖赛为主角的激动人心的周末。下午 3.05 观看欧洲最富有的赛事 - 天空体育赛车直播

paras.en: Before heading to Paris to cheer on Maltese Cross, Hollie Doyle penned her latest exclusive blog ahead of Arc weekend.
paras.zh: 在前往巴黎为马耳他十字勋章加油之前，霍莉·多伊尔在弧形周末之前写下了她最新的独家博客。

paras.en: I'm on the Maltese Cross team for obvious reasons in the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (3.05) at ParisLongchamp on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Racing. He gives my husband Tom [Marquand], his trainer William Haggas and owner George Waud an outstanding chance of winning this great race.
paras.zh: 周日，在巴黎隆尚举行的卡塔尔凯旋门大奖赛（3.05）中，我加入马耳他十字队，原因显而易见，天空体育赛车直播。他为我的丈夫汤姆（马昆德）、他的练马师威廉·哈加斯和马主乔治·沃德提供了赢得这场伟大比赛的绝佳机会。

paras.en: What he's achieved this year has been pretty spectacular and I don't think anyone's seen the best of him yet. The Grand Prix de Paris and the Great Voltigeur at York were only the tip of the iceberg in terms of how good this horse could be.
paras.zh: 他今年取得的成就相当惊人，我认为还没有人看到他最好的一面。巴黎大奖赛和约克伏尔蒂格大赛只是这匹马的优秀表现的冰山一角。

paras.en: He got roughed up a little in both those races but has a great mind for a three-year-old which will stand him in good stead again in the hurly burly of the Arc, particularly from his wide draw in stall 11.
paras.zh: 他在这两场比赛中都受到了一点粗暴，但对于一匹三岁马来说，他有着伟大的头脑，这将使他在喧闹的弧线中再次保持良好的状态，特别是在他在第11号摊位的大抽签中。

paras.en: - Kevin Blake's Arc day tips: Three fancies on star-studded undercard
paras.zh: - 凯文·布莱克 (Kevin Blake) 的 Arc Day 秘诀：对明星云集的底牌的三种幻想

paras.en: - Who wins the Arc? Sky Sports Racing team tips
paras.zh: - 谁赢得了弧线？天空体育赛车队提示

paras.en: Last year's winner Daryz will of course be a tough opponent with the draw in his favour and looks to have been produced to the minute by his master trainer Francis-Henri Graffard, but Maltese Cross, whose only defeat came on softer ground in the Derby, will be a huge threat to all.
paras.zh: 去年的冠军达里兹当然会是一个强硬的对手，他的平局对他有利，看起来是由他的主教练弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德精心打造的，但马耳他·克罗斯在德比中唯一的失利是在较软的地面上发生的，这对所有人来说都是一个巨大的威胁。

paras.en: I'd love to see his British compatriot Kalpana make her presence felt, too. After all, Andrew Balding's wonderful mare has proven she can compete against the boys at the top table by winning the King George and was impressive in the Yorkshire Oaks after that.
paras.zh: 我很高兴看到他的英国同胞卡尔帕纳也能展现出她的存在。毕竟，安德鲁·鲍尔丁 (Andrew Balding) 的出色母马赢得了乔治国王赛 (King George)，证明了她可以与顶尖选手竞争，并在约克郡橡树赛 (Yorkshire Oaks) 中表现出色。

paras.en: Great opportunity for Godolphin filly in Boussac
paras.zh: 布萨克高多芬母马的绝佳机会

paras.en: Green Empress is entitled to take the beating in a slightly disappointing renewal of the Qatar Prix Marcel Boussac Criterium des Pouliches (12.31) on Sunday.
paras.zh: 绿色皇后有权在周日卡塔尔大奖赛马塞尔·布萨克普利切斯赛道 (12.31) 的更新中稍显令人失望。

paras.en: Joseph O'Brien's filly found only the prolific Sun Goddess too strong in the Moyglare Stakes on her latest start but any chinks in her armour could be exploited by Godolphin's interesting runner Miss Miniver.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·奥布莱恩 (Joseph O'Brien) 的母马发现，多产的太阳女神 (Sun Goddess) 在莫伊格拉尔锦标赛 (Moyglare Stakes) 的最新比赛中表现过于强劲，但她盔甲上的任何缝隙都可能被戈多芬 (Godolphin) 有趣的赛跑者米尼弗小姐 (Miss Miniver) 利用。

paras.en: Though Green Empress's market rival Allela could be anything at this stage, Roger Varian is backing the daughter of Wootton Bassett up quickly after her fourth in the Group 2 Rockfel at Newmarket so this could be a great opportunity to bag a fairly weak Group 1.
paras.zh: 虽然“绿皇后”的市场竞争对手“阿莱拉”在现阶段可能会有所作为，但罗杰·瓦里安正在支持伍顿·巴塞特的女儿在纽马克特获得第二组“洛克菲尔”第四名后迅速崛起，因此这可能是一个绝佳的机会来囊括相当弱的第一组。

paras.en: Joseph O'Brien's excellent season can continue with the progressive Folsom Blues in the Qatar Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere Longines (1.09) on Sunday.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·奥布莱恩 (Joseph O'Brien) 的出色赛季将在周日的卡塔尔浪琴大奖赛 (Jean-Luc Lagardere Longines) (1.09) 中与进步的福尔瑟姆布鲁斯 (Folsom Blues) 一起继续。

paras.en: The son of Blue Point lost nothing in defeat behind last weekend's Cheveley Park heroine Sun Goddess in the Pheonix Stakes at the Curragh before returning to take the Group 1 National Stakes in most emphatic style.
paras.zh: 蓝点之子在上周末在卡拉格举办的菲尼克斯锦标赛中输给切夫利公园女英雄太阳女神后，没有损失任何东西，然后以最有力的方式重返国家一级锦标赛。

paras.en: He hasn't been blessed with the best draw but has the class to overcome that while James Doyle's mount Imperial Strike looks way overpriced in his quest to reverse Group 3 form with the unbeaten Avec Toi.
paras.zh: 他并没有获得最好的平局，但他有能力克服这一点，而詹姆斯·道尔（James Doyle）的坐骑“帝国打击”（Imperial Strike）在他与不败的阿维克·托伊（Avec Toi）扭转第3组状态的过程中看起来价格过高。

paras.en: It would be a great result for racing if Naana's Shadow could win the Prix de l'Abbaye de Longchamp Longines (1.47) on Sunday for Galashiels trainer Katie Scott.
paras.zh: 如果Naana's Shadow 能够在周日为Galashiels 练马师Katie Scott 赢得Longchamp Longines 修道院大奖赛（1.47），这对于比赛来说将是一个伟大的成绩。

paras.en: Katie, who trains only a small string, has worked wonders with this grey filly who won the Group 3 trial for this race over course and distance last month so deserves to be favourite.
paras.zh: 凯蒂（Katie）只训练了一小群，但她与这匹灰色母马创造了奇迹，这只灰色母马在上个月的比赛中赢得了第三组选拔赛的路线和距离，因此值得受到青睐。

paras.en: However, her starting position in stall 13 isn't great on such a draw-dependent track so I'm expecting Francis-Henri Graffard's SHIRI to reverse that form while keeping a close eye on Harry Eustace's Time For Sandals, who has the talent to go close if she can get back to her best form.
paras.zh: 然而，在这样一个依赖平局的赛道上，她在第 13 号摊位的首发位置并不是很好，所以我期待弗朗西斯-亨利·格拉法德 (Francis-Henri Graffard) 的 SHIRI 扭转这种状态，同时密切关注哈利·尤斯塔斯 (Harry Eustace) 的 Time For Sandals，如果她能恢复到最佳状态，她就有能力接近这一点。

paras.en: Precise can hit the right notes in Opera
paras.zh: 精确可以在 Opera 中击中正确的音符

paras.en: Aventure will be a short price to supplement her Group 1 success in the Prix Romanet when she reappears in the Prix de l'Opera Longines (3.50) on Sunday. Christophe Ferland's mare beat a below-best Diamond Necklace that day so I'm not sure how strong that form was, however.
paras.zh: 当她周日再次出现在浪琴表歌剧大奖赛 (3.50) 中时，Aventure 将以短期价格补充她在罗曼内特大奖赛第一组的成功。克里斯托夫·费兰 (Christophe Ferland) 的母马那天击败了一条低于最佳水平的钻石项链，所以我不确定这种形式有多强。

paras.en: I prefer Aidan O'Brien's filly Precise, who hasn't managed to get her head in front since winning the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot but had run well in top company before her underwhelming display in the Matron last time.
paras.zh: 我更喜欢艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 的母马“精确”(Precise)，自从在皇家阿斯科特赛马会 (Royal Ascot) 赢得加冕赛冠军后，她就再也没有领先过，但在上次在马特隆 (Matron) 中表现平平之前，她在顶级公司中表现出色。

paras.en: She's much better than she showed on Irish Champions' weekend so looks a strong alternative to the likely favourite with the ever-consistent Pink Panthera seemingly booked for another placing.
paras.zh: 她比她在爱尔兰冠军周末上表现得要好得多，因此看起来是一个强有力的替代品，可能是最受欢迎的粉红豹的有力替代品，而一直稳定的粉红豹似乎已经预订了另一个名次。

paras.en: Fozzy Stack can strike a blow for Ireland in the Qatar Prix de la Foret (4.25) on Sunday with Thesecretadversary, who should be able to roll into a nice rhythm on a track that will play to his strengths.
paras.zh: Fozzy Stack 可以在周日的卡塔尔拉福雷大奖赛 (4.25) 中与 Thesecretadversary 一起为爱尔兰队带来一击，后者应该能够在赛道上形成良好的节奏，从而发挥他的优势。

paras.en: Stepping back in trip looks ideal for the Jersey Stakes winner who is a value alternative to favourite Samangan, who only got the verdict in a bunch finish at Deauville last time so probably needs to find more.
paras.zh: 对于泽西锦标赛冠军来说，退后一步看起来是理想的选择，他是最受欢迎的萨曼根的一个有价值的替代品，萨曼根上次在多维尔的比赛中只获得了胜利，所以可能需要找到更多。

paras.en: Aidan O'Brien's True Love was only fifth in that race and didn't look herself in the Matron last month but is another who will appreciate dropping back in distance and can go well, too.
paras.zh: 艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 的“真爱”(True Love) 在那场比赛中仅排名第五，上个月在 Matron 比赛中也没有表现出自己的样子，但她也是另一位愿意退后距离并且也能跑得很好的人。

paras.en: Haggas holds key to Saturday's Cumberland Lodge
paras.zh: 哈加斯持有周六坎伯兰旅馆的钥匙

paras.en: William Haggas, who runs the strongly fancied Maltese Cross in the Arc in Paris on Sunday, holds the key to the two feature races at Ascot on Saturday, including the Group 3 Bet MGM Cumberland Lodge Stakes (2.25), live on Sky Sports Racing..
paras.zh: 周日在巴黎圆弧赛马耳他十字赛 (Maltese Cross) 上运行的威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 掌握着周六阿斯科特 (Ascot) 两场专题比赛的关键，其中包括由天空体育赛车 (Sky Sports Racing) 直播的第 3 组投注米高梅坎伯兰洛奇锦标赛 (2.25)。

paras.en: Gallant veteran Al Aasy is definitely the class horse in the race and is definitely the one they all have to beat in this Group 3. He's already won at a higher level this year and will get on well with Danny Tudhope.
paras.zh: 英勇的老将阿尔·阿西（Al Aasy）绝对是比赛中的一流马，也绝对是他们在第 3 组中必须击败的一匹马。他今年已经在更高的水平上获胜，并将与丹尼·图德霍普（Danny Tudhope）相处得很好。

paras.en: Stablemate Tenability is ultra-tough as he showed when winning the Listed August Stakes at Windsor and looks fairly progressive but will need to step forward to put Al Aasy in his place.
paras.zh: Stablemate Tenability 非常强硬，正如他在温莎赢得八月公开锦标赛时所表现出的那样，看起来相当进步，但需要挺身而出，让 Al Aasy 取代他的位置。

paras.en: Division only just failed to nail the Group 1 Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville last time - form that sets a demanding standard in the John Guest Racing Bengough Stakes (3.00).
paras.zh: 该部门上次在多维尔举行的 Maurice de Gheest 一级方程式锦标赛中只是未能获得冠军，这种状态在 John Guest Racing Bengough 锦标赛 (3.00) 中树立了严格的标准。

paras.en: William Haggas's Wathnan Racing colt can compromise his chance with a slow start but if the race is run to suit him this represents a great opportunity to get a Group 3 success on his CV.
paras.zh: 威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 的瓦斯南赛车 (Wathnan Racing) 小马可能会因起步缓慢而损害他的机会，但如果比赛进行得适合他，这将是他在第 3 组中取得成功的绝佳机会。

paras.en: Any flaws could be exposed by Godolphin's Hidden Force, who has undergone wind surgery since finishing a beaten favourite in the Craven back in the spring but could be anything, while Marco Botti's Prince Of India must go well after his win in Listed company at Newmarket.
paras.zh: 戈多芬的“隐藏力量”可能会暴露出任何缺陷，自从春季在克雷文赛上击败热门选手以来，他已经接受了风力手术，但可能是任何东西，而马可·博蒂的印度王子在纽马克特上市公司获胜后必须走得很好。

paras.en: Hollie Doyle was speaking to Sky Sports Racing's Simon Mapletoft.
paras.zh: 霍莉·多伊尔正在接受天空体育赛车队的西蒙·梅普莱托夫特的采访。

paras.en: Watch every race from Autumn Racing Weekend at Ascot live on Sky Sports Racing on Friday and Saturday
paras.zh: 周五和周六，观看天空体育赛车直播阿斯科特秋季赛马周末的每场比赛

articles.title: Jordan handles Piers Morgan 'sledging' to move into contention

paras.en: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship: Matthew Jordan moves into contention with Casey Jarvis leading by one
paras.zh: 阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛：马修乔丹进入争夺，凯西贾维斯领先一杆

paras.en: Matthew Jordan survives 'sledging' from outspoken television presenter Piers Morgan to move into contention at Alfred Dunhill Links; South African Casey Jarvis leads by one on 11 under after a 67 at Kingsbarns
paras.zh: 马修·乔丹 (Matthew Jordan) 从直言不讳的电视节目主持人皮尔斯·摩根 (Piers Morgan) 的“雪橇”中幸存下来，进入阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯 (Alfred Dunhill Links) 的竞争；南非选手凯西·贾维斯 (Casey Jarvis) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 67 杆后，以低于标准杆 11 杆的成绩领先一杆

paras.en: Matthew Jordan shot a seven-under 65 to move into contention at the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship despite having to put up with Piers Morgan's verbal jousting.
paras.zh: 马修·乔丹 (Matthew Jordan) 打出 65 杆，低于标准杆 7 杆，尽管不得不忍受皮尔斯·摩根 (Piers Morgan) 的口角，但他还是进入了阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛 (Alfred Dunhill Links Champions) 的争夺行列。

paras.en: The Royal Liverpool member is looking for his first DP World Tour win in his 183rd tournament and he shrugged off the good-natured criticism from the television presenter - his amateur playing partner for the team part of the event - to card six birdies and an eagle at Carnoustie.
paras.zh: 这位皇家利物浦成员正在寻求他的第 183 场比赛中的首个 DP 世界巡回赛胜利，他对电视节目主持人（他在赛事团队部分的业余比赛搭档）的善意批评不屑一顾，在卡诺斯蒂打出了 6 只小鸟和 1 只老鹰。

paras.en: His one mishap was a bogey at the ninth, his final hole, but he got to 10 under and into a four-way tie for second place.
paras.zh: 他的一次失误是在第九洞（最后一个洞）吞下柏忌，但他打出低于标准杆 10 杆的成绩，并以四人并列第二名的成绩。

paras.en: - Alfred Dunhill Links Championship [External Leaderboard]
paras.zh: - Alfred Dunhill Links 锦标赛 [外部排行榜]

paras.en: - DP World Tour: Latest headlines, reports, highlights
paras.zh: - DP 世界巡演：最新头条、报道、亮点

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "Yeah, with Piers, the amount of sledging that goes on towards me is incredible," said Jordan.
paras.zh: “是的，和皮尔斯一起，向我发起的雪橇数量令人难以置信，”乔丹说。

paras.en: "We are supposed to be a team but honestly it's all about him and that's how he makes it.
paras.zh: “我们应该是一个团队，但老实说，一切都与他有关，这就是他的成功方式。

paras.en: "I think Peter Jones (star of Dragons Den) missed a two-foot putt on 15 and he (Morgan) comes up to me - because I hit it to two foot as well - and he says: 'Don't do a Jonesy'.
paras.zh: “我认为彼得·琼斯（《龙穴》明星）在 15 号洞错过了一个两英尺的推杆，他（摩根）走到我身边 - 因为我也将球打到了两英尺 - 他说：‘不要做琼斯’。

paras.en: "So that kind of puts the heebie-jeebies in you over that small putt. He just cuts at me like that and every time I seem to do something good, it's him taking the limelight."
paras.zh: “所以这会让你在那个小推杆上感到惊慌。他就这样切入我，每次我似乎做了一些好事，都是他成为了众人瞩目的焦点。”

paras.en: South African Casey Jarvis leads by one on 11 under after a 67 at Kingsbarns but the round of the delay belonged to Spaniard Rocco Repetto Taylor who had an eight-under 64 at Kingsbarns, the second of three courses being used for the first three rounds with St Andrews also hosting on the final day.
paras.zh: 南非选手凯西·贾维斯 (Casey Jarvis) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 67 杆后，以低于标准杆 11 杆领先一杆，但推迟的一轮属于西班牙选手罗科·雷佩托·泰勒 (Rocco Repetto Taylor)，他在 Kingsbarns 打出 64 杆，低于标准杆 8 杆，这是前三轮比赛使用的三个球场中的第二个，圣安德鲁斯也在最后一天主办。

paras.en: The 23-year-old had four birdies and an eagle in his final nine holes to sit 10 under alongside Jordan and South African MJ Daffue.
paras.zh: 这位 23 岁的球员在最后九洞抓到 4 只小鸟和 1 只老鹰，与乔丹和南非人 MJ Daffue 并列低于标准杆 10 杆。

paras.en: Defending champion Bob MacIntyre is at eight under after a 65 at Kingsbarns, where Brooks Koepka shot a 67 to sit level with the Scot.
paras.zh: 卫冕冠军鲍勃·麦金泰尔在 Kingsbarns 打出 65 杆，低于标准杆 8 杆，布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 打出 67 杆，与苏格兰人并列。

paras.en: Tommy Fleetwood is at six under after a four-under 68 at Kingsbarns, as is Ryder Cup team-mate Matt Fitzpatrick with a 70 at the same course.
paras.zh: 汤米·弗利特伍德 (Tommy Fleetwood) 在 Kingsbarns 打出低于标准杆 4 杆的 68 杆，目前成绩为低于标准杆 6 杆，莱德杯队友马特·菲茨帕特里克 (Matt Fitzpatrick) 在同一球场打出 70 杆。

paras.en: In their first DP World Tour appearances in nearly four years, Lee Westwood got to four under after a 69 at Kingsbarns but fellow LIV golfer Ian Poulter went out in 41 at Carnoustie on his way to 76 which left him four over.
paras.zh: 近四年来首次参加 DP 世界巡回赛，李·维斯特伍德 (Lee Westwood) 在 Kingsbarns 打出 69 杆，打出低于标准杆 4 杆的成绩，但 LIV 高尔夫球手伊恩·保尔特 (Ian Poulter) 在卡洛斯蒂 (Carnoustie) 打出 41 杆，最终打出 76 杆，低于标准杆 4 杆。

paras.en: Watch the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship played over the Old Course at St Andrews, Carnoustie Golf Links and Kingsbarn Golf Links on Sky Sports Golf this Friday from midday.
paras.zh: 本周五中午起，您可以在天空体育高尔夫频道观看在圣安德鲁斯老球场、卡洛斯蒂高尔夫球场和 Kingsbarn 高尔夫球场举行的阿尔弗雷德登喜路林克斯锦标赛。

paras.en: Get the best prices and book a round at one of 1,700 courses across the UK & Ireland
paras.zh: 获取最优惠的价格并在英国和爱尔兰的 1,700 个球场中选择一轮进行预订

articles.title: Is Littler heading to Minehead? World No 1 to headline World Youth Championships

paras.en: Luke Littler: World No 1 to headline World Youth Championships with chance to reach final at Minehead
paras.zh: 卢克·利特勒：世界排名第一的世界青年锦标赛有机会进入迈恩黑德决赛

paras.en: Luke Littler will compete at the 2026 World Youth Championships but reigning champ Gian van Veen will not attend in the final year he is eligible; you can watch the conclusion of the World Grand Prix Darts live on Sky Sports this weekend
paras.zh: 卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 将参加 2026 年世界青年锦标赛，但卫冕冠军吉安·范·维恩 (Gian van Veen) 将不会参加他有资格参加的最后一年；您可以在本周末通过天空体育直播观看世界飞镖大奖赛的结束

paras.en: World No 1 and former champion Luke Littler will headline the list of Tour Card Holders and International Qualifiers competing in Monday's Winmau World Youth Championship.
paras.zh: 世界排名第一的前冠军卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 将成为周一举行的 Winmau 世界青年锦标赛的巡回赛卡持有者和国际预选赛选手名单中的头号人物。

paras.en: The full 128-player field for this year's showpiece will be finalised following the conclusion of the Development Tour season this weekend, with Events 21-24 taking place in Wigan on October 3-4.
paras.zh: 今年的 128 名参赛选手将在本周末的发展巡回赛赛季结束后最终确定，第 21 至 24 场比赛将于 10 月 3 日至 4 日在维冈举行。

paras.en: The 2026 World Youth Championship will see the round-robin phase and the knockout phase from the last 64 down to the semi-finals staged on Monday October 5 at the Robin Park Leisure Centre.
paras.zh: 2026 年世界青年锦标赛将于 10 月 5 日星期一在罗宾公园休闲中心举行，包括循环赛阶段和 64 强淘汰赛直至半决赛。

paras.en: - Darts in 2026: Key dates, calendar, results 📅
paras.zh: - 2026 年飞镖：关键日期、日历、结果 📅

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch on the Sky Sports app 📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在天空体育应用程序上观看📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get instant access with NOW 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？现在就立即访问📺

paras.en: Littler, who withdrew from Players Championship 29 and 30 after his defeat at the World Series Finals in Amsterdam effectively ended his chances of qualifying for the finals in Minehead in November, but he could still play at the venue.
paras.zh: 利特勒在阿姆斯特丹举行的世界系列赛决赛中失利后，退出了球员锦标赛第 29 和第 30 场比赛，这实际上结束了他进入 11 月份在迈恩黑德举行的决赛的机会，但他仍然可以在该场地比赛。

paras.en: The final will be held on Sunday November 29 at Butlin's Minehead Resort during the Ladbrokes Players Championship Finals, with a boosted top prize of £15,000 also on offer.
paras.zh: 决赛将于 11 月 29 日星期日在立博球员锦标赛决赛期间在布特林的迈恩黑德度假村举行，最高奖金为 15,000 英镑。

paras.en: The 128-player line-up will include all age-qualified PDC Tour Card Holders who have accepted the invitation to compete and 26 international representatives, with the remaining places set to be filled from the final Development Tour Rankings.
paras.zh: 128名选手阵容将包括所有接受参赛邀请、符合年龄要求的PDC巡回赛卡持有者以及26名国际代表，其余名额将从最终的发展巡回赛排名中填补。

paras.en: The group stage sees the players split into 32 groups of four, with one seed per group for the round-robin action - with seedings based on the PDC Werner Rankings Ladder and then the Development Tour Rankings.
paras.zh: 小组赛阶段，选手们被分成 32 个小组，每组四人，每组一名种子选手进行循环赛——种子选手的排名基于 PDC 维尔纳排名天梯，然后是发展巡回赛排名。

paras.en: The top two players in each group will subsequently progress to the knockout stages, which begin from the last 64 onwards.
paras.zh: 每组前两名选手将随后进入淘汰赛阶段，淘汰赛从 64 强开始。

paras.en: World Champion Littler - who lifted the World Youth Championship in 2023 - will be the top seed given his status as world No 1, ahead of Poland's Sebastian Bialecki and Ireland's Keane Barry.
paras.zh: 世界冠军利特勒在 2023 年举起了世青赛冠军，鉴于他的世界排名第一，他将成为头号种子，领先于波兰的塞巴斯蒂安·比亚莱茨基和爱尔兰的基恩·巴里。

paras.en: Jurjen van der Velde - the 2024 runner-up - will also return alongside the likes of Cam Crabtree, Charlie Manby, Owen Bates and Czechia's Adam Gawlas.
paras.zh: 2024 年亚军 Jurjen van der Velde 也将与 Cam Crabtree、Charlie Manby、Owen Bates 和捷克选手 Adam Gawlas 等人一起回归。

paras.en: The field also includes 16-year-old Lewis Cook from the JDC circuit - along with fellow stars Kaya Baysal, Archie Self and Ben Townley who have stepped up to the Development Tour this year - with Eleanor Cairns and Kyana Frauenfelder featuring from the PDC Women's Series rankings.
paras.zh: 参赛名单中还包括来自 JDC 巡回赛的 16 岁选手刘易斯·库克 (Lewis Cook)，以及今年参加发展巡回赛的同为明星的卡亚·贝萨尔 (Kaya Baysal)、阿奇·塞尔夫 (Archie Self) 和本·汤利 (Ben Townley)，以及来自 PDC 女子系列赛排名的埃莉诺·凯恩斯 (Eleanor Cairns) 和基亚娜·弗劳恩菲尔德 (Kyana Frauenfelder)。

paras.en: Reigning two-time champion Gian van Veen will not return to defend his title while Beau Greaves - runner-up to Van Veen 12 months ago - and Yorick Hofkens have also chosen not to compete in Monday's event.
paras.zh: 两届卫冕冠军吉安·范维恩将不会重返卫冕，而 12 个月前范维恩亚军博·格里夫斯和约里克·霍夫肯斯也选择不参加周一的比赛。

paras.en: The Winmau World Youth Championship will begin from 11.30am on Monday at the Robin Park Leisure Centre, with group games being played over the best of nine legs.
paras.zh: Winmau 世界青年锦标赛将于周一上午 11 点 30 分在罗宾公园休闲中心开始，小组赛将采用九回合三胜制进行。

paras.en: The top two players from each group will then advance to the last 64, which will be contested in a knockout format over the best of 11 legs.
paras.zh: 每组前两名选手将晋级 64 强赛，并以 11 回合两胜制的淘汰赛形式进行角逐。

paras.en: Monday October 5, Robin Park Leisure Centre
paras.zh: 10 月 5 日星期一，罗宾公园休闲中心

articles.title: Screaming, panicking, blood: Passengers detail horrifying Israel-bound flight
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: TEL AVIV — A stabbing, an emergency alert, a terrifying midair plunge.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——刺伤事件、紧急警报、可怕的半空中坠落事件。

paras.en: Details are still emerging after an Israel-bound flight carrying 180 people emitted a distress signal Wednesday, raising fears of a possible hijacking when one pilot stabbed the other in the cockpit.
paras.zh: 周三，一架载有 180 人的飞往以色列的航班发出求救信号，一名飞行员在驾驶舱内刺伤另一名飞行员，引发了人们对可能发生劫机事件的担忧。

paras.en: Aviatar Alevi, who was on the Flydubai flight Wednesday, described people “screaming, running, panicking, blood.”
paras.zh: 周三乘坐迪拜航空航班的阿维塔·阿莱维（Aviatar Alevi）描述说，人们“尖叫、奔跑、惊慌、流血”。

paras.en: “At the start, I thought it was a plane malfunction, but then I started hearing screaming about the stabbings,” Alevi, 17, told NBC News. “Then I understood the weight of the actual situation.”
paras.zh: “一开始，我以为这是飞机故障，但后来我开始听到有关刺伤事件的尖叫声，”17 岁的阿莱维告诉 NBC 新闻。 “然后我就明白了实际情况的重要性。”

paras.en: “We didn’t know what was going to happen,” he said, adding that the possibility of death “was definitely an option.”
paras.zh: “我们不知道会发生什么，”他说，并补充说死亡的可能性“绝对是一种选择”。

paras.en: The plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, one of its rudders damaged, apparently by the force of its descent.
paras.zh: 这架飞机在沙特阿拉伯紧急降落，其中一个方向舵显然是由于下降的力量而损坏。

paras.en: The passengers, who had been flying from Dubai, were mobbed by media and flag-waving fellow Israelis after they finally arrived at Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 这些从迪拜起飞的乘客最终抵达特拉维夫附近的本古里安机场后，被媒体和挥舞旗帜的以色列同胞包围。

paras.en: They said they feared for their lives after the plane plunged more than 14,000 feet in 29 seconds at one point, according to FlightRadar24.
paras.zh: 据 FlightRadar24 报道，他们表示，飞机在 29 秒内一度坠落超过 14,000 英尺的高度后，他们担心自己的生命安全。

paras.en: “Imagine sitting on the plane, all scared after you fell down five kilometers. You don’t understand anything,” 16-year-old Peleg Itali told NBC News.
paras.zh: 16 岁的 Peleg Itali 告诉 NBC 新闻：“想象一下，坐在飞机上，从 5 公里处坠落后，你感到非常害怕。你什么都听不懂。”

paras.en: Capt. Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, was recovering in a hospital in Saudi Arabia on Thursday as the other pilot, so far identified only as an Omani citizen, was being interrogated elsewhere in the country. Machchhar was widely praised for his efforts to prevent the plane from crashing, opening the cockpit door and allowing passengers and crewmembers to rush in.
paras.zh: 印度国民斯密特·马赫恰尔上尉周四在沙特阿拉伯的一家医院康复，另一名飞行员（迄今为止仅确认为阿曼公民）正在该国其他地方接受审讯。马恰哈尔为防止飞机坠毁、打开驾驶舱门并允许乘客和机组人员冲入而做出的努力受到广泛赞扬。

paras.en: Machchhar and the pilot who initiated the attack were transferred to Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, on Thursday, the Saudi Arabian Interior Ministry said in a statement, citing an unnamed “official source” at the ministry.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯内政部在一份声明中援引该部未透露姓名的“官方消息人士”的话说，马赫恰尔和发起袭击的飞行员于周四被转移到阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比。

paras.en: “The source indicated that initial investigations conducted by the competent authorities in the Kingdom, with the participation of a security team from the sisterly United Arab Emirates, revealed an assault on the pilot by his co-pilot, resulting in both sustaining various injuries,” the ministry said. “The source confirmed that the pilot and his co-pilot, after their health improved and the medical team cleared them, departed the Kingdom for Abu Dhabi this morning.”
paras.zh: 内政部表示：“消息人士表示，在来自姐妹国家阿拉伯联合酋长国的安全小组的参与下，王国主管当局进行的初步调查显示，飞行员的副驾驶袭击了飞行员，造成两人不同程度受伤。” “消息人士证实，飞行员和副驾驶的健康状况有所改善并得到医疗团队的许可后，于今天早上离开沙特前往阿布扎比。”

paras.en: Few details had emerged about the pilot Thursday morning. Questions about a possible motive, including whether it was terrorism-related, hang over the attack.
paras.zh: 周四上午，有关该飞行员的细节几乎没有透露。关于可能动机的问题，包括是否与恐怖主义有关，仍然悬而未决。

paras.en: “I don’t think it was a hijacking. It looks like a suicide attempt, simply because of what this hero, Yaniv, has described,” Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on “CBS Evening News” as he praised Yaniv Hayun, who rushed into the cockpit and subdued the attacker.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在《哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻》节目中称赞冲进驾驶舱制服袭击者的亚尼夫·哈云，“我不认为这是一起劫机事件。这看起来像是一次自杀未遂，只是因为这位英雄亚尼夫所描述的事情。”

paras.en: Hayun, who was pictured with his shirt spattered with blood sitting next to Netanyahu, said he confronted the pilot who initiated the attack, according to the Israeli government press office.
paras.zh: 据以色列政府新闻办公室称，哈云坐在内塔尼亚胡旁边，衬衫沾满血迹，他说他与发起袭击的飞行员对峙。

paras.en: “I grabbed the attacker and choked him, pulled him out first,” Hayun said. “I started pulling the controls.”
paras.zh: “我抓住袭击者并掐住他的脖子，然后把他拉了出来，”海云说。 “我开始拉动控制装置。”

paras.en: “Thank God, we pulled it off. We really put our heads together and worked as a team,” Hayun said, adding: “It was between fear and a sense of a do-or-die situation.”
paras.zh: “感谢上帝，我们成功了。我们真的齐心协力，作为一个团队工作，”海云说，并补充道：“这是在恐惧和生死攸关的感觉之间进行的。”

paras.en: “We had to win. We had to pull through and come out on top,” he said. Hayun told Netanyahu that he acted based on what he had seen on a TV show and helped stabilize the plane.
paras.zh: “我们必须获胜。我们必须渡过难关并取得胜利，”他说。海云告诉内塔尼亚胡，他根据电视节目中看到的情况采取行动，帮助稳定了飞机。

paras.en: Flydubai said on-duty crewmembers on the flight were able to land the plane.
paras.zh: Flydubai 表示，航班上的值班机组人员成功让飞机着陆。

paras.en: Netanyahu said it was still too early to determine why the pilot apparently stabbed his colleague and appeared to try to take over the Flydubai flight and whether Iran was involved.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡表示，现在确定飞行员为何刺伤同事、似乎试图接管迪拜航空航班以及伊朗是否参与其中还为时过早。

paras.en: “We’ve had signs that Iran, in particular through its proxies, was intending to heighten terrorist attacks against Israel and Israeli nationals abroad,” he said. “But I think it’s too early to say whether there was Iranian collusion here.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我们有迹象表明，伊朗，特别是通过其代理人，打算加强对以色列和海外以色列国民的恐怖袭击。” “但我认为现在判断这里是否有伊朗勾结还为时过早。”

paras.en: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz branded the incident a “jihadist terrorist attack attempt,” without expanding on how he had reached that conclusion.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨将该事件称为“圣战恐怖袭击企图”，但没有详细说明他是如何得出这一结论的。

paras.en: President Donald Trump also weighed in, calling it “an incredible story.”
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统也发表了看法，称这是“一个令人难以置信的故事”。

paras.en: “It seems as though the co-pilot was perhaps a terrorist or perhaps a whack job, and he stabbed the pilot,” Trump told reporters.
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“看起来副驾驶可能是一名恐怖分子，或者可能是一名普通人，他刺伤了飞行员。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump told reporters at the White House that the pilot who initiated the attack could be linked to Iran.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普在白宫告诉记者，发起袭击的飞行员可能与伊朗有关。

paras.en: “I would say the answer, based on what I’m hearing, is yes. But we’re working on it right now,” he said.
paras.zh: “根据我所听到的情况，我想说答案是肯定的。但我们现在正在努力解决这个问题，”他说。

paras.en: Asked whether the pilot could have been radicalized or working with Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, Trump replied, “Could have been, yeah.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这名飞行员是否可能变得激进或与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队合作时，特朗普回答说：“可能是的。”

paras.en: Trump also told reporters Thursday that there would be renewed strikes against Iran if it was behind the attack.
paras.zh: 特朗普周四还对记者表示，如果伊朗是此次袭击的幕后黑手，将会对伊朗发动新一轮打击。

paras.en: “Oh, they’ll be hit very hard, don’t worry,” he said.
paras.zh: “哦，他们会受到很大的打击，别担心，”他说。

paras.en: “You just ask them,” he added. “They know what happened. They’ll be hit very hard.”
paras.zh: “你只要问他们就行了，”他补充道。 “他们知道发生了什么。他们会受到非常沉重的打击。”

paras.en: All the passengers were Israeli, according to Netanyahu’s office. Four were dual American-Israeli citizens, two U.S. officials told NBC News.
paras.zh: 据内塔尼亚胡办公室称，所有乘客都是以色列人。两名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻，其中四人是美国和以色列双重公民。

paras.en: With few details about the suspect or any potential motive surrounding the incident, Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for Netanyahu’s office, said there was a “strong opinion” that the incident was a terrorist attack, “but we can’t be sure until we debrief everybody.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼(Doron Spielman)对嫌疑人或事件潜在动机的细节知之甚少，他表示，“强烈认为”该事件是一起恐怖袭击，“但在我们向所有人通报情况之前，我们无法确定。”

paras.en: An investigation by Saudi authorities is ongoing, David Mencer, a spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office, said separately.
paras.zh: 以色列总理办公室发言人戴维·门瑟(David Mencer)单独表示，沙特当局的调查正在进行中。

paras.en: A senior U.S. official and a Saudi official who were both briefed on the Israeli investigation said the stabbing increasingly looked like an act of terrorism based on early findings.
paras.zh: 听取了以色列调查情况简报的一名美国高级官员和一名沙特官员表示，根据早期调查结果，刺伤事件越来越像是恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates’ attorney general, Hamad Saif Al Shamsi, separately ordered an investigation.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西单独下令进行调查。

paras.en: His office said the probe would seek to “gather information and evidence, establish the facts and circumstances of the incident, and determine the underlying motives,” in addition to examining “whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose, or involved any prior planning or direction.”
paras.zh: 他的办公室表示，调查将寻求“收集信息和证据，确定事件的事实和情况，并确定潜在动机”，此外还会审查“该事件是否与任何恐怖活动或目的有关，或涉及任何先前的计划或指示”。

paras.en: Hessa Alyahya, spokesperson for the Saudi Embassy in the U.S., said authorities were waiting to determine whether the attack was a dispute between the pilots or whether it was an act sponsored by Iran or the Houthis.
paras.zh: 沙特驻美国大使馆发言人赫萨·阿利亚亚 (Hessa Alyahya) 表示，当局正在等待确定此次袭击是否是飞行员之间的纠纷，还是伊朗或胡塞武装发起的行动。

paras.en: Israel and Saudi Arabia do not have official diplomatic relations.
paras.zh: 以色列和沙特阿拉伯没有正式外交关系。

articles.title: What we know about the pilot hailed as a hero for averting crash of Israel-bound plane
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: He is being hailed around the world as a hero for helping stop a passenger plane bound for Israel from plunging into the ground, despite his own severe injuries.
paras.zh: 尽管他自己受了重伤，但他仍帮助阻止一架飞往以色列的客机坠入地面，因此在全世界被誉为英雄。

paras.en: Images of Capt. Smit Machchhar covered in blood have gone viral after he fought his fellow pilot, who, according to Israeli officials, stabbed him and attempted to nosedive the plane carrying 174 people from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 斯密特·马赫恰尔机长浑身是血的照片在网上疯传，他与自己的飞行员同伴发生冲突，据以色列官员称，后者刺伤了他，并试图使这架载有 174 人的飞机从迪拜飞往特拉维夫。

paras.en: While bleeding profusely, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door, allowing other passengers and the Emirati crew to overpower the other pilot and take control of the aircraft. The flight was diverted to an airport in Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely.
paras.zh: 在流血过多的情况下，马赫恰尔设法打开了驾驶舱门，让其他乘客和阿联酋机组人员制服了另一名飞行员并控制了飞机。该航班被转移到沙特阿拉伯的一个机场，并在那里安全着陆。

paras.en: The Mumbai native’s actions have “shown the world the highest form of courage” and “prevented another 9/11-like attack from happening,” Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Thursday, after speaking with Machchhar’s family. “The whole world is proud of him,” he added.
paras.zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周四在与马赫恰尔的家人交谈后表示，这位孟买人的行动“向世界展示了最高形式的勇气”，并“阻止了另一场类似 9/11 的袭击发生”。 “全世界都为他感到骄傲，”他补充道。

paras.en: Machchhar spoke previously of getting the “aviation bug” at 19 while pursuing a management course to grow his family’s textile business.
paras.zh: Macchhar 此前曾表示，19 岁时，他在修读管理课程以发展家族纺织业务时迷上了“航空”。

paras.en: He worked for years at a low-cost Indian airline before joining Flydubai and had nearly 10,000 hours of flying experience before Wednesday’s incident.
paras.zh: 在加入 Flydubai 之前，他在一家低成本印度航空公司工作了多年，在周三的事件发生之前，他已经拥有近 10,000 小时的飞行经验。

paras.en: Machchhar is being treated in a hospital in Tabuk city in northwest Saudi Arabia, with his condition described as “stable” on Wednesday by the Indian Embassy in Riyadh. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Fox News he was “very badly wounded.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔正在沙特阿拉伯西北部塔布克市的一家医院接受治疗，印度驻利雅得大使馆周三称他的病情“稳定”。以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡告诉福克斯新闻，他“受了重伤”。

paras.en: Deepak Mittal, India’s ambassador to the United Arab Emirates, said on X he met with Machchhar’s family on Thursday in Dubai and “conveyed full support of the Government of India in ensuring welfare and wellbeing of the Indian Hero.”
paras.zh: 印度驻阿拉伯联合酋长国大使迪帕克·米塔尔 (Deepak Mittal) 10 日表示，他周四在迪拜会见了马恰哈尔的家人，并“转达了印度政府在确保印度英雄的福利和福祉方面的全力支持”。

paras.en: Netanyahu called Machchhar “a true hero.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡称马赫恰尔是“真正的英雄”。

paras.en: “Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker — preventing a catastrophic midair disaster,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“尽管被刺伤并受重伤，但他进行了反击、抵抗，打开了驾驶舱门，使乘客和机组人员制服了袭击者，从而避免了一场灾难性的空中灾难。”

paras.en: Machchhar’s former employer, the Indian budget carrier SpiceJet, said on X that he flew for the airline for 10 years. According to his LinkedIn profile, Machchhar joined the Emirati low-cost carrier Flydubai in 2022 after flying for SpiceJet since 2011.
paras.zh: Macchhar 的前雇主印度廉价航空公司 SpiceJet 在 X 上表示，他在该航空公司工作了 10 年。根据他的 LinkedIn 个人资料，Machchhar 自 2011 年以来一直乘坐香料航空 (SpiceJet) 航班，并于 2022 年加入阿联酋廉价航空公司 Flydubai。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the veteran captain was flying a Boeing 737 Max 8, the newer variant of the 737 plane that Machchhar had nearly 10,000 hours of experience flying, according to his profile and a YouTube podcast interview he gave last year.
paras.zh: 周三，这位经验丰富的机长驾驶着一架波音 737 Max 8，根据他的个人资料和他去年接受的 YouTube 播客采访，马赫恰尔拥有近 10,000 小时的飞行经验，这是 737 飞机的更新型。

paras.en: “My first aircraft was a Boeing, and it’s always been that aircraft all my life,” he said.
paras.zh: “我的第一架飞机是波音，我一生都是这架飞机，”他说。

paras.en: Machchhar said he had flown challenging routes, dodged bad weather and handled medical emergencies in the air before.
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说，他以前曾飞过具有挑战性的航线、躲避恶劣天气并处理过空中医疗紧急情况。

paras.en: His mother was “scared” when he first told her of his plan to become a pilot, he said in the 2025 interview, but his supportive father agreed to cover the steep fees for aviation training.
paras.zh: 他在 2025 年接受采访时表示，当他第一次告诉母亲自己成为一名飞行员的计划时，他的母亲感到“害怕”，但支持他的父亲同意支付高昂的航空培训费用。

paras.en: Between 2008 and 2009, Machchhar trained for 18 months at an aviation college in New Zealand. It was the first time he had been outside India, he said, and he had been on only a “couple of flights” as a passenger before learning to fly.
paras.zh: 2008年至2009年间，马赫恰尔在新西兰的一所航空学院接受了18个月的培训。他说，这是他第一次离开印度，在学习飞行之前，他只作为乘客乘坐过“几次航班”。

paras.en: He “stood out” among those training and did well with his studies, Mainland Air chief executive Philip Kean told New Zealand’s 1News, adding: “We’re all very proud of him here.”
paras.zh: 大陆航空首席执行官菲利普·基恩 (Philip Kean) 告诉新西兰 1News，他在这些培训中“脱颖而出”，学习成绩也很好，并补充道：“我们都为他感到骄傲。”

paras.en: In his early days as a qualified pilot, he took whatever flight routes he was assigned.
paras.zh: 在他作为一名合格飞行员的早期，他按照指定的航线飞行。

paras.en: “When I started flying ... the only thing I wanted to do then was fly,” Machchhar told the podcast. “I didn’t want to sleep, I didn’t want to go anywhere, and they loved me for it.”
paras.zh: “当我开始飞行时……我唯一想做的事情就是飞，”马赫恰尔告诉播客。 “我不想睡觉，我不想去任何地方，他们因此而爱我。”

paras.en: “For a pilot to gain that experience and to refine your skills is what a pilot is,” he added.
paras.zh: “飞行员的本质就是获得经验并提高技能，”他补充道。

paras.en: But his attitude changed when he got married and started a family, he said.
paras.zh: 但他说，当他结婚并组建家庭后，他的态度发生了变化。

paras.en: “Now I would say I try when I get out of the cockpit or the aircraft, I don’t want the other guy to know that I’m a pilot. I don’t want to discuss aviation,” he said.
paras.zh: “现在我会说，当我走出驾驶舱或飞机时，我会尝试，我不想让其他人知道我是一名飞行员。我不想讨论航空，”他说。

paras.en: “Now the kids are there,” he said. “They want to play with you.”
paras.zh: “现在孩子们都在那里了，”他说。 “他们想和你一起玩。”

paras.en: In the interview, Machchhar also spoke about the “rigorous training” that pilots and cabin crew undergo, which includes safety and emergency procedures.
paras.zh: 在采访中，马赫恰尔还谈到了飞行员和机组人员接受的“严格培训”，其中包括安全和应急程序。

paras.en: “When we are up there and if something happens, who is going to save you? You’ll be lucky enough to have a doctor on board,” he said.
paras.zh: “当我们在那里时，如果发生什么事情，谁来救你？你会很幸运，船上有医生，”他说。

paras.en: “They can save your life,” he said, referring to the cabin crew.
paras.zh: “他们可以拯救你的生命，”他指的是机组人员。

articles.title: G7 countries to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil reserves
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Member countries in the Group of Seven agreed Friday to release tens of millions of barrels of diesel fuel and crude oil, the latest move by industrial economies around the world to cap soaring gas prices.
paras.zh: 七国集团成员国周五同意释放数千万桶柴油和原油，这是全球工业经济体为遏制天然气价格飙升而采取的最新举措。

paras.en: Following a G7 videoconference hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron, President Donald Trump said, “Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil.”
paras.zh: 在法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙主持的七国集团视频会议后，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，“欧洲刚刚同意释放大量库存的柴油。”

paras.en: “The process will begin immediately,” Trump posted on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “这一过程将立即开始，”特朗普在真相社交网站上发帖称。

paras.en: Gas prices have soared since the United States and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28. But diesel in particular saw a renewed surge this summer after the Russia-Ukraine war escalated in July. Since late February, the average price of U.S. diesel has surged 70% to $6.37 per gallon.
paras.zh: 自 2 月 28 日美国和以色列袭击伊朗以来，天然气价格飙升。但在 7 月俄罗斯-乌克兰战争升级后，今年夏天柴油价格再次飙升。自2月底以来，美国柴油平均价格已飙升70%至每加仑6.37美元。

paras.en: The release will be as much as 100 million barrels over the course of four months, the G7 said in a statement. It noted that there would be a “substantial diesel release within the first 20 days.”
paras.zh: 七国集团在一份声明中表示，四个月内将释放多达 1 亿桶石油。报告指出，“前 20 天内将出现大量柴油排放”。

paras.en: The leaders also said that they would begin coordinating maintenance schedules for oil refineries in their respective countries, “to prevent simultaneous capacity shutdowns and temporarily increase utilization rates where feasible.”
paras.zh: 领导人还表示，他们将开始协调各自国家炼油厂的维护计划，“以防止产能同时关闭，并在可行的情况下暂时提高利用率”。

paras.en: Many American and European refiners are already operating at maximum capacity levels.
paras.zh: 许多美国和欧洲炼油厂已经以最大产能水平运营。

paras.en: “Our citizens’ concerns about energy prices remain a top priority,” the group said.
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“我们公民对能源价格的担忧仍然是首要任务。”

paras.en: Oil analyst Andy Lipow said the release could help smooth over recent supply disruptions.
paras.zh: 石油分析师安迪·利波(Andy Lipow)表示，此次释放可能有助于缓解最近的供应中断。

paras.en: “A release of 100 million barrels of diesel fuel over four months would essentially replace Russian exports which have been banned as Ukrainian drone strikes have severely reduced Russian refining capacity,” said Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates.
paras.zh: Lipow Oil Associates 总裁 Lipow 表示：“四个月内释放 1 亿桶柴油将基本上取代因乌克兰无人机袭击严重削弱俄罗斯炼油能力而被禁止的俄罗斯出口。”

paras.en: At the gas pump, he said, “A release of this magnitude could temporarily reduce diesel prices by 25 cents per gallon but does little to increase refinery capacity to produce more.”
paras.zh: 他在加油站表示，“如此大规模的排放可能会暂时使每加仑柴油价格降低 25 美分，但对提高炼油厂生产更多产能的作用微乎其微。”

paras.en: In March, countries that are members of the International Energy Agency approved a release of 400 million barrels of crude oil. That helped to partially ease the energy supply crunch for a time, but prices continued to rise.
paras.zh: 3月份，国际能源署成员国批准释放4亿桶原油。这在一定程度上缓解了能源供应紧张的局面，但价格仍在继续上涨。

paras.en: As of Friday, prices still remain sharply elevated since the Iran war began. Brent crude oil, which was down 3% in anticipation of the news, still hovered above $100 per barrel. Since the start of the year, Brent prices are up more than 60% still.
paras.zh: 截至周五，自伊朗战争开始以来，价格仍然大幅上涨。受此消息影响，布伦特原油下跌 3%，但仍徘徊在每桶 100 美元上方。自今年年初以来，布伦特原油价格仍上涨了 60% 以上。

paras.en: The agreement between G7 countries also comes after a weeklong pressure campaign by the Trump administration on its European allies, particularly Germany and France, which hold a large share of the European Union’s diesel reserves.
paras.zh: 七国集团国家之间达成的协议也是在特朗普政府对其欧洲盟友，特别是德国和法国进行了为期一周的压力之后达成的，这两个国家在欧盟柴油储备中占有很大份额。

paras.en: “American farmers, truckers, and businesses should not be left carrying the burden of a global diesel shortage” alone, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wrote on X late Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周四晚间写道，“美国农民、卡车司机和企业不应独自承受全球柴油短缺的负担”。

paras.en: With just weeks to go until the Nov. 3 midterm elections, Republicans are facing a wall of poor polling numbers on the economy.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日中期选举仅剩几周时间，共和党人面临着糟糕的经济民调数据。

paras.en: Just 41% of registered voters approve of Trump’s handling of the U.S. economy, according to the most recent NBC News polling, while 56% disapprove.
paras.zh: 根据 NBC News 的最新民意调查，只有 41% 的登记选民认可特朗普对美国经济的处理方式，而 56% 的人不认可。

paras.en: Meanwhile, economists say Trump’s policies are fueling inflation, roiling financial markets and upending global trade.
paras.zh: 与此同时，经济学家表示，特朗普的政策正在加剧通货膨胀，扰乱金融市场并颠覆全球贸易。

paras.en: Against this backdrop, the president and his party were eager for a development like Friday’s G-7 agreement to help show the public they could make progress on a central election issue: Sky-high gas prices.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，总统和他的政党渴望出现像周五七国集团协议这样的进展，以帮助向公众表明他们可以在一个核心选​​举问题上取得进展：天价高油价。

paras.en: But at the same time as Trump is hailing the release of oil and diesel reserves, he has also been openly considering a U.S. diesel export ban.
paras.zh: 但在特朗普欢呼释放石油和柴油储备的同时，他也一直在公开考虑实施美国柴油出口禁令。

paras.en: This would hit E.U. countries, as well as the United Kingdom, particularly hard.
paras.zh: 这将打击欧盟。国家，以及英国，尤其困难。

paras.en: Earlier Friday, the E.U. said it “fully rejects any ban on diesel.”
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，欧盟表示“完全拒绝任何柴油禁令”。

paras.en: “A ban would not be beneficial to anyone,” a European Commission spokeswoman told reporters in a briefing.
paras.zh: “禁令对任何人都没有好处，”欧盟委员会发言人在简报中告诉记者。

paras.en: Following the G7 leaders’ announcement, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said they“welcome the decision of G7 countries not to impose any export bans on allies and the continued solidarity between partners.”
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人宣布这一消息后，欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，他们“欢迎七国集团国家不对盟友实施任何出口禁令的决定以及伙伴之间的持续团结”。

articles.title: Detailed plan led to murder of Hong Kong model Abby Choi, court hears

paras.en: Detailed plan led to murder of Hong Kong model and influencer Abby Choi, court hears
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，详细计划导致香港模特兼影响力人物蔡美儿被谋杀

paras.en: The ex-husband and in-laws of Hong Kong influencer Abby Choi have appeared in court on trial for the 28-year-old's murder.
paras.zh: 香港网红蔡碧儿 (Abby Choi) 的前夫和姻亲因谋杀 28 岁的崔碧碧 (Abby Choi) 案出庭受审。

paras.en: Police discovered parts of the model's dismembered body at a suburban property in Hong Kong in February 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 2 月，警方在香港郊区的一处房产中发现了该模特被肢解的部分尸体。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege Ms Choi's ex-husband Alex Kwong, his father Kwong Kau, and brother Anthony Kwong bought equipment to dispose of her body.
paras.zh: 检方指控蔡女士的前夫邝志强、他的父亲邝九和弟弟邝国健购买了处理她尸体的设备。

articles.title: Nepal plans to drain four glacial lakes after flooding disaster

paras.en: Nepal plans to drain four glacial lakes perched high in the mountains to reduce flood risks.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔计划排干高山上的四个冰川湖，以减少洪水风险。

paras.en: Rescuers are still searching for more than 5,000 people missing in the border region with China after August's glacier collapse.
paras.zh: 8月冰川崩塌后，救援人员仍在中美边境地区搜寻失踪的5000多人。

paras.en: The process of draining water "through gated structures" will start after a detailed study, and could take up to six years to complete.
paras.zh: “通过门控结构”排水的过程将在详细研究后开始，可能需要长达六年的时间才能完成。

paras.en: Nepal will kick off a high-stakes effort to drain four glacial lakes perched high in the mountains, as it scrambles to reduce flood risks, officials said, after a recent disaster that killed more than 1,400.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，在最近发生的一场导致 1,400 多人死亡的灾难之后，尼泊尔将启动一项高风险的工作，排干高山上的四个冰川湖，以减少洪水风险。

paras.en: "Our aim is to lower the risk of the lakes breaching their natural dams and reduce the risk of downstream floods," said Subash Tuladhar, an expert with a government research centre tasked with overseeing the new project.
paras.zh: “我们的目标是降低湖泊冲破天然水坝的风险，并减少下游洪水的风险，”负责监督新项目的政府研究中心专家苏巴什·图拉达尔 (Subash Tuladhar) 说。

paras.en: Canals will drain water into nearby rivers in a regulated way, he said, adding that workers faced health risks as a result of the lengthy periods of high-altitude work required, in addition to the dangers of sudden flooding.
paras.zh: 他说，运河将以规范的方式将水排入附近的河流。他补充说，由于需要长时间的高空作业，除了突然发生洪水的危险外，工人们还面临着健康风险。

paras.en: Design work and detailed studies targeting the central and eastern lakes of Thulagi, Lower Barun, Lumding Tsho and Hongu II, will begin in the fiscal year that runs until mid-July 2027, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，针对 Thulagi、Lower Barun、Lumding Tsho 和 Hongu II 中部和东部湖泊的设计工作和详细研究将于 2027 年 7 月中旬之前的财政年度开始。

paras.en: The lakes, at heights ranging from 4,050m to 5,483m rank among Nepal's most potentially dangerous, the United Nations Development Programme and the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) said in a 2020 report.
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署和国际山地综合发展中心 (ICIMOD) 在 2020 年的一份报告中表示，这些海拔从 4,050m 到 5,483m 的湖泊被列为尼泊尔最具潜在危险的湖泊之一。

paras.en: Nepal had the skills and experience required for the $50-million project to be funded by the Green Climate Fund, the UNDP and the government, added Mr Tuladhar, of Nepal's Centre for Hydrology and Water Resources Research.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔水文和水资源研究中心的图拉达尔先生补充道，尼泊尔拥有绿色气候基金、联合国开发计划署和政府资助的 5000 万美元项目所需的技能和经验。

paras.en: The work of draining "through gated structures" will start after a detailed study, and could take up to six years to complete, said Sanjeeb Baral, the Centre's executive director.
paras.zh: 该中心执行董事桑吉布·巴拉尔表示，“通过门控结构”排水的工作将在详细研究后开始，可能需要六年时间才能完成。

paras.en: It will encompass installation of sensors, a flood forecasting and warning system, and efforts to build downstream resilience and prepare communities for the risks.
paras.zh: 它将包括安装传感器、洪水预报和预警系统，以及建立下游抵御能力和让社区做好应对风险准备的努力。

paras.en: In similar previous efforts, Nepal lowered by 3 m (10 ft) the level of the central Himalayan glacial lake of Tsho Rolpa by in 2000 and that of Imja in the vicinity of Mount Everest, the world's tallest peak, 10 years ago.
paras.zh: 在之前的类似努力中，尼泊尔于 2000 年将喜马拉雅中部措罗尔帕 (Tsho Rolpa) 冰川湖的水位降低了 3 m（10 英尺），并于 10 年前将世界最高峰珠穆朗玛峰附近的伊姆贾 (Imja) 的水位降低了 3 m（10 英尺）。

paras.en: Nepal's disaster served as a warning to the world, Prime Minister Balendra Shah, 36, told the United Nations in an impassioned speech last month that blamed climate change despite his country's negligible emissions.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔36岁的总理巴伦德拉·沙阿上个月在一次慷慨激昂的演讲中对联合国表示，尼泊尔的灾难向世界发出了警告，尽管尼泊尔的排放量微乎其微，但他仍将责任归咎于气候变化。

paras.en: Retreating glaciers, unstable mountain slopes and increasingly unpredictable rivers showed Nepal was paying a heavy price, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，冰川后退、不稳定的山坡和日益不可预测的河流表明尼泊尔正在付出沉重的代价。
