paras.en: Nepal, which has reported about 26 glacial lake outburst flood events in the past four decades, loses more than 300 lives and property worth millions of dollars to extreme climate events annually on average.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔在过去40年中报告了约26起冰川湖溃决洪水事件，平均每年因极端气候事件造成300多人的生命和财产损失，价值数百万美元。

paras.en: The latest floods devastated a dozen hydro-electric plants, roads, bridges, farms and settlements. Cash-strapped Nepal would need billions of dollars for early recovery, officials have said.
paras.zh: 最近的洪水摧毁了十几座水力发电厂、道路、桥梁、农场和定居点。官员们表示，现金短缺的尼泊尔需要数十亿美元才能尽早恢复。

paras.en: Lowering the lakes by three metres would significantly reduce the threat, said Samjwal Ratna Bajracharya, a retired ICIMOD expert on glaciers, glacial lakes and outburst floods.
paras.zh: ICIMOD 冰川、冰川湖和溃决洪水专家退休专家 Samjwal Ratna Bajracharya 表示，将湖泊降低三米将大大减少威胁。

paras.en: "They are growing fast, are high up in the Himalayas and could cause outbursts any time, due to earthquakes, avalanches, climatic conditions and unplanned human-induced activity," he told Reuters.
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社：“它们生长迅速，位于喜马拉雅山高处，由于地震、雪崩、气候条件和计划外的人类活动，随时可能引发爆发。”

paras.en: Immense DNA identification task continues
paras.zh: 艰巨的DNA鉴定任务仍在继续

paras.en: With thousands still missing and recovery crews facing mounting DNA profiles to process, fragmented remains and limited technical capacity experts warn matching bodies to families could take weeks.
paras.zh: 由于仍有数千人失踪，救援人员面临着越来越多的 DNA 图谱需要处理、支离破碎的遗体和有限的技术能力，专家警告说，将尸体与家人匹配可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: Just 112 bodies have been identified and returned to their families. A further 5,285 people are missing in Nepal, including hundreds of foreigners.
paras.zh: 目前仅有 112 具尸体的身份已被确认并归还给其家人。尼泊尔另有 5,285 人失踪，其中包括数百名外国人。

paras.en: In China, the toll is 43 dead and 519 missing, according to state media -- taking the combined toll to nearly 1,500 dead and 5,800 missing.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国已造成 43 人死亡、519 人失踪，合计死亡人数接近 1,500 人、失踪人数 5,800 人。

articles.title: Magnitude-4.8 earthquake strikes in rural Victoria

paras.en: A 4.8-magnitude earthquake has been recorded near the Victorian town of Leongatha.
paras.zh: 维多利亚小镇 Leongatha 附近发生了 4.8 级地震。

paras.en: Geoscience Australia said the quake hit at a shallow depth of 10 kilometres just after 2am, and the epicentre was near the South Gippsland town, which is about 135km south-east of Melbourne.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局表示，凌晨2点刚过，地震发生在深度10公里的浅层地震，震中位于墨尔本东南部约135公里处的南吉普斯兰镇附近。

paras.en: The federal agency's websites cited almost 15,000 felt reports in the area by 3am. There have been no reports of injuries or damage.
paras.zh: 截至凌晨 3 点，联邦机构网站引用了该地区近 15,000 份有感报告。目前还没有人员受伤或损坏的报告。

paras.en: Hadi Ghasemi, a geophysicist with Geoscience Australia, told the ABC it was one of the strongest tremors the region had experienced in the last two decades.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局的地球物理学家哈迪·加塞米 (Hadi Ghasemi) 告诉澳大利亚广播公司 (ABC)，这是该地区过去二十年来经历的最强烈的地震之一。

paras.en: "The shaking was widely felt, close to the epicentre. It was a strong shake but I don't expect any major damage,"
paras.zh: “震中附近广泛感受到震动。震动很强烈，但我预计不会造成重大损失。”

paras.en: Geoscience Australia also confirmed that a 3.1-magnitude aftershock struck, also near Leongatha, just before 3am.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局还证实，凌晨 3 点左右，Leongatha 附近也发生了 3.1 级余震。

articles.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust

paras.en: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust
paras.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情因暴力和不信任导致超过 4,000 人死亡

paras.en: Health workers protest lack of pay; Congolese politician beaten to death over response to outbreak
paras.zh: 卫生工作者抗议缺乏工资；刚果政客因应对疫情被殴打致死

paras.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded more than 4,000 deaths, authorities said, as they struggle to contain the spread of the virus.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已造成 4,000 多人死亡，当局表示，他们正在努力遏制病毒的传播。

paras.en: The latest figures released by the health ministry on Thursday showed that 4,018 people have died, making up nearly half of the 8,300 confirmed cases, in what has become the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.
paras.zh: 卫生部周四公布的最新数据显示，已有4,018人死亡，占8,300例确诊病例的近一半，这已成为历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: Congo announced an outbreak on May 15, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which has no known treatment or vaccine.
paras.zh: 刚果于 5 月 15 日宣布爆发疫情，由罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起，目前尚无已知的治疗方法或疫苗。

paras.en: Some health workers gathered in Bunia, the capital of northeastern Ituri province, the heart of the outbreak. They were demanding payment for wages owed, but were quickly dispersed by officials. The protesting workers included surveillance team members, who identify people exposed to infected patients. They waved placards saying, "No money, no data!" and "No payment for months."
paras.zh: 一些卫生工作者聚集在疫情爆发中心、东北部伊图里省首府布尼亚。他们要求支付所欠工资，但很快就被官员驱散。抗议工人包括监测小组成员，他们负责识别与感染患者接触过的人。他们挥舞着标语牌，上面写着：“没有钱，没有数据！”和“几个月没有付款”。

paras.en: Front-line workers have gone on strike several times since the outbreak began, further hampering efforts to contain the disease.
paras.zh: 自疫情爆发以来，一线工人已多次罢工，进一步阻碍了遏制疫情的努力。

paras.en: A senior UN official said that an Ebola-hit camp housing a transit centre for infected patients was burned by soldiers earlier this week as they were looking for weapons in Kigonze, on the outskirts of Bunia, forcing 19,000 people in the camp to flee.
paras.zh: 一名联合国高级官员表示，本周早些时候，士兵们在布尼亚郊区基贡泽寻找武器时烧毁了一个设有感染患者转运中心的埃博拉营地，迫使营地内的 19,000 人逃离。

paras.en: Julien Harneis, the UN senior Ebola co-ordinator, said creating Ebola transit and treatment centres has been a struggle, requiring money and staff, all of which are in short supply.
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉病毒高级协调员朱利安·哈内斯(Julien Harneis)表示，建立埃博拉转运和治疗中心是一项艰巨的任务，需要资金和人员，而这些都供不应求。

paras.en: "When we lose a centre, that means we lose capacity, we lose investment and we have to start again. And above all, it means that people do not get access to the care that they really need," Harneis said.
paras.zh: “当我们失去一个中心时，这意味着我们失去了能力，我们失去了投资，我们必须重新开始。最重要的是，这意味着人们无法获得他们真正需要的护理，”哈内斯说。

paras.en: Infected aid worker evacuated to Netherlands
paras.zh: 受感染的援助人员被疏散至荷兰

paras.en: An aid worker with Médecins Sans Frontières, known in English as Doctors Without Borders, was infected with Ebola while working in Congo, the group said in a statement.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织在一份声明中表示，该组织的一名救援人员在刚果工作期间感染了埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: The worker arrived late on Thursday night after being flown to the Netherlands on a special medical flight and was transferred to a high-level isolation unit, the Leiden University Medical Center said in a statement.
paras.zh: 莱顿大学医学中心在一份声明中称，这名工人乘坐特殊医疗航班飞往荷兰后于周四深夜抵达，并被转移到高级隔离病房。

paras.en: - Suspected Ebola case at Montreal hospital turns out to be a false alarm
paras.zh: - 蒙特利尔医院疑似埃博拉病例结果是虚惊一场

paras.en: - Video Ebola outbreak now deadliest in Congo’s history
paras.zh: - 视频 刚果历史上最致命的埃博拉疫情爆发

paras.en: "The human cost of this crisis is unprecedented in the DRC, with communities facing the largest Ebola disease outbreak ever recorded in the country," MSF said.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织表示：“这场危机在刚果民主共和国造成了前所未有的人员伤亡，社区面临着该国有史以来最大规模的埃博拉疫情。”

paras.en: More than 50 health workers have died after contracting the virus.
paras.zh: 超过 50 名卫生工作者感染病毒后死亡。

paras.en: Community resistance hampering containment efforts
paras.zh: 社区抵制阻碍了遏制工作

paras.en: The World Health Organization has recently raised the alarm about the virus's rapid spread into new health zones, stretching limited resources.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织最近对病毒迅速传播到新的卫生区发出了警告，导致有限的资源捉襟见肘。

paras.en: Africa CDC said in its latest news conference that the number of newly confirmed cases is falling, but that could be attributed to insecurity and challenges in getting communities to co-operate in some of the hot spots. While the spread of the disease has slowed down in some areas, it has accelerated in others, creating what experts see as a delicate situation.
paras.zh: 非洲疾病预防控制中心在最新的新闻发布会上表示，新确诊病例数量正在下降，但这可能归因于一些热点地区的不安全局势和社区合作方面的挑战。虽然这种疾病的传播在某些地区已经放缓，但在其他地区却在加速，造成了专家认为的微妙局面。

paras.en: - Video Moderna authorized to test vaccines to fight Ebola virus in Congo
paras.zh: - 视频 Moderna 获授权在刚果测试抗击埃博拉病毒的疫苗

paras.en: - Aid cuts have slowed fight to contain Ebola in central Africa, doctors say
paras.zh: - 医生称，援助削减减缓了中部非洲遏制埃博拉病毒的斗争

paras.en: Confirmed cases have slowed in recent weeks, from around 850 cases and 470 deaths a week in mid-July to an average of 490 cases and 230 deaths in September.
paras.zh: 最近几周确诊病例数有所放缓，从 7 月中旬的每周约 850 例病例和 470 例死亡病例减少到 9 月份的平均 490 例病例和 230 例死亡病例。

paras.en: A Congolese politician was attacked and beaten to death earlier this week for defending government measures in dealing with the outbreak, highlighting tensions that have stretched both the health community and local resources.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，一名刚果政客因捍卫政府应对疫情的措施而遭到袭击并被殴打致死，这突显了卫生界和当地资源捉襟见肘的紧张局势。

paras.en: The attack on Marie-Célestin Karondwa, a local official with Congo's ruling Union for Democracy and Social Progress party, took place on Sunday at his home in Butembo, an Ebola hot spot in eastern North Kivu province. His house was set on fire afterward, and he died at a hospital from his injuries.
paras.zh: 周日，刚果执政党民主与社会进步联盟当地官员玛丽-塞莱斯廷·卡隆杜瓦 (Marie-Célestin Karondwa) 在位于北基伍省东部埃博拉热点地区布滕博的家中遭到袭击。随后他的房子被纵火，他因伤在医院死亡。

paras.en: Widespread mistrust of health workers and the authorities has hampered efforts to slow the Central African nation's 17th Ebola outbreak.
paras.zh: 对卫生工作者和当局的广泛不信任阻碍了减缓这个中非国家第17次埃博拉疫情爆发的努力。

paras.en: Authorities last month launched a village-centred approach, but those efforts face resistance from residents who dismiss Ebola as a hoax. There is also deep distrust in the country's government for reasons ranging from how it's managed past Ebola outbreaks to chronic corruption.
paras.zh: 当局上个月推出了一项以村庄为中心的方法，但这些努力面临居民的抵制，他们认为埃博拉病毒是一场骗局。由于从过去埃博拉疫情的管理方式到长期腐败等原因，人们对该国政府也存在深深的不信任。

articles.title: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, including diesel, amid energy crunch

paras.en: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, including diesel, amid energy crunch
paras.zh: G7国家同意在能源紧缩之际释放1亿桶石油，包括柴油

paras.en: Move would start with 'substantial' diesel release within first 20 days
paras.zh: 此举将从前 20 天内“大量”释放柴油开始

paras.en: The G7 nations said they agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil, starting with "substantial" amounts of diesel, after the fuel recently hit record prices in the United States.
paras.zh: 七国集团国家表示，在美国燃油价格最近创下历史新高后，他们同意释放 1 亿桶石油，首先是“大量”柴油。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on social media the diesel release would happen "immediately," echoing a G7 promise to start immediately with a "frontloaded substantial release" of diesel within the next 20 days and the rest over four months.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上表示，柴油释放将“立即”进行，这呼应了七国集团的承诺，即立即开始在未来 20 天内“提前大量释放”柴油，其余时间将在四个月内进行。

paras.en: Trump and his Republican Party face pressure to address surging prices ahead of the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前，特朗普和他的共和党面临着解决物价飙升问题的压力。

paras.en: The president faces lagging approval ratings as the Iran war and his trade battles have increased U.S. prices for oil and other goods.
paras.zh: 由于伊朗战争和贸易战导致美国石油和其他商品价格上涨，总统面临着落后的支持率。

paras.en: Gas and diesel prices have soared during the eight-month-long war, a cost Trump has repeatedly said is worth it for making sure Iran does not obtain nuclear weapons. Trump has insisted prices will come down after the war, though there's no end in sight.
paras.zh: 在长达八个月的战争期间，天然气和柴油价格飙升，特朗普一再表示，为了确保伊朗不会获得核武器，这一成本是值得的。特朗普坚称战后物价将会下降，但目前还看不到结束的迹象。

paras.en: The average price of diesel in Canada was $2.63 per litre as of Thursday, though prices were higher in some cities, like Vancouver, where a litre of the fuel cost about $2.71. Heightened prices put pressure on transport truck drivers and farmers, who rely on diesel to run vehicles and equipment.
paras.zh: 截至周四，加拿大柴油平均价格为每升 2.63 美元，但温哥华等一些城市的价格较高，每升柴油价格约为 2.71 美元。价格上涨给依赖柴油驱动车辆和设备的运输卡车司机和农民带来了压力。

paras.en: France holds the rotating presidency of the G7 group and made the announcement in a statement released after videoconference talks that French President Emmanuel Macron presided over. The G7 countries are Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the U.K. and the U.S., plus EU representation.
paras.zh: 法国是七国集团轮值主席国，法国总统马克龙主持视频会议后发表声明宣布了这一消息。七国集团国家包括加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、日本、英国和美国，以及欧盟代表。

paras.en: The International Energy Agency will co-ordinate the effort to combat soaring fuel prices.
paras.zh: 国际能源署将协调努力遏制燃料价格飙升。

paras.en: "We will implement our commitments with a co-ordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels (MB) to begin immediately over 4 months, including a front-loaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“我们将履行我们的承诺，在 4 个月内立即开始通过 IEA 协调释放 1 亿桶 (MB)，其中包括七国集团成员和合作伙伴在前 20 天内预先释放大量柴油。”

paras.en: The release follows a March announcement that International Energy Agency member countries would release 426 million barrels of oil and products to stabilize the oil market.
paras.zh: 在此之前，国际能源署成员国3月份宣布将释放4.26亿桶石油和产品以稳定石油市场。

paras.en: The move also comes after Trump last week floated the idea of banning diesel exports in hopes of bringing down gas prices for American drivers — a move experts caution could backfire, putting strain on an already-stretched global fuel market and further raising prices globally.
paras.zh: 此前，特朗普上周提出禁止柴油出口，希望降低美国司机的汽油价格，专家警告此举可能适得其反，给本已紧张的全球燃料市场带来压力，并进一步抬高全球油价。

paras.en: But the G7 statement said the group, which includes the United States, also agreed not to limit energy exports to each other.
paras.zh: 但七国集团声明称，包括美国在内的七国集团也同意不限制相互之间的能源出口。

paras.en: "We reaffirm our commitment to refrain from export restrictions on energy and energy products between G7 countries and call on all producers to refrain from imposing bans that could exacerbate market tensions," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“我们重申承诺不对七国集团国家之间的能源和能源产品实施出口限制，并呼吁所有生产商不要实施可能加剧市场紧张局势的禁令。”

paras.en: Trump had a conversation overnight with Macron about the need to address rising fuel prices and the availability of petroleum products, according to the French Embassy in the U.S., before chairing the videoconference.
paras.zh: 据法国驻美国大使馆称，在主持视频会议之前，特朗普连夜与马克龙就解决燃油价格上涨和石油产品供应问题的必要性进行了交谈。

paras.en: A new AP-NORC poll found that a majority of U.S. adults blame Trump for higher prices, and approval on his handling of the economy hit a new low.
paras.zh: 美联社-NORC的一项新民意调查发现，大多数美国成年人将物价上涨归咎于特朗普，对他处理经济的支持率创下新低。

articles.title: Gypsy Rose Blanchard speaks out about death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker
articles.author: Helen Surgenor

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard speaks out about death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德 (Gypsy Rose Blanchard) 讲述她的前未婚夫肯·厄克 (Ken Urker) 的去世

paras.en: Urker, 34, was found unresponsive in his Louisiana home on his birthday
paras.zh: 34岁的厄克在生日当天被发现在路易斯安那州的家中失去了知觉

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard, who spent more than seven years in prison for her mother's murder, is speaking out after her former fiancé and the father of her daughter was found dead on Thursday.
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德因谋杀母亲而入狱七年多，在她的前未婚夫和女儿的父亲周四被发现死亡后，她发表了讲话。

paras.en: He was found unresponsive in his Raceland, La., home on Oct. 1, his birthday.
paras.zh: 10 月 1 日，也就是他的生日，他被发现在路易斯安那州雷斯兰的家中失去了知觉。

paras.en: The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Department told CBC News it is still investigating his death, and at this point in the investigation, it has found no evidence of foul play.
paras.zh: 拉福什教区治安部门告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，他们仍在调查他的死亡，目前调查尚未发现谋杀的证据。

paras.en: Blanchard, speaking exclusively to People and TMZ, said an unidentified substance was found at the scene, and she believes Urker died of an overdose. Police have not confirmed the cause of death.
paras.zh: 布兰查德在接受《人物》杂志和 TMZ 独家采访时表示，现场发现了一种不明物质，她认为厄克死于服药过量。警方尚未确认死因。

paras.en: "I don’t know if it was intentional or not," Blanchard told People. "He was not in a good state of mind lately."
paras.zh: “我不知道这是有意还是无意，”布兰查德告诉《人物》杂志。 “他最近精神状态不太好。”

paras.en: She also told the publication that Urker was the subject of intense scrutiny and cyber-bullying throughout their relationship.
paras.zh: 她还告诉该刊物，在他们的关系中，厄克一直受到严格审查和网络欺凌。

paras.en: "I believe the tremendous weight of that scrutiny and harassment had a profound impact on him, and I hope his passing serves as a reminder that there is a real person behind every screen, every headline and every comment," she told People.
paras.zh: 她告诉《人物》杂志：“我相信这种审查和骚扰的巨大影响对他产生了深远的影响，我希望他的去世能够提醒人们，每个屏幕、每个头条新闻和每条评论背后都有一个真实的人。”

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker connected in 2017, when he wrote to her in prison after watching the HBO Documentary Mommy Dead and Dearest.
paras.zh: 布兰查德和厄克于 2017 年结识，当时他在监狱里观看 HBO 纪录片《妈妈已死》后给她写信。

paras.en: The film explains how Blanchard's mother, Dee Dee, was believed to have factitious disorder imposed on another (FDIA) — formerly known as Munchausen syndrome by proxy — and for years allegedly forced her daughter to use a wheelchair and feeding tubes she didn't need.
paras.zh: 影片讲述了布兰查德的母亲迪迪 (Dee Dee) 被认为患有强迫症 (FDIA)——以前被称为代理孟乔森综合症 (Munchausen Syndrome)——并据称多年来强迫她的女儿使用轮椅和她不需要的喂食管。

paras.en: In her early 20's, Blanchard and then-boyfriend Nicholas Godejohn came up with a scheme to murder Dee Dee.
paras.zh: 20 岁出头时，布兰查德和当时的男友尼古拉斯·戈德约翰想出了一个谋杀迪迪的计划。

paras.en: Godejohn is serving a life sentence for first-degree murder.
paras.zh: 戈德约翰因一级谋杀罪被判无期徒刑，正在服刑。

paras.en: Gypsy Rose Blanchard pleaded guilty to second-degree murder, and was still incarcerated when Urker proposed to her in October 2018. They briefly called off their engagement, before reuniting in 2019.
paras.zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德 (Gypsy Rose Blanchard) 承认犯有二级谋杀罪，2018 年 10 月厄克向她求婚时，她仍被监禁。他们短暂取消了订婚，然后于 2019 年复合。

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker separated again for several years, during which time she married Ryan Anderson, and then publicly separated from him in December 2023, four months after she was released from prison.
paras.zh: 布兰查德和厄克再次分居数年，期间她与瑞安·安德森结婚，然后于 2023 年 12 月（即她出狱四个月后）公开与他分居。

paras.en: In June 2024, the docuseries Gypsy Rose: Life After Lock Up premiered on the Lifetime channel.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月，纪录片系列《吉普赛玫瑰：锁定之后的生活》在 Lifetime 频道首播。

paras.en: It followed Blanchard as she reintegrated into society, finalized her divorce from Ryan Anderson and rekindled her relationship with Urker.
paras.zh: 随后布兰查德重新融入社会，完成了与瑞安·安德森的离婚，并重新点燃了与厄克的关系。

paras.en: Blanchard and Urker had a baby together in December 2024, a daughter named Aurora Rain Urker.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月，布兰查德和厄克生下了一个孩子，女儿名叫奥罗拉·雷恩·厄克 (Aurora Rain Urker)。

paras.en: Following his death, Blanchard told People that Urker was a devoted parent and the love of her life.
paras.zh: 乌克去世后，布兰查德告诉《人物》杂志，乌克是一位慈爱的父母，也是她一生的挚爱。

paras.en: "Ken was an amazing father and a man who was deeply loved. He will forever be my soulmate and my red string, a connection that time, distance and even death can never erase."
paras.zh: “肯是一位了不起的父亲，也是一个深受爱的人。他将永远是我的灵魂伴侣和我的红线，一种时间、距离甚至死亡都无法抹去的联系。”

paras.en: Blanchard appeared on the We Need to Talk podcast in June of this year, where she talked about her tumultuous childhood, revisited the night her mother was killed and how she's trying to move past her dark history.
paras.zh: 今年六月，布兰查德出现在“我们需要谈谈”播客中，她在节目中谈到了自己动荡的童年，回顾了母亲被杀的那天晚上，以及她如何努力摆脱黑暗的历史。

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to one of Blanchard's former representatives for further comment.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系布兰查德的一位前代表寻求进一步评论。

articles.title: Argentina launches cash-for-citizenship scheme

paras.en: Argentina's government launched a scheme it hopes will attract wealthy investors and simultaneously "further strengthen the Argentine Republic's fiscal and financial position," offering people the chance to apply for citizenship via investment and thus bypass the more typical procedures.
paras.zh: 阿根廷政府推出了一项计划，希望能够吸引富有的投资者，同时“进一步加强阿根廷共和国的财政和金融地位”，为人们提供通过投资申请公民身份的机会，从而绕过更典型的程序。

paras.en: Economy Minister Luis Caputo and Cabinet chief Diego Santilli launched the citizenship-by-investment program amid the "Argentina Week" business event in Paris, saying it would start accepting applications during the fourth quarter of 2026.
paras.zh: 经济部长路易斯·卡普托和内阁首席迭戈·桑蒂利在巴黎“阿根廷周”商业活动期间启动了投资公民计划，称该计划将于 2026 年第四季度开始接受申请。

paras.en: "This announcement is part of Argentina's drive toward international openness and integration, accompanied by reforms aimed at strengthening the investment climate and attracting capital," the Economy Ministry said in a statement.
paras.zh: 经济部在一份声明中表示：“这一宣布是阿根廷推动国际开放和一体化的一部分，同时还进行了旨在加强投资环境和吸引资本的改革。”

paras.en: Argentina's President Javier Milei has tried to portray himself as a cost-cutting pro-business leader restoring stability to one of the world's most fragile economies, which has defaulted on or restructured parts of its national debt multiple times just this century. Its most recent emergency loans scheme from the IMF and World Bank was approved last April.
paras.zh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱试图将自己描绘成一位削减成本、支持商业的领导人，致力于恢复世界上最脆弱经济体之一的稳定，仅在本世纪，阿根廷就多次拖欠或重组部分国债。国际货币基金组织和世界银行最近的紧急贷款计划于去年四月获得批准。

paras.en: What are the details of the citizenship-by-investment program?
paras.zh: 投资公民计划的细节是什么？

paras.en: The program plans to offer "two simple and transparent mechanisms" to the primary investors seeking citizenship for themselves and perhaps for their immediate family.
paras.zh: 该计划计划为为自己及其直系亲属寻求公民身份的主要投资者提供“两种简单而透明的机制”。

paras.en: The first is "making a direct, non-refundable contribution of $350,000 (roughly €310,000) to the National Treasury," the Economy Ministry said. The other higher risk, higher reward approach will be "subscribing to a $800,000 public bond created specifically for this program."
paras.zh: 经济部表示，第一个是“向国家财政部直接、不可退还捐款 35 万美元（约合 31 万欧元）”。另一种风险较高、回报较高的方法是“认购专门为此计划创建的 80 万美元公共债券”。

paras.en: The principal applicant's spouse and children aged 25 or under can then also apply, albeit themselves having to pay smaller fees. Spouses and childless children aged 18-25 would be charged $100,000 each, and minors would have to contribute $25,000 each.
paras.zh: 主申请人的配偶和 25 岁或以下的子女也可以申请，尽管他们自己需要支付较少的费用。 18-25岁的配偶和无子女的儿童每人需缴纳10万美元，未成年人每人需缴纳25,000美元。

paras.en: "Under this scheme, a typical family unit consisting of a principal applicant, their spouse, and two minor children could apply for Argentine citizenship for a total of $500,000," the ministry said, referring to a sum equating to well over a century earning Argentina's nominal median wage.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“根据该计划，一个由主申请人、其配偶和两名未成年子女组成的典型家庭单位可以申请阿根廷公民身份，金额总计为 50 万美元。”该金额相当于一个多世纪以来阿根廷名义工资中位数的收入。

paras.en: Argentina said it would incorporate recommendations from the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) and the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) to ensure the adoption of international best practices and "comply with applicable standards regarding the prevention of money laundering, terrorist financing, and financial transparency."
paras.zh: 阿根廷表示，将采纳经济合作与发展组织（OECD）和金融行动特别工作组（FATF）的建议，以确保采用国际最佳实践，并“遵守有关防止洗钱、恐怖主义融资和金融透明度的适用标准”。

paras.en: "We continue working to strengthen Argentina's ties with the world, project the value of our citizenship internationally, and consolidate the country as an open and reliable nation," Economy Minister Caputo said online.
paras.zh: 经济部长卡普托在网上表示：“我们将继续努力加强阿根廷与世界的联系，在国际上体现我们公民的价值，并巩固该国作为一个开放和可靠的国家的地位。”

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Iran accused of blocking SIM cards, digital access to silence dissent

paras.en: In Iran, cell phone numbers are a key tool for digital identity verification and access to banking, judicial, administrative and insurance services, as well as many everyday activities.
paras.zh: 在伊朗，手机号码是数字身份验证和获得银行、司法、行政和保险服务以及许多日常活动的关键工具。

paras.en: As a result, disconnecting a SIM card can do more than block calls and text messages. It can also cut off access to a wide range of digital services.
paras.zh: 因此，断开 SIM 卡的连接不仅仅可以阻止通话和短信。它还可以切断对各种数字服务的访问。

paras.en: Some Iranians said the restrictions on their cell phones were accompanied by the blocking of user accounts and access to banking and government services. They said access was restored only after they deleted critical content or pledged to stop participating in protest-related activities.
paras.zh: 一些伊朗人表示，对他们手机的限制还伴随着用户账户以及银行和政府服务的封锁。他们表示，只有在删除关键内容或承诺停止参与抗议相关活动后，访问权限才会恢复。

paras.en: DW spoke to three people in Iran about the issue. They have used pseudonyms out of concern for their safety.
paras.zh: 德国之声采访了伊朗的三名人士，讨论了这个问题。出于对自身安全的考虑，他们使用了化名。

paras.en: Sina told DW that he realized his SIM card had been disconnected while returning from university and trying to book a taxi by phone.
paras.zh: 新浪告诉德国之声，他从大学回来并试图通过电话预订出租车时发现自己的SIM卡已断开。

paras.en: The 25-year-old said that after visiting a telecommunications center, he received a call from someone claiming to be from the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IO-IRGC), who instructed him to go to a specified location to have his SIM card reconnected.
paras.zh: 25岁的男子表示，在访问一家电信中心后，他接到自称是伊斯兰革命卫队情报组织（IO-IRGC）人员的电话，指示他前往指定地点重新连接SIM卡。

paras.en: Sina said he was interrogated for about six hours and that his mobile phone was confiscated.
paras.zh: 新浪称，他被审问了大约六个小时，手机被没收。

paras.en: He said the return of his SIM card and phone was made conditional on signing a pledge expressing "remorse" for his activist activities and online "propaganda against the system." He said he was also required to publish posts supporting the Islamic Republic to "prove his brotherhood with the system."
paras.zh: 他说，归还他的 SIM 卡和手机的条件是签署一份承诺书，表达对他的激进活动和网上“反体制宣传”的“悔恨”。他说，他还被要求发布支持伊斯兰共和国的帖子，以“证明他与该系统的兄弟情谊”。

paras.en: Several hours later, he said, his family discovered that posts on his Instagram account had been deleted. Only one remained, stating that "the activities of the page are in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran."
paras.zh: 他说，几个小时后，他的家人发现他 Instagram 帐户上的帖子已被删除。只剩下一条，称“该页面的活动符合伊朗伊斯兰共和国的法律”。

paras.en: A month later, he said, he had still not received his SIM card or mobile phone back and was unable to access his social media accounts.
paras.zh: 他说，一个月后，他仍然没有收到 SIM 卡或手机，也无法访问他的社交媒体帐户。

paras.en: Sorour, a 41-year-old translator at an official translation office in Tehran, said that after her SIM card was disconnected, she went to a location designated by the IO-IRGC, where she was interrogated for hours about her activities on Instagram and X.
paras.zh: 41 岁的苏鲁尔是德黑兰官方翻译办公室的一名翻译，她说，在她的 SIM 卡被拔掉后，她去了 IO-IRGC 指定的地点，在那里她被审问了几个小时，询问她在 Instagram 和 X 上的活动。

paras.en: Sorour said she was told to make her account private and pledge to refrain from activities critical of the authorities, including advocating for political prisoners, protesting executions and supporting demonstrators during nationwide anti-government protests that began in late December 2025.
paras.zh: 索鲁尔表示，她被告知将自己的账户设为私人账户，并承诺不参与批评当局的活动，包括为政治犯辩护、抗议处决以及在 2025 年 12 月下旬开始的全国反政府抗议活动中支持示威者。

paras.en: Mina, who lives in Isfahan, said she was summoned by an institution she identified as the IO-IRGC after posting a comment supporting one of the country's political currents under a post by a foreign-based news outlet.
paras.zh: 居住在伊斯法罕的米娜表示，她在一家外国新闻媒体的帖子下发表支持该国政治潮流的评论后，被一个她称为 IO-IRGC 的机构传唤。

paras.en: The 63-year-old said her SIM card and national identification card were blocked after she refused to comply with the summons.
paras.zh: 这位 63 岁的女士表示，在她拒绝遵守传票后，她的 SIM 卡和国民身份证被封锁。

paras.en: According to Mina, the restrictions disrupted her access to bank transfers, administrative systems, online purchases and services that require electronic identity verification and one-time passwords.
paras.zh: 米娜表示，这些限制扰乱了她对银行转账、管理系统、网上购物和需要电子身份验证和一次性密码的服务的访问。

paras.en: She told DW she had also been denied access to Sana, the judiciary's electronic system, and was therefore unable to determine whether a case or charges had been filed against her.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声，她也被拒绝访问司法机构的电子系统Sana，因此无法确定是否对她提出了案件或指控。

paras.en: SIM cards: the key to digital life in Iran
paras.zh: SIM 卡：伊朗数字生活的关键

paras.en: Several other Iranian citizens also posted similar complaints on social media.
paras.zh: 其他几名伊朗公民也在社交媒体上发表了类似的抱怨。

paras.en: Zia Nabavi, a former political prisoner, said in an Instagram post that his SIM card had been suddenly disconnected.
paras.zh: 前政治犯齐亚·纳巴维 (Zia Nabavi) 在 Instagram 上发帖称，他的 SIM 卡突然断开连接。

paras.en: He said he discovered the issue while at a doctor's office, where he needed access to his mobile phone and banking text messages.
paras.zh: 他说，他在医生办公室时发现了这个问题，当时他需要访问他的手机和银行短信。

paras.en: "For a long time, I have come to the conclusion that the government's policy toward critics and opponents is to apply pressure that pushes them toward obedience or withdrawing from their activities," Nabavi wrote.
paras.zh: 纳巴维写道：“长期以来，我得出的结论是，政府对批评者和反对者的政策是施加压力，迫使他们服从或退出活动。”

paras.en: Reyhaneh Saeedi, a physician and activist, also said on Instagram that her SIM card has been blocked for months and that this is the second time she has faced such restrictions.
paras.zh: 医生兼活动家 Reyhaneh Saeedi 也在 Instagram 上表示，她的 SIM 卡已被封锁数月，这是她第二次面临此类限制。

paras.en: She said the measure has effectively prevented her from practicing medicine, issuing prescriptions and renewing her Medical Council and medical office licenses.
paras.zh: 她说，这项措施有效地阻止了她行医、开具处方以及更新医疗委员会和医疗办公室执照。

paras.en: Saeedi said her identification card had also been deactivated. She added that no ruling had been formally served on her, she had not been informed of any charges or judicial proceedings, and her efforts to determine the reason for the restrictions had yielded no results.
paras.zh: 萨伊迪说，她的身份证也已被停用。她补充说，尚未对她正式做出任何裁决，她没有被告知任何指控或司法程序，她为确定限制原因所做的努力也没有取得任何结果。

paras.en: Actress Shaghayegh Dehghan said on Instagram that her SIM card had been blocked and that she did not know which institution or authority was behind the move.
paras.zh: 女演员 Shaghayegh Dehghan 在 Instagram 上表示，她的 SIM 卡已被封锁，她不知道是哪个机构或当局在幕后黑手。

paras.en: The disconnection of SIM cards and other digital restrictions has become part of a broader set of tools that the Islamic Republic has used over the past four decades to exert pressure on opponents, critics, journalists, and civil and human rights activists.
paras.zh: SIM卡的断开和其他数字限制已成为伊斯兰共和国在过去四十年中用来向反对者、批评者、记者以及公民和人权活动家施加压力的更广泛工具的一部分。

paras.en: The Defending Free Flow of Information (DeFFI) organization reported in 2025 that journalists and activists had their SIM cards blocked without judicial orders.
paras.zh: 捍卫信息自由流动 (DeFFI) 组织在 2025 年报告称，记者和活动人士的 SIM 卡在没有司法命令的情况下被封锁。

paras.en: The measures have raised concerns about the powers exercised by security institutions to deny citizens access to communication tools and essential services.
paras.zh: 这些措施引起了人们对安全机构行使权力拒绝公民使用通信工具和基本服务的担忧。

paras.en: They have also highlighted the absence of a clear accountability mechanism, leaving those affected with no obvious avenue to challenge the restrictions or seek an explanation.
paras.zh: 他们还强调，缺乏明确的问责机制，导致受影响的人没有明显的途径质疑这些限制或寻求解释。

paras.en: This article was originally published in Farsi
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于波斯语

articles.title: Spain's parliament rejects housing bill as protests continue

paras.en: Spain's parliament has narrowly voted down a pair of emergency government decrees aiming to quell widespread protests against rising rental costs for housing.
paras.zh: 西班牙议会以微弱优势否决了两项紧急政府法令，旨在平息针对住房租金成本上涨的广泛抗议。

paras.en: Hundreds of protesters were gathered outside the parliament in Madrid amid the marathon debate culminating in a pair of votes on Friday. They yelled "shame" and "your profits, our misery," as news of the measures being quashed filtered through.
paras.zh: 数百名抗议者聚集在马德里议会外，这场马拉松式的辩论在周五的两次投票中达到了顶峰。当这些措施被废除的消息传开时，他们大喊“耻辱”和“你的利润，我们的痛苦”。

paras.en: Spain has been gripped by protests for around a week, including a tent city set up in central Madrid, ignited by the eviction of an 87-year-old pensioner from her apartment that threw the more longstanding issue of unaffordable housing costs into sharp focus.
paras.zh: 西班牙已经持续了大约一周的抗议活动，其中包括在马德里市中心建立的一个帐篷城，起因是一名 87 岁的养老金领取者被驱逐出公寓，这使得长期存在的负担不起的住房费用问题成为人们关注的焦点。

paras.en: Why and how did the emergency decrees fail?
paras.zh: 紧急状态法令为何以及如何失败？

paras.en: Left-leaning Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez leads a minority government in Spain and so relies on opposition support to legislate.
paras.zh: 西班牙左倾总理佩德罗·桑切斯领导着一个少数派政府，因此立法依赖反对派的支持。

paras.en: Sanchez spoke at the close of a marathon 5-hour debate in the Chamber of Deputies ahead of the vote, urging members: "Do the right thing, or history will judge you, and sooner than you think."
paras.zh: 投票前，桑切斯在众议院进行了长达 5 个小时的马拉松式辩论，他在结束时发表讲话，敦促议员们：“做正确的事，否则历史将会审判你，而且比你想象的要早。”

paras.en: One Catalan party that sometimes supports Sanchez's government, the economically right-leaning Junts group, joined the opposition in voting down the measures.
paras.zh: 有时支持桑切斯政府的加泰罗尼亚政党——经济上右倾的“Junts”团体也加入了反对派的行列，投票否决了这些措施。

paras.en: The first emergency decree, which the government said would stop evictions of vulnerable people, make real estate speculation harder and provide tax incentives to encourage renting, failed by a narrow margin of 178-172.
paras.zh: 政府表示，第一项紧急法令将阻止对弱势群体的驱逐，加大房地产投机力度，并提供税收优惠以鼓励租房，但以 178 票对 172 票的微弱差距未能通过。

paras.en: The second decree, which sought to make residential leases automatically renewable by tenants, fell further short of a majority at 184-166.
paras.zh: 第二项法令旨在让租户自动续签住宅租约，但以 184 票对 166 票未能获得多数票。

paras.en: Opponents to the measures argued, among other things, that they risked compounding the situation by reducing housing supply.
paras.zh: 除其他外，这些措施的反对者认为，这些措施可能会减少住房供应，从而使情况变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Some also argued that Sanchez should respond to the deadlock by calling early elections, possibly initiating a wholesale change of government.
paras.zh: 一些人还认为，桑切斯应该通过提前举行选举来应对僵局，这可能会引发政府的大规模更迭。

paras.en: The Tenants' Union which had led protests across Spain said it would press on with plans for more mass rallies on Saturday, aiming to continue heaping pressure on the coalition and opposition alike.
paras.zh: 领导西班牙各地抗议活动的租客联盟表示，将继续推进周六举行更多大规模集会的计划，旨在继续向联盟和反对派施加压力。

paras.en: "The encampment will continue and will continue expanding to other neighborhoods," Tenants' Union spokesperson Alicia del Rio said. "We're aiming for a general strike."
paras.zh: 租户联盟发言人阿丽西娅·德尔·里奥（Alicia del Rio）表示：“营地将继续存在，并将继续扩展到其他社区。” “我们的目标是举行总罢工。”

paras.en: The current wave of protests, albeit concerning an issue that's been bubbling away near the surface for years, was triggered by the high-profile eviction of 87-year-old Madrid resident Maricarmen Abascal from the apartment she had occupied for almost all of her life.
paras.zh: 当前的抗议浪潮虽然涉及多年来一直浮出水面的问题，但其起因是 87 岁的马德里居民马里卡门·阿巴斯卡尔 (Marcarmen Abascal) 被高调驱逐出她几乎居住了一辈子的公寓。

paras.en: The investment company owning Abascal's building reversed the measure in her case this week but only after the issue had become a symbol of growing frustration of housing costs.
paras.zh: 拥有阿巴斯卡大楼的投资公司本周撤销了针对她的案件的措施，但只是在该问题成为住房成本日益沮丧的象征之后。

paras.en: Rents have roughly doubled in Spain in the last decade and young people, facing one of Europe's toughest labor markets for school-leavers and graduates, frequently live with their parents past the age of 30.
paras.zh: 过去十年，西班牙的房租大约翻了一番，而年轻人面临着欧洲最艰难的离校生和毕业生劳动力市场之一，30 岁以上的年轻人往往与父母住在一起。

paras.en: "People have said 'enough is enough;' this cannot go on. The housing problem must be resolved; structural measures must be taken, and this cannot continue," Abascal's lawyer, Beatriz Duro, said in an interview with Reuters on Thursday.
paras.zh: “人们常说‘受够了’；这种情况不能再继续下去了。住房问题必须解决；必须采取结构性措施，这种情况不能继续下去，”阿巴斯卡尔的律师比阿特丽斯·杜罗(Beatriz Duro)周四在接受路透社采访时表示。

paras.en: The next step after Friday's failed vote in parliament is difficult to identify. Sanchez has so far ruled out calling early elections. He could try to formulate another emergency decree or decrees in response to the protests, but any such move would need to overcome the same hurdles in parliament.
paras.zh: 周五议会投票失败后下一步的行动很难确定。桑切斯到目前为止已经排除了提前举行选举的可能性。他可以尝试制定另一项紧急法令或多项法令来应对抗议活动，但任何此类举措都需要克服议会中的相同障碍。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: US job growth slows as unemployment rises before midterm elections

paras.en: Job growth in the United States slowed in September, falling short of economists’ expectations as the unemployment rate rose in the final jobs report before the consequential midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国 9 月份就业增长放缓，低于经济学家的预期，因为中期选举前的最终就业报告中失业率上升。

paras.en: The US economy added 29,000 jobs in September, according to the Labor Department’s report released on Friday, far below economists’ expectations. Dow Jones had forecast 84,000 jobs, while economists polled by Reuters said they expected 90,000 job additions.
paras.zh: 美国劳工部周五发布的报告显示，9 月份美国经济新增 29,000 个就业岗位，远低于经济学家的预期。道琼斯预计将增加 84,000 个就业岗位，而接受路透社调查的经济学家表示，他们预计将增加 90,000 个就业岗位。

paras.en: The unemployment rate also rose by 0.1 percentage point, from 4.1 percent to 4.2 percent.
paras.zh: 失业率也上升了0.1个百分点，从4.1%升至4.2%。

paras.en: The healthcare sector led the gains, accounting for the majority of new jobs. The industry added 17,000 jobs, marking a slowdown from an average of 33,000 jobs per month over the past year. Construction added 11,000 jobs, while manufacturing added 9,000.
paras.zh: 医疗保健行业领涨，占新增就业岗位的大部分。该行业新增 17,000 个就业岗位，较去年平均每月 33,000 个就业岗位有所放缓。建筑业增加了 11,000 个就业岗位，而制造业则增加了 9,000 个就业岗位。

paras.en: Financial activities, which include sectors such as commercial banking and insurance, shed 7,000 jobs.
paras.zh: 金融活动（包括商业银行和保险等行业）减少了 7,000 个工作岗位。

paras.en: Most other sectors were largely unchanged, including retail, oil and gas extraction, and leisure and hospitality.
paras.zh: 大多数其他行业基本没有变化，包括零售、石油和天然气开采、休闲和酒店业。

paras.en: “Today’s disappointing report shows the labour market is grinding to a halt, marked by slow hiring and declining real wages that leave workers with very little leverage,” Kyle Moore, chief economist at the think tank The Century Foundation, said in remarks provided to Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 智库世纪基金会首席经济学家凯尔·摩尔在向半岛电视台提供的讲话中表示，“今天令人失望的报告显示，劳动力市场正在陷入停滞，其特点是招聘缓慢和实际工资下降，使工人的影响力微乎其微。”

paras.en: Previous jobs reports were also revised downward. July was revised from an initial gain of 21,000 jobs to a loss of 10,000 jobs. August was revised down by 29,000 jobs, from 162,000 to 133,000.
paras.zh: 此前的就业报告也被下调。 7月份的就业岗位从最初增加21,000个调整为减少10,000个。 8 月份就业岗位下调 29,000 个，从 162,000 个下调至 133,000 个。

paras.en: Wages grew by 3 percent, marking the slowest annual wage increase in five years.
paras.zh: 工资增长了3%，创下五年来最慢的年度工资增幅。

paras.en: Friday’s jobs report caps a week of weakening economic data before the consequential midterm election on November 3.
paras.zh: 周五的就业报告为 11 月 3 日中期选举之前一周疲软的经济数据画上句号。

paras.en: According to an AP-NORC poll released on Thursday, 61 percent of Americans polled said the US economy is worse off now than when Trump took office in January 2025.
paras.zh: 美联社-NORC 周四公布的民意调查显示，61% 的受访美国人表示，美国经济现在的状况比特朗普 2025 年 1 月上任时更糟糕。

paras.en: “When businesses are barely hiring and raises aren’t keeping up with rising prices, it’s a stalled economy – and working families are stuck in it,” Breyon Williams, chief economist for Groundwork Collaborative, an economic policy think tank, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 经济政策智囊团 Groundwork Collaborative 首席经济学家布雷永·威廉姆斯 (Breyon Williams) 在一份声明中表示：“当企业几乎不招聘员工，加薪跟不上物价上涨的步伐时，经济就会陷入停滞，工薪家庭就会陷入困境。”

paras.en: Trump has been trying to change the narrative on the slumping economy. On Monday, he said in a Truth Social post that “The United States has the BEST Employment Numbers in HISTORY.”
paras.zh: 特朗普一直试图改变人们对经济下滑的看法。周一，他在《真相社会》帖子中表示，“美国拥有历史上最好的就业数据。”

paras.en: On Tuesday, the US Labor Department released the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, or JOLTS report, which showed little change, suggesting what economists call a low-hire, low-fire environment. That means those who have jobs are generally not leaving for new ones, while employers are maintaining the status quo rather than expanding.
paras.zh: 周二，美国劳工部发布了职位空缺和劳动力流动率调查（JOLTS）报告，该报告几乎没有变化，这表明经济学家所说的低雇用、低解雇环境。这意味着那些有工作的人通常不会跳槽去寻找新的工作，而雇主则维持现状而不是扩张。

paras.en: On the other hand, ADP’s private payroll report, released on Wednesday, showed that 90,000 jobs were created across the private sector. The sheer number of layoffs fell, too, according to Challenger, Gray & Christmas. The report, released Thursday, showed that employers cut more than 43,000 jobs in September, marking an 18 percent decline in layoffs from August.
paras.zh: 另一方面，周三发布的 ADP 私营部门就业报告显示，私营部门创造了 9 万个就业岗位。 Challenger、Grey & Christmas 的数据显示，裁员数量也有所下降。周四发布的报告显示，9 月份雇主裁员超过 43,000 人，较 8 月份裁员人数减少 18%。

paras.en: Friday’s jobs report comes before the Federal Reserve’s final policy decision before the midterm election. During its two-day policy meeting on October 27-28, the central bank will decide whether to raise, cut or maintain interest rates.
paras.zh: 周五的就业报告发布之前，美联储将在中期选举前做出最终政策决定。在10月27日至28日为期两天的政策会议上，央行将决定是否加息、降息或维持利率不变。

paras.en: The odds increasingly suggest the Fed will hold rates steady in the 3.75-4.00 percent range, according to CME FedWatch, a tool that tracks the likelihood of monetary policy decisions. The FedWatch tool indicates there is currently a 77.3 percent chance that rates will hold steady, up from 35.8 percent this time last week.
paras.zh: 根据跟踪货币政策决策可能性的工具 CME FedWatch 的数据，越来越多的迹象表明美联储将利率稳定在 3.75-4.00% 的范围内。 FedWatch 工具显示，目前利率保持稳定的可能性为 77.3%，高于上周的 35.8%。

paras.en: US markets are trending upward on the heels of the report. The tech-heavy Nasdaq is up 1.5 percent, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 0.6 percent and the S&P 500 is up 1.1 percent in midday trading.
paras.zh: 报告发布后，美国市场呈上涨趋势。午盘交易中，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.6%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1.1%。

paras.en: The price of gold, which is largely considered a safe investment during times of economic uncertainty, rose 1.1 percent to $4,223.49 amid the jobs report.
paras.zh: 在经济不确定时期，金价在很大程度上被认为是一种安全投资，在就业报告发布后，金价上涨了 1.1%，至 4,223.49 美元。

articles.title: How the Banco Master scandal injected chaos into Brazil’s presidential race

paras.en: Sao Paulo, Brazil – It is one of the largest fraud scandals in modern Brazilian history. And experts say it may play a role in the nail-biter race unfolding for Brazil's presidency.
paras.zh: 巴西圣保罗——这是巴西现代历史上最大的欺诈丑闻之一。专家表示，这可能会在巴西总统大选的激烈角逐中发挥作用。

paras.en: On Sunday, Brazilian voters will head to the polls for the first round of the country's presidential vote.
paras.zh: 周日，巴西选民将前往投票站进行该国第一轮总统投票。

paras.en: Centre-left incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, 80, is currently the frontrunner. He is seeking an unprecedented fourth term, after previously leading the country from 2003 to 2011.
paras.zh: 80 岁的中左翼现任议员路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦 (Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva) 目前是领先者。继2003年至2011年领导国家之后，他正在寻求史无前例的第四个任期。

paras.en: His main challenger is far-right Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, 45, the eldest son of embattled former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year prison sentence for an alleged coup attempt.
paras.zh: 他的主要挑战者是 45 岁的极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗 (Flavio Bolsonaro)，他是陷入困境的前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 的长子，后者因涉嫌政变而被判 27 年徒刑，目前正在服刑。

paras.en: The two candidates are locked in a neck-and-neck race. But both have faced fallout from the Banco Master scandal, a sprawling financial scheme that has cast a shadow over Brazil's political sphere.
paras.zh: 两位候选人的竞争势均力敌。但两家公司都面临着 Banco Master 丑闻的影响，这一规模庞大的金融计划给巴西政治领域蒙上了阴影。

paras.en: “I get the sense that the bases of both of these candidacies are not that happy with how the campaigns have gone," said Anthony W Pereira, head of the Stone Center for Latin American Studies at Tulane University.
paras.zh: 杜兰大学斯通拉丁美洲研究中心主任安东尼·佩雷拉 (Anthony W Pereira) 表示：“我感觉到，这两位候选人的选民基础都对竞选活动的进展并不满意。”

paras.en: He pointed to the high levels of rejection Brazilian voters have expressed for both candidates.
paras.zh: 他指出，巴西选民对两位候选人都表示强烈反对。

paras.en: In late September, the pollster Quaest found that 56 percent of respondents said they would refuse to vote for Bolsonaro. About 54 percent said the same about Lula.
paras.zh: 9月下旬，民意调查机构Quaest发现，56%的受访者表示他们将拒绝投票给博尔索纳罗。大约 54% 的人对卢拉也有同样的看法。

paras.en: “Rates of rejection are really high for both candidates. That helps explain why mobilisation and enthusiasm are fairly low,” Pereira said.
paras.zh: “两位候选人的拒绝率都非常高。这有助于解释为什么动员和热情相当低，”佩雷拉说。

paras.en: One factor in the widespread disillusionment has been the Banco Master scandal. The financial imbroglio has delivered a black eye to both ends of Brazil's political spectrum.
paras.zh: 造成普遍失望的因素之一是“Banco Master”丑闻。金融纠纷给巴西政治光谱的两端都带来了伤害。

paras.en: A range of business leaders, political figures, regulators and judges have been swept up in the scandal.
paras.zh: 一系列商界领袖、政治人物、监管者和法官都卷入了这起丑闻。

paras.en: A mid-sized lender, Banco Master grew aggressively over the last decade by selling high-yield deposit certificates. Some of those certificates offered returns of up to 140 percent relative to Brazil’s benchmark interbank rate.
paras.zh: 作为一家中型银行，Banco Master 在过去十年中通过销售高收益存款证实现了积极发展。相对于巴西基准银行同业拆借利率，其中一些证书的回报率高达 140%。

paras.en: But Banco Master did not have the assets needed to sustain that output.
paras.zh: 但 Banco Master 没有维持这一产出所需的资产。

paras.en: It lacked the money to pay back its risky loans, and what assets it did have were diverted to shell accounts, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检察官称，该公司缺乏资金偿还高风险贷款，其拥有的资产也被转移到空壳账户。

paras.en: Brazil's Central Bank ultimately liquidated Banco Master in 2025, as the lender faced a major funding squeeze.
paras.zh: 由于 Banco Master 面临严重的资金紧缩，巴西央行最终于 2025 年清算了该银行。

paras.en: Its owner, Daniel Vorcaro, was subsequently arrested, accused of an array of financial crimes, including money laundering and fraud.
paras.zh: 其所有者丹尼尔·沃卡罗随后被捕，被指控犯有一系列金融犯罪，包括洗钱和欺诈。

paras.en: The collapse of Banco Master triggered a nearly $7.7bn payout from Brazil's Credit Guarantee Fund, the largest disbursement in the nonprofit insurance's history.
paras.zh: Banco Master 的倒闭引发了巴西信用担保基金近 77 亿美元的支出，这是该非营利保险历史上最大的一笔支出。

paras.en: Investigators have suggested that Vorcaro protected his fraud scheme by cultivating influence among power brokers among Brazil's elite.
paras.zh: 调查人员表示，沃卡罗通过在巴西精英的权力掮客中培养影响力来保护他的欺诈计划。

paras.en: Among those implicated in the scandal is Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the presidential candidate.
paras.zh: 卷入丑闻的人包括总统候选人、参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: Last month, the Supreme Court unsealed documents showing he is under investigation for alleged corruption and money laundering in connection with Vorcaro.
paras.zh: 上个月，最高法院公布的文件显示，他因涉嫌与沃卡罗有关的腐败和洗钱而接受调查。

paras.en: Audio recordings have also surfaced, appearing to show Bolsonaro soliciting the disgraced bank leader for millions in funding. The money was slated as financing for Dark Horse, a film about his imprisoned father, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 录音也浮出水面，似乎显示博尔索纳罗向这位名誉扫地的银行领导人寻求数百万美元的资金。这笔钱将用于资助《黑马》，这是一部关于他被监禁的父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗的电影。

paras.en: Flavio Bolsonaro has denied any wrongdoing. He described the interaction as a private sponsorship opportunity, unrelated to the Banco Master scandal.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗否认有任何不当行为。他将这次互动描述为私人赞助机会，与万事达银行丑闻无关。

paras.en: But while Bolsonaro appears to have direct ties to the scandal, polling suggests that left-wing campaigns like Lula's may suffer more.
paras.zh: 尽管博尔索纳罗似乎与丑闻有直接关系，但民意调查显示，像卢拉这样的左翼竞选活动可能会遭受更多损失。

paras.en: In September, the polling institute Datafolha released a survey that found 34 percent of respondents associated the Banco Master scandal more with left-wing politicians than with any other kind of political leaning.
paras.zh: 9 月，民意调查机构 Datafolha 发布了一项调查，发现 34% 的受访者将 Banco Master 丑闻更多地与左翼政客联系在一起，而不是与任何其他政治倾向联系在一起。

paras.en: Only 27 percent believed it involved more right-wing politicians.
paras.zh: 只有 27% 的人认为其中涉及更多右翼政客。

paras.en: Another 13 percent associated the scandal with politicians of all stripes, and 16 percent said they did not know how to answer the question.
paras.zh: 另外 13% 的受访者将丑闻与各种政治人物联系起来，16% 的受访者表示他们不知道如何回答这个问题。

paras.en: Leonardo Paz, a political scientist at the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV), a think tank, said that Brazilian media shares part of the blame for the public's perception of the scandal.
paras.zh: 智库热图利奥·巴尔加斯基金会（FGV）的政治学家莱昂纳多·帕斯表示，巴西媒体对公众对丑闻的看法负有部分责任。

paras.en: “Make no mistake, this is a corruption scandal that predominantly involves the right," Paz said.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，这是一起主要涉及右翼的腐败丑闻，”帕斯说。

paras.en: He argues that the news coverage created a false equivalency between Lula's involvement and Bolsonaro's.
paras.zh: 他认为新闻报道将卢拉的参与与博尔索纳罗的参与错误地等同起来。

paras.en: “Flavio’s up to his neck in this scandal, but the press’s need to come across as impartial has ended up generating this inaccurate perception that the Master case affects everyone equally,” Paz explained.
paras.zh: 帕斯解释说：“弗拉维奥在这起丑闻中已经竭尽全力，但媒体需要表现出公正，最终导致了一种不准确的看法，即马斯特案对每个人的影响都是平等的。”

paras.en: Lula has not been directly linked to the Banco Master scandal.
paras.zh: 卢拉与万事达银行丑闻没有直接关系。

paras.en: But revelations have emerged regarding Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, a frequent target of right-wing criticism.
paras.zh: 但最高法院法官亚历山大·德·莫赖斯 (Alexandre de Moraes) 的丑闻已经曝光，他是右翼批评的经常目标。

paras.en: Earlier this year, a rival justice released a document purporting to show Vorcaro composing messages to de Moraes, in some cases asking for legal advice.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，一位竞争对手法官发布了一份文件，据称显示沃卡罗正在给德莫赖斯撰写信息，在某些情况下还寻求法律建议。

paras.en: De Moraes has denied exchanging any messages with the banker. He has also called the accusations an "incriminating farce for political and electoral purposes".
paras.zh: 德莫赖斯否认与银行家交换过任何信息。他还称这些指控是“出于政治和选举目的的有罪闹剧”。

paras.en: The justice was appointed to the court in 2017, under then-President Michel Temer, a centre-right figure. But in recent years, de Moraes played an instrumental role in blocking Jair Bolsonaro's attempts to overturn his defeat to Lula in the 2022 election.
paras.zh: 这位法官于 2017 年在时任总统米歇尔·特梅尔（中右翼人物）的领导下被任命为最高法院法官。但近年来，德莫赖斯在阻止雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗试图扭转其在 2022 年大选中输给卢拉的企图方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: De Moraes ultimately oversaw the criminal case that landed the elder Bolsonaro in prison. Bolsonaro's right-wing allies have called that case a political "witch hunt", accusing de Moraes of being beholden to Lula.
paras.zh: 德莫赖斯最终监督了这起导致老博尔索纳罗入狱的刑事案件。博尔索纳罗的右翼盟友称此案为政治“政治迫害”，指责德莫赖斯受制于卢拉。

paras.en: "Anyone voting for Lula is voting for Alexandre de Moraes," Flavio Bolsonaro said on the campaign trail this year.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在今年的竞选活动中表示：“任何投票给卢拉的人都是投票给亚历山大·德莫赖斯。”

paras.en: Pereira, the Latin American studies director at Tulane, explained that some members of the public have conflated Lula and de Moraes as a result of the prosecution.
paras.zh: 杜兰大学拉丁美洲研究主任佩雷拉解释说，由于起诉，一些公众将卢拉和德莫赖斯混为一谈。

paras.en: Flavio Bolsonaro has successfully leveraged that perception, Pereira added.
paras.zh: 佩雷拉补充说，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗成功地利用了这种看法。

paras.en: “Flavio is far more implicated [in the Banco Master scandal], but he’s gotten lucky,” he said. “Some lazily assume that Alexandre de Moraes is more or less the same as Lula, so it becomes a wash.”
paras.zh: “弗拉维奥（在 Banco Master 丑闻中）受到的牵连要大得多，但他很幸运，”他说。 “有些人懒惰地认为亚历山大·德·莫赖斯或多或少与卢拉相同，所以这就成了一种洗礼。”

paras.en: With Brazil's presidential race expected to be tight, experts warn that even small fluctuations in voter intent could affect the outcome.
paras.zh: 由于巴西总统竞选预计将非常激烈，专家警告说，即使选民意愿的微小波动也可能会影响结果。

paras.en: Neither Bolsonaro nor Lula is expected to cross the 50-percent threshold needed to avoid a run-off on October 25.
paras.zh: 预计博尔索纳罗和卢拉都不会超过避免 10 月 25 日决选所需的 50% 门槛。

paras.en: Jorge Chaloub, a political scientist at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, said the race may ultimately come down to the voters currently backing other candidates.
paras.zh: 里约热内卢联邦大学政治学家豪尔赫·夏洛布表示，这场竞选最终可能取决于目前支持其他候选人的选民。

paras.en: Also in the running are self-help author Augusto Cury and right-wing figures Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos and Romeu Zema.
paras.zh: 参与竞选的还有自助作家奥古斯托·库里和右翼人物罗纳尔多·卡亚多、雷南·桑托斯和罗梅乌·泽马。

paras.en: Combined, they are polling at a little more than 10 percent support. Their second-round endorsements could end up deciding the election, according to Chaloub.
paras.zh: 综合来看，他们的支持率略高于 10%。查洛布表示，他们的第二轮支持可能最终决定选举结果。

paras.en: “Ideologically, the other candidates are more to the right, and you’d expect them to side with Flavio," Chaloub said.
paras.zh: “从意识形态上讲，其他候选人更偏右，你会期望他们站在弗拉维奥一边，”查洛布说。

paras.en: But, he added, the scandal-plagued race has been volatile so far. Chaloub warned that voters looking for right-wing alternatives may not ultimately side with Bolsonaro, should a run-off occur.
paras.zh: 但他补充说，迄今为止，丑闻缠身的竞选一直不稳定。查洛布警告说，如果发生决选，寻求右翼替代方案的选民最终可能不会站在博尔索纳罗一边。

paras.en: “There’s a reason that those voters didn’t choose Flavio Bolsonaro in the first place," he said.
paras.zh: “这些选民一开始没有选择弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗是有原因的，”他说。

articles.title: ‘I want the truth’: NY governor appoints prosecutor in Cornell rape case

paras.en: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed state Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor to investigate an alleged gang rape at Cornell University, saying newly released information had undermined her confidence in the local prosecutor’s handling of the case.
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）任命州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯（Letitia James）为特别检察官，负责调查康奈尔大学涉嫌轮奸案，称新发布的信息削弱了她对当地检察官处理此案的信心。

paras.en: In a news conference on Friday, Hochul said that the woman who reported the alleged assault had been failed by institutions responsible for protecting her, including Cornell University Police and the Tompkins County district attorney’s office.
paras.zh: 在周五的新闻发布会上，霍楚尔表示，负责保护她的机构（包括康奈尔大学警察局和汤普金斯县地方检察官办公室）未能履行举报涉嫌性侵事件的妇女的职责。

paras.en: “In what world does the district attorney not even interview her, or anyone else involved, or even request the full transcript?” Hochul asked at the news conference. “And I want the truth. I think every parent in this state, every New Yorker wants the truth in this case.”
paras.zh: “在哪个世界里，地方检察官甚至不采访她或其他相关人员，甚至不要求提供完整的笔录？”霍楚尔在新闻发布会上问道。 “我想要真相。我认为这个州的每一位家长、每一位纽约人都希望了解这起案件的真相。”

paras.en: Hochul signed an executive order on Thursday requiring the attorney general to investigate the alleged October 2024 assault. If warranted, evidence will be presented to a grand jury and the case prosecuted.
paras.zh: Hochul 于周四签署了一项行政命令，要求司法部长调查涉嫌 2024 年 10 月的袭击事件。如果有必要，证据将提交给大陪审团并对案件进行起诉。

paras.en: The order states the Tompkins County district attorney declined to prosecute the case in November 2024 without speaking to the woman and relied, at least in part, on information from a Cornell police statement that omitted her assertion that she had been sexually assaulted.
paras.zh: 该命令称，汤普金斯县地方检察官在 2024 年 11 月未与该女子交谈的情况下拒绝起诉此案，并至少部分依赖康奈尔警方声明中的信息，该声明忽略了她关于自己遭到性侵犯的说法。

paras.en: The appointment of James means the state attorney general’s office, rather than the county district attorney, will now control the criminal investigation.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯的任命意味着州总检察长办公室，而不是县地方检察官，现在将控制刑事调查。

paras.en: Prosecutors initially closed the case without criminal charges in 2024. Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten reopened the investigation on Monday, after the woman filed a civil lawsuit accusing seven members of the Chi Phi fraternity of sexually assaulting her.
paras.zh: 检察官最初于 2024 年在没有提出刑事指控的情况下结案。汤普金斯县地方检察官 Matthew Van Houten 于周一重新启动调查，此前该女子提起民事诉讼，指控七名 Chi Phi 兄弟会成员对她进行性侵犯。

paras.en: Van Houten has defended his original decision, saying in a September 28 statement that prosecutors reviewed a six-page sworn statement the woman gave Cornell police in November 2024.
paras.zh: Van Houten 为自己最初的决定进行了辩护，他在 9 月 28 日的一份声明中表示，检察官审查了该女子于 2024 年 11 月向康奈尔警方提交的一份长达六页的宣誓声明。

paras.en: He said the statement did not allege that she had been drugged against her will, and described her participation in sexual conduct as voluntary and consensual. He said multiple prosecutors and investigators reviewed the statement and concluded that, as presented, the facts did not establish a crime under New York law.
paras.zh: 他说，声明并未指控她在违背自己意愿的情况下被下药，并称她参与性行为是自愿和双方同意的。他说，多名检察官和调查人员审查了这份声明，得出的结论是，根据纽约法律，事实并未构成犯罪。

paras.en: The governor, however, said the full account given to police was not conveyed to prosecutors. She cited reports that the woman told investigators she was “100% confident” she had been raped.
paras.zh: 不过，州长表示，向警方提供的完整叙述并未转交给检察官。她援引报道称，该女子告诉调查人员，她“100%确信”自己被强奸了。

paras.en: Cornell has said its police department provided prosecutors with the evidence it had gathered, including a Snapchat screenshot, and that the university separately investigated the allegations through its disciplinary process. Cornell said sanctions imposed after that process included expulsions and suspensions.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学表示，其警察部门向检察官提供了收集到的证据，包括 Snapchat 截图，并且该大学通过纪律程序单独调查了这些指控。康奈尔大学表示，该程序之后实施的制裁包括开除和停职。

paras.en: Cornell has also said it is conducting an independent review of how it handled the allegations.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学还表示，正在对其如何处理这些指控进行独立审查。

paras.en: The Cornell case has renewed debate over New York’s definition of incapacity to consent. Under current state law, a person is considered “mentally incapacitated” when drugs or alcohol are given to someone without consent.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的案件重新引发了关于纽约州对无能力同意的定义的争论。根据现行州法律，未经同意向某人提供毒品或酒精的人被视为“精神上无行为能力”。

paras.en: A state bill introduced in June would extend the provision to cases in which a victim voluntarily consumed alcohol or drugs but became so intoxicated that they were temporarily unable to control their conduct, if the accused knew or reasonably should have known of the victim’s condition.
paras.zh: 6月份提出的一项州法案将把这一规定扩大到受害者自愿饮酒或吸毒但因醉酒而暂时无法控制自己行为的案件，前提是被告知道或理应知道受害者的状况。

paras.en: The legislation has gained renewed attention following the Cornell allegations. Lawmakers said on Thursday that the case highlighted what they described as a gap in the state’s current law.
paras.zh: 在康奈尔大学提出指控后，该立法再次受到关注。立法者周四表示，此案凸显了他们所说的该州现行法律的漏洞。

paras.en: “If someone is too intoxicated to consent, it should not matter whether they chose to use drugs or alcohol,” Hochul said at Friday’s news conference. “Voluntary intoxication is not a licence for sexual assault or gang rape, period.”
paras.zh: 霍楚尔在周五的新闻发布会上说：“如果有人喝得酩酊大醉而无法同意，那么他们选择吸毒还是酗酒都无关紧要。” “自愿中毒并不是性侵犯或轮奸的许可。”

paras.en: Lindsey Boylan, a New York City Council candidate and the first woman to accuse former Governor Andrew Cuomo of sexual harassment publicly, said Hochul should use the moment to push for broader legislative change.
paras.zh: 纽约市议会候选人、第一位公开指控前州长安德鲁·科莫性骚扰的女性林赛·博伊兰表示，霍赫尔应该利用这个机会推动更广泛的立法改革。

paras.en: “I expect to see her follow through with not just supporting the independent investigation, but also changing the state laws,” Boylan said. “That is what I’m expecting her to do now, and I think that is what every survivor is expecting her to do now.”
paras.zh: 博伊兰说：“我希望看到她不仅支持独立调查，而且还会改变州法律。” “这就是我期望她现在做的事情，我认为这也是每个幸存者现在期望她做的事情。”

articles.title: Pro-democracy activists increasingly vulnerable to authoritarian governments in Southeast Asia
articles.author: Shibani Mahtani

paras.en: Pro-democracy activists increasingly vulnerable to authoritarian governments in Southeast Asia
paras.zh: 民主活动人士越来越容易受到东南亚独裁政府的攻击

paras.en: Last month, 26-year old Laotian activist Khieo Lapchanh disappeared on his way to his apartment in a Thai province just outside Bangkok. He didn't show up for his registration interview with the United Nations Refugee Agency in Bangkok the next day, and hasn't been heard from since, according to a human rights group tracking his case.
paras.zh: 上个月，26 岁的老挝活动家 Khieo Lapchanh 在前往位于曼谷郊外的泰国省份的公寓的途中失踪。据追踪他案件的人权组织称，他第二天没有出席曼谷联合国难民署的登记面谈，此后就再也没有音讯。

paras.en: Days later, Australian democracy campaigner Tran Hiep, who was in Cambodia to meet with other activists of Vietnamese origin, similarly disappeared. Tran Hiep was due to meet his wife in Bangkok but never boarded his flight. This week, Vietnamese officials confirmed his arrest and that of the two other activists who were with him.
paras.zh: 几天后，正在柬埔寨与其他越南裔活动人士会面的澳大利亚民主活动人士陈协同样失踪。陈协原计划在曼谷与妻子见面，但他从未登机。本周，越南官员证实了他和与他在一起的另外两名活动人士的被捕。

paras.en: "My husband entered Cambodia legally, and now he's gone missing and it appears [he's] in a Vietnamese prison somewhere," said Chloe Dang, Hiep's wife. "How can the Vietnamese government abduct someone on another country's land?"
paras.zh: “我的丈夫合法进入柬埔寨，但现在他失踪了，看来他在越南某处监狱里，”希普的妻子克洛伊·邓 (Chloe Dang) 说。 “越南政府怎么能在别国的土地上绑架人呢？”

paras.en: Their cases underscore the precarious landscape for activists across Asia, who are increasingly vulnerable to transnational repression – hunted down by authoritarian governments even across international borders. Human rights groups have been warning of a "swap market" of repression in Southeast Asia, where governments in the region work together to intimidate, arrest, extradite and punish critics and refugees.
paras.zh: 他们的案件突显了亚洲各地活动人士面临的不稳定局面，他们越来越容易受到跨国镇压——甚至跨国界遭到独裁政府的追捕。人权组织一直警告东南亚存在镇压的“互换市场”，该地区各国政府共同努力恐吓、逮捕、引渡和惩罚批评者和难民。

paras.en: "Everyone has to be looking over their shoulder all the time," said Phil Robertson, director of Bangkok-based Asia Human Rights & Labour Advocates, who has tracked and advocated for victims of transnational repression for almost two decades.
paras.zh: 总部位于曼谷的亚洲人权与劳工倡导者协会主任菲尔·罗伯逊（Phil Robertson）表示：“每个人都必须时刻保持警惕。”近二十年来，他一直在追踪跨国镇压的受害者并为其提供支持。

paras.en: In recent years, Cambodian opposition leaders say they have been surveilled and jailed in Thailand, once a refuge for asylum seekers. Laotian refugees in the country – verified and registered by the United Nations – have gone missing or been found dead.
paras.zh: 近年来，柬埔寨反对派领导人表示，他们在曾经是寻求庇护者避难所的泰国受到监视和监禁。经联合国核实和登记的该国老挝难民已经失踪或被发现死亡。

paras.en: Viet Tan, a pro-democracy group composed of members of the Vietnamese diaspora, published a report in September that documented 20 cases where Vietnamese authorities pursued critics and activists outside its own borders. These include blogger Duong Van Thai, who in April 2023 disappeared off the streets of Bangkok before showing up in detention in Vietnam. Thai, who was a U.N.-registered refugee seeking asylum, has since been sentenced to 12 years in prison.
paras.zh: 由海外越南人组成的民主组织 Viet Tan 在 9 月发表了一份报告，记录了越南当局在境外追捕批评者和活动人士的 20 起案件。其中包括博主 Duong Van Thai，他于 2023 年 4 月在曼谷街头失踪，随后在越南被拘留。 Thai 是一名在联合国登记寻求庇护的难民，现已被判处 12 年监禁。

paras.en: "You'd expect there would be some larger outcry because what we're talking about is violation of refugee rights [and] of state sovereignty," said Robertson. But countries in the region have been "muted."
paras.zh: 罗伯逊说：“你会预料到会有更大的抗议，因为我们谈论的是侵犯难民权利和国家主权。”但该地区国家却“保持沉默”。

paras.en: "It seems to almost be like: if you do something in my country… later I'll expect a favor from you," a trade where dissidents are mutually suppressed, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，“这似乎几乎是这样的：如果你在我的国家做某事……以后我会期待你的帮助，”这是一种持不同政见者相互压制的行业。

paras.en: Thailand's Ministry of Information and a spokesman for the Cambodian government did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The Manushya Foundation, a human rights group that has previously assisted other Laotian asylum seekers, reported Khieo Lapchanh's disappearance to the Thai police.
paras.zh: 泰国新闻部和柬埔寨政府发言人没有立即回应置评请求。此前曾协助其他老挝寻求庇护者的人权组织马努什亚基金会(Manushya Foundation)向泰国警方报告了Khieo Lapchanh的失踪。

paras.en: The Office of the High Commissioner for Refugees, in a statement to NPR, said it does not comment on individual cases. It added that "states have the primary responsibility to provide protection and safety to persons on their territory, including refugees and asylum seekers and people whose lives could be at risk if they were returned."
paras.zh: 难民事务高级专员办事处在给全国公共广播电台的一份声明中表示，不会对个别案件发表评论。它补充说，“各国负有为其领土上的人员提供保护和安全的主要责任，包括难民和寻求庇护者以及如果被遣返可能面临生命危险的人。”

paras.en: Hiep, now 50, had moved to Australia more than three decades ago, said Dang, his wife. He lived in Melbourne, where he founded an advocacy organization focused on combating human trafficking of Vietnamese girls and women. The freelance IT professional was also passionate about free speech, Dang said, and helped those in the Vietnamese diaspora improve their digital security against the authoritarian state. They were texting about commonplace topics – issues with their fridge, preparing for Hiep's niece's birthday party – when he stopped replying on Sept. 18.
paras.zh: 现年 50 岁的 Hiep 的妻子 Dang 说，三十多年前就搬到了澳大利亚。他住在墨尔本，在那里创立了一个倡导组织，专注于打击越南女孩和妇女的人口贩运。邓说，这位自由 IT 专业人士还热衷于言论自由，并帮助越南侨民提高他们的数字安全，以对抗独裁国家。他们正在发短信讨论一些常见的话题——冰箱问题、为希普侄女的生日聚会做准备——当他在 9 月 18 日停止回复时。

paras.en: Viet Tan, the pro-democracy group, said Hiep was one of their members. So was Nguyen Duc Thuan, who disappeared from Cambodia along with Hiep on the same day. Thuan holds a Norwegian passport.
paras.zh: 亲民主组织 Viet Tan 表示，希普是他们的成员之一。 Nguyen Duc Thuan 也是如此，他与 Hiep 于同一天从柬埔寨失踪。 Thuan 持有挪威护照。

paras.en: Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security said in a statement this week that it had arrested Hiep, Thuan and a third man, Thai Cong Truong Son, for trying to "cross illegally" from Cambodia into Vietnam. They've accused the three of terrorism and forging their identity documents. The Vietnamese government has designated Viet Tan as a "terrorist group," a charge the group denies.
paras.zh: 越南公安部本周在一份声明中表示，已逮捕了 Hiep、Thuan 和第三名男子 Thai Cong Truong Son，罪名是试图从柬埔寨“非法越境”进入越南。他们指控三人犯有恐怖主义罪并伪造身份证件。越南政府已将 Viet Tan 列为“恐怖组织”，但该组织否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Authorities have not specified where they are held and their families say they have been provided no information. The activists have not been granted consular access.
paras.zh: 当局没有具体说明他们被关押的地点，他们的家人表示没有向他们提供任何信息。这些活动人士尚未获得领事探访权。

paras.en: Dang has called for the Australian government to fight for Hiep's freedom, given he's a citizen of their country. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Vietnamese President To Lam met in Canberra last month, pledging to deepen their partnership on issues like defense and trade. Albanese, in comments to the media this week, said his government was providing consular assistance and engaging directly with the family.
paras.zh: 邓呼吁澳大利亚政府为希普的自由而战，因为他是澳大利亚公民。越南总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞和越南国家主席苏林上个月在堪培拉会面，承诺深化双方在国防和贸易等问题上的伙伴关系。阿尔巴内斯本周在向媒体发表评论时表示，他的政府正在提供领事协助并直接与家人接触。

paras.en: "I'm not naive to say that I don't know [what the Vietnamese government can do]," Dang said. "But I hope as an Australian, his fate could be different."
paras.zh: “我不天真地说我不知道​​[越南政府能做什么]，”邓说。 “但我希望作为一名澳大利亚人，他的命运可能有所不同。”

articles.title: Cornell rape case gets special prosecutor. And, Renee Good's family sues the government
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Cornell rape case gets special prosecutor. And, Renee Good's family sues the government
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学强奸案由特别检察官负责。而且，蕾妮·古德的家人起诉政府

paras.en: A Cornell University sexual assault case that produced no criminal charges is now under state scrutiny. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed Attorney General Letitia James' office as special prosecutor after new information raised questions about what campus police shared with the local district attorney. NPR confirmed the woman who reported the assault gave police a detailed account, including that she had been raped.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的一起性侵犯案没有提出刑事指控，目前正在接受国家审查。纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）任命总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯（Letitia James）办公室为特别检察官，因为新的信息引发了人们对校园警察与当地地方检察官分享的信息提出质疑。美国国家公共广播电台证实，报告这起袭击事件的妇女向警方提供了详细的叙述，包括她被强奸的情况。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Brian Mann tells Up First the case has shattered students' trust in Cornell. Hundreds gathered Thursday night, some sobbing as they spoke. One student told Mann the woman at the center of the case "could have been any one of my friends or a classmate."
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的布莱恩·曼 (Brian Mann) 告诉 Up First，此案粉碎了学生对康奈尔大学的信任。周四晚上，数百人聚集在一起，一些人在讲话时哭泣。一名学生告诉曼，案件中心的女性“可能是我的任何一个朋友或同学”。

paras.en: Tennessee tried to execute Christa Pike on Wednesday. She survived. Pike, who was sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of Colleen Slemmer, remains in critical condition after receiving two doses of the lethal injection drug pentobarbital. Gov. Bill Lee has now paused executions for the remainder of his term and ordered an independent review of what went wrong.
paras.zh: 田纳西州周三试图处决克里斯塔·派克。她活了下来。派克因 1995 年谋杀科琳·斯莱默而被判处死刑，在接受两剂注射死刑药物戊巴比妥后，仍处于危急状态。州长比尔·李现已在其剩余任期内暂停执行死刑，并下令对问题所在进行独立审查。

paras.en: - 🎧 It's the second failed execution in Tennessee this year. WPLN's Marianna Bacallao says that one failed execution might be a fluke, but two suggest a pattern. Lee previously paused executions from 2022 to 2025 after a review found problems with the state's execution drugs. The current protocol grew out of that review, but the state is again investigating what went wrong.
paras.zh: - 🎧 这是今年田纳西州第二起失败的处决事件。 WPLN 的玛丽安娜·巴卡劳 (Marianna Bacallao) 表示，一次执行失败可能是侥幸，但两次执行失败表明了一种模式。此前，在审查发现该州的处决药物存在问题后，李明博暂停了 2022 年至 2025 年的处决。目前的协议是在该审查的基础上制定的，但该州正在再次调查出了什么问题。

paras.en: The monthly jobs report will be released this morning. For many Americans, the math is getting harder: prices are up, wages aren't keeping pace and borrowing costs more.
paras.zh: 月度就业报告将于今天上午发布。对于许多美国人来说，计算变得越来越困难：物价上涨，工资跟不上，借贷成本上升。

paras.en: - 🎧 Forecasters expect today's report to show that employers added 80,000 to 90,000 jobs in September, NPR's Scott Horsley says. That would be slower than August but stronger than earlier in the summer. Horsley says wage growth is another key measure, and pay increases aren't keeping pace with prices.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Scott Horsley 表示，预测者预计今天的报告将显示雇主在 9 月份增加了 80,000 至 90,000 个工作岗位。这将比八月慢，但比夏季早些时候更强。霍斯利表示，工资增长是另一个关键指标，但工资增长并没有跟上物价上涨的步伐。

paras.en: Renee Good's family filed two civil lawsuits against the federal government yesterday over her death last January. The 37-year-old was fatally shot by a federal agent during an immigration enforcement operation in Minnesota. The first lawsuit alleges ICE officer Jonathan Ross used excessive force. The second alleges that federal officials conspired to interfere with the civil rights of individuals in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 蕾妮·古德 (Renee Good) 的家人昨天就她去年一月的死亡向联邦政府提起了两起民事诉讼。这名 37 岁的男子在明尼苏达州的一次移民执法行动中被一名联邦特工开枪打死。第一起诉讼指控 ICE 官员乔纳森·罗斯过度使用武力。第二项指控称，联邦官员合谋干涉明尼苏达州个人的公民权利。

paras.en: NAZA features 24 anonymous Israeli intelligence officers and soldiers describing the surveillance and targeting systems they used in Israel's war in Gaza – including AI — and the civilian deaths they say those systems allowed. Palestinian and international journalists have long documented that toll; the film brings testimony from inside the Israeli military system. Its title loosely translates to "collateral damage." The film turns that abstraction back into human lives. NAZA opens in U.S. theaters this week after winning praise abroad, while in Israel it has drawn protests, accusations of treason and threats to revoke the filmmakers' citizenship.
paras.zh: NAZA 报道了 24 名匿名以色列情报官员和士兵，他们描述了他们在以色列加沙战争中使用的监视和瞄准系统（包括人工智能），以及他们所说的这些系统造成的平民死亡。巴勒斯坦和国际记者早已记录了这一事件。这部电影带来了以色列军事系统内部的证词。它的标题大致可以翻译为“附带损害”。这部电影将这种抽象重新带回到人类的生活中。 《娜扎》在海外赢得好评后，本周在美国影院上映，但在以色列却引发了抗议、叛国罪指控以及取消电影制片人公民身份的威胁。

paras.en: 🎧 Morning Edition's Leila Fadel speaks with filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor about what they learned and the backlash that followed. Listen to the full interview here.
paras.zh: 🎧 早间版的莱拉·法德尔 (Leila Fadel) 与电影制作人尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 谈论了他们学到的东西以及随之而来的强烈反对。在这里收听完整的采访。

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.en: 🍿 Movies: Forgotten Island follows childhood friends Jo and Raissa, who are unexpectedly transported to a magical island just before they are about to part ways.
paras.zh: 🍿 电影：被遗忘的岛屿讲述了儿时好友乔和瑞莎的故事，他们在即将分别之前意外地被传送到了一座神奇的岛屿。

paras.en: 📺 TV: The Spanish-language miniseries My Sad Dead follows an Argentinian doctor who can communicate with ghosts. Fresh Air critic John Powers describes it as a unique blend of creepiness, sarcastic humor and political anger, unlike anything else on TV.
paras.zh: 📺 电视：西班牙语迷你剧《我的悲伤死者》讲述了一位可以与鬼魂沟通的阿根廷医生的故事。 《新鲜空气》评论家约翰·鲍尔斯将其描述为一种令人毛骨悚然、讽刺幽默和政治愤怒的独特融合，与电视上的其他任何内容不同。

paras.en: 📚 Books: Min Jin Lee's American Hagwon is the third installment in a planned four-novel series about the Korean diaspora. It explores the complexities of immigration, the fragile promise of America and the purpose of education.
paras.zh: 📚 书籍：李敏珍（Min Jin Lee）的《美国哈格文》（American Hagwon）是计划中的关于韩国侨民的四本小说系列的第三部分。它探讨了移民的复杂性、美国脆弱的承诺以及教育的目的。

paras.en: 🎵 Music: Now in her 60s, singer-songwriter Sheryl Crow says she has aged out of pop music. She describes her latest album, Pick You Up, as exploring questions many of us ask about our identity at this moment in humanity.
paras.zh: 🎵 音乐：现年 60 多岁的歌手兼作曲家谢丽尔·克劳 (Sheryl Crow) 表示，她已经不再适合流行音乐了。她将她的最新专辑《Pick You Up》描述为探索我们许多人在此时此刻对我们的人类身份提出的问题。

paras.en: ❓ Quiz: Bears, Beyoncé, and colleges. This week's news features a mix of serious headlines and lighter moments. Test your memory with this week's quiz.
paras.zh: ❓ 测验：熊、碧昂丝和大学。本周的新闻既有严肃的头条新闻，也有轻松的时刻。通过本周的测验测试您的记忆力。

paras.en: - SpaceX launched four astronauts on NASA's Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station for a six-month stay before returning to Earth.
paras.zh: - SpaceX 在 NASA 的 Crew-13 任务中将四名宇航员发射到国际空间站，在返回地球之前停留六个月。

paras.en: - Google launched a refrigerator-sized satellite equipped with AI chips as part of Project Suncatcher, its effort to put AI data centers in space.
paras.zh: - 谷歌发射了一颗冰箱大小的卫星，配备了人工智能芯片，作为“阳光捕手计划”的一部分，该计划旨在将人工智能数据中心放入太空。

paras.en: - The Pearly Kings were once a fixture of East London, raising money in their mother-of-pearl suits. Now, NPR looks back at George Major, who died in August, and the tradition he helped carry on.
paras.zh: - 珍珠国王队曾经是东伦敦的常客，他们穿着珍珠母贝套装筹集资金。现在，美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 回顾了八月份去世的乔治·梅杰 (George Major)，以及他帮助延续的传统。

articles.title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
articles.author: Justin Chang

paras.en: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
paras.zh: 匿名的以色列士兵描述了“NAZA”中大规模屠杀平民的事件

paras.en: For most of the shattering and damning new documentary NAZA, we are on a series of rooftops in Tel Aviv, watching the Israeli journalist Yuval Abraham conduct one-on-one interviews with Israeli soldiers and intelligence personnel.
paras.zh: 在这部令人震惊、令人震惊的新纪录片《NAZA》中，我们在特拉维夫的一系列屋顶上观看以色列记者尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕对以色列士兵和情报人员进行一对一的采访。

paras.en: The rooftop footage was filmed at night, mostly by Abraham's co-director, Rachel Szor, and their interview subjects — 24 of them in total — are all cloaked in darkness. We're told that their appearances and voices have been digitally altered to protect their anonymity. In precise detail, they speak about their role in launching the airstrikes that have killed tens of thousands of Palestinian civilians in Gaza since the Hamas-led attacks in Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, when around 1,200 people were killed and 250 hostages were taken.
paras.zh: 屋顶的镜头是在晚上拍摄的，主要由亚伯拉罕的联合导演雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 拍摄，他们的采访对象（总共 24 人）都笼罩在黑暗中。我们被告知，他们的外表和声音已被数字化修改以保护他们的匿名性。他们详细讲述了自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以色列以来，他们在发动空袭中所扮演的角色，空袭造成加沙数万名巴勒斯坦平民死亡，当时约 1,200 人死亡，250 名人质被劫持。

paras.en: Unsurprisingly, NAZA has already stirred considerable outrage — much of it, it should be noted, from people who haven't seen and maybe never will see it. Abraham and Szor, both Israeli filmmakers, have been denounced as traitors in Israel, and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu himself has threatened to revoke their citizenship. The anonymization of sources has been one of the more contested issues; Israel supporters have said it discredits the soldiers' testimony, while Palestine supporters have criticized the film for shielding self-confessed war criminals.
paras.zh: 毫不奇怪，NAZA 已经激起了相当大的愤怒——值得注意的是，其中大部分来自那些没有看过、也许永远不会看到它的人。以色列电影制片人亚伯拉罕和索尔被谴责为以色列叛徒，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡本人也威胁要取消他们的公民身份。消息来源的匿名化一直是最具争议的问题之一。以色列支持者表示，这部电影抹黑了士兵的证词，而巴勒斯坦支持者则批评这部电影包庇自首的战犯。

paras.en: Without the promise of anonymity, of course, NAZA as a film wouldn't exist. But the reporting that it presents would exist. Much of it has already been published in outlets including +972 Magazine, an Israeli-Palestinian publication; Local Call, a Hebrew-language outlet; and The Guardian, which co-produced the film. Abraham wrote many of those investigative pieces himself; he's also credited the many Palestinian journalists who brought these revelations to light.
paras.zh: 当然，如果没有匿名的承诺，《娜扎》这部电影就不会存在。但它所呈现的报告将会存在。其中大部分内容已在包括以色列-巴勒斯坦出版物+972 杂志在内的媒体上发表。 Local Call，希伯来语渠道；和《卫报》联合制作了这部电影。亚伯拉罕自己写了许多这样的调查文章。他还赞扬了许多揭露这些真相的巴勒斯坦记者。

paras.en: The testimony is riveting. Some of the interview subjects speak about how they were motivated to help the Israeli military annihilate Hamas after Oct. 7. Some express guilt and regret for their involvement. Others see themselves as cogs in a necessary war machine. But for the most part, the filmmakers are less interested in the questions of why than in the mechanics of how. They want us to understand how these systems of remote surveillance and mass killing work, and to grasp the horrific scale of the civilian deaths.
paras.zh: 证词引人入胜。一些采访对象谈到了 10 月 7 日之后他们是如何被激励去帮助以色列军队消灭哈马斯的。一些人对自己的参与表示内疚和遗憾。其他人则将自己视为必要战争机器中的齿轮。但在大多数情况下，电影制片人对“为什么”的问题更感兴趣，而不是“如何”的机制。他们希望我们了解这些远程监视和大规模杀戮系统是如何运作的，并了解平民死亡的可怕规模。

paras.en: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi, Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the estimated number of civilian casualties considered acceptable by the Israeli military. "Twenty NAZA" would mean that up to 20 civilian deaths were approved in the elimination of a single target. For one high-value target, a figure of 500 NAZA was approved — the population of a small Israeli town, Abraham notes.
paras.zh: NAZA 是 nezek agavi 的缩写，希伯来语的意思是“附带损害”。它指的是以色列军方认为可以接受的估计平民伤亡人数。 “20 NAZA”意味着在消除单个目标时批准最多造成 20 名平民死亡。亚伯拉罕指出，对于一个高价值目标，批准了 500 NAZA 的数字——以色列小镇的人口。

paras.en: The logistics of trackings and killings are calmly and methodically laid out. Because the military can hack into any Palestinian's phone in Gaza, their power of surveillance is near-total. We learn about the military's practice of bombing the homes of suspected Hamas operatives at night, while their wives and children were with them. We also hear about the widespread use of AI systems to gather intelligence, much of it faulty, about potential targets.
paras.zh: 追踪和杀戮的后勤安排是冷静而有条不紊的。由于军方可以侵入加沙任何巴勒斯坦人的手机，因此他们的监视能力几乎是全面的。我们了解到，军方在夜间轰炸疑似哈马斯特工的家，而他们的妻子和孩子都在他们身边。我们还听说人工智能系统被广泛使用来收集有关潜在目标的情报，但其中大部分都是错误的。

paras.en: One of the most chilling passages describes a tracking technology referred to as "Where's Daddy?," which uses children's words to confirm whether their targeted fathers are at home. One soldier talks about having used this method on a 12-year-old girl, saying, "You hack her phone and then you kill her." At one point, Abraham asks a subject if Israel is committing a genocide. Without hesitating, he responds, "Yes. Completely." As the film notes, more than 73,000 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since Oct. 7 — and the death toll continues to rise.
paras.zh: 最令人毛骨悚然的段落之一描述了一种名为“爸爸在哪里？”的跟踪技术，该技术使用孩子们的话语来确认他们的目标父亲是否在家。一名士兵谈到对一名 12 岁女孩使用这种方法时说：“你黑了她的手机，然后杀了她。”有一次，亚伯拉罕问一个主题，以色列是否正在实施种族灭绝。他毫不犹豫地回答：“是的。完全正确。”正如影片所述，自 10 月 7 日以来，已有超过 73,000 名巴勒斯坦人在加沙被杀，而且死亡人数还在继续上升。

paras.en: I've watched NAZA twice now, both times in a state of quiet horror and fury — and with enormous admiration for Abraham and Szor's courage in holding their government to account. My admiration extends to the unerring precision of their filmmaking. NAZA runs just 77 minutes. It doesn't linger on the atrocities it describes, mainly because there are so many of them to address. There's some archival material, including footage from the early days of Israeli intelligence and the building of Tel Aviv in the 1920s.
paras.zh: 我现在已经看了两遍《纳扎》了，两次都是在一种安静的恐惧和愤怒的状态下进行的——并且对亚伯拉罕和索尔追究政府责任的勇气充满了极大的钦佩。我的钦佩还体现在他们电影制作的精准无误。 NAZA 运行时间仅为 77 分钟。它没有停留在它所描述的暴行上，主要是因为有太多的暴行需要解决。有一些档案材料，包括以色列情报部门早期和 20 年代特拉维夫建筑的镜头。

paras.en: But most of the imagery we see is of modern-day Tel Aviv at night. Szor's camera captures the glittering lights of the city and often peers into apartment windows, showing us Israeli citizens working out, eating meals and watching the news. There's tremendous power — and, I think, a stealthy indictment — in these everyday images.
